jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Enterprise | US | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the US and Canada.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Enterprise is our composable observability platform focused on large-scale operators with security and regulatory requirements who need to self-operate their observability solutions. Grafana Enterprise features are also part of our Grafana Cloud service. Grafana Cloud is an integrated suite of observability applications offered as a service. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software, including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, and Tempo, without the overhead of installing, maintaining, and scaling their own observability stack.

The Grafana Enterprise team is a diverse team of expert technologists working remotely from around the globe. The team focuses on innovative solutions to large-scale customer challenges and developing solutions that improve security, robustness, flexibility, multitenancy, and interoperability on behalf of our customers. We work across the larger Grafana Labs organisation and directly with external customers, including major cloud service providers and global enterprises running observability and build infrastructure at massive scale, to solve their most demanding distributed systems challenges. Our customers include software engineers, site reliability engineers, and platform operators at medium, large, and global enterprises.

As a company we are remote-only and global; we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. Our meetings tend to happen between 14:00 and 17:00 UTC, but we are flexible and responsive to the needs of our engineers and our customers. We measure ourselves by our openness, helpfulness, and our shared successes.

We are looking for experienced software engineers who are passionate about distributed systems and building reliable, scalable backend infrastructure to join our growing team. Our backend is Go, and we build tools for people operating some of the world's largest observability and software delivery stacks. Backend Engineers at Grafana also contribute to open source communities.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Earning the trust of our large-scale operator customers to further Grafana's "big tent" philosophy of data accessibility and to meet clear business objectives
  • Designing and leading the development of backend services, distributed systems, and enterprise features at scale
  • Driving continuous improvement of our engineering culture through words and actions
  • Driving projects from initial ideation through the development lifecycle to production
  • Contributing to the scalability, reliability, security, and multi-tenancy of the Grafana platform trusted by some of the world's largest operators
  • Owning the operational health of our platform by participating in weekday 12h x 5d and separate weekend 24h x 2d on-call rotations. (Yes, we prioritize ops load reduction.)
  • Hiring and developing the best engineers to build the future of Grafana
  • Developing your skills as a thought leader to drive continuous improvement of engineering and operational practices across Grafana Labs
  • As we are remote-first, we provide guidance and meet regularly using video calls, so strong teamwork and excellent written and interpersonal communication skills are a must.

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards.

You’ll also have access to frontier models (e.g., GPT-Codex 5/3, Claude Opus 4.7, Gemini 3 Pro).

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • You work well as a communicative member of a team of engineering professionals.
  • You earn trust by saying what you mean and doing what you say.
  • You are customer focused and especially attuned to the needs of large-scale operators who rely on Grafana as critical infrastructure. You start with their needs and work backwards.
  • You insist on the highest standards and work to develop the skills and knowledge of your fellow team members.
  • You take on complex distributed systems challenges, break them down into digestible problems, and leverage your team and organization to deliver.
  • You design modular solutions, deliver minimum loveable products, gather data and feedback, and then progress iteratively.

What will you be doing? (Role specifics)

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you will design and build the backend systems powering Grafana Enterprise — the platform trusted by the world's largest operators to run their observability and software delivery infrastructure.

  • Hiring and developing the best engineers we can to deliver the future of Observability.
  • Architecting and implementing distributed backend services in Go, with a focus on correctness, observability, and performance at scale
  • Designing APIs and service contracts used by thousands of enterprise operators and cloud service providers
  • Collaborating with Product and UX to shape features and partnering with frontend engineers to ship complete, end-to-end solutions
  • Driving scalability and reliability improvements that matter to large-scale operators running Grafana in regulated, high-availability environments
  • Engaging directly with large enterprise customers and cloud service providers to understand their requirements and translate them into robust engineering solutions
  • Advocating for our customers at every stage of the development lifecycle

What technical competencies are we looking for?

  • Deep professional experience writing production services, from ideation through to production operations at scale
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals: replication, consistency models, partitioning, fault tolerance, and the trade-offs that come with operating at scale
  • Demonstrated experience designing and operating systems for large-scale, high-traffic, high-availability, or multi-tenant environments, ideally in the context of infrastructure, observability, or software delivery platforms
  • Professional experience building and consuming gRPC/protobuf APIs and designing clean service contracts across service boundaries
  • Strong database skills, such as PostgreSQL and/or MySQL; including schema design, query optimisation, and schema migrations at scale
  • Experience with large-scale CI/CD systems and build tooling, designing, operating, or integrating with continuous delivery pipelines that serve large engineering organisations or external operators at scale
  • Comfort working with Kubernetes and containerised deployment environments, including patterns for operating stateful workloads and multi-tenant clusters
  • Experience with observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing
  • Familiarity with dependency injection patterns (e.g., Google Wire) and clean, testable service architecture

What are your "nice to have" technical competencies?

  • Experience with TypeScript and React for contributing to frontend features and collaborating closely with frontend engineers
  • Experience with Grafana's LGTM+ observability stack (Loki, Mimir, Tempo, Pyroscope, Alloy)
  • Prior experience at or building for large-scale cloud service providers, IaaS providers, or global enterprises with demanding SLA requirements
  • Experience designing or operating large-scale build infrastructure artifact registries, distributed build caches, hermetic build systems (e.g., Bazel), or developer platform tooling

In the United States, the compensation range for this role is $174,986 - $209,983 USD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The video and audio interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment**


Essential Job Functions:

  • Respond to video and audio interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Participate in online, video and audio training sessions.
  • Deliver interpretation services via video and expediently type data on a dedicated device, such as a laptop, desktop computer, mobile phone, or tablet, in order to perform the essential functions of the job.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the video and audio interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during video and audio interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during scheduled work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inPolish and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States.
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages – highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**

    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
What is Reach Financial?

Reach Financial is a FinTech platform helping people outsmart debt for good.

We are building innovative products and best-in-class support that enable our customers to take control of their debt and de-mystify their personal finances. Our products and tools empower our customers to turn their financial goals into a reality.

Reach Financial launched in 2015 and has helped our customers pay off over $1 billion in debt. We offer debt consolidation loans and personal loans; together, these markets represent a $1.5T opportunity. In time, we will expand beyond these products to offer solutions for a variety of our customers' personal finance challenges.

We are a fast-growing and fast-paced FinTech startup with the stability of an established firm. You will have a front-row seat at a rapidly growing company innovating the FinTech industry.

About the role

As a Senior Data Engineer at Reach, you’ll work alongside our existing Data Engineering team on our data platform modernization effort. You’ll be a key contributor to our broader data practice, building and maintaining pipelines, data models, and transformations as we modernize Reach’s data stack. You’ll help establish scalable, reliable, and consistent data engineering practices across the organization, ushering in a new era of cohesive data design and management within the broader Engineering organization.

What you'll do

  • Develop and manage data pipelines, data models, schemas, and data artifacts as a core contributor to our data squad.
  • Champion data engineering best practices, including data quality, version control, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Data, Software, and Platform Engineers to evolve and improve existing engineering practices, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Partner with data scientists, analysts, stakeholders, and cross-functional data teams across the organization to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Stay up to date on emerging data engineering tools and technologies, and help evaluate new solutions to optimize our data ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineers to ensure seamless integration and deployment of data pipelines using shared CI/CD tools and Infrastructure as Code solutions, such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, proactively identifying and resolving issues to ensure data quality, reliability, and availability.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for data pipelines, data models, and engineering processes.

What you should have

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, working with dbt (Core or Cloud), Snowflake, Fivetran, Amazon RDS, PostgreSQL, etc
  • Strong proficiency in dbt development best practices and coding conventions, with hands-on experience designing and implementing Medallion data architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers) in a production environment.
  • Extensive knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar platforms
  • Experience implementing automated data quality checks, dbt testing, and data validation frameworks
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based version control, and automated deployment processes for data engineering workflows
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing Snowflake performance, dbt models, SQL queries, and data warehouse costs
  • Production experience working with and managing a Snowflake deployment
  • Experience extracting information from SaaS systems like Salesforce using ETL tools like FiveTran
  • Production experience using dbt Cloud or other source-driven transformation management tools
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and Database Change Management tooling
  • Experience with operational database management, including backup, recovery, tuning, data modeling, scaling
  • Demonstrated experience with Python, Java, Scala, or similar languages
  • Must be self-motivated, focused, and highly committed to delivering value
  • Must be a collaborative team player with strong communication skills, a willingness to share knowledge, and the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.

Nice to haves

  • Experience preparing data for analysis in Tableau or other BI tools
  • Experience with Tableau CRM Analytics Data Pipelines
  • Experience with Sigma Computing
  • Experience with Fivetran Activations
  • Experience working in the Financial Services industry and familiarity with working in a SOC2 and PCI-DSS environment.

What is it like working at Reach Financial?

Our culture is built around advancing our teams, and we are dedicated to the success and growth of every team member. We believe in retaining a high-performing workforce and we prioritize diversity, intellectual curiosity, and continued learning. Our generous benefits packages reflect that.

We’ve been hard at work perfecting our product for years, and now we’re growing faster than ever before. Our strong foundation and company culture is readily equipped for this growth, and we believe that with the right people, our products will continue to help customers make real changes in their financial lives.

What benefits will you receive?

  • Healthcare, Life Insurance, 401k Match
  • Paid Time Off, Paid 12-week Parental Leave
  • Disability (short-term, long-term), Employee Assistance Program
  • Spending Accounts (Transit/Parking, Medical, Dependent Care)
  • Insurance Discounts (home, auto, pet)

Overview

Overview:

We are looking for a self-directed BI Analyst to join our growing HealthEdge Business Intelligence team. In this role you will own the end-to-end design and delivery of business intelligence dashboards in Tableau and Amazon QuickSight, working in close partnership with internal HealthEdge stakeholders to turn data into clear, actionable insight.

You will collaborate daily with our onshore and offshore data engineers, who build and maintain the AWS-based lakehouse and analytics-ready data sources you will consume. Your focus is on the analytical and visual layer: understanding what business teams need to decide, modeling the data into intuitive dashboards, and delivering a polished, usable experience that holds up to executive and operational scrutiny.

The ideal candidate operates independently, has strong opinions about usability and visual design, and is relentless about working efficiently — shipping high-quality dashboards quickly and iterating with users rather than disappearing for weeks at a time.

Core Responsibilities

Dashboard Design and Development

  • Build, publish, and maintain Tableau and Amazon QuickSight dashboards that serve internal HealthEdge operational and executive audiences.
  • Translate business questions into well-modeled QuickSight datasets and Tableau data sources, applying appropriate joins, calculated fields, parameters, and filters.
  • Apply strong visual design principles — clear hierarchy, intentional use of color, consistent layout, and accessible typography — so dashboards are immediately usable by their intended audience.
  • Optimize dashboard performance, evaluating SPICE vs. Direct Query in QuickSight and live vs. extract connections in Tableau, and managing refresh schedules.
  • Maintain a clean, well-organized portfolio of published assets across both BI platforms, retiring stale content rather than letting it accumulate.

Stakeholder Partnership and Insight Delivery

  • Engage directly with internal business stakeholders across the organization to understand the decisions they need to make and what evidence would change those decisions.
  • Distill findings into clear narratives and recommendations; package insights so non-technical stakeholders can act on them without translation.
  • Maintain lightweight documentation describing what each dashboard answers, what it does not, and who owns the underlying data.

Collaboration with Data Engineering

  • Partner with onshore and offshore data engineers to define and refine the analytics-ready data sources that power dashboards.
  • Write your own SQL for ad-hoc analysis, prototyping, and data validation; surface gaps, quality issues, or modeling changes back to the data engineering team.
  • Help prioritize the data engineering backlog by clearly articulating which new data, columns, or refresh frequencies are needed to unlock business value.

Quality, Iteration, and Continuous Improvement

  • Validate dashboard numbers against source systems and surface discrepancies promptly.
  • Monitor usage and gather feedback from end users; retire or rework dashboards that are not earning their place.
  • Identify and propose opportunities to consolidate redundant reports, improve refresh cadence, or migrate legacy Tableau or Excel content into QuickSight (or vice versa) as the platform strategy evolves.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional experience building production BI dashboards in Tableau, Amazon QuickSight, Power BI, Looker, or comparable modern BI tooling — with at least one tool used at deep, hands-on proficiency.

jobs.title: Developer Relations Engineer
jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

Tailscale is looking for a Developer Relations Engineer to own and improve the developer experience across Tailscale’s expanding product portfolio. You’ll help developers understand, adopt, extend, and build with our core VPN/connectivity product, while also shaping how that experience evolves as Tailscale expands into new product areas like secure AI access (Aperture), privileged access management (PAM), and whatever comes next.

You’re a builder, investigator, and storyteller. You write code, chase technical curiosities all the way down, and turn what you learn into things other developers can use like demos, docs, talks, blog posts, sample apps, workshops, videos, tools, and open source contributions. You build things, break things, explain things, and keep going until the thing you’re working on has a name.

You’re comfortable speaking at conferences and just as comfortable digging through an API, a GitHub issue, or a weird networking edge case until it makes sense. You’re probably the kind of person who runs a local AI model in your homelab and can explain exactly why. You ask “why does it work that way?” often, and your instinct is to make the answer clearer, simpler, and better for the next developer.

Requirements

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with demonstrated experience building, debugging, and shipping real projects through professional work, open source, self-directed learning, or ambitious personal projects.
  • Ability to create clear, useful developer-facing materials, including code samples, demos, tutorials, docs, blog posts, videos, talks, and workshops.
  • Deep curiosity about how systems work, especially across networking, infrastructure, security, identity, cloud, open source, AI, or developer tooling.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems, such as production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, homelabs, local AI setups, networking experiments, or open source contributions.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas clearly, creatively, and practically.
  • Experience presenting to technical audiences, whether through conferences, meetups, livestreams, workshops, podcasts, videos, or internal engineering forums.
  • Comfortable working in public through GitHub issues, pull requests, community forums, social channels, open source projects, and developer feedback loops.
  • Strong developer empathy, emotional intelligence, and product sense; you notice friction, understand why it matters, and help translate it into better docs, APIs, examples, workflows, and product experiences.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing, support, community, and other technical stakeholders while operating independently and driving high-impact projects from idea to execution.
  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams, meeting regular publishing, event, or launch deadlines, discussing technical tradeoffs in detail, and traveling for events, conferences, and community moments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Go, networking, VPNs, WireGuard, identity, access controls, infrastructure automation, or security products.
  • Experience building developer education programs, sample apps, workshops, technical video content, or conference talks.
  • A visible history of technical writing, talks, demos, open source contributions, or community work.
  • Experience with homelabs, self-hosting, local AI models, infrastructure experiments, or other “I wanted to understand how this works, so I built it” projects.
  • Familiarity with secure AI access, privileged access management, zero trust, or modern infrastructure security patterns.
  • Familiarity with open source contribution workflows and technical collaboration in public.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, whether gained through formal education, professional experience, open source work, self-directed learning, or building ambitious projects on your own.
  • A track record of building and explaining technical systems. This could include production software, developer tools, infrastructure projects, open source contributions, homelab experiments, local AI setups, networking projects, or anything else that shows how you think.
  • If your background is less conventional, we still want to hear from you. Bring us your GitHub repos, blog posts, diagrams, configs, talks, demos, lab notes, or the deeply specific story of why your homelab is built the way it is.
  • Comfort discussing technical tradeoffs in detail such as explaining what you built, why you built it, what broke, what you learned, and what you would do differently next time.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

UK Pay Range
£100,330—£111,390 GBP

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

Tailscale is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive hiring process. If you require an accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process or related to any aspect of this role, please contact your recruiter.

Our hiring process uses AI-assisted tools to help screen and assess candidates. All hiring decisions are made by people.

Please be aware that legitimate emails from Tailscale's talent team will only originate from @tailscale.com, @greenhouse.io, and @interviews.modernloop.io email addresses. For more information about protecting yourself from impersonators and scams, please visit .

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, technical customer success is about helping businesses successfully implement, understand, and use our software. We value technical curiosity, clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of complex customer challenges.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Customer Success Engineer to help Bask Health's customers successfully implement, integrate, troubleshoot, and adopt our software platform.

This role combines technical problem-solving with customer-facing communication and long-term customer success.

You'll work directly with merchants, entrepreneurs, and healthcare businesses using Bask Health to operate direct-to-consumer telehealth experiences.

Our platform supports storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and other business-critical capabilities.

You'll develop a strong technical understanding of how these systems work together and how customers use them in their daily operations.

You'll serve as a technical point of contact for customers who need help with complex implementations, integrations, platform configuration, and advanced troubleshooting.

You'll collaborate with customer success managers to understand customer goals and identify technical challenges affecting adoption or account health.

You'll help customers move from initial setup to reliable day-to-day use of the platform.

You'll provide technical guidance during onboarding, implementation, and the introduction of new platform capabilities.

You'll investigate customer-reported issues, reproduce problems when possible, and identify likely causes using available technical tools and documentation.

You'll work with engineering teams to resolve issues that require code changes, infrastructure investigation, or deeper product expertise.

You'll be responsible for communicating technical findings and next steps in a way customers can understand.

You'll help customers troubleshoot API integrations, webhooks, authentication issues, data flows, and other supported technical connections.

You'll also assist with platform configuration challenges involving storefronts, questionnaires, checkout, and workflow automation.

You'll help customers understand technical requirements, supported configurations, and implementation limitations.

As a senior member of the team, you'll take ownership of particularly complex technical customer situations.

You'll be expected to investigate issues independently, organize relevant evidence, and involve the appropriate teams when necessary.

You'll help distinguish between configuration issues, product defects, integration problems, and requests for new functionality.

You'll document your findings so customers and internal teams have clear records of technical issues and resolutions.

You'll proactively identify recurring technical challenges that may be affecting multiple customers.

You'll recommend improvements to onboarding processes, troubleshooting documentation, and technical customer education.

You'll work with product managers to communicate customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve usability and technical reliability.

You'll collaborate with engineers on issue reproduction, technical requirements, and validation of customer-facing fixes.

You'll help customers adopt new features by explaining technical functionality and supporting implementation when appropriate.

You'll also work with customer success managers to identify technical risks that could affect retention or expansion.

You'll participate in technical customer meetings when specialized knowledge is needed.

You'll be comfortable speaking with both nontechnical business owners and technically experienced customer stakeholders.

You'll translate technical information into practical guidance without overwhelming customers with unnecessary complexity.

You'll maintain awareness of security, privacy, and appropriate handling of sensitive information when investigating issues involving healthcare-related workflows.

You'll recognize when clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or patient-related questions require involvement from the appropriate authorized teams.

You'll contribute to internal technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and repeatable support processes.

You may also mentor less-experienced customer success engineers and share approaches for investigating complex issues.

This is a senior individual-contributor position with substantial technical ownership, not a formal engineering management role.

We're looking for someone with strong technical troubleshooting skills, experience supporting customer-facing SaaS products, and the ability to build trust through clear communication.

Experience supporting e-commerce merchants, online storefronts, payment workflows, or merchant-facing platforms is particularly valuable.

You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, learning new systems, and taking responsibility for driving technical issues toward resolution.

Success in this role means helping customers implement the platform successfully, reducing recurring technical friction, improving adoption, and building confidence in Bask Health's technology.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a senior technical point of contact for assigned customer accounts.
  • Support technical onboarding and implementation for new customers.
  • Help customers configure and adopt supported Bask Health platform capabilities.
  • Investigate complex technical issues affecting customer workflows.
  • Reproduce reported problems and document relevant technical findings.
  • Troubleshoot API integrations, webhooks, and supported data connections.
  • Assist with authentication, permissions, and configuration-related issues.
  • Support troubleshooting involving merchant storefronts and checkout workflows.
  • Investigate technical issues involving questionnaires and platform configuration.
  • Help customers understand supported technical requirements and limitations.
  • Collaborate with customer success managers on technical account needs.
  • Partner with engineering teams to escalate product defects and complex issues.
  • Provide engineers with clear reproduction steps, logs, and technical context.
  • Coordinate customer communication during technical investigations.
  • Translate technical findings into clear, actionable explanations.
  • Track technical escalations through resolution and customer follow-up.
  • Identify recurring technical problems and recommend preventive improvements.
  • Help develop technical onboarding guides and troubleshooting resources.
  • Document common integration issues and recommended resolutions.
  • Support customers adopting new product features or integrations.
  • Participate in customer meetings requiring advanced technical expertise.
  • Work with product managers to communicate technical customer feedback.
  • Assist with validating fixes for customer-reported issues.
  • Identify technical risks that may affect customer adoption or retention.
  • Support internal investigations of customer configuration problems.
  • Help improve technical escalation and issue-triage processes.
  • Share technical knowledge with other customer-facing team members.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer issues, findings, and resolutions.
  • Follow security and privacy requirements when investigating customer issues.
  • Coordinate with appropriate clinical or pharmacy stakeholders when needed.
  • Recommend product improvements based on recurring customer challenges.
  • Take ownership of complex technical customer outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in customer success engineering, technical account management, solutions engineering, technical support engineering, or a closely related customer-facing technical role.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting customers using B2B SaaS or other complex software platforms.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience investigating software configuration, integration, or application issues.
  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP requests, and common integration concepts.
  • Familiarity with JSON, webhooks, and API authentication.
  • Ability to use technical documentation to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Experience communicating directly with customers about technical problems.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineers on customer-reported issues.
  • Ability to reproduce bugs and provide clear technical reproduction steps.
  • Experience distinguishing product defects from configuration or integration issues.
  • Strong understanding of software onboarding and implementation processes.

jobs.title: Founding Go-to-Market Lead, Wholesale Distribution
jobs.description:
Wholesale distributors still take a large share of their customer orders by email: a PDF from a contractor, a spreadsheet from a plant, a photo of a handwritten list, a few lines typed into the email body. Someone on the order desk reads each one and keys it into the ERP (the distributor's core system: Prophet 21, Eclipse, Infor, and others). Ten minutes and forty clicks per order, six people doing it all day, and every mistyped part number is a return. We are building software that reads those orders in any format, matches them to the distributor's catalog and contract pricing, and creates the order in the ERP itself, with a person reviewing only the exceptions. We are at the validation stage: before we build the full product, we want to talk to twenty distributors and run three paid pilots on real order flow. Your job is to make that happen.

Who we are

DeepSense is an AI-native company builder headquartered in Cyprus. We build software businesses with small teams and a lot of AI agents doing the routine work, and we are starting a new venture for the US wholesale distribution industry. This role is our first person on the ground in the United States.

What you will do in the first 90 days

  • Weeks 1–2: build a target list of about 100 distributors in one vertical (plumbing and HVAC) with $20–100M in revenue, using association and buying-group membership and your own network. Our agents do the research and draft the outreach; you put your name on it and pick up the phone.
    - Weeks 3–8: book and lead 20 conversations (45 minutes each) with owners, presidents, and directors of operations. The goal is to learn, not to sell: how orders come in today, how many people touch them, what breaks, what they have tried, why they said no to the vendors who called before us, whether their ERP has an API license. Our founder joins most calls; an agent takes notes.
    - Weeks 9–12: convert the best conversations into three paid pilots ($3,000–5,000 for 60 days) on live email order flow, and help define what "success" means for each one.
    - Throughout: tell us the truth about what you hear, including "nobody wants this." That answer is worth as much to us as a yes.

How we will measure the work

Three to four booked conversations per week; most of them with the person who owns the P&L or operations; three signed pilots by the end of the contract.

Who you are

- 8–15 years in US wholesale distribution, on one of two sides: you ran operations, customer service, or inside sales at a distributor with $30–200M in revenue, or you sold or implemented software for distributors (Epicor Prophet 21 or Eclipse, Infor CloudSuite Distribution or SX.e, Conexiom, DCKAP, Unilog, Proton, or similar).
- You have personally sat on, or managed, an order desk, and you know what a bad part-number match costs.
- You can name twenty distributors you would call tomorrow, and some of them would take the call.
- You are comfortable hearing no fifteen times in a row and writing down exactly why.
- You can travel to two industry events during the contract.
- You are based in the US, ideally within reach of Chicago, Dallas, Atlanta, or the Ohio Valley.

Nice to have

- Relationships inside a buying group (Affiliated Distributors, IMARK) or an association (ASA, HARDI, NAED, NAW).
- An earlier stint at an early-stage company, or a distributor that went through an ERP migration.
- You have already used AI tools in your own work and have opinions about what they get wrong.

Who this is not for

Enterprise software sellers who have never been on a warehouse floor. People who want to build a sales team before there is a product. Consultants who advise but do not make calls. Anyone who needs a finished product and a price list before they can start a conversation.

How we work

Small team, no middle management. AI agents do the list building, research, drafting, note taking, and follow-up scheduling; you do the part that needs a human who speaks the industry's language. Weekly written updates instead of status meetings. Decisions on the product are made from your call notes, so we will read every one of them.

Process

1. A 30-minute intro call with the founder.
2. A paid trial task ($1,000, five working days): book three conversations with directors of operations at distributors in the target vertical and send us notes from the first one.
3. Contract offer within 48 hours of the trial.

Contract-to-hire · Remote, US (Midwest or South preferred) · ~20% travel
$10,000–14,000 per month for a 3-month full-time contract; conversion to a founding full-time role at $130,000–170,000 base, pilot bonus, and 0.5–1% equity

jobs.title: Data Analyst / Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SQL, BI & Data Analytics | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to transform business data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and scalable data systems.

Depending on your experience, this role may lean toward data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a combination of these areas.

You’ll work with SQL, dashboards, reporting tools, databases, and data pipelines to help teams better understand performance and make informed business decisions.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

What You’ll Own

Data Analysis & Business Insights

  • Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance drivers
  • Translate raw data into meaningful business insights
  • Investigate data questions and provide evidence-based recommendations
  • Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs

SQL & Data Management

  • Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries
  • Extract and combine data from multiple sources
  • Work with relational databases and structured datasets
  • Validate datasets for completeness and accuracy
  • Troubleshoot inconsistencies across reporting and source systems

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar BI platforms
  • Build recurring reports for business stakeholders
  • Create clear visualizations that make complex information easier to understand
  • Maintain consistent definitions and reporting logic across dashboards

Data Pipelines & Integrations

  • Build or maintain data pipelines and integrations
  • Help connect business systems and reporting environments
  • Support reliable movement of data between platforms
  • Troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues
  • Improve the scalability and reliability of data workflows

Reporting Automation

  • Automate recurring reporting and data preparation processes
  • Reduce manual spreadsheet and reporting work
  • Build repeatable workflows for common reporting requirements
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency
  • Help ensure stakeholders have timely access to reliable information

Data Quality & Reliability

  • Monitor and improve data accuracy
  • Identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information
  • Validate reporting outputs against source data
  • Improve processes that support reliable reporting
  • Maintain organized documentation around reporting and data workflows

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements
  • Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Explain trends, metrics, and recommendations in practical business terms
  • Collaborate across teams to improve data accessibility and reporting

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role
  • Strong hands-on SQL skills
  • Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Experience using at least one BI or visualization platform such as:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
    • Similar tools
  • Familiarity with databases and data warehouses
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to identify patterns and insights within complex datasets
  • Strong attention to data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Professional working English
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python for data analysis or automation
  • Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems
  • Familiarity with cloud-based databases or data warehouses
  • Experience automating recurring reporting workflows
  • Experience with data modeling and reporting architecture
  • Experience supporting business intelligence or executive reporting

Tools & Technologies

SQL | Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker | Python | Databases | Data Warehouses | Data Pipelines | BI & Reporting Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy turning messy data into clear, reliable information
  • Are comfortable working deeply with SQL and datasets
  • Question inconsistencies instead of accepting numbers at face value
  • Can move between technical analysis and business conversations
  • Look for opportunities to automate repetitive reporting
  • Care about data accuracy and reporting reliability
  • Can explain complex findings in simple, actionable terms
  • Take ownership of analytical problems from question through insight

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include writing SQL queries, cleaning datasets, updating dashboards, investigating business trends, or automating a recurring report.

Depending on the project, you may also maintain data pipelines, troubleshoot reporting inconsistencies, work with stakeholders to define new metrics, or present findings to business leaders.

In short: you turn company data into reliable reporting, useful insights, and better business decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accuracy and reliability of reporting
  • Quality and usability of dashboards
  • Timely delivery of recurring reports and analysis
  • SQL query and reporting efficiency
  • Reduction in manual reporting processes
  • Reliability of data pipelines and integrations
  • Improvement in overall data quality
  • Stakeholder confidence in reporting and insights

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Data / Technical Interview
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you have experience with SQL, data analytics, business intelligence, dashboards, reporting, or data engineering and enjoy turning complex data into clear business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build reliable data systems that support smarter business decisions.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Legal Support (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Coordinator, Legal Support, accountable for providing reliable administrative and general legal support to the Legal team. The role requires a foundational understanding of commercial law, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work accurately and autonomously in a remote environment.

  • Manage assigned tasks across the agreed three-day schedule, communicate progress and potential delays, and work collaboratively with internal stakeholders. Use Microsoft 365 tools to prepare documents, track work, and communicate with the team.

  • Exposure to intellectual property or privacy law.

Skills, Knowledge and Specialist Expertise

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously in a remote environment while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Reliability, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential information.
  • Working arrangements: This is a casual position, with hours generally expected to be approximately 9 hours per week. Hours may vary depending on business requirements and Legal team priorities, but expectation is working hours are to be spread across three business days.

What’s In It For You

  • Remote Work Practices: Cogstate is a virtual first company. Cogstate employees can work from anywhere where Cogstate is registered to business within the United States, Australia, or the United Kingdom!

We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. jobs.title: Executive Director, Customer Support Operations
jobs.description:
College Board – Operations – Customer Support Operations

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

College Board’s Operations division leads all aspects of customer support, learning and delivery for the organization’s digital product portfolio of assessments and classwork products. We are comprised of ~130 professionals supporting millions of students and thousands of test centers each year. Our three functional areas—Assessment Delivery Operations, Customer Engagement & Experience, and Knowledge, Learning and Operational Effectiveness—work together as “One Ops” to deliver against our ambitious priorities:

  • Clean Delivery+: Deliver assessments and support with the consistency and quality that sustain the trust of students, educators, and partners, while continuously improving how we work.
  • Build for the Future: Invest in digital tools, data strategy, and AI to modernize assessment delivery and support, and to help more students prepare and succeed.
  • Customer Experience: Design a seamless end-to-end journey for students, parents, educators, and our state and district partners, using data to represent the voice of the customer across the organization.

Our Customer Support Operations team is a combination of vendor management and delivery, specialized technical and Tier 3 support teams, program/product SMEs and forecasting and planning operations to deliver all aspects of a multi-channel support model to ensure success for users, including students, parents, educators, and our state/district partners. We oversee approximately 1.5 million contacts per year across phone, email, and chat and a vendor budget of ~20 million. Our integrated team plays a critical role in leveraging data to advocate for the voice of the customer, partnering across the organization to provide a positive and effective overall customer experience.

About the Opportunity

As the Executive Director, Customer Support Operations, you are a customer operations leader who has run support at scale and is ready to reinvent it. You’ll lead all aspects of customer support and service and call center vendor operations for College Board’s customers, from students and parents to educators and our state and district partners. You lead a team of leaders who own their numbers, drive performance across large external vendors, and use AI to advance access to support and the accuracy of guidance.

This role is central to that work, driving measurable gains in cost efficiency, contact containment, and customer experience quality across voice, chat, and emerging digital channels. As a key contributor to our Operations leadership team, you will help optimize our digital testing operational structures and support models and build for the future. Behind every contact is a student, parent, or educator who needs an answer, and you make sure they get a good one.

In this role, you will:

Set Vision & Strategy (40%)

  • Set the overarching vision and direction for Customer Support Operations as part of the enterprise Operations division, aligning with division priorities and pairing best-in-class support strategies with a strong customer experience differentiated by customer needs and expectations.
  • Foster a customer centric mindset and framework for processes, products and decision-making, including AI-assisted self-service and in-app support pathways that reduce friction for students, educators, and state partners.
  • Develop a deep understanding of College Board’s customer base and work with stakeholders across the organization to provide strong service and address the root of the problem. Bring the voice of the customer, including AI-generated insights from voice and chat interactions, to policy, product, and communication decisions.
  • Define clear measurements of success. Develop, monitor, and report on critical measurements and metrics that drive high levels of customer satisfaction. Go beyond service levels, FCR, AHT, and CSAT to measure customer success and the quality of agent guidance, and drive FCR improvements and AHT reductions.
  • Set a strategic vendor management and optimization strategy for a wide range of customer support models, including generative AI-powered voice/chat bots, digital platforms insights management, and SaaS in-app support tools, with a focus on access, efficiency, and quality of customer experience.

Provide Team Leadership & Management (40%)

  • Lead and develop a remote team of ~4 direct reports, building a high-performing leadership team with shared expectations, candid feedback, and clear accountability. Model a service and team-first mindset that makes psychological safety, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning the norm.
  • Set vision and priorities for the team, track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission
  • Cultivate an inclusive and high achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles.
  • Bring proven leadership experience and consistently embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work.
  • Partner with Operations leadership peers to drive a One Ops culture, align on shared priorities and critical dependencies, ensure alignment across teams, and establish a presence as an enterprise leader.
  • Establish critical forecasting and workforce planning capabilities, including planning models for call center vendors. Manage work volumes and a vendor budget of ~$25M based on data, and equip Customer Engagement & Experience (CEE) leaders to own their numbers and drive vendor performance.
  • Enhance the customer support vendor management function, including forecasting and quality improvements, effective diversification strategies, and oversight of AI-powered support vendors to ensure performance standards and cost targets are met. Anticipate vendor readiness and quality risks and put mitigation plans in place before issues reach customers.

Drive Continuous Improvement & Innovation (20%)

  • Provide actionable intelligence and insights through analysis and assessment of all escalation data that comes into the team.
  • Advance real-time, executive level reporting disciplines, including test administration insights and analysis of variances, and establish reporting protocols to monitor performance data and drive continuous improvement.
  • Analyze escalation data to find and solve for root causes; elevate key trends with leadership and field teams. Make data-driven decisions on continuous improvement for our escalations programs to advance visibility for leadership and field teams with a focus on transparency.
  • Foster an innovative culture and champion the use of AI insights to drive evidence-based recommendations that measurably improve cost efficiency, customer experience, and program outcomes.
  • Lead the technical and agent readiness infrastructure required to support new product and program launches (e.g., Bluebook Platform pilots), including IVR configuration, agent training requirements and quality measures, agent-AI assistance, and support readiness and escalation structures. Ensure tools, products, and systems deliver the capabilities support teams need.
  • Define Customer Service Support requirements for new program and product pilots, and convert pilot learnings into scalable requirements for full launch/es

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 15+ years leading customer experience or customer support functions, with some related product management, budgeting and forecasting, and workforce management expertise.
  • Financial acumen and experience managing a vendor budget at scale, including oversight of large external call center vendors.
  • Deep understanding of industry best practices, trends, and technologies related to customer operations and support, support platforms, and in-app support delivery models.
  • Proven ability to leverage AI to advance efficiency or deliver actionable product, program, and policy improvement insights for cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success managing complex customer escalations.
  • A track record of driving operational excellence and delivering exceptional customer experiences, including leading high-visibility projects from start to finish with measurable results.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes, and dynamic environment and lead teams and stakeholders through transformational change.
  • Fluency with data and confidence in making data-driven decisions, paired with strategic thinking and planning skills to build a strategy, connect the dots, and build towards the future.
  • A strategic and inclusive leadership style:you set clear priorities, build effective team structures, plan for future needs, and foster a culture of belonging.
  • A proven ability to drive performance and growth:you set high expectations, deliver real-time, evidence-based feedback, and coach team members to take smart risks, stretch their skills, and achieve meaningful impact.
  • Demonstrated experience building high-performing, collaborative teams, including coaching, developing, and retaining top talent and empowering others through delegation with accountability.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, including ability to work with product leads and technologists to drive business requirements and to influence and build relationships across internal and external stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree (required), Master’s/MBA degree (preferred).
  • The ability to travel at least once a month to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Authorization to work in the United States for any employer
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Lithuania. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

jobs.title: Agentic Photonic Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Flexcompute is the physics company. We tackle multi-scale, multi-physics problems with simulators that combine numerical methods and AI models. We are GPU-native and support agentic workflows for the fastest path to physics insight. We scale first-principles physics into foundational physics models to eliminate the latency to physical insights. Our platforms help teams design and optimize products from electric aircraft and wind turbines to photonic chips and quantum hardware. Built by engineers from Stanford University and MIT and backed by top VC firms, we are growing fast across aerospace, automotive, semiconductors, photonics, and beyond.

About the Role

We're looking for an Agentic Photonic Design Engineer to join the PhotonForge team. This is a software development role at the intersection of photonic design automation, EDA integration, and agentic AI. You'll extend our end-to-end platform for photonic integrated circuit (PIC) design, working in Python and navigating a C++ codebase to ship production integrations and AI-native workflows.

PhotonForge unifies component simulation, circuit simulation, compact modeling, layout generation, PDK integration, and foundry handoff into a single platform backed by Flexcompute's GPU-accelerated Tidy3D multi-physics solvers. You'll build EDA tool integrations, develop physics-driven application workflows, and design agentic tools that make photonic design faster and more accessible.

This is a remote role based in Singapore.

What You’ll Do

Build Interfaces & Connectors to EDA Tools

• Develop and maintain integrations between PhotonForge and industry-standard EDA tools for layout, DRC, LVS, and schematic-driven design, such as Cadence Virtuoso (through our Cadence connector), KLayout and Siemens Calibre.

• Enable seamless round-trip workflows between EDA environments, PhotonForge, and Tidy3D simulation.

• Build Python-based APIs and automation scripts that connect PhotonForge to existing toolchains (GDSII and OASIS layouts, Touchstone S-parameters, SPICE netlists, and Verilog-A models for SPICE simulators); read, debug, and extend C++ components where integrations touch the core platform.

Design Agentic & AI-Native Workflows

• Build agentic tools and automation that help engineers set up layout, simulation, and verification with less manual friction.

• Prototype and ship AI-powered features inside PhotonForge and adjacent developer experiences (e.g., scripted flows, assistants, workflow agents).

Drive Physics & Application Workflows

• Work with end users on real-world design challenges in quantum photonics, RF photonics, co-packaged optics, or silicon photonics.

• Develop application workflows and reference designs across component simulation, circuit simulation, compact modeling, and layout.

• Leverage Flexcompute’s GPU-accelerated Tidy3D multi-physics solvers (tackling optical, RF, charge, and thermal physics) to build fabrication-aware simulation pipelines.

Requirements

• Software developer first. You write production-quality Python and are comfortable reading, debugging, and contributing to C++ codebases (our platform includes performance-critical native components).

• Hands-on EDA and PIC flow experience. You've worked with industry-standard EDA platforms (such as Cadence Virtuoso, Siemens Calibre or KLayout) and photonic design tools and understand real tapeout-oriented workflows: GDSII and OASIS, DRC, LVS, PDKs, schematic-driven design, and compact models (such as Verilog-A).

• Strong physics or engineering foundation. Degree (MS or PhD preferred) in electrical engineering, applied physics, photonics, or a related field. Working knowledge of Maxwell's equations, waveguide theory, and semiconductor device physics.

• AI-native builder. You actively use AI tools in your own work and are motivated to build agentic automation into engineering products, not just consume off-the-shelf chat interfaces.

Nice to Have

• Contributions to open-source photonics or EDA tooling

• The chance to shape how an entire generation of engineers learns to work with AI-driven

simulation
