jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineering Intern
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineering Intern to join Bask Health's engineering team and gain practical experience developing machine learning models, working with real application data, and supporting production ML systems.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities. As we expand our machine learning capabilities, we're looking for motivated individuals who want to learn how intelligent systems are developed, evaluated, and integrated into real software products.

You'll work alongside experienced machine learning engineers, applied AI engineers, software engineers, and product teams to contribute to machine learning projects across the platform.

This internship is designed to provide hands-on engineering experience. Rather than focusing exclusively on theoretical research, you'll learn how machine learning models are developed, tested, improved, and prepared for use in production applications.

Your work may include preparing datasets, exploring model architectures, implementing training scripts, evaluating model performance, and helping integrate machine learning capabilities into existing software systems.

You'll gain exposure to practical machine learning workflows, including feature engineering, experiment tracking, model validation, performance monitoring, and reproducible development practices.

You'll also learn how engineering teams evaluate whether a machine learning solution is appropriate for a product problem, compare model approaches, and balance accuracy with reliability, latency, and operational cost.

You'll receive guidance from experienced engineers while contributing to appropriately scoped projects. As you develop your skills, you'll have opportunities to take greater ownership of technical tasks and communicate your findings to the team.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn how privacy, secure data handling, appropriate permissions, and human oversight affect machine learning development. You'll work with approved datasets and established safeguards, and your work will not involve independently making clinical decisions or determining patient treatment.

We welcome candidates who have developed machine learning skills through university coursework, independent projects, research, internships, hackathons, or self-directed learning. Previous professional machine learning engineering experience is not required.

We're looking for someone who enjoys programming, is curious about how machine learning systems work, and wants to develop the practical engineering skills needed to build reliable intelligent software.

What You'll Do

  • Assist with developing machine learning models and supporting engineering systems across Bask Health.
  • Work with experienced engineers to understand practical machine learning development workflows.
  • Prepare, clean, and transform approved datasets for model training and evaluation.
  • Write Python scripts for data processing, experimentation, and model development.
  • Assist with implementing supervised learning models and baseline algorithms.
  • Explore classification, regression, ranking, and other machine learning approaches.
  • Help develop feature engineering pipelines for machine learning applications.
  • Assist with training, validating, and evaluating machine learning models.
  • Compare model performance using appropriate evaluation metrics.
  • Help investigate model errors and unexpected predictions.
  • Support the development of reproducible machine learning experiments.
  • Document model configurations, datasets, assumptions, and evaluation results.
  • Assist with building automated data validation and model testing workflows.
  • Learn how machine learning models are integrated into backend services and APIs.
  • Contribute to small machine learning application features under engineering guidance.
  • Assist with model inference testing and performance measurement.
  • Help monitor model behavior and investigate reliability issues.
  • Work with engineers to understand model deployment and production monitoring processes.
  • Assist with developing scripts and utilities that support ML engineering workflows.
  • Explore techniques for improving model accuracy, efficiency, and generalization.
  • Help identify data quality issues that affect model performance.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from experienced engineers.
  • Learn and follow Bask Health's software engineering and machine learning development standards.
  • Use version control and collaborative development tools to manage assigned work.
  • Collaborate with software engineers and product teams to understand machine learning use cases.
  • Present experiment results, technical findings, and project progress to team members.
  • Learn about responsible machine learning practices and secure data handling.
  • Complete assigned machine learning engineering projects with mentorship, documentation, and appropriate testing.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing, recently completed, or independently developing skills equivalent to a degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field.
  • Foundational programming skills in Python or a comparable language.
  • Basic understanding of machine learning concepts and common algorithms.
  • Familiarity with supervised learning, including classification or regression.
  • Understanding of basic programming principles and data structures.
  • Familiarity with data processing and manipulation techniques.
  • Basic knowledge of Python libraries such as NumPy, pandas, or comparable tools.
  • Understanding of model training, validation, and testing concepts.
  • Familiarity with common machine learning evaluation metrics.
  • Basic understanding of probability, statistics, or linear algebra.
  • Ability to write and debug Python scripts.
  • Familiarity with structured datasets and tabular data.
  • Basic understanding of SQL or willingness to learn database querying.
  • Familiarity with Git or willingness to learn version control workflows.
  • Ability to read technical documentation and follow implementation instructions.
  • Interest in building practical machine learning applications.
  • Willingness to learn machine learning frameworks and development tools.
  • Understanding of basic software testing and debugging practices.
  • Ability to explain technical concepts and experiment results clearly.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail when working with datasets and model outputs.
  • Ability to collaborate with engineers and other technical team members.
  • Openness to feedback and mentorship.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and communicate progress.
  • Strong curiosity about production machine learning systems and their real-world applications.

Nice to Have

  • Academic, personal, research, or internship projects involving machine learning.
  • Experience using scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or comparable ML frameworks.
  • Familiarity with model training and hyperparameter tuning.
  • Experience developing classification, regression, or recommendation models.
  • Basic understanding of neural networks and deep learning.
  • Familiarity with natural language processing or text classification.
  • Experience working with Jupyter notebooks or comparable development environments.
  • Familiarity with data visualization libraries.
  • Experience using SQL to query and analyze datasets.
  • Exposure to feature engineering and data preprocessing techniques.
  • Familiarity with model evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, F1 score, or ROC-AUC.
  • Experience using GitHub to share programming or machine learning projects.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Weights & Biases, or comparable experiment tracking tools.
  • Basic understanding of model deployment and inference APIs.
  • Experience participating in machine learning competitions, hackathons, or research projects.
  • Familiarity with recommendation systems, ranking models, or predictive analytics.
  • Interest in healthcare technology, telehealth, or e-commerce applications.
  • Basic awareness of data privacy, model bias, and responsible machine learning.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

jobs.title: Program Manager (R-00259)
jobs.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced Cybersecurity Program Manager to provide strategic leadership, technical oversight, and comprehensive program management for large-scale cybersecurity and information technology initiatives within complex federal environments. This senior leadership position is responsible for overseeing the complete program and project lifecycle, managing multidisciplinary technical teams, coordinating resources and budgets, and ensuring successful delivery of cybersecurity solutions aligned with federal customer objectives, contractual requirements, and applicable security standards.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive experience leading federal cybersecurity programs, strong technical knowledge of enterprise security technologies and cloud infrastructure, and demonstrated expertise in program governance, strategic planning, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate must demonstrate exceptional leadership, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to oversee multiple cybersecurity workstreams, manage complex technical initiatives, and engage effectively with senior government officials to deliver secure, innovative, and high-quality solutions on schedule and within budget.

Job Responsibilities

    Job Responsibilities

  • Cybersecurity Program & Project Lifecycle Management: Plan, organize, coordinate, and oversee the complete lifecycle of cybersecurity technology and infrastructure initiatives, including technology lifecycle management, initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, controlling, and closeout. Ensure program activities align with federal customer priorities, contractual requirements, and established delivery objectives.
  • Technical Project Planning & Execution: Establish project requirements, priorities, schedules, and deadlines while overseeing solution development activities, including planning, architecture, design, programming, testing, implementation, and operational transition. Ensure technical deliverables meet defined performance, quality, and security standards.
  • Resource Acquisition & Workforce Management: Assess program and project resource requirements, secure necessary personnel and technical capabilities, and coordinate support from internal teams, external specialists, subcontractors, and other functional disciplines to ensure successful execution of cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Project Scope, Budget & Milestone Management: Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans identifying scope, objectives, deliverables, dependencies, resource allocations, budgets, personnel requirements, and major milestones. Monitor execution against established baselines and implement corrective actions to address schedule, cost, or performance challenges.
  • Technical Solution Delivery & Innovation: Manage approved project scopes and direct the delivery of innovative cybersecurity and IT solutions that address complex technical and operational challenges. Identify opportunities to accelerate development, improve operational efficiency, strengthen security capabilities, and support federal customer business and mission objectives.
  • Solution Planning & Technical Team Leadership: Coordinate enterprise solution planning, oversee technical solution development teams, and provide strategic direction, technical leadership, and ongoing coaching to direct reports and multidisciplinary personnel. Promote accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement across program delivery teams.
  • Technology Research & Strategic Alignment: Direct technical research and evaluation of emerging cybersecurity technologies, engineering practices, and enterprise IT solutions by assessing organizational goals, strategic priorities, operational requirements, and customer initiatives. Recommend technologies and architectural approaches that improve security, scalability, and mission effectiveness.
  • Solution Roadmap Development & Quality Assurance: Oversee the creation and execution of strategic technology roadmaps, translating long-term solution visions into actionable implementation plans, technical milestones, and measurable outcomes. Ensure all projects meet established quality requirements, operational standards, and customer expectations.
  • Federal Customer Leadership & Contract Liaison: Serve as the primary liaison between True Zero Technologies and federal customer leadership, maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, facilitating executive-level communications, resolving program challenges, and ensuring alignment between contractor performance and government mission priorities.
  • Contract Oversight & Federal Cybersecurity Compliance: Oversee all contract-related activities and ensure program execution aligns with federal cybersecurity missions, contractual obligations, and applicable regulations and guidance, including the Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA), NIST standards, Executive Order 14028, CISA guidance, and other relevant federal cybersecurity policies.
  • Strategic Planning & Cross-Functional Cybersecurity Leadership: Lead program-level strategic planning, resource allocation, prioritization, and stakeholder engagement across cybersecurity functional areas, including Security Operations Center (SOC), Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM), Red Team operations, DevSecOps, and enterprise architecture. Ensure effective coordination and integration across technical workstreams.
  • Program Risk, Performance & Executive Reporting: Establish and maintain comprehensive program risk management processes, performance metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and executive reporting mechanisms. Monitor financial, operational, technical, and contractual performance; identify emerging risks; implement mitigation strategies; and communicate program status to federal stakeholders and organizational leadership.
  • Zero Trust, CDM & DevSecOps Integration: Ensure Zero Trust Architecture, Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM), and DevSecOps principles are incorporated throughout cybersecurity program activities and technical workstreams. Promote secure system design, automated security controls, continuous monitoring, and integration of cybersecurity capabilities across enterprise environments.

Job Requirements

    Job Requirements

  • Federal IT & Cybersecurity Program Management Experience: Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience supporting information technology initiatives in roles such as Program Manager, Deputy Program Manager, or Senior Project Manager, including demonstrated responsibility for leading complex technical programs, managing multidisciplinary teams, and overseeing large-scale project execution.
  • Large-Scale Federal Cybersecurity Program Leadership: Proven experience managing large-scale federal cybersecurity programs involving complex enterprise environments, multiple technical workstreams, significant resource requirements, and federal customer engagement. Demonstrated ability to oversee cybersecurity operations, coordinate contractual deliverables, and ensure alignment with federal mission objectives and security requirements.
  • Professional Project Management Certification: Must possess an active, industry-recognized project management certification, such as Project Management Professional (PMP), demonstrating proficiency in program and project planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, and delivery methodologies.
  • Federal Security Clearance: Must possess and maintain a Non-Sensitive / High Risk Public Trust security clearance (Tier 4/6c), as required to support federal information technology and cybersecurity programs.
  • Enterprise Cybersecurity & Cloud Technical Expertise: Strong technical understanding of enterprise cybersecurity technologies and infrastructure, including Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM), DevSecOps, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and AWS GovCloud systems and services. Ability to provide strategic oversight of complex cybersecurity solutions and technical integrations.
  • IT Service Management & ITIL Proficiency: Demonstrated proficiency in IT service management principles, processes, tools, and techniques associated with ITIL Foundation practices. Experience applying service management methodologies to program delivery, operational transitions, service quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Agile Development & Application Lifecycle Management: Proven experience managing Agile software development and engineering teams, including coordinating iterative development activities, overseeing technical backlogs, and managing delivery priorities. Strong understanding of how application enhancements, defects, change requests, and evolving technical requirements affect system architecture, integration, security, and overall project delivery.
  • Emerging Technology & Engineering Knowledge: Strong knowledge of current and emerging technological advances in computer science, cybersecurity engineering, cloud computing, enterprise architecture, and infrastructure modernization. Ability to evaluate innovative technical solutions, assess organizational impacts, and provide strategic guidance on technology adoption and implementation.
  • Executive Communication & Federal Stakeholder Engagement: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including demonstrated experience delivering executive briefings, presenting technical and program information, preparing performance reports, and communicating complex cybersecurity initiatives, risks, and recommendations to senior government officials and organizational leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Coordination: Demonstrated ability to collaborate with senior managers, functional subject matter experts, internal service delivery teams, federal customer representatives, external provider project teams, and subcontractors to develop, negotiate, and obtain approval for project scope, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, and quality management plans.
  • Program Execution, Performance Monitoring & Delivery Excellence: Proven track record of successfully executing, monitoring, controlling, and managing complex cybersecurity and IT programs to achieve high-quality, on-time, and on-budget completion. Experience identifying and mitigating program risks, resolving technical and operational challenges, maintaining contractual performance standards, and ensuring successful delivery of customer requirements.

jobs.title: AI Platform Engineering Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.


Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.


Who you are:

An AI Infrastructure Architecture leader who is ready to make sure our clients have the foundation to run AI in customer service at scale. You lead teams of platform engineers and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who design, implement, and govern the compute, deployment infrastructure, and tooling AI depends on, and you tune how those workloads run, so a virtual agent answers in real time on the busiest day of the year and the cost per interaction still makes business sense.


You are a confident client partner and team leader with deep experience managing senior stakeholder relationships. You will need to inspire and challenge a design, unblock a team, and tell a client the hard truth about what it takes to get AI into production. You develop practitioners into leaders and form clear points of view that help clients navigate how AI is reshaping customer service. Your teams include FDEs, hybrid practitioners who embed directly with clients to discover, prototype, and deploy AI solutions into production. You may have been one yourself; now your job is to lead them, set the standard for how they work, and scale their impact across engagements.


The work:

In this role you will have accountability across three dimensions:


Client Delivery:

  • Oversee AI platform programs, providing technical direction and quality oversight across leads and their teams while maintaining accountability for delivery health, team performance, and measurable outcomes such as availability, latency, throughput, and cost per interaction.
  • Stay connected to the work: inspire and challenge your teams' designs, unblock delivery when it stalls, and give clients a candid view of what it takes to get AI into production.
  • Direct how your FDEs embed with clients: running discovery to find the highest-value use cases, prototyping fast to prove value, and owning solutions end to end through production rollout, adoption, runbooks, and a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
  • Own the design and governance of AI platform infrastructure for service, including model serving and inference, deployment pipelines, environments, and tooling across cloud and hybrid estates.
  • Give your FDEs a platform path from prototype to production, with environments, platform-native tooling, CI/CD, and observability that make hardening a solution a standard step rather than a rebuild.
  • Lead performance and capacity engineering for real-time service workloads: latency budgets for voice and chat, concurrency planning for seasonal and event-driven peaks, load testing, and scaling strategies.
  • Bring cost discipline to AI at scale through inference and token economics, model routing, caching, and right-sizing, with FinOps reporting that leaders can act on.
  • Shape the data foundations behind service intelligence, including service data lakes, pipelines, and the platforms that power reporting, dashboards, and analytics agents.
  • Stand up AI platform operations with clear SLOs, observability, and incident management, and run models that hand over cleanly to client teams.
  • Set performance targets around what customers actually feel, like the pause before a voice agent responds, and give design and engineering teams clear constraints to design and build against.

Business Development:

  • Grow a pipeline of work by building strong client relationships and proactively connecting Song's service AI capabilities to client priorities, shaping platform modernization and scale-up proposals that win work and fuel future demand.
  • Use FDE-led discovery and rapid prototypes to prove value before full engagement, and partner with sales teams on business cases, ROI models, executive narratives, and RFP responses.
  • Develop thought leadership on running AI economically and reliably at scale in customer service, opening doors to new conversations with client technology leaders.
  • Strengthen relationships with cloud, data, and AI platform partners to sharpen joint solutions and go-to-market.

People & Practice Development:

  • Lead, coach, and grow Forward Deployed Engineers and platform engineers and architects, helping them navigate challenges and grow their technical depth, leadership skills, and client acumen so they can step up as workstream and program owners.
  • Build inclusive, high-performing teams where practitioners are supported, challenged, and able to grow into stronger leaders over time.
  • Scale the FDE capability within Service AI & Data: hire the right hybrid profiles, define how FDEs engage with clients, and build career paths from FDE to workstream and program leadership.
  • Bring AI-augmented delivery into your teams, applying AI tooling across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise speed and quality.
  • Codify platform blueprints, performance benchmarks, and operating playbooks that make delivery repeatable across clients.

Here's what you'll need:

  • 10+ years of experience in technology, data, or AI roles across consulting or industry, with a track record across varied industries and business problems.
  • 5+ years leading technology, data, or AI programs end-to-end, with experience managing complexity, ambiguity, shifting scope, and senior stakeholders.
  • 5+ years directly managing and developing technical practitioners, with demonstrated ability to grow them into workstream and program leaders.
  • 5+ years of experience leading transformation in customer service, contact center, or customer experience operations, with a working understanding of service metrics such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, and cost-to-serve, and how AI moves them.
  • Experience leading FDEs or similar client-embedded technical teams, such as solutions architects, sales engineers, or technical consultants; a hands-on FDE or engineering background yourself is a strong plus.
  • Deep experience designing and operating cloud infrastructure at enterprise scale on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including containers and orchestration (Kubernetes), infrastructure as code, and CI/CD.
  • Experience running AI and ML workloads in production, including model serving, inference optimization, accelerator capacity, and managed AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, Google Vertex AI or Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, or Databricks Mosaic AI.

jobs.candidate_required_location: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, Uruguay
jobs.description:
We sell mushroom coffee direct to consumers. Paid ads on Meta and Google are how we grow, and the creative is the variable that decides whether it works. We test continuously and we measure what wins, so the feedback you get here is specific rather than taste-based.

Our creative strategists write the scripts and own the angle. You own the execution and, specifically, the first five seconds. You will ship 15 to 25 finished ads a month, deliberately fewer than most performance shops expect, because we would rather you spend the hours deciding what to change than cutting another variant nobody learns from.

What you will do

  • Cut paid ads for Meta and Google from scripts and angles handed to you by a strategist. Vertical, sound-on, short, fast-paced.
  • Own the hook. The script arrives written; the first five seconds are your call. We have firm views, built from our own account data, about which openers work for this product and which quietly kill a good ad. You will learn them in week one, apply them without being asked, and argue when one is wrong.
  • Iterate winners, not only originate. Most of your month is making something that already works work harder, which in our testing beats originating from scratch by a wide margin.
  • Build variants that change one thing on purpose. We have burned whole quarters on same-day copies that duplicated instead of testing. A variant that teaches us nothing is worse than no variant.
  • Read your own numbers. You get access to our creative analytics and attribution tools, and your output is measured. You bring reads to the weekly creative review rather than waiting to be told what lost.

Requirements

What we are looking for

Three or more years cutting ads that ran on a paid account. We care about what you have shipped, not your title.

Required

  • Paid ads as the spine of your work. You can name a brand that spent money distributing something you cut.
  • A performance number you personally moved on a specific piece of creative, before and after.
  • You know which metrics decide and which mislead. An ad is judged on spend and acquisition cost over its first week, not on thumbstop or hold rate. Plenty of good editors optimise for retention and engagement because those are the numbers they are shown. We will ask you which metrics you have actually been held to and what you think they do and do not predict. There is a right answer and it is not the obvious one.
  • AI creation, fluently and invisibly. Generative tooling is how you hit variant volume at this cadence: image and video generation, voice, upscaling, automated captioning and reframing. The bar is output nobody can tell was generated. We are not buying AI-looking content, we are buying your speed.
  • Premiere or DaVinci to a professional standard, plus After Effects or CapCut. You finish your own sound.
  • English good enough to argue with a media buyer about why a hook is wrong.
  • Your own machine, reliable internet, a quiet place to take a call.

Strongly preferred

  • Supplements, wellness, beverage, beauty or DTC subscription. Our claims language is regulated.
  • Range across the formats direct response actually runs on: offer-led creative, objection and confession openers, and one person talking to camera. Tell us which you are strongest in.
  • Creative analytics tooling such as Motion, Triple Whale or Northbeam.
  • Cutting from creator and UGC footage, including the unglamorous work of making mediocre raw material perform.

Not required: a degree, a cinematic showreel, agency names on your resume, or managing anyone.

Before you apply

We decline a lot of genuinely skilled editors who have never cut a direct-response ad. That wastes everyone's time, so, plainly:

Not a fit if your portfolio is mainly corporate or internal communications, brand films, weddings and events, news or broadcast, documentary, event recaps and sizzle reels, music videos, real estate, podcast production, long-form YouTube, or B2B training. Those are real crafts and close to the opposite problem: a beautiful 90-second brand film and an ad that holds a stranger for three seconds and sells coffee are not the same skill.

The test: can you name a brand that paid to distribute something you cut, and the metric you were judged on? If the honest answer is that you have made great videos but nobody bought media against them, this seat will not work, and we would rather say so now than after two interviews.

One more thing. A cover letter that repeats this posting back to us reads exactly as it sounds. Tell us about your work instead.

Benefits

Engagement

Independent contractor, ongoing, invoiced monthly. Not employment.

Location

Remote, anywhere in Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, or Uruguay. You are responsible for your own taxes and any local registration.

Hours

Async by default. We ask for 2-3 hours of daily overlap with Austin, Texas (Central Time) for the creative review and buyer conversations. You choose which hours.

Commitment

Full-time equivalent effort. We are not looking for someone fitting this between three other clients.

Equipment

Yours. We provide software seats (Adobe CC, Motion, Frame.io) and all footage, product and creator assets.

Start

As soon as the right person is found.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS
Our customers run real-time pipelines that cannot stop: fraud detection, payments, telemetry, recommendations. When something breaks, you are the engineer who gets it running again.

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will solve real production problems on Kubernetes, in the cloud and inside Flink itself. You will work side by side with the engineers who build Flink, so every hard ticket is a chance to learn how a distributed system works under the hood.

This role suits someone who enjoys a good puzzle, likes helping people and wants to grow into a stream processing expert.

  • 2+ years in technical support or a similar hands-on role, ideally with cloud-based products.
  • Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
  • Practical experience with containers and Kubernetes. Our product runs on Kubernetes, so this matters.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. You enjoy finding out why something fails.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and the patience to explain technical ideas to any audience.
  • A customer-first mindset and the ability to stay calm when a customer is under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team.
  • Curiosity and a drive to keep learning.
  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

No one ticks every box. If you have some of these, tell us.
  • Experience with stream processing, Apache Flink or Apache Kafka.
  • Scripting or programming skills in Shell, Python, Java or SQL.
  • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Experience with cloud monitoring and observability tools.
  • Cloud certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or Azure Administrator.

LOCATION AND WORKING HOURS

This is a remote role for someone based between UTC-4 and UTC-7. That covers US and Canadian Eastern, Central, Mountain and Pacific time, plus Latin American countries in the same range.
  • Your core hours follow customers' business day in the Americas.
  • You will work closely with our EMEA support team to give customers follow-the-sun coverage.

  • Be the first technical point of contact for customers using Ververica Unified Streaming Data Platform.

  • Keep accurate records of cases and resolutions in our ticketing system.
  • Turn what you learn into knowledge base articles, tutorials and runbooks that help customers and teammates.
  • Keep sharpening your skills in cloud technologies and stream processing, and share them with the team.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive compensation: salary, equity and performance bonus
  • Remote-first culture with flexible hours
  • Direct access to Flink core developers and a global open-source community
  • A clear path to grow into senior support, Technical Account Manager or engineering roles
  • Generous vacation, personal leave and wellness benefits

At Ververica, we believe innovation starts with diverse perspectives. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If you are passionate about helping customers succeed with real-time data, we would love to hear from you.

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Virtual Assistant (VA) to provide reliable executive, administrative, CRM, and operational support.

This is not a passive administrative role. You’ll serve as an execution partner, helping keep calendars, communication, records, projects, and day-to-day priorities organized and moving forward.

You’ll work across multiple business functions and may support founders, executives, clients, vendors, and internal teams.

If you’re someone who takes initiative, communicates professionally, and makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Calendar, Inbox & Executive Support

CRM & Data Management

    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
  • Update contacts, activities, notes, and relevant business information.

File & Document Management

Research & Task Execution

    • Vendors
    • Market opportunities

  • Support small projects from assignment through completion.

  • Respond to routine client inquiries or route them to the appropriate person.

  • Track outstanding requests and ensure timely completion.
  • Maintain professional and responsive communication across stakeholders.

Operations & Project Support

  • Maintain project and task trackers using tools such as:
    • Asana
    • Trello
    • Notion
    • Monday.com
  • Track deadlines, priorities, and outstanding action items.
  • Support invoicing and expense tracking.

  • Help maintain organized operational workflows.
  • Identify missing information, overdue tasks, or potential bottlenecks and follow up proactively.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely succeed in this role if you:

  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented.

AllTrails is the app for exploring the outdoors. We help people spend more time outside by connecting them to their next adventure. While this role does not require in-person attendance, we have a strong preference for candidates based in or near one of these cities: San Francisco CA, Portland OR, Seattle WA, Denver CO, and New York NY. Being in one of these cities creates opportunities to connect with teammates through Trail Days, co-working sessions, and local gatherings while still having the flexibility to work remotely. San Francisco employees are highly encouraged to come to the office one day per week. Please note that, at this time, we’re unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

About the role

This role leads a small, centralized engineering function of AllTrails that cross-functionally supports the entire business cross-functionally across separate product, data analytics, finance, and marketing teams. The team sits within the Maps & Data org and reports to the Director of Engineering.

The team's scope spans ownership of scalable data infrastructure, data governance, reliability, compliance, and the development and productionization of machine learning, AI, and algorithmic solutions that power internal operations and member-facing product experiences. A core focus of this role is building and maturing the team's MLOps capabilities, including model deployment pipelines, monitoring, and lifecycle management, alongside a strong foundation in hands-on data pipeline design, development, and operation.

This manager will be both a technical leader and a hands-on practitioner: someone who can roll up their sleeves on pipeline architecture and code reviews while also driving the strategy and culture needed to ship data and ML systems reliably into production.

What you'll be doing

  • Lead and support a small team of talented data engineers and applied data scientists, fostering their professional growth and ensuring high performance through coaching, performance management, hiring, and team health assessments

  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their needs, translate them into requirements, prioritize work, and communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs across a wide range of business-critical and product-critical data initiatives

  • Drive data governance, reliability, quality, cost-efficiency, privacy, compliance, and data access best practices across our data platform

  • Oversee the systems and processes that keep data flowing reliably across the organization, including orchestration, transformation, alerting, and production pipelines.

  • Own and mature the team's MLOps practice including architecture for model deployment, versioning, monitoring, drift detection, evaluation, retraining, and rollback — turning prototype models into dependable, production-grade systems

  • Champion the creation of tools to improve data and model cataloging, discoverability, documentation, and self-service to enhance overall democratization of data assets.

  • Troubleshoot complex data issues, performance bottlenecks, and system failures, providing timely and effective resolutions

  • Create leverage for the broader organization by improving time-to-insight, time-to-detect, time-to-debug, and overall deployment velocity for data-related work

  • Act as a thought partner on how AllTrails uses data, AI, and automation to improve internal productivity, trail content, map quality, personalization, and other member experiences

  • Balance long-term platform investment with near-term delivery needs

  • Architect, build, and maintain complex data pipelines for both batch and streaming workloads, moving data reliably to and from our data warehouse and operational systems; hands-on participation in research, diagramming, design reviews, code reviews, and on-call rotations is expected

  • Research, evaluate, and recommend new data technologies, tools, and platforms to enhance our data capabilities and improve efficiency

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering or ML engineering, with at least 3+ years in managing high-performing data engineering, machine learning, and product-applied data science teams

  • Comfort leading work across both platform foundations and applied data use cases, with the judgment to prioritize effectively across competing stakeholder needs

  • Demonstrated, hands-on experience designing, building, and operating complex data pipelines, both batch and streaming, using tools such as Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, Apache Beam, Google Dataflow, or equivalent

  • Multiple years of experience governing data infrastructure in Google Cloud Platform

  • Extensive proficiency in transforming and governing high-volume datasets in industry-standard columnar SQL-based warehouses such as BigQuery (preferred) or Snowflake, preferably with experience in ELT tools like Dataform or dbt

  • Proven expertise in leading the design, development, and maintenance of complex data pipelines using SQL and Python

  • Solid understanding of best data modeling techniques (e.g. dimensional modeling, star schema, data normalization)

  • Deep understanding and practical experience in data access patterns, storage solutions, caching, replication, and optimization techniques

  • Proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Direct experience leading the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices as they apply to both data pipelines and ML systems

  • Proven expertise leading the full MLOps lifecycle: model deployment, versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining pipelines, and rollback strategies in a production environment

  • Experience supporting AI/ML use-cases such as personalization, classification, ranking, recommendations, etc.

  • Willingness to be hands-on and participate in code reviews and an on-call support rotation (currently monthly)

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders, translate business requirements into detailed technical specifications, and own projects from inception through successful completion

  • Strong people leadership skills, including coaching senior ICs, giving clear feedback, growing careers, and building an inclusive, accountable team culture

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where you may need to zoom between strategic planning, stakeholder management, and hands-on technical decision-making.

  • Self-motivation and a deep sense of pride in your team's and your own work

  • Comfort with ambiguity and an instinct for moving quickly while maintaining high standards.

  • Humility, empathy, and open-mindedness – a commitment to a collaborative, ego-free environment

  • Passion for the outdoors

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with geospatial data, maps, tiling, graph databases, and/or routing

  • Experience working in a multi-cloud environment (GCP + AWS)

  • Experience working at a B2C company

  • Skilled at managing infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform)

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive and equitable compensation, including ownership through equity and performance-based bonuses

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage to support your physical and mental well-being

  • Unlimited PTO in addition to company holidays

  • Dedicated time once a month to test and improve our product through company-wide no-meeting days

  • Fully paid parental leave to birthing and non-birthing parents

  • 401k Match & access to financial wellness resources through Origin

  • Remote work stipend to help you design a comfortable and productive home office

  • Annual learning stipend to invest in your long-term professional growth and skills

  • Exclusive discounts on our subscriptions and merchandise for you and your friends & family

  • An authentic investment in you as a human being and a professional—we value your identity as much as your output

Nature celebrates you just the way you are and so do we! At AllTrails we’re passionate about nurturing an inclusive workplace that values diversity. It’s no secret that companies that are diverse in background, age, gender identity, race, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity, and perspective are proven to be more successful. We’re focused on creating an environment where everyone can do their best work and thrive.

AllTrails will consider all qualified applicants, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

This includes leading the integration of medical devices and diagnostic-enabling platforms (Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics) into patient journey frameworks for strategic CEERJ therapeutic areas (C3G/IC-MPGN, sHTG and secondarily haemophilia).

Own the patient journey agenda for C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG across CEERJ. Define, maintain and continuously refine a regional patient journey framework that identifies diagnostic difficulties, delays and post-therapy difficulties, and translates them into prioritized, measurable initiatives.

jobs.title: Applications Engineer - Membrion
jobs.description:
About Membrion

Membrion is a growing clean technology company transforming how industries manage wastewater. Our proprietary electro-ceramic desalination (ECD) technology helps industrial customers treat challenging wastewater streams, recover valuable resources, and reduce the environmental and financial costs of water treatment. Working across industries including semiconductor manufacturing, food and beverage, and consumer packaged goods, we're bringing innovative treatment solutions into real-world industrial operations.

Are you an engineer who loves solving problems that don't have obvious answers?

We're looking for an Applications Engineer who can turn complex customer challenges into practical, technically sound treatment solutions.

Working closely with our Sales, Technology, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success teams, you'll evaluate customer wastewater processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and develop integrated treatment solutions that balance technical performance, cost, and operational realities.

Our projects typically range from $500,000 to $5 million, and no two applications are quite the same. You'll need to think creatively, understand how different processes and equipment work together, and develop solutions that can be successfully integrated into existing industrial facilities.

This is a role for someone who enjoys getting into the details, challenging assumptions, and taking ownership of problems through to resolution. You'll have the independence to manage your work, the support of an experienced technical team, and the opportunity to see your solutions put into practice.

What You Will Do

Understand the Customer Application

•Gather and evaluate wastewater analyses, operating data, treatment objectives, site constraints, and existing infrastructure through customer discussions, records, and site inputs.

•Identify data gaps, likely root causes, ECD applicability, and technical risks; define the additional information or testing needed to advance the opportunity.

•Establish a traceable design basis that clearly distinguishes verified data, assumptions, and uncertainties.

Develop Integrated Treatment Solutions

  • Develop creative, practical treatment concepts that integrate ECD with appropriate pretreatment and downstream processes, considering existing customer equipment, infrastructure, and operational constraints.
  • Prepare process flow diagrams, mass balances, preliminary P&IDs where appropriate, and equipment and membrane sizing.
  • Evaluate treatment alternatives based on performance, recovery, utility requirements, capital and operating costs, and sensitivity to changing feed conditions.
  • Translate bench-scale and pilot results into practical design inputs, collaborating with Technology and Engineering to address system integration, safety, constructability, and operability before customer commitments.

Prepare Credible Technical Proposals

  • Prepare technical scopes, system descriptions, process drawings, equipment information, and supported performance expectations, with clear assumptions and exclusions.
  • Create customer proposals that balance customer technical requirements with project execution planning and risk mitigation.
  • Support Sales in customer technical discussions by explaining design choices, treatment tradeoffs, and the value of the proposed solution.
  • Check consistency across calculations, drawings, costs, scope, and performance claims; incorporate review feedback and maintain clear decision and revision records.

Deliver Reliably and Improve Future Applications

  • Manage assigned milestones across multiple opportunities, communicate progress proactively, and escalate missing inputs or technical blockers early.
  • Provide Engineering and Customer Success with clear and complete handoff documentation covering the design basis, scope boundaries, decisions, and unresolved items.
  • Use and improve approved calculators, templates, and workflows. Capture validated application learnings and share recurring customer needs with Product and the broader team.

Requirements

Qualifications:

We're interested in Applications Engineers who bring strong technical judgment, curiosity, and a practical approach to solving problems. While experience in industrial wastewater treatment is particularly valuable, we recognize that relevant skills can be developed through different engineering backgrounds and career paths.

  • Experience in applications engineering, process engineering, or a related technical role, ideally involving industrial water or wastewater treatment.
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex technical challenges and develop practical solutions.
  • An understanding of industrial processes, equipment integration, and the operational requirements of treatment systems.
  • Knowledge of water chemistry, mass balances, treatment performance, fouling, scaling, and operating cost considerations.
  • Ability to develop and review engineering calculations, process flow diagrams, technical specifications, and proposal documentation.
  • Sound engineering judgment, including the ability to recognize incomplete information, challenge assumptions, and identify when further technical validation is required.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and commercial colleagues.
  • A proactive, self-directed approach to work, with the ability to manage competing priorities and take ownership of deliverables.
  • Comfort working in a collaborative, predominantly remote environment where communication, initiative, and follow-through are essential.

Experience That Would Be Particularly Valuable

  • Direct experience with industrial wastewater treatment systems, particularly membrane processes such as UF, NF, RO, or related technologies.
  • Experience designing, sizing, or specifying packaged process equipment, including skid-mounted or containerized systems.
  • Hands-on experience with equipment commissioning, field startup, operational troubleshooting, or supporting equipment integration at customer facilities.
  • Experience preparing technical proposals, process flow diagrams, preliminary P&IDs, or CAPEX/OPEX evaluations.
  • Experience with industrial applications in semiconductor manufacturing, food and beverage, or consumer packaged goods.
  • A background in chemical, environmental, mechanical, or related engineering disciplines.

We value practical experience and demonstrated capability over any particular educational pathway. Candidates with transferable experience and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.

You'll Thrive in This Role If You...

  • Love solving complex technical problems, especially when the answer isn't immediately obvious.
  • Take initiative, work independently, and follow problems through to resolution.
  • Can balance technical detail with practical commercial and operational considerations.
  • Enjoy collaborating with people from different technical and commercial backgrounds.
  • Want to see your engineering work translate into real-world environmental and operational impact.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in recognizing the experience, expertise, and contributions of our team. We offer a competitive compensation package and the opportunity to be part of a growing company working on meaningful environmental challenges.

  • Base Salary: $90,000–145,000 USD annually, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications.
  • Work Arrangement: Predominantly remote, with opportunities to collaborate in person with colleagues and customers.
  • Travel: Approximately 25–30%, including customer site visits and occasional travel to our Seattle facility.
  • Health & Wellness: Medical, dental and vision coverage through CAMPS Health Trust, starting the first of the month after you join, with no long waiting period. Also includes life and AD&D insurance, optional additional life coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program.

Why Membrion?

Solve problems that matter. Industrial wastewater treatment is a complex challenge, and the solutions aren't always obvious. At Membrion, we're developing technology that helps industries treat difficult wastewater streams, recover valuable resources, and reduce their environmental impact. Your engineering work will have a tangible, real-world purpose.

Work with genuinely innovative technology. Our electro-ceramic desalination (ECD) technology is opening up new possibilities for industrial wastewater treatment. You'll work on challenging applications where conventional approaches don't always deliver, combining established engineering principles with creative thinking to develop better solutions.

See your ideas become reality. This isn't a role where your work ends with a calculation or a drawing. You'll help develop solutions that become real equipment, integrated into operating industrial facilities. You'll have opportunities to see your work in action and understand the impact of your engineering decisions.

Have the freedom to figure things out. We're a growing company, and we value people who take initiative, ask good questions, and find ways forward. You'll have the autonomy to own your work, the support of experienced colleagues, and the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution without layers of bureaucracy.

Work with people who care about getting it right. We're a collaborative team of engineers, scientists, and commercial professionals who bring different perspectives to the same challenges. We value curiosity, accountability, practical problem-solving, and people who are willing to roll up their sleeves and help each other succeed.

Our Core Values

  • See What Isn't Obvious
  • Relentlessly Flow Like a River
  • Obnoxiously Reliable
  • All in This Together
  • Better Each Day

jobs.title: Programmatic Director
jobs.description:
The Shipyard is a leading, independent marketing and communication agency headquartered in Columbus, OH and San Diego, CA that brings together talented individuals across the creative, communications, media and digital landscape. Uniquely designed to Engineer Brand Love through a unifying approach of paid, owned and earned channels, we work together to grow brands that audiences can't help but love.

Our family of brands, Fahlgren Mortine, TURNER and TinyWins, span integrated communications, travel and lifestyle, and digital innovation, giving us the range and depth to deliver for clients locally, regionally and nationally.

Momentum is nothing without the people driving it. See who we are at before you hit apply!

SUMMARY

We are looking for a smart, experienced, and motivated Programmatic Director to join our team.

The Programmatic Director is the senior-most leader of the programmatic practice at The Shipyard. This role exists to set the vision for how Shipyard approaches programmatic advertising — establishing the strategic and technical standard, developing the talent pipeline, driving the growth of client relationships, and ensuring the programmatic team consistently delivers work that is best-in-class.

A great Programmatic Director doesn't just oversee campaigns — they define what great programmatic looks like for the entire team and for the agency. They are a trusted strategic advisor to clients, a visible expert in the programmatic marketplace, and a leader who makes everyone around them better.

At The Shipyard, we know that it's your unique talents, backgrounds, and perspectives that make you who you are, just like our team, who come from various career paths and experiences. We believe we can't be truly diverse without you bringing your most authentic self to the agency.

Studies show that people from marginalized communities may not always apply for positions if they don't meet every single requirement in a job posting. At The Shipyard, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements. We believe that your passion for what we stand for — our values and purpose — is just as important as meeting every checkbox.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Media Knowledge

The Programmatic Director is the foremost programmatic expert at the agency. Your knowledge is not just deep — it is visionary, and you use it to set the direction for how the team thinks, plans, and executes.

  • Possess and actively demonstrate expert, current, and forward-looking knowledge of the full programmatic ecosystem — DSPs, SSPs, ad exchanges, identity solutions, data clean rooms, AI-driven optimization, emerging programmatic formats, and the evolving privacy landscape — and apply it to set the strategic direction for the programmatic team
  • Define and evolve the standards for how programmatic platforms and technology are used across the team — ensuring rigorous, sophisticated application that consistently delivers competitive advantage for clients
  • Serve as the senior-most steward of client investment within the programmatic practice — ensuring budgets are managed responsibly, billing processes are accurate and timely across every account, and the team treats client spend with the same care they would their own
  • Lead the agency's thinking on programmatic investment strategy, budget allocation, and technology evaluation — setting a high bar for how programmatic campaigns are planned, executed, and measured
  • Serve as the agency's internal and external thought leader on programmatic — bringing a clear, informed, and forward-thinking POV to client conversations, industry discussions, and new business opportunities
  • Proactively identify and evaluate emerging programmatic platforms, technology shifts, privacy developments, and industry disruptions — and translate them into clear strategic implications for clients and the agency
  • Build and maintain the agency's most strategic platform and technology partnerships — negotiating at the highest level to secure preferential access, beta opportunities, and competitive intelligence that benefit clients across the portfolio

Strategic Thinking & Planning

The Programmatic Director sets the strategic vision for the programmatic team and ensures that sophisticated, insight-driven channel strategy is embedded in every campaign across the portfolio. This role creates a programmatic practice that delivers on client solutions so effectively that it attracts spend and growth.

  • Set and own the strategic vision for programmatic advertising across the agency's client portfolio — ensuring every channel plan reflects a sophisticated audience strategy, a defensible inventory and targeting approach, and a measurable commitment to business outcomes
  • Bring a strong, informed point of view to the evolution of the agency’s programmatic strategy frameworks, best practices, and optimization standards – partnering with the VP, Media Investment to ensure consistency, ambition, and continuous improvement across all accounts and team members
  • Lead the development of programmatic strategy for the agency's most complex and high-value accounts — applying the highest level of strategic rigor to multi-channel, full-funnel programmatic challenges
  • Drive a culture of insight-driven strategy across the programmatic team — ensuring data, platform intelligence, and audience research are consistently embedded in how the team plans, optimizes, and learns
  • Identify transformative strategic opportunities for clients — new programmatic approaches, emerging technology applications, advanced measurement capabilities — and bring them forward with a compelling business case
  • Serve as the programmatic strategic anchor in all cross-functional, new business, and client leadership contexts — ensuring programmatic thinking actively elevates the overall media strategy across the agency

Communication

The Programmatic Director is an exceptionally skilled communicator who can move a room, build client confidence, and inspire the programmatic team. Your communication sets the tone for the entire practice.

  • Lead client presentations with authority, strategic depth, and the ability to connect programmatic thinking to business outcomes in a way that earns trust and wins confidence
  • Develop and drive a communication standard for the programmatic team — in presentations, in campaign reporting, and in day-to-day client interactions — that consistently reflects Shipyard's ambition and expertise
  • Communicate complex, multi-faceted programmatic strategies to senior client stakeholders, C-suite audiences, and agency leadership clearly, persuasively, and memorably
  • Represent Shipyard's programmatic capabilities and POV externally — in industry forums, new business contexts, and marketplace conversations — with confidence and conviction
  • Coach and develop strong communicators across the programmatic team, from Coordinators through Associate Directors, ensuring communication excellence at every level

Partnership

The Programmatic Director builds and leads the relationships across the agency’s programmatic practice — with clients, with platform partners, and across the integrated agency team.

  • Serve as the senior client programmatic partner for the agency's highest-value accounts — building deep, trust-based partnerships rooted in strategic value and business impact
  • Manage agency relationships with key DSP platforms, data partners, and programmatic technology vendors — leveraging relationships to build preferential access and identifying opportunities that create meaningful competitive advantage across the client portfolio
  • Partner closely with media planning, analytics, creative, client engagement, and brand planning to drive integrated, outcome-focused work across the agency
  • Build a strong working relationship with the data and analytics team – ensuring programmatic campaigns are grounded in data intelligence and that measurement is built into the work from the start, not bolted on at the end
  • Serve as a senior leader for the programmatic practice in new business, agency growth, and industry contexts — building The Shipyard's reputation as a programmatic leader in the marketplace
  • Model and champion a culture of partnership — across the programmatic team, across the agency, and in the marketplace

Team Development

The Programmatic Director is a committed people leader who builds a strong, capable programmatic team. Building, developing, and retaining great programmatic practitioners is among the most important things this role does.

  • Directly manage the programmatic team, including hiring, onboarding, development, and performance management
  • Build and sustain a high-performing team culture defined by technical excellence, strategic rigor, intellectual curiosity, genuine collaboration, and a commitment to doing great work
  • Develop a strong bench of talent at every level — from Coordinator through Associate Director — ensuring the team is always growing toward the next level of capability
  • Set clear performance expectations and hold team members accountable with fairness, directness, and genuine care for their development
  • Serve as a mentor and career advisor to senior practitioners and Associate Directors, helping them develop the leadership skills and strategic vision to grow into the next generation of programmatic leaders at Shipyard
  • Partner with the VP, Media Investment on workforce planning, talent acquisition strategy, and team structure to ensure the programmatic practice is built for long-term success

WHAT YOU’LL GET

  • The overall target range of base compensation for this role is $135,000 - $150,000. Compensation offered will be determined by additional factors such as location and experience.
  • Open PTO
  • Paid sick time (in applicable states)
  • Flexible work hours
  • Paid holidays + holiday closure between Christmas Eve and New Year’s Day
  • Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance and disability benefits
  • 401k program with employer matching
  • 6 weeks paid parental leave
  • Employee bonus referrals
  • Dog-friendly offices
  • Company-provided snacks and beverages (yes, beer/wine included)
  • … and lots more!

Requirements

  • Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for visa sponsorship.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working with complex software products and can understand how technical systems function without relying entirely on high-level marketing descriptions.

You'll develop positioning for AI-enabled product experiences, workflow automation, data intelligence capabilities, and related platform features.

You'll help explain how these tools can support operational efficiency, improve access to business information, and simplify complex workflows.

You'll also help define the language customers use to understand emerging AI functionality, including what a feature does, what information it uses, and where human review remains necessary.

A major part of this role will involve distinguishing meaningful product capabilities from broad AI marketing claims.

You'll collaborate with technical teams to understand how features operate, what their limitations are, and which customer problems they are designed to solve.

You'll develop messaging that communicates product value accurately while avoiding unsupported claims about automation, intelligence, reliability, or outcomes.

You'll conduct market research to understand how businesses evaluate AI-powered software and data products, including concerns about trust, implementation, accuracy, and return on investment.

You'll analyze competing platforms and emerging product capabilities to identify opportunities for differentiation.

You'll partner with product teams to prepare launches, develop customer-facing narratives, and determine how new technical functionality should be introduced to the market.

You'll create technical product overviews, launch briefs, sales enablement materials, demonstrations, and educational resources.

You'll also work with customer success teams to help existing customers understand and adopt relevant AI and data capabilities.

Because Bask Health operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll need to approach AI positioning carefully and collaborate with appropriate stakeholders when messaging touches clinical, patient, or pharmacy workflows.

You'll help establish consistent terminology for AI, analytics, and automation across marketing materials and customer communications.

You'll measure the effectiveness of product marketing initiatives using customer feedback, launch outcomes, adoption trends, and commercial performance indicators.

We're looking for someone who combines technical curiosity, strong product marketing judgment, clear communication, and the ability to take ownership of initiatives from early research through launch and measurement.

What You'll Do

  • Own technical product marketing strategy for Bask Health's AI and data capabilities.
  • Develop positioning and messaging for AI-enabled platform features.
  • Create clear value propositions for data intelligence and automation tools.
  • Translate technical functionality into understandable customer benefits.
  • Build messaging frameworks for AI-powered product experiences.
  • Develop product narratives for business intelligence and data exploration capabilities.
  • Support positioning for BaskQL and related conversational analytics functionality, as applicable.
  • Explain how AI-enabled tools support merchant and operational workflows.
  • Partner with AI engineers to understand feature architecture and technical limitations.
  • Collaborate with data stakeholders to understand analytics capabilities and underlying information.
  • Work with product managers to define go-to-market strategies for technical features.
  • Lead cross-functional launch planning for AI and data product releases.
  • Conduct customer research to understand AI adoption needs and concerns.
  • Identify customer questions related to accuracy, reliability, transparency, and usability.
  • Develop messaging that accurately communicates supported AI functionality.
  • Coordinate technical validation of product claims with relevant stakeholders.
  • Research competing AI-enabled SaaS platforms and data intelligence products.
  • Develop competitive positioning and differentiation materials.
  • Create technical product presentations, feature overviews, and launch briefs.
  • Build sales enablement resources for technical product conversations.
  • Support product demonstrations and customer education initiatives.
  • Partner with customer success teams to improve AI feature adoption.
  • Develop educational materials explaining new automation and analytics capabilities.
  • Collaborate with growth and marketing teams on technical product campaigns.
  • Support website and landing page messaging for AI and data products.
  • Establish consistent technical terminology across customer-facing materials.
  • Define launch objectives and evaluate product marketing effectiveness.
  • Present technical product marketing strategies, research findings, and recommendations to leadership.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in product marketing, preferably within B2B SaaS, AI software, data platforms, or developer-focused technology.
  • Demonstrated experience marketing technical software products.
  • Experience developing product positioning and differentiated messaging.
  • Proven ability to lead go-to-market strategies and product launches.
  • Strong understanding of B2B SaaS products and customer buying processes.
  • Working knowledge of AI-enabled software capabilities and common limitations.
  • Familiarity with data platforms, analytics products, or workflow automation software.
  • Ability to understand technical product functionality and explain it clearly.
  • Experience collaborating directly with engineers and technical product managers.
  • Strong written communication and technical storytelling skills.
  • Experience developing technical value propositions for different customer audiences.
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts without overstating product capabilities.
  • Experience conducting customer, market, and competitive research.
  • Ability to identify customer needs and translate them into positioning strategies.
  • Experience creating technical sales enablement materials.
  • Experience developing product launch briefs, presentations, and educational content.
  • Ability to collaborate with sales and customer success teams.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with product adoption and launch performance metrics.
  • Experience managing cross-functional product marketing initiatives.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and presentation abilities.
  • Comfortable working in a rapidly evolving technical environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate technical communication.

Nice to Have

  • Product marketing experience at an AI or machine learning software company.
  • Experience marketing analytics, business intelligence, or data infrastructure products.
  • Familiarity with large language models and generative AI applications.
  • Understanding of AI agents, tool use, and workflow automation.
  • Experience positioning conversational analytics or natural-language data tools.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation and AI-assisted search.
  • Understanding of AI evaluation, reliability, and quality considerations.
  • Experience working with technical APIs and software integrations.
  • Familiarity with SQL and structured data concepts.
  • Experience marketing developer tools or technically complex SaaS platforms.
  • Understanding of product-led growth strategies.
  • Experience developing AI product demonstrations.
  • Familiarity with AI product adoption and customer education programs.
  • Experience supporting sales teams with technical competitive comparisons.
  • Understanding of data privacy, security, and responsible AI communication.
  • Experience working with healthcare technology or telehealth platforms.
  • Familiarity with operational analytics and merchant intelligence tools.
  • Experience marketing white-label or embedded software products.
  • Experience building technical product marketing functions in growing companies.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted product development workflows and tools.
