jobs.title: Commercial SOC Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title: Commercial SOC Analyst

Reporting to: Head of SOC

Location: Remote

Hours of Work: 12 Hour shift pattern, day and night shifts including working weekends and public holidays

Future requirement to join on-call rota

We are looking for a Cyber Security Analyst to join our Remote Security Operations Centre (SOC). You will ideally have some hands-on experience within a commercial SOC environment and a solid understanding of cyber security principles, threat detection, and incident response. We would also welcome applications from individuals who can demonstrate a genuine passion for cyber security, a proactive mindset, and a strong desire to help protect both our customers and our internal environments from evolving cyber threats.

The Role:

You are going to be responsible for triaging, investigating, classifying, and managing cyber security incidents. We collect log data from any sources our customers require reactive monitoring of, along with deploying agents to provide proactive protection.

You will need to be comfortable with managing multiple simultaneous tasks, at different stages, each with their own priorities across different customers. You’ll have a team to support you along with time to develop yourself.

Once you’ve identified an event which requires our customer to be alerted, you’ll follow defined processes to raise this. You will also need to provide our customers with support to help prevent any damage to them and ensure that it doesn’t happen again.

We have Threat Intelligence feeds which will aide you in keeping up to date with the latest tools, techniques, and procedures. You will also use this intelligence to proactively hunt for threats and create or update existing detection rules.

This role, in addition to protective monitoring, will involve Vulnerability Management and asset discovery, including configuring custom scans and dashboards. You will be required to ensure that our vulnerability scanning service remains a valuable asset to our customers by providing contextualised information and analysis. You will have team support to achieve this.

As a team we’re always looking to raise the bar, learn new things and incorporate new technologies and you will too! You’ll share your knowledge with the team and the wider Cyberfort community, contributing to Group blogs and undertaking research related to technology enhancements.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform event triage and incident analysis

  • Provide advice and guidance in the event of a cyber security breach

  • Help maintain documentation owned by the CSOC team including but not limited to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)

  • Assist with/own ad-hoc requests (within reason)

  • Remain current on cyber security trends and intelligence

  • Identify opportunities to automate processes within the CSOC

  • Stakeholder and Client Reporting (incident reports and vulnerability management)

Nice to have (any of these):

  • Programming/scripting skills

  • Experience in operational security

  • Experience in Systems administration (Linux/Windows)

  • Experience in open-source threat intelligence

  • General IT practices

  • General security practices and knowledge

  • IT Service Management basics (ITIL)

  • Knowledge of:

    • Cyber threats and vulnerabilities

    • Adversarial tactics, techniques, and procedures

    • Incident response and handling methodologies

    • Risk management processes

    • IT architecture and operations (computing, network, storage & cloud)

    • Computer networking concepts and protocols, and network security methodologies

    • Responding to audit and regulatory requirements

    • Familiarization of the MITRE ATT&CK Framework.

  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and/or holidays in the event of an incident response emergency

Why Join Cyberfort

At Cyberfort, we're committed to creating an environment where our people can do their best work, develop their careers and feel part of something meaningful. Alongside a supportive culture and opportunities to grow, we've offer a package that supports your health, wellbeing, finances, development and work-life balance, helping you feel your best both inside and outside of work. Our benefits include:

  • 25 days annual leave, plus bank holidays, and your birthday day off

  • The option to buy and sell annual leave

  • Hybrid and flexible working opportunities (where applicable)

  • Enhanced family-friendly policies

  • Company pension scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Private Medical Insurance and wellbeing support

  • Professional training, certifications and learning opportunities

  • Employee referral bonus scheme

  • Recognition and reward programmes

  • Electric Car & Cycle to Work scheme

  • Discounts and savings through our employee benefits platform

A place where you can be yourself

At Cyberfort, we believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger. We're committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, supported and able to be themselves at work.

We know that talent comes in many forms, and we're dedicated to ensuring our recruitment process is accessible and inclusive for all. If there's anything we can do to support you during your application or interview experience, we'd encourage you to let us know.

We're proud to champion inclusion through our partnerships and commitments, including:

  • Signatories of the Armed Forces Covenant

  • Corporate Members of Neurodiversity in Business

  • A Disability Confident Employer

  • Supporters of the CyberFirst initiative

We're continually learning, listening and evolving to build a workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive, grow and make a meaningful impact.

About Cyberfort

Cyberfort helps organisations stay ahead of cyber threats. We work alongside businesses and public sector organisations to strengthen their security, identify vulnerabilities and respond to threats before they become incidents.

Our expertise spans cyber security consultancy, penetration testing and managed detection and response (MDR). From helping customers understand their cyber risks and improve their security posture, to testing critical systems and providing 24/7 threat monitoring, we deliver practical solutions that help organisations operate with confidence.

What makes Cyberfort different is our people. We combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative, customer-first approach, building trusted partnerships and helping our customers navigate an ever-changing threat landscape.

Our Values

At Cyberfort, how we work is just as important as what we do. Our culture is built around five core values: being curious, working as a team, staying agile, taking ownership, and thinking innovatively.

We’re looking for individuals who are naturally inquisitive, collaborative, and adaptable people who take pride in their work, are open to learning, and are always looking for ways to improve both themselves and the way we deliver for our customers.

APPLY NOW:

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to move quickly through our selection process, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you would like to apply for this role, we'd like to see your CV and a cover letter.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Product Engineer to build and improve software features that solve real problems for Bask Health's merchants, internal teams, and platform users.

This role combines full-stack product engineering with direct exposure to the people and workflows our software supports. You'll work closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and customer-facing teams to understand user needs, identify product opportunities, and turn those insights into working features.

Rather than focusing exclusively on technical integrations or one-off implementations, you'll help develop reusable product functionality that improves the experience for multiple merchants and users across Bask's platform.

You'll work across frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and application workflows. Your projects may involve merchant dashboards, storefront functionality, patient experiences, internal tools, or improvements to existing platform features.

This is a hands-on engineering position with meaningful product ownership. You'll contribute to defining solutions, implementing features, testing functionality, and improving the product based on feedback and real-world usage.

We're looking for someone who enjoys building software, understands the connection between technical decisions and user experience, and takes initiative when identifying opportunities to make a product better.

What You'll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy product features across Bask Health's platform.
  • Work directly with product, engineering, and customer-facing teams to understand user needs and technical requirements.
  • Develop full-stack functionality using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, or comparable technologies.
  • Build intuitive frontend interfaces for merchants and internal platform users.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and application logic supporting new product features.
  • Translate user feedback and operational challenges into practical product improvements.
  • Participate in technical discovery and solution planning for new features.
  • Build reusable components and functionality that can support multiple merchants and use cases.
  • Improve existing product workflows to reduce friction and increase usability.
  • Develop features for merchant dashboards, platform configuration, and operational tools.
  • Contribute to patient-facing or internal application functionality when needed.
  • Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and services.
  • Work with SQL databases and application data to support product functionality.
  • Build and maintain third-party integrations when required for product features.
  • Collaborate with designers to implement polished, responsive user interfaces.
  • Help define technical requirements and evaluate implementation approaches.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows through better product design.
  • Develop prototypes and proof-of-concept features to validate product ideas.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production code.
  • Implement appropriate validation, error handling, and application security.
  • Troubleshoot product issues and investigate bugs affecting user experiences.
  • Improve application performance, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering architecture decisions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate feature effectiveness and identify improvements.
  • Document technical decisions, feature behavior, and reusable components.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering productivity.
  • Take ownership of assigned product initiatives from discovery through deployment and iteration.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, product engineering, full-stack development, or a comparable hands-on technical role.
  • Strong programming experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience developing frontend applications using React or comparable frameworks.
  • Experience building backend services, APIs, or application logic using Node.js or comparable technologies.
  • Familiarity with Next.js or other modern full-stack web frameworks.
  • Experience developing and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong understanding of frontend and backend application architecture.
  • Experience working with REST APIs or comparable integration technologies.
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and relational data.
  • Experience building reusable frontend components and application functionality.
  • Understanding of responsive web development and user interface fundamentals.
  • Experience translating product requirements into working software.
  • Ability to independently implement features across multiple application layers.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience writing maintainable, well-structured production code.
  • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and secure application development.
  • Understanding of application validation, error handling, and reliability.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative software development workflows.
  • Familiarity with automated testing and software quality practices.
  • Experience collaborating with product managers, designers, and engineers.
  • Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend practical solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to user experience.
  • Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to different stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ownership of assigned projects.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a Product Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, or Full-Stack Engineer.
  • Experience working directly with customers or users to understand product needs.
  • Experience building merchant-facing SaaS applications.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, storefronts, or subscription commerce.
  • Experience developing configurable or white-label software products.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript in production.
  • Familiarity with tRPC, Prisma, or Drizzle ORM.
  • Experience with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable cloud technologies.
  • Familiarity with event-driven application architectures.
  • Experience building dashboards, administrative tools, or workflow management applications.
  • Experience integrating third-party services using APIs and webhooks.
  • Familiarity with Stripe or other payment processing integrations.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
  • Experience building internal tools or operational automation.
  • Familiarity with product analytics, feature experimentation, or A/B testing.
  • Experience with design systems and reusable UI component libraries.
  • Experience developing healthcare or telehealth applications.
  • Understanding of healthcare data privacy and security considerations.
  • Experience contributing to product discovery or technical prototyping.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

jobs.title: Client Partner, Consumer Products & Services - US-Based
jobs.description:
About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As a Client Partner at Toptal, you will be responsible for growing and deepening relationships with our enterprise clients by understanding their business challenges, identifying new opportunities, and bringing together the right solutions to help them succeed. You will own the commercial growth, strategic development, and long-term health of an assigned portfolio of clients, turning established relationships into broader, more valuable partnerships.

This is a highly consultative, commercially driven role for professionals who are as curious about solving business problems as they are motivated to grow revenue. You will immerse yourself in your clients’ businesses, understand the pressures and opportunities shaping their industries, and proactively identify where Toptal can make a meaningful difference. Rather than waiting for clients to tell you what they need, you will bring ideas, challenge conventional thinking, and work with our experts to shape solutions that address both immediate priorities and longer-term strategic objectives.

We are looking for individuals who combine the commercial drive of a business developer, the problem-solving mindset of a consultant, and the relationship skills of a trusted advisor. You should be energized by uncovering opportunities within complex organizations, expanding into new business units, building executive relationships, and converting ideas into meaningful commercial engagements. At Toptal, we believe our potential is defined by the problems we can solve and the outcomes we can deliver for our clients. With capabilities spanning technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent, we have the opportunity to take on increasingly complex and meaningful business challenges. Realizing that potential requires people who think beyond the immediate ask, challenge conventional approaches, and bring the initiative and judgment to turn ideas into results.

We have high expectations of ourselves and the people we work alongside. We value individuals who combine intellectual curiosity with commercial ambition, move with urgency, and take personal ownership of outcomes. You will have the autonomy to shape client strategies, challenge assumptions, and bring forward new ideas, but you will also be expected to execute with discipline, collaborate effectively, and deliver measurable results. We are building a business that can compete at the highest levels, and we expect our Client Partners to help lead that ambition.

Your focus is on growing and retaining existing enterprise clients. Enterprise Sales Executives acquire new clients and secure the initial commercial engagement. From that point forward, you will own the ongoing commercial relationship, including identifying and closing expansion opportunities, renewals, extensions, and additional agreements. You will also be accountable for client satisfaction, retention, and the continued growth and diversification of your portfolio.

You will be expected to grow and manage a substantial portfolio, with an annualized gross revenue expectation of $10M+ as your portfolio matures. Success will be measured by sustained revenue growth, retention, client satisfaction, account diversification, and your ability to establish Toptal as a valued partner across increasingly important areas of your clients’ businesses. Toptal’s Consumer Products and Services (CP&S) portfolio serves leading consumer brands and retailers across three segments: Consumer Packaged Goods, Retail and eCommerce, and Hospitality and Consumer Services. Retail and eCommerce is one of our priority growth segments, spanning eCommerce, Traditional Retail, Mass Merchandisers, Grocery and Convenience, and Food Service. Our clients face margin pressure, shifting consumer behavior and the need to turn AI into measurable results. Toptal helps them move faster by combining Professional and Managed Services, backed by top talent and AI-first capabilities.

This is a remote position with a strong expectation of regular, in-person client engagement. You will be expected to spend meaningful time in the field, building executive relationships, uncovering opportunities, and advancing commercial growth. Travel is an integral part of this role, not an occasional requirement. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

You will own the commercial strategy and growth of assigned enterprise client relationships, serving as a strategic partner who understands each client’s business, identifies emerging needs, and proactively develops opportunities to deliver greater value. You will work across client organizations to uncover challenges, shape solutions, and expand Toptal’s role in helping clients achieve their objectives.

This is not a passive account management role. You will be expected to continuously create demand within your accounts, build new relationships, and bring forward ideas that lead to new commercial opportunities. You will have strong partners across Toptal, but you will be personally accountable for driving growth and advancing the commercial relationship.

Understand your clients’ businesses. Develop a deep understanding of client strategies, operating models, industry dynamics, competitive pressures, and emerging priorities. Ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and identify business problems and opportunities where Toptal can deliver meaningful value.

Proactively shape solutions. Bring thoughtful ideas and recommendations to clients, working with Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams to develop differentiated, commercially viable solutions that address their challenges and create measurable business outcomes.

Own portfolio growth and commercial performance. Take direct accountability for revenue growth, retention, expansion, diversification, and the overall commercial health of your assigned client portfolio. Set ambitious growth objectives and execute with the discipline and urgency required to achieve them.

Hunt for opportunities within existing clients. Identify unmet needs, new initiatives, and emerging challenges across business units and functions. Create demand, develop opportunities, and convert those opportunities into new engagements and revenue rather than relying on existing business to sustain performance.

Expand and diversify client relationships. Build relationships across business units, geographies, functions, and executive stakeholders, reducing dependence on individual buyers, engagements, or service offerings.

Lead ongoing commercial engagements. Own renewals, extensions, ancillary agreements, and all subsequent commercial opportunities following the initial new-client signing, including opportunity development, solution positioning, pricing, negotiation, contracting, and close. Build trusted executive partnerships. Establish credibility with senior business and technology leaders through informed perspectives, sound judgment, and a genuine understanding of their priorities. Become a partner clients turn to when navigating important business decisions.

Develop and execute strategic account plans. Build actionable growth strategies informed by client priorities, competitive positioning, whitespace opportunities, buying centers, and long-term revenue potential. Translate those strategies into specific actions, measurable objectives, and commercial results.

Connect client challenges to Toptal’s capabilities. Identify opportunities to bring together technology, AI, marketing, management consulting, managed services, and specialized talent in ways that address client needs and broaden the value of our relationships.

Own commercial client health and retention. Maintain a clear understanding of client satisfaction, relationship strength, delivery performance, and emerging risks. Partner proactively with Client Management and Delivery teams to address concerns, protect revenue, and strengthen long-term relationships. Take ownership of the commercial relationship without assuming responsibility for day-to-day delivery execution.

Collaborate across client teams. Work closely with other Client Partners, Industry GMs, Sales Leaders, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Client Management, and Delivery teams to share insights, coordinate account strategies, and develop solutions across complex client organizations. Where multiple Client Partners support an account, operate within clearly defined commercial ownership and a coordinated account strategy.

Lead complex expansion pursuits. Bring together the right expertise to develop compelling proposals, navigate enterprise buying processes, negotiate commercial terms, and close new business within existing accounts.

Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence. Own expansion pipeline development, forecasting accuracy, account planning, and visibility into commercial opportunities and risks. Make informed decisions, maintain momentum, and take accountability for the quality of your execution. Set a high standard for performance and execution. Operate with urgency, preparation, and personal accountability. Bring thoughtful perspectives to client conversations, follow through on commitments, and continuously look for ways to improve client outcomes and commercial performance. Take ownership of challenges, work across teams to solve them, and hold yourself accountable for delivering measurable results.

Represent the voice of the client. Bring client feedback, emerging needs, and market insights into Toptal to help inform our solutions, capabilities, and overall client experience.

We are looking for Client Partners who are genuinely interested in how businesses work, why challenges exist, and how they can be solved. The strongest performers will consistently turn that curiosity into new ideas, stronger relationships, and meaningful commercial growth.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard with Toptal and develop a strong understanding of our business model, value proposition, capabilities, and expectations for performance.
  • Familiarize yourself with our commercial operating model, account ownership principles, and client engagement processes.
  • Meet the Industry, Practice, Pursuits, Client Management, and Delivery leaders who will support your success.
  • Understand our approach to account planning, opportunity management, forecasting, and commercial execution.
  • Become familiar with our contracting, legal, and renewal processes.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Develop a strong understanding of your assigned client portfolio, including business priorities, active engagements, executive relationships, current revenue, and growth potential.
  • Begin engaging client stakeholders to understand their strategic objectives, operating challenges, and emerging priorities.
  • Work with your Industry GM or Sales Leader to develop account strategies and identify priority opportunities for growth.
  • Assess account health, renewal exposure, concentration risks, and opportunities to expand into new business units or service offerings.
  • Establish a regular operating cadence with Client Management and Delivery teams to understand engagement performance, client feedback, and potential growth signals.
  • Begin identifying business problems and opportunities where Toptal’s broader capabilities could deliver additional value.
  • Establish clear priorities and a disciplined operating rhythm that supports proactive client engagement and commercial execution.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Establish credibility with senior client stakeholders through informed, consultative conversations tied to their business priorities.
  • Develop actionable account growth plans that connect client needs and strategic initiatives to specific commercial opportunities.
  • Proactively bring new ideas and potential solutions to clients, collaborating with internal experts to shape compelling approaches.
  • Build and advance a qualified pipeline of expansion opportunities across your assigned portfolio.
  • Lead renewals, extensions, and additional commercial engagements with sound judgment and clear accountability.
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of client satisfaction, commercial risks, and opportunities to strengthen long-term relationships.
  • Establish effective collaboration with other Client Partners and cross-functional teams supporting shared or complex accounts.
  • Demonstrate ownership of your commercial objectives through consistent execution, accurate forecasting, and measurable progress against your growth plan.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable portfolio growth through new opportunities, expanded relationships, and additional commercial engagements.
  • Develop a deeper understanding of client business challenges and translate that knowledge into proactive, solutions-led commercial pursuits.
  • Expand executive relationships and increase Toptal’s presence across business units, geographies, and service offerings.
  • Introduce new capabilities and solutions that address emerging client priorities and create additional sources of revenue.
  • Proactively identify and address client satisfaction and retention risks in partnership with Client Management and Delivery.
  • Successfully lead renewals, extensions, and complex expansion opportunities through negotiation and close.
  • Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline and accurate portfolio forecast.
  • Demonstrate consistent progress against ambitious growth objectives, with clear evidence of personal initiative, commercial judgment, and disciplined execution.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver sustained revenue growth and retention across your assigned client portfolio, progressing toward or maintaining a $10M+ annualized gross revenue expectation.
  • Establish deeper, more diversified client partnerships with broader executive engagement and increased strategic relevance.
  • Demonstrate a strong track record of identifying client challenges, proactively shaping solutions, and converting those solutions into new commercial engagements.
  • Expand Toptal’s presence across client organizations through new buying centers, capabilities, and strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain strong client satisfaction and proactively manage risks that could affect retention or growth.
  • Build a repeatable approach to account planning, opportunity development, and solutions-led commercial execution.
  • Be recognized for your ability to combine thoughtful client engagement with commercial ambition, strong execution, and measurable results.
  • Contribute to broader team success through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 7–10+ years of experience in enterprise client development, strategic account growth, consulting, or professional services, ideally within technology services, management consulting, or managed services.
  • Demonstrated success growing complex enterprise relationships through a combination of consultative selling, proactive opportunity creation, and strategic account development.
  • Experience managing substantial enterprise client portfolios, ideally with annualized revenue of $5M–$10M+.
  • Strong business acumen and intellectual curiosity, with a demonstrated ability to understand complex client challenges, ask insightful questions, challenge assumptions, and develop commercially viable approaches to solving them.
  • Proven ability to identify emerging client needs, shape solutions, and create opportunities beyond existing engagements or stated requirements.
  • Experience expanding enterprise relationships across multiple business units, executive stakeholders, geographies, and service offerings.
  • Ability to engage credibly with C-suite executives on business strategy, operating challenges, emerging technologies, and industry trends.
  • Demonstrated success originating and closing complex expansion opportunities, including technology, consulting, and managed services engagements.
  • Experience negotiating renewals, extensions, complex service agreements, and additional commercial engagements with enterprise procurement and legal teams.
  • Strong understanding of emerging technologies, including AI, and the ability to connect new capabilities to practical client business needs.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute strategic account plans that identify whitespace, deepen relationships, and drive sustained commercial growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify client satisfaction risks, navigate difficult conversations, and strengthen long-term commercial relationships.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, product marketing plays an important role in connecting what we build with the businesses that use it. We value clear communication, a strong understanding of our customers, and the ability to turn complex product capabilities into practical value.

About the Role

We're looking for a Technical Product Marketing Manager, AI & Data to develop product positioning, execute go-to-market initiatives, and help customers understand Bask Health's AI-enabled capabilities, data intelligence tools, and technical platform features.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

As a Technical Product Marketing Manager, you'll help translate complex AI and data functionality into clear, accurate messaging that communicates what our products do and how customers can use them.

You'll work closely with product managers, software engineers, AI engineers, data stakeholders, sales, customer success, and company leadership to develop customer-facing product communications.

This role requires someone who is comfortable learning technical software, asking detailed questions, and understanding how product features work beyond their marketing descriptions.

You'll develop messaging for AI-enabled experiences, data intelligence capabilities, analytics tools, workflow automation, and related platform functionality.

You'll help prospective and existing customers understand how these tools can support business operations, improve access to information, and simplify repetitive workflows.

You'll also support positioning for new AI and data features as they are developed and introduced to customers.

A major part of this role will involve communicating technical product value without overstating what AI systems can reliably accomplish.

You'll collaborate with engineers and product teams to understand feature functionality, supported use cases, technical requirements, and limitations.

You'll help explain how AI-enabled tools work, what customers should expect from them, and where human review or additional verification may be necessary.

You'll conduct customer research to understand how businesses evaluate AI-powered software and data products.

Who we are.

Solo.io is reimagining infrastructure for cloud and AI. We unite secure, seamless cloud connectivity with AI-ready, agentic infrastructure, and leading enterprises worldwide trust us to securely connect their applications, services, and AI workloads across any environment.

About the role.

Solo.io is hiring a Growth Marketing Manager to drive pipeline across our Central and West regions. You'll be the main Marketing partner for regional Sales. That means deciding which accounts and audiences to reach, building the programs that engage them, and making sure engagement turns into pipeline.

The role combines ABM, field and community events, and sales activation. One week you might run an executive dinner; the next, a developer meetup, an ABM campaign for named accounts, or the plan for a major industry event. You'll work closely with Sales, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and the open-source community teams.

This role may require occasional travel. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. Solo does not provide sponsorships at this time.

Job Description:

Own regional growth

  • Work with Central and West Sales leaders and AEs to build regional plans tied to pipeline goals, priority accounts, and territory whitespace.
  • Be an embedded, integral member of the regional sales team, not a service desk. Join their planning, understand their territories, and bring program ideas to the table. Share regular updates on what's launching, what's coming, and which accounts are engaging.
  • Use account and pipeline data, along with AI-powered research and automation, to decide where to invest. For example, focus on the cities with the most account density and open pipeline.
  • Help design the AI-powered workflows that automate account research, program setup, and reporting, so more of your time goes to strategy and Sales.

Run account-based programs

  • Align with AEs on priority accounts, then engage key personas with targeted content, landing pages, retargeting, direct mail and gifting, and outreach.
  • Run focused ABM motions, such as converting open-source users to enterprise customers.
  • Track account engagement and agree with Sales on follow-up so activity turns into conversations and pipeline.

Lead field and community programs

  • Plan and run executive dinners, advisory boards, customer events, workshops, meetups, community days, and sponsored conferences.
  • Choose events by audience fit, account coverage, and pipeline potential, not by attendance alone.
  • Own every phase of an event: pre-event promotion, onsite experience, and post-event follow-up. That includes logistics, vendors, swag, and speakers.
  • Support flagship events like KubeCon with targeted account plans, side events, and parties.

Extend company campaigns

  • Bring company-wide launches, webinars, and content programs to Central and West audiences, using paid, social, and digital channels.
  • Work with Product Marketing so messaging stays current on product, competition, and market trends.
  • Turn successful regional programs into repeatable plays for other territories.

Measure and optimize

  • Report on account engagement, pipeline created and influenced, and how far opportunities progress.
  • Keep the regional calendar, budget, and results visible to Sales and Marketing leadership.

Job Requirements:

  • 4–7+ years in B2B growth, demand generation, field marketing, or ABM, ideally in enterprise tech or SaaS.
  • A track record of building territory- or account-specific programs directly with AEs and Sales leaders.
  • Hands-on experience running events end to end, from executive dinners and workshops to conferences and community meetups.
  • ABM experience with named or strategic accounts.
  • Comfort with AI and a real interest in using it. You'll work hands-on with our internal AI platform, where many of our marketing automations run, and help shape how it supports regional programs.
  • Skill at managing many programs, vendors, budgets, and deadlines at once, with strong attention to detail.
  • A habit of judging programs by pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics.
  • Clear communication and the confidence to work with senior stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience with developer, open-source, cloud-native, Kubernetes, networking, security, or AI audiences is a plus. Curiosity and a fast grasp of technical buyers matter just as much.

What you’ll love about Solo.

At Solo, our culture is all about hiring great people, creating a fun and fast-paced work culture, and letting our teams work with our customers to successfully solve their challenges.

Solo works collaboratively with our customers, partners and open source communities to deliver technology innovation, technology solutions, architectural best-practices, and hands-on education. Solo uses a unique engagement model with our customers that allows us to quickly make them successful, and continue to work closely with them as their production environments grow.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States now and in the future as Solo is unable to provide visa sponsorship.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

When a 911 call is answered, a detective investigates a case, or a forensic lab processes evidence, there's a good chance our software is working behind the scenes. That's been true for over four decades.

AI is central to where we're going. Not as a feature but as core infrastructure. We're embedding intelligence directly into the workflows our customers rely on every day, and we're doing it alongside them. Our customers tell us what the mission demands. We build what answers it.

This work attracts a specific kind of person — someone who wants to be pushed by great people, build things that outlast a sprint cycle, and go home knowing the work connected back to something real.

The Role

The Marketing Operations Manager runs Marketo as the core marketing automation platform, optimizes the marketing technology stack, data governance and campaign execution across the organization, and owns CaPDB, Versaterm's competitive and market intelligence data in Salesforce. This role ensures that marketing systems, workflows and reporting are efficient, scalable and aligned with the company's go-to-market strategy. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing and Analytics to strengthen data integrity and turn account intelligence into targeted campaigns and pipeline.

In addition, this role provides day-to-day guidance and support to junior team members, helping to prioritize work, share best practices and foster team development.

What You Do

CaPDB Data Ownership and Market Intelligence (new)

  • Own CaPDB end to end as the named data owner: data standards, quality, refresh cadence and documentation.
  • Define and publish what "complete" means for a strategic account, including confirmed CAD and RMS product (not just vendor family), contract start and end dates, satisfaction, key contacts and last verified date.
  • Build and maintain the weekly Salesforce completeness report by tier, account owner and field, and review it with Sales leadership.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations and Salesforce Admin on field cleanup, picklists, vendor mapping, duplicate accounts and data loads.
  • Plan and run data enrichment programs, including vendor and outsourced calling partners, Gong and rep-sourced intel, and automated purchase and contract data sources. Set scope, scripts and quality checks, and review output on a regular schedule.
  • Maintain the renewal and competitive view of the account base so Growth Marketing can time Marketo campaigns to contract end dates.
  • Work with Sales leadership and account owners on a clear split of who confirms and updates which fields, and report ownership gaps.
  • Support Product Marketing and Growth Marketing with segmented lists for competitor, renewal and product-gap campaigns.

Funnel Operations and Optimization

  • Design and implement lead scoring, routing and lifecycle stage definitions in Marketo and Salesforce in partnership with Sales and Marketing.
  • Maintain and enforce SLA compliance across MQL, SAL and SQL handoffs.
  • Identify bottlenecks and conversion gaps across the funnel and propose data-driven solutions.
  • Provide guidance to team members on funnel management best practices and support execution consistency.

Marketing Systems Ownership

  • Act as the Marketo power user and platform owner: manage programs, channels, templates, smart lists, tokens and scoring, and keep the Marketo-Salesforce sync reliable.
  • Sync CaPDB account, competitor, product and renewal fields from Salesforce into Marketo so we can segment audiences and trigger campaigns by competitor, product gap and contract end date.
  • Collaborate with the GTM Systems team on system enhancements and architecture scalability.
  • Evaluate new tools and platforms to support account-based marketing, campaign automation and customer engagement.
  • Offer support and informal coaching to team members on system usage and troubleshooting.

Data Governance, Attribution and Reporting

  • Ensure marketing data quality, campaign attribution and lead-source tracking are accurate and reliable.
  • Partner with Analytics to build dashboards that measure pipeline contribution, channel ROI and marketing effectiveness, including CaPDB coverage and pipeline influenced by account intelligence.
  • Support data audits, segmentation strategies and compliance reporting.
  • Review team outputs for accuracy and consistency, providing feedback as needed.

Campaign Execution Enablement

  • Define best practices, templates and workflows to standardize campaign operations.
  • Conduct QA testing for all outbound marketing programs, including Marketo email, nurture and renewal campaigns.
  • Provide training and support to campaign managers and content marketers.
  • Act as a go-to resource for team members, helping to unblock issues and ensure smooth execution.

Program and Change Management

  • Lead cross-functional projects (for example tech rollouts, compliance updates and operational audits).
  • Develop documentation and training resources for new processes or tools, including the CaPDB playbook.
  • Monitor KPIs and iterate on strategies to drive continuous improvement.
  • Help coordinate project work across the team, ensuring clear ownership and timely delivery of key tasks.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in marketing operations, demand generation or revenue operations roles within a B2B SaaS or technology environment, with some prior experience providing mentorship, guidance or informal leadership.
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM, including custom objects, reports, dashboards, data loads and field and picklist management, and with Marketo, including programs, smart lists, scoring, tokens and the Marketo-Salesforce sync.
  • Proven experience owning data quality: defining standards, measuring completeness, cleaning and deduplicating records, and getting other teams to maintain data.
  • Experience managing outside vendors or outsourced data programs, including scoping, quality checks and performance review.
  • Strong understanding of lead management processes, funnel metrics and campaign attribution models.
  • Experience with data management, reporting and visualization tools (for example Tableau, Power BI or Salesforce dashboards).
  • Proven ability to manage complex projects and cross-functional initiatives with multiple stakeholders, including Sales leadership and Revenue Operations.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a focus on process improvement and operational excellence.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into actionable insights.
  • Experience in account-based marketing (ABM) and revenue attribution frameworks is an asset.
  • Experience with competitive intelligence, public sector or public safety technology markets, or contract and renewal data is an asset.
  • Experience providing informal mentorship, guidance or onboarding support to junior team members or peers.
  • Comfortable offering feedback, sharing best practices and helping to coordinate work across team members when needed.

jobs.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

Location: U.S. Based
Annual salary: USD 175,000 - USD 250,000
Final base salary within this range will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

About the Role

Nex is looking for an IT Director to own the strategy, delivery, and governance of our business systems and technology operations as we scale Nex Playground globally. This is a senior leadership role with broad scope — spanning enterprise systems, business systems integration and vendor relationships — and direct influence on how Nex operates and grows.

Key Responsibilities

Corporate Technology Stack Oversight

  • Lead the roadmap and execution of Nex’s corporate IT and business systems.

  • Support audit and due diligence readiness for corporate IT systems and implement compliance initiatives across corporate IT systems.
  • Deliver employee security training programs, including anti-phishing, access hygiene, and applicable statutory requirements.
  • Set the direction for Nex’s corporate IT infrastructure for internal use in partnership with internal teams and vendors, ensuring data integrity and appropriate access controls.

Team & Organisational Leadership

  • Serve as a thought partner to the executive team on technology investments, build vs. buy decisions, and organisational capability building.

Qualifications

What you must have

  • Demonstrated success owning enterprise-wide technology strategy and delivery in a fast-scaling company

Preferred Qualifications

What Success Looks Like

mate. is a shopping platform that millions of shoppers trust for rewards, and a performance channel that helps brands reach and convert their next million customers.

You'll build your own pipeline, run discovery and demos, build a business case, and close. Our pitch positions mate as a performance channel that drives incremental revenue.

If you've sold a performance, adtech, or media product into large brands and know how to land and expand an enterprise account, this will feel like home.

jobs.title: Dorothy/Comfort Analyst
jobs.description:
Prominence Advisors is actively seeking a Senior Epic Dorothy/Comfort Consultant (Home Health & Hospice) to join our team.

Who We Are

Prominence is a healthcare and life sciences technology and consulting firm dedicated to helping leading organizations do more with their data. With deep expertise across the full ecosystem — spanning providers, payers, and life sciences — we turn complex data into actionable insight.

We deliver a full spectrum of services, including advisory, analytics, optimization, and IT staffing. Our work helps organizations operate more efficiently, improve patient outcomes, and deliver measurable financial impact through smarter use of data. Recognized as a 2x Best in KLAS organization, we partner with more than 120 health systems and 40 life sciences organizations, including 7 of the top 10 U.S. News & World Report-ranked institutions.

Through our life sciences brands, Tegra Analytics and WLH Consulting & Learning Solutions, we extend these capabilities to pharmaceutical and biotech organizations — combining data, consulting, and learning to advance commercial excellence.

By connecting strategy, data, and execution, we help organizations translate data into clarity, strategy into action, and vision into measurable results. At our core, we are a people-first, values-driven organization that believes strong teams and trusted partnerships are what ultimately make healthcare and life sciences smarter.

Job Summary

Prominence is looking for a Senior Epic Dorothy/Comfort Consultant with deep experience in Epic Home Health (Dorothy) and Epic Hospice (Comfort) to lead a current-state assessment and gap analysis for one of the nation's leading health systems. This role will evaluate how Dorothy and Comfort are built and used day to day, compare the current state against Epic Foundation System design and industry best practice, and deliver a prioritized roadmap of optimization opportunities. Helping our customers get more value from their Epic investment by uncovering unused functionality, workflow gaps, and practical next steps that improve clinician experience, operational efficiency, compliance, and financial performance.

  • Lead a structured current-state assessment of Epic Dorothy and Epic Comfort, including review of build and workflow documentation, policies and procedures, open tickets and enhancement requests, operational KPIs, and known pain points.
  • Facilitate virtual stakeholder interviews with home health and hospice leadership, intake, scheduling, field clinicians, the hospice interdisciplinary team (IDT), revenue cycle, and IS application teams.
  • Conduct screen-share workflow walkthroughs with frontline users to understand how the applications are used in practice.
  • Review system build against Epic Foundation System design, identifying licensed but unused functionality and Epic release adoption gaps.
  • Document handoff points and workflow impacts between Epic and adjacent third-party systems, such as workforce and time and attendance platforms.
  • Catalog gaps by workflow area and score each by impact (operational, financial, clinician experience, and compliance risk) and effort to resolve.
  • Lead validation working sessions with client project leadership and key stakeholders to confirm findings.
  • Build a prioritized next-steps action list organized into quick wins, near-term (~90-day), and longer-term strategic items, with a suggested owner for each (IS, operations, Epic, or partner).
  • Help define follow-on remediation options and scope to inform future phases of work.
  • Prepare and deliver an executive readout that translates findings into clear, actionable recommendations for clinical, operational, and IS leaders.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Epic Dorothy (Home Health) and Epic Comfort (Hospice), including build, implementation, optimization, or application support.
  • Current Epic certification or proficiency in Dorothy and/or Comfort.
  • Deep working knowledge of Epic Foundation System design and Epic-recommended workflows for home health and hospice.
  • Demonstrated experience leading current-state assessments, gap analyses, or optimization reviews of Epic applications.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end home health and hospice operations, including referral and intake, scheduling, field clinician documentation, plan of care, hospice IDT, and billing.
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder interviews and workflow walkthroughs with clinical, operational, revenue cycle, and IS audiences.
  • Ability to evaluate findings by impact and effort and turn them into a clear, prioritized roadmap.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to develop and deliver executive-level presentations to non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to work independently and deliver results in a fully remote consulting environment.

Desired Qualifications

  • Prior consulting experience delivering Epic assessments or optimization engagements across multiple health systems.
  • Knowledge of home health and hospice regulatory and compliance requirements, such as CMS Conditions of Participation, OASIS, PDGM, HOPE, and hospice benefit periods.
  • Familiarity with home health and hospice revenue cycle workflows in Epic, including billing and claims.
  • Experience with Epic integrations and handoffs to third-party workforce management or time and attendance systems (e.g., Infor).
  • Knowledge of recent Epic releases and new Dorothy and Comfort functionality, with experience driving release adoption.
  • Experience defining remediation scope, estimates, or phased roadmaps to support follow-on project planning.
  • Familiarity with Epic reporting tools (Reporting Workbench, Radar, SlicerDicer) to identify reporting gaps.
  • Clinical background (e.g., RN, PT, OT, SLP, or MSW) in a home health or hospice setting.

Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities

  • Professional: Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism by treating others with respect, keeping commitments, building trust within the team, working with integrity, and upholding organizational values (“Do Great Work and Move Mountains”).
  • Organized: Capable of managing a fast-paced, time-boxed assessment across multiple workflow areas, stakeholder groups, and deliverables, ensuring smooth project flow.
  • Self-Motivated: Adept at independently driving an engagement from kickoff to executive readout, meeting milestone deadlines, and monitoring work quality with minimal oversight.
  • Highly Adaptable: Quickly acclimates to a new client environment, an unfamiliar build, and diverse clinical and operational teams.
  • Analytical: Objectively evaluates build and workflows against best practice, getting to root causes rather than symptoms.
  • Consultative: Builds credibility quickly with clinicians, operational leaders, and IS teams; asks the right questions and listens to understand.
  • Communication: Effectively conveys clear and concise messages that resonate with audiences ranging from frontline clinicians to executive sponsors, both in written and verbal forms.
  • Proactive: Anticipates potential issues, such as access delays or stakeholder availability, addresses concerns before they escalate, and effectively raises them when necessary.
  • Team-Oriented: Collaborates closely with Prominence Epic subject matter advisors and client project leadership, and thrives in a team-based environment.

Hours Worked

This role is part of our active pipeline for upcoming client engagements and is contingent on project availability, with timing aligned to client demand.

Benefits

Prominence is dedicated to hiring the best and brightest minds in healthcare and maintaining a culture that rewards our employees for following their passion. We are excited to offer the following benefits for this position:

  • Competitive Salaried and Hybrid Compensation Plans

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with senior leaders across operations, feasibility, finance, regulatory affairs, and site leadership to align study opportunities with site capacity, capabilities, and execution readiness. jobs.description:
Redwood Automation Solution Designer (RunMyJobs / SAP BPA), SAP Finance Close, Denmark

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Denmark. Day rate: EUR 400 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its SAP finance close on the Redwood platform, the same engine that runs RunMyJobs and that SAP sold for years as SAP Central Process Scheduling (CPS) and SAP Business Process Automation (BPA). The work covers the record-to-report cycle: accruals, balance sheet reconciliation, journal posting and the period-end close, all driven into SAP S/4HANA and ECC.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineers can build on the Redwood platform. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the SAP period-end close with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design: close task lists, dependencies, calendars, approvals and exception paths, written up as the solution design. Accruals, balance sheet reconciliation and certification, and journal posting with its posting controls. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems, through APIs, files and middleware. Security and controls designed in: role-based access, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Monitoring, recovery and the non-functional design that keeps the close running. Leading the engineers through build, and reviewing what they deliver against the design at design-authority and go-live checkpoints. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users.

What you bring

Solution design on the Redwood platform under any of its names: RunMyJobs, SAP BPA by Redwood, SAP CPS or Cronacle. Design of an automated SAP FI/CO period-end close, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. Controls built into your designs: role-based security, segregation of duties, audit trails and SOX-aligned evidence. Leading engineers from an approved design through build, testing and go-live. 8 or more years in SAP finance systems, finance automation or record-to-report process design.

Useful but not essential:

Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance). A BPA-to-RunMyJobs migration. CPS or Redwood tasks run from the SAP Financial Closing cockpit, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. Financial services or another regulated industry.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood or SAP close automation project: which Redwood product it ran on, the finance processes in scope, and which design decisions were yours.

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood and SAP finance close automation people in front of the client.

Operating at the intersection of enterprise business systems, AI engineering, and CS operational strategy, this role provides end-to-end governance over core CS platforms (including CRM, CSM software, Contact Center, PSA, LMS, and voice/AI engines) while establishing a cohesive strategy for RPA and tailored automation. Furthermore, the position serves as the primary Product Owner for flagship CS AI initiatives, driving agentic AI adoption, digitally led implementation frameworks, automated data conversions, and next-generation workflow orchestration to dramatically enhance customer value and operational velocity.


Primary Duties & Responsibilities


Product Ownership of CS AI & Agentic Capabilities:

Serve as executive Product Owner for high-impact Customer Success AI initiatives, with a core focus on architecting and deploying Agentic AI solutions. Lead product strategy, roadmap definition, user story mapping, and deployment for digitally led client implementation/onboarding programs, automated data conversion engines, and intelligent customer journey touchpoints. Evaluate emerging AI model capabilities to embed autonomous agents directly into daily CS workflows.


Centralized CS Tech Stack Governance & Day-to-Day Administration:

Oversee centralized ecosystem management and hands-on system administration for all primary CS applications—including enterprise CRM, Customer Success platforms, Contact Center systems, Voice AI tools, Professional Services/Project Management software, and Learning Management Systems (LMS). Establish global administration rules, maintain pristine data architecture and hygiene, oversee vendor management, and guarantee high availability and integration integrity across all connected environments.


Workflow Automation, RPA & AI Architecture Strategy:

Design and execute a unified, cohesive operational strategy incorporating Robotic Process Automation (RPA), custom workflow automation, and embedded AI across the CS toolchain. Systematically audit manual operational touchpoints to build automated data pipelines, cross-tool triggers, and custom event handlers that maximize team efficiency and eliminate structural friction.


Cross-Functional Strategic Alignment & IT Demand Management:

Act as the key technical anchor and liaison bridging CS business strategies with central IT, Enterprise Applications, Data Engineering, and InfoSec teams. Translate complex business requirements and customer journey blueprints into rigorous technical specifications, ensuring security compliance, robust data governance, and strategic alignment during enterprise Program Increment (PI) planning. Partner closely with the CS R&A Team to ensure alignment on data flows from the tech stack to Databricks for reporting purposes, coordinating with system admins when modifying data structures to prevent reporting outages and maintain proactive alignment across analytics.


Technical Leadership & Operations Management:

Direct and mentor a dedicated team of System Administrators, Business Analysts, and AI/Automation Engineers. Establish agile sprint discipline, code and configuration standards, peer testing protocols, and continuous development practices to accelerate feature delivery while promoting technical upskilling across the squad.


Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Business Analytics, or related technical field. Master's Degree (MBA, MS in Information Systems, or Software Engineering) strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive technical experience in CS Operations, RevOps, or Enterprise Business Systems.
  • Minimum 3+ years of direct people management experience overseeing technical personnel (System Admins, Analysts, Developers).
  • Demonstrated experience in platform administration across key CS tools (CRM, Customer Success platforms, Contact Center, PSA, LMS).
  • Proven Product Ownership experience launching AI initiatives, custom automated playbooks, and RPA solutions.
  • Hands-on expertise with agentic AI frameworks, automated workflow design, and generative AI integrations.

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

United States

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
  • 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
  • Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
  • Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
  • Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
  • Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

jobs.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

TransUnion sits at the intersection of data, technology, analytics, and trust, helping leading organisations understand their customers, unlock growth, combat increasingly sophisticated fraud, and make smarter decisions throughout the customer lifecycle. Across credit, affordability, identity, fraud, advanced analytics, and real-time automated decisioning, our capabilities help address some of the most important challenges facing financial services today. As TransUnion continues to invest in AI-enabled analytics, cloud-based platforms, differentiated data, and new approaches to identity and fraud, the Enterprise Banking team brings these capabilities together to create meaningful outcomes for our largest banking clients. This role reports to the Director of Banking.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

  • Own the full profit and loss (P&L) responsibility for Tier 1 banking relationships, driving multi-million-pound revenue and margin growth while delivering against agreed commercial objectives.
  • Build and execute strategic account plans that deepen relationships, expand TransUnion’s product footprint, and unlock new revenue opportunities across existing and new areas within Tier 1 banks.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, renewals, and deal cycles to maximise long-term client and commercial value.
  • Act as executive sponsor, domain expert, and trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, including C-suite, commercial, risk, compliance, digital, and product leadership, aligning TransUnion’s capabilities to clients’ transformation priorities.
  • Create a shared vision for client success by bringing together cross-functional teams across Sales, Product, Delivery, Legal, and Marketing to support innovation and deliver strong client outcomes.
  • Influence TransUnion’s product roadmap through client advocacy, market insight, Voice of Customer feedback, and a deep understanding of evolving banking priorities.
  • Lead sales cadence, deal-level forecasting, pipeline visibility, and performance reporting, maintaining strong Customer Relationship Management (CRM) discipline and transparency through Salesforce and internal frameworks.
  • Lead the global coordination of strategic banking relationships, sharing insights and relevant client information with peers and stakeholders across international regions to support a consistent enterprise approach.
  • Strengthen client satisfaction and long-term partnerships by using client feedback and performance measures to identify opportunities for innovation, improvement, and further growth.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • Proven experience leading complex, enterprise-level client relationships within financial services, ideally across banking, credit bureaus, fintech, data, or analytics environments, with the ability to operate as a trusted advisor to strategic clients.
  • Strong commercial acumen and experience owning significant revenue portfolios, with a demonstrated record of exceeding revenue targets, delivering sustained growth, and leading complex, high-value deal cycles and negotiations.
  • Deep understanding of banking transformation, regulatory environments, and data-driven innovation, with the ability to connect market and client priorities to commercial opportunities and TransUnion capabilities.
  • Extensive stakeholder-management experience, with the credibility and communication skills to influence C-suite executives and senior stakeholders across commercial, risk, compliance, digital, and product functions.
  • Strategic and commercially focused leadership capability, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity, translate insight into action, mobilise cross-functional teams, and deliver outcomes at pace.

Required Technical Skills

  • Proficiency with Salesforce to maintain Customer Relationship Management (CRM) discipline, opportunity visibility, client information, and transparency across strategic banking relationships.
  • Ability to manage sales forecasting, commercial performance, pipeline, and deal-level reporting to support effective decision-making and achievement of revenue and margin objectives.
  • Ability to interpret and apply client satisfaction measures, including Voice of Customer insight, to identify client priorities, improve outcomes, and inform strategic account planning.
  • Strong commercial and financial capability to manage profit and loss (P&L), revenue, margin, commercial negotiations, and strategic account performance.

What’s in it for you?

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business. As well as an excellent salary and bonus scheme or commission scheme (if joining our sales teams) our benefits package comes with:

  • 26 days annual leave and bank holidays (increasing with service)
  • Global paid wellness days off and a bonus day off to celebrate your birthday
  • A generous contributory pension scheme and access to the TransUnion Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Private health care and a variety of physical, mental and financial fitness wellbeing programmes such as access to mindfulness tools
  • Access to our diversity forums and communities so you can get involved in causes close to your heart

TransUnion – a place to grow:

If there’s something on the list of essential or desirable skills that you can’t quite tick off, don’t let that stop you from applying. We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful. We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together.

Flexibility at TU:

We recognise that our people need the freedom to balance their day-to-day lives with their work. This is why we’ve set out to create inclusive and flexible policies and practices for you to accommodate all your responsibilities and needs: children, family and beyond. If the role is advertised as full time, don’t let this stop you from applying. Let us know if you’re looking for a part time or flexible working arrangement and we can discuss this with you.

Additional support:

At TransUnion, we’re committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace where all individual’s talents and perspectives are valued. When you apply for a position with us, you’re not just joining a team, you’re becoming part of a community that celebrates differences and embraces equality. We understand that everyone has different needs, which is why we offer a range of reasonable adjustments to our recruitment process. Please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments to help you through the application process or to attend an interview with us by contacting .

Interview & Hiring Process:

Most of our recruitment processes are virtual, so you’ll get to know our hiring managers and teams over the phone and through video. If we need you to attend a physical in person interview, your recruiter will inform you of this.

We do not accept any unsolicited CV’s from recruitment agencies. If you are a recruitment agency on our PSL, our talent team will contact you directly should we require any assistance.

Find out more about Life At TU UK:

TransUnionUK


TransUnion Overview:

At TransUnion, we encourage and are committed to creating a real, positive impact and shared sense of purpose within our Workforce for Good, which empowers our people to grow, innovate and contribute to a better future for our communities and customers. We strive to build an environment where our associates are in the driver’s seat of their professional development— while having access to help along the way. We recognize that success comes when our associates thrive both professionally and personally; that’s why we prioritize work/life flexibility and offer resources for our teams across the globe to collaborate and drive excellence.

Be a part of our Workforce for Good – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.
