Introduction to the Team & Role

As the Enterprise Sales Director for North America, you will lead new logo acquisition for organizations of 5,000+ employees, one of the most strategic and fastest growing segments of 360Learning's business. Reporting to the Chief Sales Officer, you will manage a current team of 4 high performing Account Executives and own a strategic pipeline built on 6 and 7 figure deals.360Learning has strong commercial traction in Enterprise North America. This is a critical, high visibility mission: we need a leader who can quickly reach full autonomy and bring the segment to the next level of ambition the company has set for this market.This is a hands-on coach role. You will directly support and, when needed, escalate into complex commercial cycles alongside your Account Executives, while also stepping back to read business and market trends and translate them into a clear strategic direction.

What You Will Do

Within 1 month, you will:

  • Complete your onboarding and ramp up on 360Learning's product, market positioning, and Convexity operating model
  • Meet individually with each of your 4 Account Executives to assess their pipeline, deal status, and account coverage
  • Review the existing Enterprise pipeline, forecast, and territory structure
  • Build working relationships with your key cross-functional partners, mostly in Pre-sales, Product, Alliances (Partners) and Professional Services.

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Run weekly pipeline and forecast reviews with rigor and accuracy, providing clear, rational visibility to the Chief Sales Officer
  • Identify the strengths and areas of improvement of each Account Executive and put in place a proactive coaching plan (call preparation, live deal support, debriefs)
  • Play an active, hands-on role in strategic deal cycles, through escalation support and direct involvement in complex 6-7 figure ARR deals
  • Work closely with BDRs to qualify opportunities and deepen strategic discovery around prospects' business pain points
  • Start leveraging 360Learning's partner and alliances ecosystem to accelerate new logo acquisition
  • Begin to achieve world class performance and hit quarterly targets

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Own a full strategic read of your market, translating business and market trends into clear deal prioritization decisions
  • Be fully autonomous in driving the Enterprise North America segment toward the company's ambition in this market
  • Be involved in hiring and onboarding new Account Executives as the team scales
  • Have a proven track record of closing complex, strategic deals directly or through hands-on support of your team
  • Meet and exceed quarterly sales targets with a clean, reliable forecast.

The Skill Set

  • Proven 3+ year track record as a top performing sales leader in software or SaaS (experience in HR solutions is a real plus), with direct experience managing Enterprise Account Executives
  • Demonstrated ability to close and support complex, strategic deals in the 6 to 7 figure range
  • Strong coaching mindset: able to diagnose individual strengths and areas of improvement and act proactively rather than reactively
  • Rigorous, data-driven approach to pipeline management and forecasting, with genuine attention to detail and hygiene
  • Comfortable playing a hands-on role in commercial cycles, including escalation and direct deal support
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Pre-sales, Product, and Professional Services teams
  • Familiarity with leveraging a partner or alliances ecosystem to support new logo acquisition
  • Ability to hire, onboard, and set up new Account Executives for success
  • A customer-first mindset, obsessed with impact rather than activity
  • Comfortable with a written, asynchronous culture and a strong fit with our Convexity operating model
  • Willingness to travel to meet prospects and attend trade shows
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Pay structure includes base salary, variable incentive pay, and company equity 📈
  • Benefits/Perks: Comprehensive health insurance starting your first day of employment 🏥 RRSP contribution matching 🏦 Generous parental leave 👶 Professional development opportunities through our own platform 📚
  • Balance: We offer unlimited days of annual PTO 🌴 5 days for sick leave 🤒 Holiday time in accordance with the Ontario Holiday Calendar 🗓 We are a remote-first organization and promote flexible work hours 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: & find out more about the teams, product and processes 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

Interview Process

  • Call with the Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Interview with the Chief Sales Officer (hiring manager)
  • Case study interview with the Chief Sales Officer & Sales Operations & EMEA VP Enterprise Sales
  • Clarification Interview with a North American Sales Leader
  • Culture Interview with 360Learning CEO
  • References & Offer

Who We Are

360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.
360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

Learning Includes Everyone.

In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

jobs.title: Staff Product Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Staff Security Engineer to lead penetration testing across Guidewire’s products.

In this role, you’ll shape and run a pen testing program that combines hands-on testing, third-party vendor engagements, and AI-assisted tooling. You’ll ensure every product is tested before release, findings are validated and fixed, and our products meet customer, contractual, and regulatory requirements. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, and compliance teams, setting the direction for how security testing scales with the business as a Staff Security Engineer.

As needed, you’ll also support broader Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) activities, such as vulnerability triage and incident coordination.

Job Description

What you’ll do

Primary responsibilities

Penetration testing

  • Plan and perform penetration tests of Guidewire web applications, APIs, cloud services, and integrations to identify critical vulnerabilities before release and in production.
  • Test tenant isolation, cross-tenant data access and authorization boundaries in multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Lead security testing of AI/ML-powered product features, including LLM applications, APIs, and inference endpoints. Identify issues such as prompt injection, data and model leakage, insecure RAG implementations, and abuse vectors.
  • Validate, reproduce and risk-rate findings using industry-standard metrics such as CVSS, and give engineering teams clear, actionable remediation guidance.
  • Retest fixes and confirm closure before findings are marked resolved.
  • Develop pen testing tooling, scripts and automation, and evaluate AI-assisted and autonomous testing tools to scale coverage and repeatability.

Pen testing vendor management

  • Own the pen testing schedule across the product release lifecycle, from early access through general availability (including continuously delivered products), ensuring every product is tested prior to key release milestones.
  • Decide when and how products need testing based on risk, release scope and compliance requirements.
  • Define testing scope, rules of engagement, environments, and access for each vendor engagement.
  • Align product teams, implementation partners and vendors on their pen testing responsibilities, including environment readiness and access.
  • Manage vendor relationships end-to-end: onboarding, statements of work, kickoff, status tracking, quality reviews of reports, and issue escalation.
  • Manage the pen testing budget, including vendor costs, forecasting and utilization.
  • Review vendor reports for accuracy and completeness, remove false positives and consolidate findings into the vulnerability management process.
  • Evaluate vendor performance and coverage, recommending methodology or vendor changes as needed.

Compliance and reporting

  • Ensure pen testing meets compliance obligations for Guidewire products, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, and customer contractual requirements.
  • Maintain pen test evidence, attestation letters and executive summaries for auditors and customers.
  • Track remediation of pen test findings against SLAs and report status and risk to product, engineering, and security leadership.
  • Define and report program metrics such as test coverage, on-time completion, finding age, and SLA compliance.
  • Respond to customer security questions about pen testing practices and results.

Secondary responsibilities (as needed)

When PSIRT needs extra capacity, you will support the broader incident response program:

  • Triage internally and externally reported security issues, verify them across product versions, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Coordinate with external security researchers, reporting organizations, and customers on reported vulnerabilities.
  • Support security releases with engineering and sustaining teams, including security-focused code and design reviews.
  • Validate findings from SAST, DAST, SCA and container scanning tools, and help improve PSIRT and vulnerability management processes.

What you’ll bring

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, or equivalent experience.
  • 7+ years of application or product security experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on penetration testing of web applications, APIs, and cloud-hosted services.
  • Proven experience managing third-party pen testing vendors, including scoping, scheduling and report review.
  • Hands-on experience testing applications hosted on AWS, including IAM and multi-tenant architectures.
  • Working knowledge of compliance requirements for pen testing, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or PCI DSS.
  • Solid understanding of the OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, and common product vulnerability classes.
  • Hands-on experience with pen testing tools such as Burp Suite, along with SAST, DAST and vulnerability scanning tools.
  • Experience risk-rating vulnerabilities with CVSS.
  • Scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar) to build testing tools and automation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear pen test reports for engineers, executives, and customers.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence people at all levels, as well as vendors and external partners.

Nice to have

  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, GPEN, GWAPT, CSSLP, or CISSP.
  • Experience testing AI/LLM applications in production.
  • Bug bounty participation or published security research.
  • Knowledge of the security research community.
  • Development experience in Java, C++ or Python.
  • Experience in a PSIRT or product incident response role.
  • Experience with insurance, financial services, or other regulated SaaS products.

About Guidewire


Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.


For more information, please visit www.guidewire.com and follow us on Twitter: @Guidewire_PandC.


Guidewire Software, Inc. is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to an inclusive workplace, and believe that a diversity of perspectives, abilities, and cultures is a key to our success. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship, marital status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability. All offers are contingent upon passing a criminal history and other background checks where it's applicable to the position.

Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Boulevard customers are passionate about what they do. Their needs are nuanced and critical, and they rely on us to stand alongside them so they can focus on what they do best. As a Staff Software Engineer on the Ecosystem team, you’ll set the technical direction for Boulevard’s external developer platform and its app and integrations ecosystem, then work across teams to make it real.

This is a green field opportunity. You’ll shape the API platform, the partner experience, and the foundations partners and customers depend on, including API security, identity and access, audit trails, and eventing infrastructure. It’s an individual contributor role with wide influence: you won’t manage people, you’ll lead through technical judgment, clear communication, and trust, working closely with Engineering, Product Management, Design, Partnerships, and Product Marketing. We’re small enough that your work is visible every day.

What you’ll do here:

  • Set the technical strategy for Boulevard’s API and app ecosystem, making sure it supports company goals and partner needs.
  • Work across engineering teams to align on direction and drive the right implementation, without formal authority over those teams.
  • Lead platform-level changes that cross team boundaries: gain agreement, plan the rollout, and see the work through.
  • Find the gaps between what the platform provides and what business priorities require, and turn them into clear, scoped, prioritized proposals.
  • Learn what partners and integrators need and bring those needs into the platform roadmap.
  • Write and review design documents and architecture decisions, explaining trade-offs and risks to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Write code and ship high-impact work, setting the standard for quality, observability, and security.
  • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and coaching, and remove blockers so teammates can do their best work.
  • Define and monitor system health metrics for the API platform, address technical debt before it affects reliability or performance, and help guide incidents from response to resolution and improvement.

What you’ll need to thrive:

  • Experience as a Staff-level or senior engineer who has led large, cross-team technical initiatives.
  • Experience building and scaling external-facing API products. GraphQL experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience building and maintaining integrations with third-party APIs.
  • Experience designing and operating systems at scale, including enterprise-grade systems.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, Go, or Elixir. Elixir experience is a bonus, not a requirement.
  • Influence without authority and sound technical judgment: you gain alignment through clear reasoning and trust, and you anticipate scale, maintenance, and operational cost.
  • Business and partner awareness, and clear communication: you connect technical decisions to business priorities and partner needs, and adapt your message to your audience.
  • A mentor’s mindset, ownership, and forward thinking: you help other engineers grow, move work forward when the path is unclear, state risks openly, and set long-term direction while delivering value in the short term.
  • A plus: experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

How we’ll take care of you:

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we're happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $193,900 - 225,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

How we take care of our team

Our business is deeply immersed in an industry that’s centered around helping people feel their best, so we know that taking care of yourself isn’t selfish; it’s essential. That’s why our culture pairs high standards with genuine care. We don't glorify burnout or wear ‘always on’ as a badge of honor. Instead, we’ve created benefits designed to support you inside and outside of work, so you can bring your best self to both.

Here’s how we support you:

  • Competitive base pay and performance bonus eligibility because you deserve to be rewarded for your impact.
  • Equity participation for all full-time employees because we believe the people helping build Boulevard should share in our long-term success.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage with up to 100% employee premium coverage and 75% dependent coverage to help take care of you and your loved ones.
  • An annual $1,200 HSA employer contribution for eligible plans to help support healthcare costs and future planning.
  • 100% covered dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, ensuring you stay healthy, protected, and ready for whatever life brings.
  • 12 weeks of fully paid U.S. parental leave supporting all new parents equally as they take the time to bond, adjust, and be present when welcoming a new family member.
  • Flexible paid time off, plus 10 U.S. company holidays, where you are encouraged to rest, recharge, and take the time you need, guilt-free.
  • Fully remote with support, including a $200 home office setup allowance and a $50 monthly WFH reimbursement so your workspace is set up for success.
  • $200 quarterly Boulevard Bucks to prioritize your well-being and stay connected to the industry we serve.
  • And other perks like One Medical membership and Employee Assistant Program.

To learn how Boulevard collects, uses, and protects personal information related to candidates and employees, please review our Boulevard Employee & Personnel Privacy Notice.

Boulevard Labs, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to hiring a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All employment decisions at Boulevard Labs, Inc. are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

Outside Employment Disclosure
Boulevard serves the beauty, wellness, and self-care industry, and many of our employees have access to our customers' business and client data. Because of that, we ask all candidates to disclose any concurrent employment, self-employment, ownership interest, or advisory role during the hiring process, including the company name and industry. Disclosure is a normal part of our process and is not by itself a barrier to being hired. jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
ABOUT POWER FACTORS

Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.*

Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management.

With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code.

* Outside China and India

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Solutions Architect for renewable energy management to help spearhead Power Factors’ continued growth. This role ultimately accountable for driving revenue growth by acting as the trusted technical advisor and facilitating complex technical engagements throughout the sales cycle and translating complex business challenges in the renewable energy sector into compelling, well-scoped solution that accelerate time-to-value and lay the foundation for long-term customer success.

The Solutions Architect is responsible for engaging with prospects and customers as technical advisor, knowing our customers business intimately and understands the unique challenges and aspirations of each of them. The individual brings a consultative mindset and strong customer facing competencies besides relevant experience in the renewables industry, specifically in BESS, Solar PV and Wind asset management for utility scale and deeply understanding the systems architecture that support IPPs, investors and other stakeholders managing renewable operational assets and often with a background within or involving contact with relevant IPPs.

The Solutions Architect is an entrepreneurial, cross-functional role that requires multiple skill sets and involves significant interaction and coordination with our prospects and customers and Power Factors’ internal stakeholders like Product, Technology, and Customer Success.

Key Responsibilities:

Presales Support:

o Lead technical presentations, product demonstrations, prospect’s trainings and proof-of-value (POV) engagements aligned to each prospect's specific pain points and desired outcomes.

o Respond to RFPs and RFIs with accurate, differentiated, and commercially aware technical content.

o Evaluate feasibility of client requests during the sales process and provide clear guidance on solution pathways, trade-offs, and constraints.

o Define the solution scope for each prospect, including integration architecture, data flows, and any configuration or customization required.

o Collaborate with Account Executives to develop tailored proposals for enterprise and strategic accounts and with well-defined and executed competitive moats.

o Contribute to SA team tooling, playbooks, and demo environments to raise the baseline quality of all engagements.

Technical Leadership and Customer Engagement:

o Lead technical discovery sessions and solution workshops with customer stakeholders at all levels (operational, IT, executive).

o Act as the primary technical point of contact throughout the sales cycle, managing expectations and building credibility.

o Deliver solution design documentation and reference architectures for complex engagements.

o Serve as technical liaison between customers and Power Factors' Product, Technology, and Professional Services teams.

o Stay current with renewable energy trends, SaaS/IoT architectures, SCADA/DAS platforms, and competitive landscape.

Solution Design & Scoping:

o Conduct rigorous discovery to understand each customer's unique operational environment, data sources, integration requirements, and success criteria.

o Design integration approaches connecting Power Factors applications with client systems (SCADA, historians, ERP, CMMS, etc.).

o Identify, document, and manage technical risks, gaps, and dependencies for each opportunity.

o Coordinate with Professional Services on delivery assumptions underpinning commercial proposals.

Customer-First Mindset & Communication

o Tailor customer-facing collaterals —decks, RFP responses, POV reports — to each audience and engagement context.

o Tailor demos addressing both non-technical (asset owners, operations managers, executives) and technical (IT) audiences.

o Ensure a seamless, high-quality buying experience that reflects Power Factors' brand and builds long-term trust.

o Partner with customer stakeholders to ensure their requirements and feedback are accurately captured and acted upon

Product Feedback & Market Intelligence

o Aggregate and communicate product gaps, feature requests, and market signals from customer engagements to the Product team.

o Contribute to roadmap discussions by providing a market-wide perspective, not just individual customer needs.

o Attend industry events and trade shows as a Power Factors technical brand ambassador.

o Support Product Marketing with competitive moats, battle cards and marketing launches.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

We believe you enjoy working in a purpose-driven organization and that you thrive in an environment where you need to find creative solutions to challenging problems in a fast-changing context. This also means that you are effective at managing multiple creative tasks of varying complexities, work well under pressure, and are driven by continuous learning and growth. Specifically, we are looking for someone with the following creative skillset:

  • Bachelor’s or Master's in a technical field, e.g., Software Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering; Master’s degree is considered an asset
  • Minimum five (5) years of relevant experience in the renewable energy industry with experience in technical product/project management, business process development, software development, IoT/networking
  • Work experience using and configuring Web-based IoT, SaaS, and IPaaS data platforms, including DAS platforms, SCADA systems, enterprise databases and historians, OSIsoft PI, and other cloud platforms, e.g., Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services
  • Relevant work experience in navigating the renewable energy landscape, including utilities, EPCs, third-party O&M organizations, asset owners, asset managers, and hardware and software vendors
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly jump into complex problems and navigate competing priorities to drive solutions using analytical and decision-making skills and priority management
  • Excellent, clear, concise written and oral communication skills in English. The ability to present in other languages is considered an important asset
  • Ability to connect with all relevant audiences within an organization with the right message and level of detail
  • Process-oriented with a growth mindset; ability to perform as an individual contributor and as a project coordinator; as such, you can work autonomously, facilitate teamwork between multiple stakeholders, and escalate as required
  • Proven track record of high performance in a fast-paced environment

LIFE @ POWER FACTORS

We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and execute in a growing industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results. We are passionate about making the world a better place. We seek fierce and humble people to help us achieve our ambitious plan.

WHY JOIN US

By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together - committed, conscientious and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry.

WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: FP&A Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview

Overview:

This role is a foundational hire for HealthEdge's growing Strategic Finance function, supporting the BPaaS business and the broader Finance organization. The Analyst partners closely with, and reports directly to, the Director of Strategic Finance & Corporate Development, taking ownership of the recurring analysis, modeling and reporting that underpin how HealthEdge communicates financial performance to its leadership, its Board and the investment community.

This is a builder's role, not a support role. The right person is a strong modeler and clear communicator who wants real ownership early, thrives in an environment with limited inherited infrastructure, and is energized by turning ambiguous, high-stakes problems into repeatable, well-documented processes. As the function scales, this individual has a clear path to expanded scope and increasing responsibility.

Key Responsibilities

  • Investor Engagement & External Reporting

    • Serve as the day-to-day owner of the analytical and reporting engine behind HealthEdge's investor communications.

    • Maintain and enhance the investor data model used to update the investment community on financial performance, ensuring accuracy, consistency and readiness across reporting cycles.
    • Prepare investor-facing reporting packages and supporting analysis, partnering with the Director and Investor Relations to translate financial results into a clear performance narrative.
    • Own the recurring production and version control of these deliverables so that each cycle requires minimal rework.
  • Board Reporting & Financial Analysis

    • Produce the analysis and materials that inform Board and executive-level decision-making.

    • Build and refine Board reporting materials, including slide creation, financial analysis and supporting exhibits.
    • Develop competitive and market positioning analysis to contextualize HealthEdge's performance against relevant benchmarks.
    • Synthesize complex financial information into concise, executive-ready formats.
  • Long-Term Product Economics Modeling

    • Partner with the Director to develop revenue and margin models at the customer level.

    • Help build and maintain long-term economic models that project future revenue, cost structure, margin and unit economics.
    • Develop scenario and sensitivity analysis to test how contract structures, growth assumptions and cost drivers shape long-term economics.
    • Translate evolving business models into structured, well-documented modeling frameworks that mature as products scale.
  • AI Adoption in Finance

    • Help lead the adoption of AI and automation across the Finance organization.

    • Identify and pilot AI and automation opportunities that reduce manual effort in reporting, modeling and data aggregation.
    • Help build and document scalable, automated workflows that expand the team's analytical capacity.
  • Special Projects

    • Support high-priority, cross-functional special projects as needed.

    • Provide financial modeling, analysis and research to support strategic initiatives across the enterprise.
    • Partner with business, advisory and operational teams to deliver timely, decision-ready analysis.

    Qualifications

    Required

    • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field, or a Master's in Finance (MSF).
    • 0 – 3 years of relevant work experience in finance, accounting, FP&A, investment banking, consulting or a comparable analytical role.
    • Strong financial modeling skills and fluency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to present financial information clearly.
    • High attention to detail, strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

    Preferred

    • Demonstrated interest in healthcare and/or technology.
    • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward building repeatable processes from scratch.
    • Curiosity about AI and automation tools and how they can be applied to finance workflows.

    Geographic Responsibility: Remote, US

    Type of Employment: Full-time, permanent

    FLSA Classification (USA Only): Exempt

    Work Environment: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job: 

    • The employee is occasionally required to move around the office. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.
    • Work across multiple time zones in a hybrid or remote work environment.
    • Long periods of time sitting and/or standing in front of a computer using video technology.
    • May require travel dependent on company needs.

    The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the job being performed by the individual(s) assigned to this position. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills required. HealthEdge reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other duties as necessary. In addition, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Candidates may be required to go through a pre-employment criminal background check.

    HealthEdge is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to workforce diversity and actively encourage all qualified persons to seek employment with us, including, but not limited to, racial and ethnic minorities, women, veterans and persons with disabilities.

    **The annual US base salary range for this position is $83,000 to $88,000. This salary range may cover multiple career levels at HealthEdge. Final compensation will be determined during the interview process and is based on a combination of factors including, but not limited to, your skills, experience, qualifications and education.

jobs.title: Design System Manager
jobs.description:
Bold

Nuestra compañía fue fundada en Mayo de 2019 por un equipo de personas increíbles y con una experiencia única, el grupo de fundadores está conformado por los creadores de PayU Latam y otras empresas expertas en tecnología financiera. Estamos creando soluciones de pago y de banca para MiPymes, independientes y emprendedores en Colombia. Actualmente contamos con más de 450.000 clientes registrados en nuestra plataforma y hemos recibido más de USD $120 millones de fondos de inversión nacionales y extranjeros, somos una de las startups de más rápido crecimiento en LatAm en el sector fintech. Bold es una fintech que provee una solución de pagos a los microempresarios para recibir pagos con tarjetas débito, crédito y billeteras a través de datáfonos y links de pago. Sin embargo, la visión de Bold es más ambiciosa que ser una empresa de pagos y estamos trabajando para volvernos una plataforma de servicios financieros y tecnológicos para las pequeñas empresas en el país complementando las soluciones de pagos y banca con otros productos de software conexos a toda nuestra propuesta de valor. Nuestra misión en Bold es liberar el potencial de los emprendedores. En Bold creemos firmemente que podemos ayudar a los pequeños emprendedores a desarrollar sus negocios ofreciendo servicios financieros y tecnológicos hechos a su medida, que sean amigables y cercanos. En Bold definimos los siguientes valores como los pilares de nuestra cultura organizacional: Maestría, Pensamiento crítico, Trabajo en equipo, Sentido de urgencia, Somos abiertos y el cliente el centro de lo que hacemos. Para más información acerca de Bold visita nuestro sitio web:

El Rol:

El Design System Manager define y lidera la estrategia del design system de Bold, para que diseñadores, ingenieros y agentes de AI construyan productos consistentes, accesibles y muy intuitivos a partir de una única fuente de verdad.

Lidera un equipo multidisciplinario de UX, UI e ingeniería. Su reto es que el sistema exista en Figma y en código, sincronizado de punta a punta, que su adopción en la organización sea medible y que sus componentes y reglas sean legibles tanto para personas como para agentes de AI.

Responsabilidades:

Estrategia y visión

  • Definir la visión, el roadmap y las prioridades del design system de Bold, alineados con los objetivos de producto y de negocio.

  • Establecer principios, gobernanza y criterios de contribución: qué entra al sistema, quién decide y cómo se versiona.

  • Diseñar el sistema para que lo consuman personas y agentes de AI por igual: tokens, componentes y documentación estructurados, semánticos y legibles por máquina.

Liderazgo del equipo

  • Gestionar y desarrollar al equipo de design system: diseño UX, diseño UI e ingeniería de desarrollo.

  • Planificar capacidad, priorizar el backlog y asegurar entregas con calidad y consistencia.

  • Coordinar con los equipos de producto, diseño e ingeniería (web y app) como socio, no como área de soporte.

Librería de componentes

  • Crear y mantener la librería de componentes en diseño (Figma) y en código, con paridad entre ambas.

  • Garantizar accesibilidad, rendimiento, responsive y documentación de uso (UI y UX) en cada componente.

  • Gestionar tokens de diseño (color, tipografía, espaciado, motion) como base común de ambos mundos.

Adopción medible

  • Lograr que los diseñadores UX construyan prototipos con los componentes UI del sistema.

  • Lograr que los ingenieros front de web y app construyan los productos con el código de los componentes.

  • Definir y seguir métricas de adopción (por ejemplo, % de pantallas y productos que usan componentes del DS, cobertura de componentes, desviaciones, tiempo de entrega) y usarlas para priorizar mejoras.

  • Dar soporte, formación y comunicación continua para impulsar el uso en toda la organización.

Flujo de trabajo end to end diseño a código

  • Ser dueño del flujo completo: toda actualización de UI o UX en el DS debe reflejarse en el repositorio de componentes en código.

  • Implementar pipelines de versionado, publicación y pruebas (incluidas pruebas visuales y de accesibilidad) que permitan a los productos actualizarse a nuevas versiones de forma automática.

  • Gestionar cambios importantes, deprecaciones y comunicación de versiones para no romper los productos.

¿Qué tenemos para ti?

👨🏽‍⚕️ Auxilio de salud.

🚀 Bono anual por cumplimiento de objetivos empresariales (acciones o dinero).

🤝 Contrato a término indefinido.

💲 Salario competitivo.

👩🏿‍💻 Trabajo remoto 100%.

📚 Apoyo económico para educación.

🌎 Tecnologías y procesos de clase mundial.

🏖️ Días libres adicionales a las vacaciones.

Requirements

Experiencia requerida

  • 3 a 6 años o más en product management, ingeniería front-end o design systems, con al menos 2 años liderando equipos.

  • Portafolio o casos que muestren resultados medibles de adopción y de impacto en velocidad o consistencia.

Habilidades técnicas

  • Dominio de Figma: componentes, variables, tokens, variantes y librerías compartidas.

  • Conocimiento sólido de front-end: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, React y desarrollo de librerías de componentes (también deseable conocimiento de desarrollo móvil).

  • Gestión de tokens y su automatización del diseño al código (por ejemplo, Style Dictionary o Tokens Studio).

  • Pipelines de CI/CD, versionado semántico, publicación de paquetes y pruebas (unitarias, visuales y de accesibilidad).

  • Documentación de componentes (por ejemplo, Storybook) y accesibilidad (WCAG).

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Graduate Intern – AI-Enabled Knowledge Graphs for Patient Journey Analytics

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. During this program, you will explore how artificial intelligence, knowledge graphs, and graph analytics can be used to better understand patient journeys and address complex epidemiology and real-world evidence questions—ultimately supporting our mission to serve patients.

  • Design and develop a prototype knowledge graph representing longitudinal patient journeys, including relevant relationships among patient characteristics, treatments, clinical events, and outcomes.
  • Identify and apply established graph algorithms to investigate epidemiology questions that can be challenging to address using traditional tabular data structures and predictive modeling approaches.
  • Explore approaches for stratifying patients based on treatment patterns and outcomes and for identifying patient subgroups with similar clinical journeys.
  • Use AI-assisted tools and methods to support project development—for example, accelerating knowledge graph design, data mapping, code development, documentation, and quality review—while applying appropriate human oversight, validation, and responsible AI practices.
  • Evaluate additional use cases, such as identifying common treatment pathways, characterizing transitions in care, and assessing relationships among treatments, clinical events, and outcomes.
  • Compare knowledge graph–based methods with selected traditional analytical approaches, documenting their relative strengths, limitations, and appropriate applications.
  • Deliver reusable analytical code, technical documentation, a working prototype or demonstration, and a final presentation summarizing findings, organizational value, and recommendations for future development.

  • Ability to work with complex datasets and translate scientific or business questions into analytical approaches.
  • Strong problem-solving, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with data scientists, epidemiologists, and other cross-functional partners.

  • Currently enrolled in an MBA program for an MBA internship OR a Master’s program for a Master’s internship OR a PharmD program for a PharmD internship OR Ph.D. for a PhD internship from an accredited college or university and completion of the first year of MBA OR Master’s OR Pharm D OR Ph.D. program before the internship starts

Preferred Qualifications:

jobs.title: Quality Cell Lead
jobs.description:
Brief

We are looking for an experienced Quality Cell Lead to define, lead, and continuously improve quality engineering and testing practices across multiple engineering cells. This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on embedding quality throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring that quality is engineered into products from the outset rather than verified only at the end. You will own the overall quality and test strategy, establish consistent standards and best practices, and ensure comprehensive testing coverage across the platform. Working closely with Technical Leads, Product Owners, and engineering teams, you will oversee functional testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, performance testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing. A key aspect of the role is supervising and improving AI-agent-driven testing capabilities, including automated test generation, defect detection, test execution, and continuous quality monitoring. The ideal candidate combines strong software testing expertise, quality management experience, technical problem-solving skills, and a forward-thinking approach to AI-enabled software delivery.

Company Details

Our client is a well-established UK-based digital retail and financial services organization with a strong focus on technology, customer experience, and innovation.

The business is undertaking a significant technology transformation program involving a new website, order management, customer service, and credit platform capabilities. The technology team is responsible for delivering the credit platform, while working closely with Financial Services business teams to support regulatory, operational, and business readiness.

The program is moving through a staged customer cohort go-live from October through February, creating a need for strong delivery leadership, stakeholder coordination, governance, and readiness management.

This is an opportunity to join an established technology transformation program at a critical stage, working across technology and business teams to ensure successful and controlled delivery.


Responsibilities

    Define, own, and maintain the overall quality assurance and test strategy across engineering cells, ensuring consistent standards, methodologies, and coverage across the platform.
    Establish and maintain quality requirements, testing standards, best practices, and engineering guidelines that support reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable software delivery.
    Ensure quality is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle, promoting early testing, defect prevention, continuous validation, and risk-based quality practices.
    Lead functional testing activities across development stages, ensuring that test coverage aligns with functional requirements, technical specifications, and business priorities.
    Oversee user acceptance testing planning and execution, ensuring that test scenarios, environments, entry criteria, exit criteria, and reporting processes are appropriately defined and managed.
    Supervise AI-agent-driven testing capabilities, including automated test generation, regression testing, defect detection, test execution, and test coverage maintenance.
    Identify and implement opportunities for agent-led testing and continuous testing, including improvements to testing tools, frameworks, workflows, and AI prompts.
    Work hands-on where necessary to develop, improve, debug, and maintain test automation frameworks, testing tools, and quality engineering solutions.
    Collaborate with Technical Leads, Product Owners, and engineering cell members to ensure quality requirements are understood, prioritised, implemented, and validated.
    Ensure clear ownership and alignment of acceptance criteria, recognising that Product Managers own business acceptance criteria while the Quality Cell Lead owns technical acceptance criteria.
    Define and monitor quality metrics, test coverage, defect trends, automation performance, and testing effectiveness across engineering cells.
    Establish measurement objectives and reporting mechanisms that provide visibility into quality performance, testing efficiency, and areas requiring improvement.
    Lead quality reviews, assess testing outcomes, identify process gaps, and implement corrective actions to improve consistency and engineering standards.
    Ensure appropriate integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, load, and stress testing is implemented and maintained for critical APIs and services.
    Improve test data availability and test environment readiness, reducing delays caused by missing data, configuration issues, or unreliable environments.
    Identify, track, and reduce testing-related technical debt, including flaky tests, outdated frameworks, missing automation, and gaps in regression coverage.
    Assess software deliverables against agreed technical quality and service acceptance criteria, identifying risks that could affect operational readiness or production releases.
    Provide authoritative guidance on testing methodologies, quality management techniques, test automation, and appropriate tools and frameworks.
    Maintain a quarterly quality and testing roadmap, alongside a lower-confidence six-month forecast aligned with engineering delivery objectives and platform evolution.
    Monitor emerging technologies, testing methodologies, AI capabilities, and quality engineering tools, assessing their potential benefits, risks, and opportunities for adoption.
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of organisational quality policies, standards, processes, and engineering practices.
    Support and guide engineering teams in applying quality standards consistently while ensuring that day-to-day work allocation remains with the respective cell leads.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Quality Engineering and Testing Performance

    Quality roadmap:Maintain a quarterly quality and test roadmap and a lower-confidence six-month forecast aligned with engineering delivery goals and platform evolution.
    API and critical-service test coverage:Monitor the percentage of critical API endpoints and services covered by functional, integration, and end-to-end tests.
    Test automation execution rate:Measure the percentage of test cases executed automatically versus manually across environments and CI/CD pipelines, including agent-authored tests.
    Defect detection and resolution:Track mean time to detect and resolve defects, covering issues identified before and after production release.
    Defect leakage rate:Measure the percentage of critical defects that escape into production compared with those identified during testing.
    Consistency of quality standards:Assess adherence to quality frameworks, testing standards, tooling requirements, and review practices across engineering cells.
    Performance and load testing coverage:Track the percentage of critical services with implemented and maintained load, stress, and performance tests.
    Test data and environment readiness:Measure the percentage of test cycles delayed by unavailable or invalid test data, environment misconfiguration, or infrastructure issues.
    Testing technical debt:Track and reduce flaky tests, outdated testing frameworks, missing automation, and outstanding test coverage improvements.
    AI-led testing effectiveness:Monitor the reliability, coverage, maintainability, and effectiveness of AI-generated tests and agent-led testing workflows.
    Service acceptance readiness:Ensure critical deliverables are evaluated against agreed technical quality and operational acceptance criteria before release.
    Continuous improvement:Demonstrate measurable improvements in test reliability, automation, defect prevention, and the consistency of quality practices across engineering cells.

Qualifications

    Proven experience in software quality engineering, QA, or software testing in a senior or lead role.
    Strong experience defining test strategies, quality standards, and testing frameworks.
    Hands-on expertise in functional, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
    Experience with test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and continuous testing.
    Knowledge of performance, load, and stress testing for critical services.
    Experience with quality metrics, defect management, test coverage, and service acceptance.
    Strong understanding of software development fundamentals, code reviews, and requirements management.
    Experience using AI coding agents and AI-driven testing tools for test creation, execution, and defect detection.
    Ability to validate AI-generated tests for accuracy, reliability, and coverage.
    Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
    Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
    Ability to provide technical leadership, work hands-on, and drive continuous quality improvements.
    Fully remote:Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed engineering teams in a remote environment.

jobs.title: Associate Product Designer, New Grad
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for an Associate Product Designer, New Grad to join Bask Health and help design intuitive, functional, and visually polished experiences across our software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As an Associate Product Designer, you'll work with experienced designers, product managers, and engineers to help improve how users interact with Bask Health's products.

This is an entry-level product design role intended for recent graduates and designers beginning their professional careers. We're looking for someone with strong design fundamentals, curiosity about how software works, and the motivation to develop their skills through hands-on product work.

You'll contribute to user interface design, user experience improvements, wireframes, prototypes, and visual design tasks across different parts of the platform.

Your work may involve merchant dashboards, onboarding experiences, patient questionnaires, account settings, administrative tools, or other product features.

You'll help translate product requirements and user needs into clear, practical interface designs.

You'll work with senior designers to understand design decisions, evaluate different approaches, and improve the usability and consistency of your work.

You'll also collaborate with engineers to understand how designs are implemented and learn how technical considerations influence product decisions.

A key part of this role will be developing your ability to think beyond individual screens. You'll learn to consider how users move through workflows, how different features connect, and how interface decisions affect the overall product experience.

You'll use Figma to create wireframes, interface layouts, interactive prototypes, and design specifications.

You'll also contribute to Bask Health's design system by using established components, maintaining visual consistency, and helping document reusable patterns.

You'll participate in design reviews, incorporate feedback, and refine your work through multiple iterations.

You'll have opportunities to learn from usability research, customer feedback, and product analytics to better understand how users interact with the platform.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn to approach patient-facing and operational experiences with appropriate attention to clarity, accessibility, privacy, and accuracy.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable asking questions, open to feedback, detail-oriented, and excited to grow into a well-rounded product designer.

What You'll Do

  • Support product design initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Create user interface designs for web-based product features.
  • Develop wireframes and early-stage design concepts.
  • Build interactive prototypes using Figma.
  • Help translate product requirements into intuitive interface layouts.
  • Contribute to merchant-facing dashboards and administrative tools.
  • Support design improvements for patient onboarding experiences.
  • Assist with the design of digital questionnaires and multi-step forms.
  • Create layouts for account settings and configuration workflows.
  • Collaborate with senior designers to improve usability and visual consistency.
  • Participate in product design reviews and feedback sessions.
  • Refine designs based on feedback from designers, product managers, and engineers.
  • Use established design system components and interface patterns.
  • Help maintain consistent spacing, typography, colors, and component usage.
  • Support the documentation of reusable design components.
  • Create responsive designs for different screen sizes.
  • Consider accessibility and inclusive design principles in interface work.
  • Help identify confusing interactions and opportunities to simplify workflows.
  • Collaborate with UX researchers to understand user feedback and usability findings.
  • Work with content designers to ensure interface language and layouts work together.
  • Partner with engineers to understand implementation requirements.
  • Prepare design files and specifications for development handoff.
  • Review implemented features and identify differences from approved designs.
  • Assist with design quality assurance before product releases.
  • Explore alternative design solutions when appropriate.
  • Learn how product decisions balance user needs, business requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Maintain organized Figma files and design documentation.
  • Take ownership of assigned design tasks while seeking guidance when needed.

Requirements

  • Recent graduate or early-career designer with 0–2 years of professional product design, UX design, or UI design experience.
  • Educational background in product design, UX/UI design, interaction design, human-computer interaction, graphic design, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated skills.

  • Ability to explore multiple design approaches before selecting a solution.
  • Familiarity with the product development process.

Nice to Have

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Content Strategist to help define how content is structured, written, managed, and maintained across Bask Health's software platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As our platform grows, clear and consistent product content becomes increasingly important. Different users interact with different parts of the software, but they should encounter terminology, instructions, and interface patterns that feel connected and understandable.

As a Product Content Strategist, you'll help establish the content principles, standards, and systems that make this possible.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role combining product content strategy, UX writing, content design, information architecture, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll work on both the long-term structure of our content and the practical details of how that content appears in product experiences.

You'll develop and maintain terminology standards, voice and tone guidelines, reusable interface content patterns, and content governance practices. You'll help teams make consistent decisions about how features are named, how workflows are explained, and how users receive guidance.

Your work will span merchant-facing, patient-facing, and internal software experiences. You'll consider how content supports business configuration, patient onboarding, questionnaires, subscriptions, administrative settings, and other workflows.

You'll collaborate closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, UX writers, researchers, and operational stakeholders to ensure content decisions are integrated into product development rather than treated as a final editing step.

You'll also help improve how product content is organized and maintained. This includes identifying duplicate or inconsistent terminology, documenting reusable patterns, and recommending approaches that allow content to scale as new features are introduced.

Because Bask supports healthcare-related businesses, some product language involves sensitive or specialized information. You'll work with appropriate subject matter experts to ensure content standards support accuracy, privacy, and approved clinical and pharmacy workflows.

You'll use research findings, usability feedback, product analytics, and content reviews to identify opportunities for improvement. You'll help teams understand where inconsistent language or poorly structured information creates unnecessary friction.

jobs.description:
About LumiMeds

LumiMeds is a fast-growing U.S.-based telehealth startup focused on weight management and long-term metabolic health. We are building the next generation of e-commerce and clinical infrastructure from the ground up.

As an early-stage company, we move quickly, operate with limited layers, and expect high ownership from every team member. There is no bureaucracy here — decisions happen fast, priorities evolve, and builders thrive.

We are a remote-first, globally distributed team that values clarity, accountability, and people who take initiative rather than wait for direction.

About the Role

LumiMeds is hiring a video editor to cut short-form video across three streams: educational content from our licensed healthcare creators, UGC from real customers and paid creators, and paid social ads. You'll take a clinician's 90-second explanation of how GLP-1s work and make it land. You'll turn a customer's iPhone testimonial into a Meta ad that converts. On spec, on time, and on the right side of compliance.

This is not a generalist editing role. You'll be cutting healthcare content in a tightly regulated category (compounded medications, metabolic health, HRT). Every cut, every overlay, every text card has to be both watchable and compliant. Paid ads in this space get extra scrutiny from Meta, TikTok, and the FTC, so you'll work closely with our social media manager, healthcare creators, and compliance reviewer to make sure everything ships clean.

The right person is fast, opinionated about what makes short-form work, and fluent with modern AI editing tools. You're also detail-oriented enough to catch when a stray B-roll clip, an AI voiceover, or a misplaced caption could create a compliance problem. No healthcare background required (we'll train you), but you do need to care about getting it right.

What You'll Do

Educational content (organic)

  • Edit 12–16 short-form educational videos per month (15–90 seconds) from self-shot creator footage for Instagram Reels and TikTok
  • Add captions, lower thirds, callouts, on-screen text, and B-roll where it strengthens the message

Paid ads

  • Cut 8–15 paid ad variations per month for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube: hook-led, conversion-focused, built for testing
  • Produce multiple variants of each concept (different hooks, CTAs, and first-3-second openers) so the media team can run proper creative tests
  • Iterate quickly on winning ads: recut hooks, swap B-roll, refresh creative when fatigue sets in

UGC

  • Edit UGC submissions from real customers and paid UGC creators into polished short-form content that still feels native and authentic (not over-produced)
  • Stitch multi-clip UGC into cohesive narratives (problem, product, result framing, within compliance bounds)

Across all streams

  • Use AI tools strategically to speed up production (auto-captioning, transcript-based editing, B-roll generation, voice cleanup) without letting AI shortcuts compromise accuracy or compliance
  • Apply LumiMeds brand standards consistently: fonts, colors, logo placement, end cards, disclosure formatting
  • Implement compliance reviewer feedback on cuts and revisions, sometimes across multiple rounds
  • Maintain organized project files and an archive of raw footage, approved B-roll, finished cuts, and ad variant trees
  • Stay current on what's working on Reels, TikTok, and paid social in the health and wellness space

What You Won't Do

  • You will NOT write scripts or determine clinical content — that comes from our licensed creators and the marketing team
  • You will NOT add efficacy claims, weight-loss promises, or outcome language in captions, on-screen text, or ad copy
  • You will NOT use AI to generate fake clinician footage, deepfake any creator or customer, clone voices, or fabricate B-roll that misrepresents what's being described
  • You will NOT use before/after imagery, testimonial framings, or comparisons to branded products (Wegovy, Ozempic, Zepbound, Mounjaro)
  • You will NOT upload, publish, or push final files live to ad accounts — final files go to the social media manager and media buyer

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 2+ years editing short-form vertical video for social. Portfolio with current work required
  • Demonstrated experience editing paid social ads (Meta, TikTok, or YouTube) — not just organic content. You understand hook-led structure, retention curves, and why ad creative is different from organic creative
  • Strong fluency in at least one of: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Pro
  • Working knowledge of AI editing tools: Descript or similar transcript-based editing, AI captioning (CapCut, Submagic, Opus Clip), AI audio cleanup (Adobe Enhance, Auphonic)
  • Comfort cutting UGC: taking imperfect, multi-source footage and making it work without stripping out the authenticity that makes UGC perform
  • Captioning skills that go beyond auto-generated: accurate, well-timed, well-styled, readable on mute
  • Genuine taste for what makes short-form work: pacing, hooks, retention, when to cut, when to let a beat breathe
  • Willingness to learn FDA marketing compliance basics as they apply to compounded medications and paid health advertising (we'll train you)

Strongly Preferred

  • Direct experience editing paid DTC ads in healthcare, wellness, supplements, telehealth, or other regulated, performance-driven categories
  • Familiarity with the visual language differences between educational, UGC, and ad content
  • Experience producing ad variant trees (same concept, multiple hooks, CTAs, and openers) for systematic creative testing
  • Experience working with a brand kit and maintaining visual consistency across many cuts
  • Motion graphics chops: clean text animations, simple lower thirds, callout treatments
  • Comfort with audio cleanup (noise reduction, leveling, music ducking)
  • Experience using AI tools responsibly in regulated contexts
  • Working knowledge of Meta, TikTok, and YouTube ad creative specs and policy (especially health and wellness ad policies)

Bonus

  • Color grading skills beyond basic correction
  • Spanish or Tagalog fluency (we're planning bilingual content and matching captioning helps)
  • Experience with AI dubbing or translation tools (ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Rask) for bilingual ad and content workflows
  • Experience editing for accounts or ad accounts in the 100K+ follower or six-figure monthly ad spend range

Logistics

  • Engagement type: Full-time (W-2)
  • Location: Fully remote, U.S.-based preferred (open to Canada/Latin America for the right person)
  • Software: You bring your own. We'll cover any LumiMeds-specific tools, plugins, or AI tool subscriptions
  • Start date: As soon as the right person is found

What Working With Us Looks Like

  • Footage and briefs drop into a shared folder: educational footage from creators, UGC from customers and paid UGC creators, raw assets for ad concepts
  • Each project comes with a brief: format, platform, aspect ratios needed, hook variations to produce, compliance considerations flagged upfront
  • You cut, deliver a first version (or variant set), and post to a review thread
  • You revise (usually 1–2 rounds for organic, sometimes 3+ for ads where compliance is stricter)
  • Final files get approved, you upload to the delivery folder, marketing and media buying take it from there
  • Weekly check-in during high-volume ad pushes; monthly check-in (30 min) otherwise

How to Apply

Send the following to :

  • A short note (3–5 sentences) on why this role interests you
  • Your reel or 3–5 links to recent work, ideally a mix of organic short-form, UGC edits, and paid ads
  • At least one example of a paid ad you edited, with a sentence on what platform it ran on and what the goal was
  • A sentence or two on which AI tools you actually use in your workflow and what for
  • Your rate expectations (per-video, per-variant, or monthly retainer)
  • Software you cut on
  • If you have it: an example of a piece you edited for a regulated category and a sentence on what constraints you were editing under

We review applications on a rolling basis. Expect to hear back within 2 weeks if there's a fit.

Why This Role Exists

LumiMeds runs three video streams that all live or die on the same craft: educational content that earns trust, UGC that proves real people use the product, and paid ads that bring new patients in the door. They look different, they perform on different metrics, and they each have their own compliance traps. We need one editor who can move between all three without losing the plot.

AI tools have made parts of this faster than ever. They've also made it easier than ever to ship something polished, plausible, and quietly wrong — especially in paid ads. We need someone who can use modern tools to move fast, and never let the polish drift into territory that compromises the brand, the creators we work with, or the audience's trust.

How to Apply

If this role sounds like a fit, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English and ensure your resume reflects relevant experience for the role.

This position is open to candidates based in approved locations, depending on the role and business needs. Qualified applicants will be contacted for next steps.

LumiMeds is an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on skills, experience, and alignment with our values.

Please note: This role requires professional-level English communication and availability to work U.S. business hours.

Overview

As part of the Corporate Services organization at Waters Corporation, this role will provide global leadership for the Security workstream supporting future SAP S/4HANA releases, upgrades, and transformation initiatives. The Sr Manager will own and coordinate security design, role build and remediation, segregation of duties analysis, security testing, cutover readiness, deployment, and post-go-live hypercare. The role will partner with business process owners, Enterprise Applications, IT Security and GRC, Internal Controls, Basis, testing, change management, and implementation partners to deliver secure, scalable, and supportable access solutions. This leader will also establish the knowledge transfer, training, documentation, metrics, and governance model required to transition solutions into sustainable operations and drive ongoing process improvement.

Responsibilities

Lead the Security workstream for S/4HANA releases, upgrades, and transformation programs. Translate business and technical requirements into a security delivery plan; manage scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, partner performance, and executive-level status reporting.

Direct future-state SAP security architecture and role design across S/4HANA, Fiori, GRC, and integrated applications. Promote least privilege, scalable role structures, appropriate organizational restrictions, secure privileged access, and alignment with information security and compliance requirements.

Own role build quality, access remediation, segregation of duties analysis, sensitive-access review, and coordination of mitigating controls. Partner with process owners, IT Security and GRC, Internal Controls, and auditors to resolve design gaps and support timely, sustainable remediation.

Plan and oversee security unit, integration, user acceptance, and regression testing. Confirm test identities and role assignments reflect the required access model; manage defects through resolution; and provide evidence of readiness for deployment and control assurance.

Lead security cutover, deployment, and hypercare activities, including production provisioning, transport and access validation, incident triage, escalation, stabilization, and transition to steady-state support. Establish clear readiness criteria, ownership, support coverage, and exit criteria.

Build a sustainable Security operating and governance model. Deliver knowledge transfer, role-owner and support-team training, procedures, standards, service metrics, backlog governance, periodic role optimization, and continuous improvement for future releases and ongoing operations.

Qualifications

Education / Certifications:

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Business, Accounting, or related field. SAP security, SAP GRC, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent certification preferred.

Experience:

Minimum of 12-15 years of progressive experience in SAP security, identity and access governance, enterprise applications, or related technology risk disciplines, including experience leading SAP S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, releases, or large-scale transformation programs. Experience managing global teams and third-party delivery partners preferred.

Complexity:

Demonstrated expertise and leadership in:

  • SAP S/4HANA and Fiori security concepts, role design, authorization objects, user administration, and GRC access controls.
  • Least privilege, segregation of duties, sensitive and privileged access, role ownership, access provisioning, and mitigating-control processes.
  • Security design, build, remediation, testing, cutover, deployment, hypercare, and transition to steady-state support.
  • Regression-test planning, defect governance, root-cause analysis, risk-based decision-making, and production-readiness assessment.
  • Governance models, operating procedures, metrics, service management, documentation, training, knowledge transfer, and continuous improvement.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business process owners, Enterprise Applications, Basis, IT Security and GRC, Internal Controls, audit, change management, testing, and implementation partners.
  • Clear executive communication, stakeholder influence, issue escalation, vendor management, and delivery in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Balancing security, compliance, usability, operational supportability, program timelines, and business continuity.

Overview
