About HealthEdge

HealthEdge is a leading healthcare SaaS company delivering modern, cloud-native solutions that transform how health plans operate. With a global workforce spanning the US, India, Philippines, Mexico, and the UK, our Business Technology team powers the tools and platforms that keep HealthEdge running at scale – and Atlassian is at the center of how work gets done across the organization.

Role Overview

The Atlassian Administrator is a hands-on platform administration role responsible for the day-to-day configuration, maintenance, and user support of HealthEdge's Atlassian environment, including Jira Software, Jira Service Management (JSM), and Confluence. Working within the Atlassian Products team and reporting to the Manager, Atlassian Products, you will be a key execution resource for platform requests, project configuration, user management, and basic automation – ensuring that thousands of users across the organization can work effectively in Atlassian tools every day.

This is a great role for someone with solid Atlassian fundamentals who wants to deepen their platform expertise in a complex, high-scale environment. You'll work closely with Senior Atlassian Administrators, Architects, and the team manager, taking on well-defined configuration tasks and growing toward more advanced solution design and automation work over time. As HealthEdge moves fully to Atlassian Cloud Enterprise, this role will grow to include working with AI-native features like Atlassian Intelligence and Rovo — making content governance and platform hygiene directly connected to AI quality.

What You'll Do

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Administer Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence in a cloud environment
  • Create and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, permission schemes, notification schemes, and screens under the guidance of senior team members
  • Configure and manage JSM service desk projects including request types, queues, SLA configurations, and portal settings
  • Manage Confluence spaces, page permissions, templates, and basic macros to support team knowledge management
  • Perform user and group management including account creation, license assignments, group membership, and access reviews
  • Process and fulfill Atlassian support requests from end users, maintaining SLA compliance in the team's JSM queue

Automation & Reporting

  • Build and maintain native Jira and JSM automation rules for common workflows – ticket routing, notifications, field updates, and status transitions
  • Create and maintain dashboards, saved filters, and basic reports to support team and stakeholder visibility
  • Assist with Confluence automation and page template maintenance
  • Support testing and rollout of automation changes developed by Senior Administrators

User Support & Enablement

  • Serve as a first point of contact for Atlassian support requests, resolving common configuration and usage questions
  • Escalate complex or high-impact issues to Senior Atlassian Administrators with clear documentation and context
  • Assist in onboarding new users and teams to Atlassian tools, including basic training and guidance on project setup
  • Contribute to and maintain Atlassian knowledge base articles and how-to documentation for end users

Governance & Housekeeping

  • Perform routine platform hygiene tasks including inactive user cleanup, stale project reviews, and unused field or scheme audits
  • Assist with license usage tracking and reporting to support renewal planning
  • Follow and help enforce Atlassian governance standards for project naming, permissions, and configuration consistency
  • Support audit and compliance activities related to Atlassian access and configuration

Overview:

About This Role

HealthEdge is seeking a Product Manager, HRP Artificial Intelligence to lead the AI strategy and product vision for HealthRules® Payer – our flagship core administrative processing platform. jobs.description:
Overview

The Leave of Absence and Benefits Analyst is responsible for administering and managing all aspects of employee leaves of absence, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local leave laws while providing exceptional customer service to employees, managers, HR partners, and business leaders. This role serves as the primary point of contact for leave-related matters and coordinates with internal departments, benefits, Human Resources, payroll, and third-party vendors to ensure accurate administration of leave programs, disability benefits, and return-to-work processes and assists with additional daily benefit needs and processes as needed.

At this time, US Anesthesia Partners does not hire candidates residing in California, Hawaii, or Alaska.

The base pay estimate for this role is $60,800 - $103,400 annually. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.

Job Highlights

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation)

  • Administer and manage leaves of absence, including Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), state family and medical leave programs, military leave, personal leave, sick and safe leave, and company-specific leave programs.
  • Notify employees of FMLA rights, responsibilities, eligibility, and required documentation; provide notification to managers regarding leave approvals, extensions, denials, return-to-work dates, and next-step requirements.
  • Educate and counsel employees on all aspects of leave of absence programs, policies, procedures, and benefits implications; Educate and counsel managers, HR partners, and business leaders on leave-related policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.
  • Coordinate and manage complex leave cases involving multiple stakeholders and overlapping leave programs using both Workday and FreshService systems.
  • Maintain accurate leave documentation and records in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements; Monitor leave durations, certification deadlines, and return-to-work processes.
  • Provide monthly leave reporting to HR Business Partners.
  • Interpret and administer federal, state, and local leave regulations across multiple states.
  • Provide guidance regarding state and city family and medical leave laws, paid family leave programs, and disability regulations and ensure compliance with FMLA, ADA, USERRA, state leave laws, paid family leave programs, and company policies.
  • Research and communicate legislative and regulatory changes impacting leave administration and maintain knowledge of both fully insured and self-insured benefit plans and related leave implications.
  • Calculate Short-Term Disability (STD) payments for MSO, RCM, and Corporate employees.
  • Receive and review state-paid leave computation notices and calculate benefit offsets based on state-paid benefits compared to company-provided salary continuation programs.
  • Perform payroll and leave-related calculations for self-funded disability plans and salary continuation programs.
  • Manage employees benefit premium collections during unpaid leaves, including self-funded payment calculations including arrears process and coordinate with Payroll to ensure accurate leave coding, benefit deductions, and disability payment processing.
  • Support continuation of benefits during leave, including health, welfare, and retirement plan considerations.
  • Administer PTO tracking and coordinate leave integration with paid time off programs; maintain employee leave records and transactions within Workday and FreshService and other leave administration systems and generate leave reports, audits, metrics, and compliance documentation.
  • Engage in general benefit processes, as needed, and support USAP policies and practices for the enterprise and applicable platform process.
  • Perform other duties in support of Total Rewards where process overlap may impact benefit functions to ensure compliance and a positive employee experience.

Qualifications

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities (KSAs):

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field preferred; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience administering leave of absence programs, disability benefits, and employee benefits, working with multi-state leave programs and regulatory requirements, calculating disability benefits, salary continuation, and leave-related payroll transactions, working with fully insured and self-insured benefit plans, and coordinating with third-party leave and disability vendors.
  • Experience using Workday HRIS and leave management systems.
  • Strong knowledge of FMLA, ADA, state leave laws, paid family leave programs, and related employment regulations.
  • Working knowledge of employee benefits, benefit eligibility, and leave-related benefit administration.
  • Knowledge of PTO administration and leave integration practices.
  • Ability to interpret complex leave laws and apply them in a practical business environment.
  • Strong analytical and mathematical skills with the ability to perform disability, payroll, and leave calculations.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills with the ability to counsel employees and leaders on sensitive situations.
  • Ability to manage confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Effective problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex employee relations and leave scenarios.

  • Occasional Walking

jobs.title: Power BI Adoption Lead-Remote UK Only
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Power BI Adoption Lead

Most Power BI roles ask you to build what someone else has already specified. This one asks you to decide how an entire enterprise uses Power BI — and then to make it happen.

A leading UK financial services organisation is standing up a modern cloud data platform, with Power BI as the strategic reporting layer on top of it. The governed semantic layer, certified datasets, enterprise design standards and community of practice are still being shaped — and the organisation is serious enough about data capability to have already invested in it. You will decide what good looks like, and own it end to end.

This is deliberately not a pure Power BI developer role, and equally not a change-management role. It is the rarer combination: someone who can build a performant enterprise semantic model, credibly challenge a developer's DAX, then stand in front of the business and teach it.

What you'll do

  • Own the enterprise Power BI adoption roadmap, with measurable adoption and value targets.
  • Build engagement from the ground up: stakeholder buy-in, a champions network, forums, clinics and a genuine community of practice.
  • Design and personally deliver structured training — workshops, learning materials and guidance, pitched from Excel-refugee to seasoned analyst.
  • Shape the governed semantic layer alongside data engineering: consistent KPI definitions, certification processes, naming conventions and refresh strategy.
  • Author the enterprise reporting Design Guide — standards, templates, palettes, UX conventions — and hold the organisation to it.
  • Establish workspace governance: deployment pipelines, Dev/QA/Prod design, RLS/CLS, sensitivity labelling and auditability.
  • Build and optimise flagship dashboards yourself, and troubleshoot performance where others are stuck.
  • Reduce duplicated, ungoverned reporting — and prove you have.

Requirements

Essential experience

  • Power BI technical depth — you have personally delivered enterprise-scale Power BI. Advanced DAX, Power Query/M, semantic model design and optimisation, large and complex datasets, workspace strategy and administration, RLS, certified datasets. You can coach on all of it and push back on poor implementation.
  • Adoption & change leadership — you have created an enterprise adoption roadmap, run champion networks, driven cultural change around data-driven decision making, and measured adoption and business value. This is the most critical dimension of the role.
  • Training & enablement — you have designed and personally delivered structured training programmes and built the materials yourself. Occasional knowledge-sharing is not what we mean.
  • Governance & operating model — reporting standards, dashboard design principles, workspace management, certified dataset processes and self-service controls. You know how to scale Power BI without creating a governance problem.

Desirable

  • Microsoft Fabric — architecture, capacity and medallion/lakehouse patter
  • Power Apps, ideally integrated with Power BI.
  • Sensitive, confidential or regulated data; Azure exposure; PL-300 and/or

Interview process

Shortlisted candidates will prepare a maximum of two PowerPoint slides on their approach to enterprise Power BI adoption, and demo a Power BI dashboard they personally designed and built on a dataset of their choice — covering the business problem, auorytelling, accessibility and how they would drive ongoing usage. Format and style are entirely your own.

To apply: send a CV or get in touch for a confidential conversation .

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. About the Role

We're looking for an AI Product Engineer, Clinical & Pharmacy Workflows to help build intelligent software features that improve how clinical and pharmacy-related processes operate across Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health supports direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses through technology that connects patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce systems. These workflows involve structured information, administrative tasks, operational coordination, and interactions between multiple teams and applications.

You'll help develop AI-powered capabilities that make these processes easier to manage, reduce repetitive administrative work, and provide useful information to authorized users.

This is a hands-on product engineering role that combines large language models, backend development, frontend application development, APIs, and workflow automation. You'll work with existing application infrastructure and modern AI technologies to build features that integrate directly into clinical and pharmacy-related tools.

Your work may include AI-assisted administrative summaries, workflow navigation, document information extraction, operational task support, and intelligent assistance for approved clinical and pharmacy coordination processes.

Leidos has an immediate opening for a Mid-Level Network Migration Engineer to support the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) program.

This is an exciting opportunity to help modernize and secure the Army's global enterprise network, supporting critical communications and mission operations worldwide.

In this remote role, you'll work with experienced network engineers and technical teams to support network migrations, routing and switching, SD-WAN connectivity, troubleshooting, and infrastructure modernization.

We're looking for someone with strong hands-on networking experience who enjoys solving technical challenges, working with advanced technologies, and supporting mission-critical infrastructure.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.title: Junior Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Applied AI Engineer to help develop, test, and improve AI-powered software features across Bask Health's platform.

Bask Health provides the technology behind direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses, connecting merchant storefronts, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools. As we continue building AI-powered capabilities, we're looking for an early-career engineer who wants to apply modern AI technologies to real product challenges.

You'll work alongside experienced software engineers, applied AI engineers, and product teams to develop intelligent features that improve how merchants, patients, and internal teams interact with our platform.

This is a hands-on engineering position where you'll contribute to production software while developing your technical skills. You'll gain experience working with large language models, backend APIs, application integrations, automated testing, and AI development tools.

Your work may include implementing AI-assisted application features, integrating model APIs, improving prompts, building supporting backend services, and testing model outputs for accuracy and reliability.

You'll also help investigate technical issues, write documentation, and improve existing AI features based on feedback from engineers and product stakeholders.

We're looking for someone who understands the fundamentals of software development, has experimented with modern AI technologies, and is comfortable learning new tools and frameworks.

You don't need to have years of professional AI engineering experience. Strong personal projects, internships, coursework, open-source contributions, or other demonstrated technical work can help show your ability to succeed in this role.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn to build AI features with appropriate attention to privacy, permissions, reliability, and human oversight. You'll work within established engineering safeguards and will not be responsible for independently designing clinical decision-making systems.

This role offers the opportunity to gain practical experience building AI-powered products, contribute meaningful engineering work, and grow alongside a team developing modern software for healthcare businesses.

What You'll Do

  • Assist with developing AI-powered features across Bask Health's platform.
  • Work with experienced engineers to integrate large language models into software applications.
  • Implement application features using TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or comparable languages.
  • Build and maintain backend API integrations for AI-powered functionality.
  • Assist with connecting applications to approved AI model providers.
  • Develop and improve prompts for supported AI features.
  • Implement structured model outputs and basic response validation.
  • Help build AI-assisted tools for merchant-facing and internal workflows.
  • Contribute to patient-facing AI features within approved product and safety boundaries.
  • Assist with developing AI-powered search, summarization, and information retrieval features.
  • Write automated tests for AI integrations and application functionality.
  • Help evaluate AI-generated responses for accuracy, consistency, and relevance.
  • Investigate unexpected model outputs and report reproducible issues.
  • Assist with testing AI features using realistic application scenarios.
  • Help improve error handling and fallback behavior in AI-powered applications.
  • Work with backend engineers to connect AI functionality to existing services.
  • Contribute to frontend integrations for AI-powered user experiences.
  • Assist with maintaining application data flows and API connections.
  • Help document AI features, implementation details, and technical limitations.
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback from senior engineers.
  • Learn and follow Bask Health's engineering standards and development practices.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity while reviewing generated code carefully.
  • Assist with troubleshooting development and production issues.
  • Collaborate with product managers and engineers to understand feature requirements.
  • Help identify opportunities to improve existing AI-powered workflows.
  • Participate in engineering planning, technical discussions, and team collaboration.
  • Learn about secure software development and responsible handling of sensitive information.
  • Take ownership of appropriately scoped engineering tasks and deliver reliable, well-tested code.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience through internships, coursework, personal projects, or open-source contributions.
  • Foundational programming skills in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, or comparable languages.
  • Understanding of basic software engineering principles and application development.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs or comparable application integration methods.
  • Basic understanding of large language models and generative AI applications.
  • Experience experimenting with AI model APIs, AI development tools, or AI-powered applications.
  • Familiarity with backend development concepts.
  • Understanding of basic data structures and programming logic.
  • Familiarity with Git and version control workflows.
  • Ability to read, understand, and modify existing application code.
  • Understanding of debugging and troubleshooting fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with automated testing concepts.
  • Basic understanding of databases and structured application data.
  • Willingness to learn new programming languages, frameworks, and AI technologies.
  • Ability to follow technical documentation and implementation instructions.
  • Understanding of basic authentication and application security concepts.
  • Ability to write clear, maintainable code with guidance.
  • Familiarity with JSON and structured API responses.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to communicate technical questions and challenges clearly.
  • Willingness to ask questions and incorporate engineering feedback.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with other engineers and product teams.
  • Interest in developing production software rather than only experimenting with AI models.
  • Strong curiosity about applied AI and modern software development.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and communicate progress consistently.

Nice to Have

  • Internship or project experience involving AI-powered applications.
  • Experience using OpenAI, Anthropic, or comparable model APIs.
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering and structured model outputs.
  • Experience building a chatbot, AI assistant, or other LLM-powered application.
  • Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation.
  • Basic understanding of embeddings and vector databases.
  • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js.
  • Familiarity with React or Next.js.
  • Experience with Python-based AI development libraries.
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or comparable AI application frameworks.
  • Experience developing backend APIs or serverless functions.
  • Familiarity with SQL or relational databases.
  • Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience writing automated tests using Jest, Vitest, Pytest, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation and testing concepts.
  • Experience participating in hackathons or building independent technical projects.
  • Open-source contributions or a GitHub portfolio demonstrating software development skills.
  • Interest in healthcare technology, telehealth, or e-commerce platforms.
  • Basic understanding of data privacy and responsible AI development.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

The remaining focus will involve key adjacent global learning products, such as enterprise LMS platforms, alumni and teacher networks, or global data extensions, depending on organizational priorities. All work is delivered virtually. Up to 10 % of travel may be required. Given that we work across different time zones, some non-traditional hours for early or later calls are an expectation of this role.

Each network partner recruits and develops promising leaders to teach in their nations’ under-resourced schools and communities and, with this foundation, to work with others, inside and outside of education, towards a world where all children have the education, support, and opportunity to shape a better future. Teach For All’s global organization works to increase the network’s impact by supporting the development of new organizations; fostering network connectivity and learning; providing coaching and consulting; and enabling access to global resources for the benefit of the network.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Pharmacy Integrations
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer, Pharmacy Integrations to help build, maintain, and improve the technical connections between Bask Health's telehealth platform and pharmacy systems.

In this role, you'll combine hands-on software engineering with practical integration work involving prescription workflows, pharmacy operations, and fulfillment processes. You'll work closely with engineering, product, and operational teams to understand how pharmacy systems exchange information and develop reliable solutions that support those workflows.

You'll build APIs, backend services, and integrations that help move prescription-related information between connected systems. Your work may involve prescription transmission, order processing, status updates, pharmacy routing, fulfillment tracking, and troubleshooting issues across different platforms.

This is a software engineering position rather than a pharmacy operations or technical support role. You'll write production-quality code, investigate complex integration problems, and help ensure pharmacy-related workflows are accurate, secure, and dependable.

You'll also help identify recurring integration challenges and develop reusable technical solutions that improve how Bask connects with pharmacy partners and related services.

We're looking for someone who enjoys solving complex integration problems, communicates clearly with technical and operational stakeholders, and understands the importance of reliability when working with healthcare-related systems.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain integrations between Bask Health's platform and external pharmacy systems.
  • Work with engineering, product, and pharmacy operations teams to understand technical integration requirements.
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and integration functionality using TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable technologies.
  • Support technical workflows involving prescription transmission, pharmacy routing, and order processing.
  • Build integrations that exchange prescription-related information between connected applications.
  • Develop functionality for tracking pharmacy order status and fulfillment updates.
  • Integrate external pharmacy services using REST APIs, webhooks, and other supported communication methods.
  • Implement data mapping and transformation between Bask's platform and pharmacy systems.
  • Build reliable processes for synchronizing prescription and fulfillment information.
  • Investigate and troubleshoot issues involving prescription data, API requests, and integration failures.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to improve pharmacy-related application services.
  • Work with SQL databases and application data to support integration workflows.
  • Develop automated processes that reduce repetitive pharmacy integration tasks.
  • Implement validation to help ensure accurate data exchange between systems.
  • Build appropriate error handling, retry mechanisms, and failure recovery processes.
  • Support secure authentication and authorization for pharmacy integrations.
  • Help maintain appropriate controls for sensitive healthcare information.
  • Monitor integration reliability, processing failures, and data synchronization issues.
  • Develop tools that improve visibility into pharmacy integration activity and system status.
  • Support technical discovery and implementation planning for new pharmacy connections.
  • Collaborate with pharmacy stakeholders to understand operational requirements and technical limitations.
  • Develop reusable integration components that support multiple pharmacy partners.
  • Write automated tests for important pharmacy integration workflows.
  • Document API requirements, data mappings, integration behavior, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to engineering best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of assigned pharmacy integration projects from development through deployment and maintenance.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, integrations engineering, forward deployed engineering, or a comparable hands-on technical role.
  • Strong programming experience with JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Experience developing backend applications, APIs, or services using Node.js or comparable technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building integrations between software applications and third-party services.
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and common integration patterns.
  • Experience developing and maintaining production software.
  • Familiarity with asynchronous processing and event-driven workflows.
  • Experience working with SQL databases and relational data.
  • Understanding of data mapping, transformation, and synchronization between systems.
  • Experience debugging and troubleshooting API and integration issues.
  • Ability to translate operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • Familiarity with authentication, authorization, and secure API communication.
  • Understanding of application validation, error handling, and reliability.
  • Experience implementing logging, monitoring, or troubleshooting tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and modern deployment practices.
  • Experience working with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience writing tests and maintaining software quality.
  • Strong attention to detail when working with structured data and interconnected systems.
  • Ability to investigate technical issues independently.
  • Experience collaborating with engineers, product managers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple technical priorities.
  • Ability to document integration requirements and implementation decisions.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ownership of assigned projects.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving, remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Integration Engineer, or Healthcare Software Engineer.
  • Experience integrating pharmacy management systems or prescription processing platforms.
  • Familiarity with electronic prescribing and prescription transmission workflows.
  • Understanding of pharmacy fulfillment, dispensing, and order management processes.
  • Experience working with pharmacy partners or healthcare technology vendors.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Experience with NCPDP standards or pharmacy-related data exchange formats.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy considerations.
  • Experience developing healthcare or telehealth applications.
  • Familiarity with prescription routing, medication information, or pharmacy order status workflows.
  • Experience building event-driven integrations or asynchronous processing systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, or comparable cloud technologies.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, and TypeScript in production.
  • Familiarity with tRPC, Prisma, or Drizzle ORM.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
  • Familiarity with OAuth, API authentication, and webhook security.
  • Experience implementing retry logic, idempotency, and failure recovery for integrations.
  • Experience developing internal monitoring or operational dashboards.
  • Experience turning custom integrations into reusable platform capabilities.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.

Your impact will extend beyond a single product or application. As a Sales Consultant on the dotloop SMB team, you will win new business with small and mid-sized brokerages, real estate teams and agents. jobs.title: Senior Planning & Consents Project Manager
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

This role is only open to current residents of the UK. No relocation or visa support is provided, but there may be routes to visa sponsorship for suitable candidates in the future. It is important that you possess full working rights within the UK at the time of your application. Candidates who do not meet this requirement may not be responded to.

We are a specialist project management consultancy supporting the development and delivery of major energy and infrastructure projects across England, Wales and Scotland.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Planning & Consents Project Manager to lead consenting work-streams for complex infrastructure projects from early concept and feasibility through application, examination, determination, pre-construction and Final Investment Decision (FID).

Working as part of integrated client and project teams, you will develop consenting strategies, coordinate multidisciplinary inputs and manage the programmes, risks, interfaces and stakeholders required to secure project approvals.

This is a project management and coordination role rather than a purely technical planning position. It would suit someone who combines knowledge of UK planning and consenting regimes with the ability to lead complex programmes, influence decisions and maintain momentum across multidisciplinary teams.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead planning and consenting work-streams from early feasibility and site selection through determination, pre-construction and FID
  • Develop proportionate planning and consenting strategies for major energy and infrastructure projects
  • Establish and manage consenting programmes, budgets, governance arrangements and delivery plans
  • Coordinate inputs from environmental, engineering, land, legal, stakeholder engagement and commercial specialists
  • Manage planning consultants, legal advisers and other specialist suppliers
  • Identify the required consents, licences, permissions and approvals for each project
  • Develop and maintain consent registers, responsibility matrices, risk registers and decision logs
  • Identify and manage planning risks, programme dependencies, critical interfaces and potential barriers to consent
  • Coordinate the preparation, review and submission of planning and consent applications
  • Support projects through pre-application engagement, consultation, examination and determination
  • Manage responses to requests for information, representations and examination questions
  • Coordinate the discharge of planning conditions, requirements and other consent obligations
  • Engage with planning authorities, examining bodies, statutory consultees, government departments and regulators
  • Provide clear advice and recommendations to clients, project directors and governance forums
  • Report on programme, cost, risk, progress and key decisions
  • Ensure planning and consenting activities remain aligned with engineering design, land strategy, environmental assessment and commercial objectives
  • Support investment approvals, due diligence and project readiness for FID
  • Contribute to the continued development of the consultancy’s planning and consenting capability
  • Build trusted client relationships and identify opportunities to provide additional support

Requirements

You will have experience managing the planning and consenting of major infrastructure, energy or other complex development projects. You may come from a consultancy, developer, utility, public-sector body or client-side project delivery background.

You will be comfortable taking ownership of complex workstreams, coordinating multiple specialist disciplines and translating planning requirements into clear project actions. You should also be able to operate independently within a remote consultancy while building effective relationships with clients and project stakeholders.

Essential Experience
  • Experience managing planning or consenting workstreams for major infrastructure, energy or complex development projects
  • Experience supporting projects from concept through consent and towards FID
  • Knowledge of UK planning and infrastructure consenting processes
  • Experience supporting nationally significant or major infrastructure projects
  • Knowledge of one or more consenting regimes, including:
    • Development Consent Orders in England
    • Developments of National Significance in Wales
    • Section 36 applications in Scotland
    • Town and Country Planning Act applications
    • Transport and Works Act Orders
    • Marine licensing and associated secondary consents
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and technical inputs
  • Ability to develop and manage consenting strategies, programmes, budgets and risk registers
  • Experience managing planning applications, consent submissions or examination processes
  • Understanding of the interfaces between planning, environmental assessment, engineering design, land and stakeholder engagement
  • Experience working with planning authorities, statutory consultees, regulators or other public bodies
  • Ability to identify risks, dependencies and critical path activities
  • Confidence managing external consultants and specialist suppliers
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to present complex information and recommendations to senior decision-makers
  • Confidence operating in a client-facing consultancy environment
  • Ability to prioritise effectively and work independently within a remote team

Benefits

Benefits include:

  • A fully remote role that can be based anywhere in the UK
  • An autonomous, mature and completely flexible working environment
  • An entrepreneurial and supportive culture that will help you develop your career in the direction that works for you
  • A highly competitive remuneration package, including profit-related bonus payments
  • The opportunity to work on complex, nationally important infrastructure projects
  • The ability to influence projects during the development stages when effective planning and consenting leadership can have the greatest impact
  • The opportunity to help shape and grow the consultancy’s planning and consenting capability

jobs.description:
LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Bambara-English Phone Interpreter


Job Title: BambaraInterpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.50 - $0.65 per minute


We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:


The Bambara Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Bambaraand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency inBambara and English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.

    • Kaspersky products.

  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.

jobs.title: Patient Journey Director CEE-Russia-Japan
jobs.description:
The Patient Journey Director CEERJ enables journey from first symptom to diagnosis, referral and appropriate care outcomes faster, clearer and fairer for people living with C3G/IC-MPGN and severe hypertriglyceridemia (sHTG) across CEERJ.

The role is driven by a genuine passion for improving the patient journey. It identifies where patients are delayed, missed or lost, partners with country medical and commercial teams to understand why, and turns those barriers into practical, compliant and measurable initiatives. This includes leading the integration of medical devices and diagnostic-enabling platforms (Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics) into patient journey frameworks for strategic CEERJ therapeutic areas (C3G/IC-MPGN, sHTG and secondarily haemophilia).

The role operates in a fast-moving, changing environment. The holder works in an agile way: sets few clear priorities, adapts quickly as launches, access and evidence evolve, and turns insight into executive-ready plans that are communicated clearly to the Brand Teams, Leadership Teams and Core Medical Team.

Main responsibilities:

Own the patient journey agenda for C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG across CEERJ. Define, maintain and continuously refine a regional patient journey framework that identifies diagnostic difficulties, delays and post-therapy difficulties, and translates them into prioritized, measurable initiatives.

Partner with countries to map and clear barriers & opportunities. Work alongside country leaders and field teams to map country-specific barriers (awareness, testing access, laboratory and biopsy pathways, referral fragmentation, expert centre availability, non-pharmaceutical therapy optimization opportunities)

Build & resource executive plans. Develop concise, prioritized patient journey improvement projects with clear milestones, owners, dependencies and KPIs. Resource and adjust them rapidly as conditions change. Report progress to senior leadership in Core Medical Team, CEERJ LT and Brand Team forums.

Lead projects and matrix teams: drive relevant Patient Journey projects and allocated matrix teams from kick off to close out ensuring clear planning, budgeting, delivery and reporting on time and within budget

Lead integration of medical devices and enabling platforms. Lead integration of Florio, Enfuse, diagnostics and pipeline tools into patient journey frameworks across CEERJ. Ensure stakeholder value, country readiness and compliant use. Track adoption, escalate barriers and propose solutions.

Generate and act on patient journey insights. Interact with external community to enable systematic collection and synthesis of insights from HCPs, KOLs, diagnostic initiatives, patient organisations and country teams. Turn them into clear recommendations that change plans and decisions.

Mastery of the landscape. Keep current knowledge of C3G/IC-MPGN and sHTG science, diagnostic pathways, competitive and customer landscape, Tier 1 KOLs and patient advocacy groups, and related areas such as PNH and haemophilia.

  • University degree such as M.D., Pharm. D., or PhD preferably with biological sciences background.
  • Academic, clinical or industry experience in therapeutic areas such as nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology or immunology
  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in commercial field role or medical affairs at a local level from larger country, with recognized success internally and externally. Experience in Patient Access, Community Engagement or Diagnostics will be a plus
  • Strong business acumen and presentation / communication skills across all levels of organization within and outside country
  • Multi-stakeholder project management and leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver results on time and within budget
  • Strong project management skills and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power Point and other Microsoft Office programmes
  • Working knowledge of EFPIA regulations and compliance requirements with demonstration of highest ethical standards
  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Highly motivated and self-driven with ability to think innovatively & strategically, skillfully plan, manage and prioritize multiple projects independently; demonstrates resilience and flexibility
  • Ability to work independently, while still maintaining a team and corporate approach to the function
  • Proactive, open minded, experienced leader, able to identify and carry out strategic initiatives with high patient impact in launches and life-cycle management
  • Strong business and scientific acumen, leadership skills, project management and scientific communication skills.

Additional requirement

  • Frequent regional and international travel is required, approximately 40% of working time.
  • Availability for external meetings, congresses and internal meetings outside standard hours with advance notice.
  • Valid driver's license may be required depending on local role set-up.
  • The role may be home-based or hybrid depending on country, local employment set-up and business requirements.
  • All activities must comply with applicable laws, regulations, industry codes, internal SOPs and Sobi policies.

Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day.

Sobi is a global company with over 2000 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. We are a specialised international biopharmaceutical company transforming the lives of people with rare and debilitating diseases, providing reliable access to innovative medicines in the areas of haematology, immunology, and specialty care. Sobi’s share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More about Sobi at sobi.com and LinkedIn.
We know our employees are our most valuable asset and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.
As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. Together, we define how our business can create solutions that serve the needs of those affected by rare diseases while facilitating sustainable growth.

At Sobi, each person brings their unique talents to work as a team and make a difference. We are dedicated to developing and delivering innovative therapies to improve the lives of rare disease patients and our edge comes from our team of people.

Sobi offers the opportunity to work at an international pharmaceutical company focused on specialty pharmaceuticals meeting the high medical needs of rare disease patients and providing treatment and services to them. Our employees come from a variety of backgrounds within research, healthcare, industry and the academic sphere.

jobs.title: Junior UX Researcher
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior UX Researcher to help Bask Health better understand how people interact with our software and support research that improves usability across the platform.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform connects merchant tools, patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a Junior UX Researcher, you'll help investigate how users navigate digital experiences, complete tasks, interpret information, and respond to different product designs.

This is an early-career research role focused on developing practical skills in usability testing, user interviews, research planning, observation, and qualitative analysis.

You'll work alongside experienced researchers, product designers, product managers, and engineers to understand user problems and identify opportunities to improve the product experience.

Your work may involve merchant onboarding, administrative dashboards, patient questionnaires, account settings, checkout experiences, and other workflows across the platform.

You'll help prepare research plans, develop interview questions, organize usability testing sessions, and document research findings.

You'll also have opportunities to participate in moderated usability studies, observe how users interact with prototypes, and identify areas where people encounter confusion or difficulty.

A key part of this role will be learning how to ask useful research questions, avoid leading participants, and distinguish observations from assumptions.

You'll support the analysis of qualitative research findings by organizing notes, identifying recurring patterns, and helping develop clear summaries.

You'll work with product designers to understand how research findings influence interface decisions.

You'll collaborate with product managers to learn how research priorities connect to product goals and development timelines.

You'll also work with engineers to understand how technical constraints and implementation decisions affect the user experience.

You'll become familiar with research tools, participant recruitment processes, research documentation, and the methods used to evaluate digital products.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, you'll learn to conduct research with appropriate attention to participant consent, privacy, sensitive information, and the boundaries of clinical workflows.

You'll receive guidance on research methodology and have opportunities to take increasing ownership of clearly defined research tasks as your skills develop.

We're looking for someone who is curious about human behavior, enjoys understanding how people use technology, and is motivated to develop into a strong UX researcher.

What You'll Do

  • Support UX research initiatives across Bask Health's software platform.
  • Assist with planning and organizing usability studies.
  • Help develop research questions and study objectives.
  • Prepare interview guides and usability testing materials.
  • Support moderated user interviews and research sessions.
  • Observe participants interacting with digital products and prototypes.
  • Take structured notes during research sessions.
  • Help document user behaviors, challenges, and feedback.
  • Assist with participant recruitment and screening through approved processes.
  • Support usability testing for merchant-facing software.
  • Help evaluate patient onboarding and questionnaire experiences.
  • Research how users navigate dashboards and administrative interfaces.
  • Assist with task-based usability evaluations.
  • Help identify confusing interactions and workflow friction.
  • Organize qualitative research notes and observations.
  • Support the identification of recurring themes and patterns.
  • Help prepare research summaries and presentations.
  • Collaborate with product designers to understand usability findings.
  • Work with product managers to understand research priorities.
  • Participate in product discovery and design review discussions.
  • Assist with prototype testing and concept evaluation.
  • Help evaluate interface comprehension and navigation clarity.
  • Learn how product analytics can complement qualitative research.
  • Support accessibility and inclusive research practices.
  • Follow appropriate research ethics, consent, and privacy procedures.
  • Maintain organized research files and documentation.
  • Contribute to reusable research templates and study materials.
  • Take ownership of assigned research tasks while seeking guidance when needed.

Requirements

  • Early-career candidate with 0–2 years of relevant experience in UX research, user research, human-computer interaction, behavioral research, or a related field.
  • Internship experience, academic research, freelance projects, or substantial independent research projects may be considered.
  • Portfolio, research case studies, or project examples demonstrating foundational research skills.
  • Understanding of basic user research principles.
  • Familiarity with qualitative research methods.
  • Basic knowledge of usability testing.
  • Familiarity with user interviews and observational research.
  • Ability to develop thoughtful research questions.
  • Understanding of how to avoid leading or biased interview questions.
  • Ability to take clear, organized research notes.
  • Familiarity with identifying patterns in qualitative information.
  • Strong analytical thinking and curiosity about user behavior.
  • Understanding of user-centered design principles.
  • Familiarity with digital products and web applications.
  • Willingness to learn research tools and methodologies.
  • Basic understanding of research ethics and informed consent.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain research observations clearly.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Willingness to incorporate feedback and improve research practices.
  • Ability to collaborate with designers, product managers, and engineers.
  • Comfortable asking questions and seeking clarification.
  • Ability to manage assigned tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Interest in improving software usability and accessibility.
  • Motivation to develop professionally as a UX researcher.

Nice to Have

  • Internship or professional experience in UX research.
  • Academic background in human-computer interaction, psychology, cognitive science, sociology, design, or a related field.
  • Experience conducting usability tests for web or mobile applications.
  • Familiarity with moderated or unmoderated research sessions.
  • Experience conducting interviews for academic or product research.
  • Familiarity with tools such as UserTesting, Maze, Dovetail, or comparable research platforms.
  • Experience evaluating Figma prototypes.
  • Understanding of information architecture and navigation testing.
  • Familiarity with survey design and basic quantitative research.
  • Experience organizing or coding qualitative research data.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive research principles.
  • Interest in healthcare technology or telehealth products.
  • Familiarity with patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Experience researching SaaS platforms or business software.
  • Understanding of e-commerce or direct-to-consumer products.
  • Familiarity with merchant dashboards or administrative applications.
  • Experience collaborating with UX or product designers.
  • Basic understanding of product analytics.
  • Experience using AI-assisted research tools with appropriate review and privacy safeguards.
  • Participation in academic research, design clubs, hackathons, or collaborative product projects.

Description

Centralized monitoring is an integral part of risk-based monitoring strategy, defined as the timely, remote review of accumulating subject and operational data to help distinguish between reliable and unreliable data, trends, outliers and unusual variability using analytics and statistical methods.

The Principal Central Monitor is responsible for leading the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses essential for centralized statistical review of study data from study start through to study database lock. The Principal Central Monitor enables proactive identification, communication, escalation and management of risks at the study/country/site level.

More specifically, the Principal Central Monitor must:

  • Lead effort on the development of new tools, instruction guidelines and analyses within the area of specialty, including complex and collaborative approaches with other functions.
  • Lead the development and setup of study-specific tools, analyses, and centralized monitoring plans, ensuring that the monitoring approach is aligned with study risks, critical data, and critical processes.
  • Act as the strategic and technical lead for centralized monitoring across multiple studies and for function-wide initiatives, providing direction on complex analyses, resolving escalated issues, and establishing consistent approaches and standards.
  • Assist in creating tools, techniques and processes for automating risk-based monitoring tasks (data integration automation, data retrieval automation, data mapping automation, and automated report generation).
  • Act as mentor as well as train new team members and junior staff.
  • Identify data quality trends indicative of systematic errors and potential performance issues at study/country/site level and track evidence of issues and potential risks with support from senior team members.
  • Represent centralized monitoring in cross-functional study risk assessment meetings and provide expert guidance on identification, evaluation, prioritization, mitigation, and ongoing review of study risks.
  • Provide input to leadership as needed to support development of risk characterization and reporting.

Employees may be assigned to other responsibilities that do not pertain to their former description, if they have the required experience, are qualified and/or have received adequate training.

Requirements

Education

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research.

Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in central statistical monitoring with an overall 10 years of experience in two or more operational areas such as clinical monitoring, data management, drug safety, medical monitoring, biometrics, or project management.
  • Excellent understanding of statistical monitoring and Risk Based Quality Management (RBQM) and their impact on data integrity.
  • Thorough understanding of the processes associated with clinical study management, data management, and regulatory operations.
  • Knowledge of clinical trial database systems (EDC, IRT, CTMS etc.).
  • Excellent computer skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and the ability to learn and use interactive computer systems and tools.
  • Advanced level of understanding of descriptive analysis e.g. means, medians, significance, confidence intervals.
  • Demonstrated expertise in analyzing and reviewing clinical data, ability to extract pertinent information from standard study documentation, such as protocols, electronic study data systems with the ability to learn to identify trending of site/study data.
  • Must be able to work in non-traditional work environments.
  • Fluent in English (excellent oral and written).
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels within the organization and with external customers.
  • Must be a fast learner and able to understand new concepts quickly.
  • Prioritization skills with ability to plan, monitor and manage workload fluidly in response to changing project demands.
  • Good understanding of project protocol, project documentation including centralized monitoring and risk-based monitoring.
  • Broad working knowledge of the roles, functions and process of conducting clinical trials.
  • Must be able to manage time effectively, working with multiple functions and requirements.
  • Must have been involved in the use of trial management or data management systems

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule

A Global Clinical Leader In Dermatology!

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.
