Agilent Technologies is seeking a strategic and operational leader to own the business vision, improvement roadmap, value governance, and business operating model for delegated Commercial processes.


In this role, you will partner closely with the commercial leadership teams, commercial operations, marketing, and IT to translate business strategy into scalable Salesforce solutions, modern go-to-market frameworks, AI-enabled capabilities, and disciplined agile delivery. You will establish and drive a cohesive roadmap that elevates commercial productivity, data integrity, revenue execution, and organizational effectiveness, balancing executive stakeholder engagement with hands-on operating-model leadership.

The ideal candidate combines deep commercial process expertise, Salesforce fluency, cross-functional influence, and change leadership with the ability to build and lead a high-performing, specialized team in a global matrix environment.


Business accountability and IT governance

This position sits within Commercial Operations and contributes to the continuous improvement of agreed commercial processes enabled by Salesforce. The role is accountable for its assigned business outcomes, delivery responsibilities, and compliance with enterprise controls.

The business pod owns business requirements, value-based prioritization, functional acceptance, adoption, and benefits measurement within its delegated scope. Qualified pod members may design, configure, develop, test, and document solutions in authorized environments using IT-approved standards and tools.


IT retains accountability for enterprise technical architecture, cybersecurity and identity controls, privileged access, environment and deployment controls, production change and release authorization, and production service operations, in coordination with applicable enterprise control owners.

Business acceptance does not authorize production deployment. Production configuration, code, integrations, security settings, and material data changes must follow the applicable IT-controlled change process. Execution may be delegated through documented, role-based authorization; control ownership and required independent review remain in place. Individuals may not independently approve and release their own changes.


The role will work with the designated IT platform and delivery leads through a shared backlog, agreed delivery arrangements, and defined escalation paths.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Roadmap & Operating Model

  • Define and execute a strategic roadmap that aligns Salesforce and integrated systems investments with commercial priorities.
  • Bridge strategy and technical delivery to own business accountability from problem definition through adoption and measured benefits, working with IT’s technical and service owners.
  • Establish business prioritization, acceptance, and readiness governance within the IT-owned release framework, including OKRs and decision rights, to ensure technology investments deliver transparent commercial impact.
  • Partner with commercial leadership to design performance metrics and operating mechanisms that increase accountability, visibility, and efficiency across the revenue engine.
  • Identify and drive opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate commercial processes as they are operationalized in Salesforce.
  • Set portfolio direction and resolve larger trade-offs on behalf of Commercial stakeholders.

Executive Partnership & Cross-Functional Governance

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to commercial executives on Salesforce-enabled process improvement, operational performance, and investment prioritization.
  • Translate complex business and technology considerations into clear recommendations, trade-off analyses, and actionable decisions for senior leadership.
  • Strengthen partnership models between Commercial Operations, IT, and other enterprise functions within a global matrix organization.
  • Build and develop a high-performing commercial systems capability that elevates delivery quality and stakeholder trust.

Process Excellence, Data Quality & Financial Stewardship

  • Sponsor data-quality outcomes and business reconciliation that keep Salesforce a trusted source of commercial truth.
  • Lead initiatives that improve process standardization and end-to-end commercial execution.
  • Optimize technology spend while protecting required capabilities, quality, and service levels; partner with Finance and Procurement on budgeting, forecasting, and commercial technology financial management.
  • Champion rigorous change management, stakeholder engagement, process documentation, and user adoption for new workflows and system capabilities.
  • Design and deliver structured train-the-trainer programs and knowledge transfer processes that equip Tier 1 and Tier 2 support leaders and their teams to confidently support new capabilities from day one of release.
  • Embed agile ways of working, continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and operational accountability across the team and stakeholder community.

Digital Transformation & AI Innovation

  • Drive adoption of AI, automation, analytics, and emerging technologies that improve commercial decision-making and productivity.
  • Sponsor, prioritize, and validate approved AI use cases

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering, Operations, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Commercial Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Systems, Enterprise Technology, or GTM Systems Strategy within hyper-growth or large enterprise environments.
  • Exceptional executive communication skills with a demonstrated ability to partner directly with C-suite stakeholders, translate complex technical and data scenarios into clear, actionable insights for non-technical commercial leaders, and direct cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience operating (or rapidly standing up) a multi-disciplinary GTM systems team that spans strategy, technical architecture, development, and enablement.
  • Experience leading business delivery in an enterprise environment with disciplined technical controls
  • Hands-on experience deploying next-generation AI solutions to solve enterprise data challenges.
  • Strong financial and operational acumen with a proven track record of optimizing tech stack spend.
  • Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Administrator, or Agentforce Specialist certifications strongly preferred.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Systems Design
  • Commercial Operations Excellence
  • Technology Strategy & Governance
  • Executive Influence & Communication
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Data Quality & Process Excellence
  • Technology Investment Optimization
  • Digital Transformation & AI Innovation
  • Change Management & Enablement

Additional Details

Applications for this job will be accepted until at least November 20, 2026 or until the job is no longer posted.The full-time equivalent pay range for this position is $153,040.00 - $286,950.00/yr plus eligibility for bonus, stock and benefits. jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
About Fusemachines

Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services and products provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, United States, Canada, and Dominican Republic and more than 450 full-time employees), Fusemachines seeks to bring its global expertise in AI to transform companies around the world.

Type: Remote, Contracted

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer with deep expertise in Tableau, Google BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic data modeling (LookML / Looker, dbt, Omni, or Looker Studio) to join our team. In this role, you will lead critical business intelligence modernization initiatives, reverse-engineering complex reporting logic from legacy dashboards and rebuilding high-performance analytical data models to power executive decision-making.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Analyst / Analytics Engineer, you will work closely with technical leads, product managers, and business stakeholders to modernize legacy BI environments.

You will be responsible for deconstructing legacy dashboard architectures, extracting embedded business rules and Level of Detail (LOD) calculations, and re-architecting those metrics into scalable SQL models and LookML-governed cloud semantic layers.

You will perform as a core data translator, bridging the gap between cloud data warehouses, semantic layers, and client-facing business teams.

Qualification & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field such as computer science, systems engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical discipline.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or analytics engineering.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience using Tableau to design, maintain, and audit complex dashboards and calculated fields.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience coding and maintaining LookML semantic models (views, explores, derived tables) in Looker.
  • Demonstrated experience with cloud data warehouses, specifically Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Proven experience delivering BI migration, dashboard refactoring, or semantic data modeling projects.

Required Skills / Competencies

  • Advanced Tableau Engineering: Deep understanding of complex Tableau calculations, parameters, table calculations, and Level of Detail (LOD) expressions (FIXED, INCLUDE, EXCLUDE), with the ability to unpack workbook logic.
  • Cloud Data Warehousing & Advanced SQL: Strong expertise in writing performant, modular SQL (CTEs, window functions) and structuring data within Google BigQuery and/or Snowflake.
  • Modern Transformations & Modeling: Hands-on experience with dbt for building curated data models and managing transformation workflows.
  • LookML & Modern BI Semantic Layers: Direct, hands-on experience writing LookML (.view and .model files, Explores, Persistent Derived Tables, symmetric aggregates) with Git version control, alongside building curated topics in Omni Analytics or Looker Studio.
  • Data Validation & Quality Assurance: Rigorous approach to data reconciliation, checking data parity between legacy source reporting and modernized target models.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills (Full Professional / Advanced) to lead technical discussions, clarify metric definitions, and present solutions directly to stakeholders.
  • Ways of Working: Self-motivated, proactive problem-solver comfortable working independently in an Agile sprint-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Reverse-Engineer Reporting Logic: Audit and deconstruct legacy Tableau workbooks, deciphering nested formulas, calculated fields, and LOD expressions into clear business documentation.
  • Warehouse Data Modeling: Translate extracted business logic into scalable, maintainable SQL and transformation models using dbt across BigQuery and Snowflake.
  • Semantic Layer Implementation: Architect, write, and maintain LookML semantic models, reusable metrics, and self-service Explores/topics in Looker, Omni Analytics, or Looker Studio.
  • Data Parity & Governance: Implement thorough data validation checks to ensure metrics produced in the modern semantic layer match legacy benchmarks with 100% precision.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with technical teams, data engineers, and business leaders to define canonical KPI definitions and document data dictionaries.
  • Best Practices & Documentation: Establish reusable modeling standards, Git workflows, documentation, and maintainable BI pipelines for long-term platform health.

If you are a senior data practitioner with deep experience across Tableau, LookML, BigQuery, Snowflake, and modern semantic modeling, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

jobs.title: Google Ads Specialist
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build and improve the clinical applications and electronic medical record (EMR) workflows that support care delivery on Bask Health.

You'll develop the interfaces clinicians and internal healthcare teams use to review patient information, manage clinical tasks, document encounters, and navigate prescribing workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex frontend problems and building intuitive, reliable software for users managing detailed and time-sensitive information.

You'll work closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and clinical operations stakeholders to turn complicated processes into clear, efficient application experiences.

We're looking for someone with strong technical judgment, attention to usability and data accuracy, and the ability to take ownership of complex frontend features from design through production.

  • Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive web design.

  • Experience collaborating with product managers, designers, and backend engineers.
  • Ability to translate complicated requirements into clear application workflows.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to make sound technical decisions and take ownership of complex features.
  • Experience reviewing code and providing constructive technical feedback.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing clinician dashboards or healthcare operations tools.

jobs.title: Digital Prescribing Pharmacist
jobs.description:
Thanks for stopping by! We’re Doctor Care Anywhere: (DCA) is the UK’s largest private provider of telehealth services. The Company works with insurers, healthcare providers and corporate customers to serve patients with a range of digitally enabled telehealth services on its proprietary platform.

DCA is committed to delivering the best possible patient experience and clinical care through digitally enabled, joined up, evidence-based pathways. DCA’s strategic ambition is to be the UK market leader in digitally enabled primary care, helping to meet the health needs of patients and payors in a challenging and fast changing environment.

What we are looking for? We are looking for Digital Prescribing Pharmacists who are able to commit to a minimum of 16 hours a week to provide virtual consultations via our intuitive platform, delivering high quality care to our patients.

Working as an autonomous non-medical independent prescriber, you will assess, diagnose and manage a wide range of primary care conditions, including minor ailments, long-term condition monitoring, medicines optimisation and complex polypharmacy reviews. This role is well-suited to individuals with a strong foundation in general practice or community primary care settings. In particular, experience diagnosing and managing minor illnesses would be beneficial.

Salary based on 40 hours FTE: £55,000

Salaried Sessions: We offer fixed shifts and sessions (minimum of 16 hours a week) that can be divided throughout the week based on your preferred hours, along with optional additional 'ad-hoc' shifts, from 8am-8pm across the week

Requirements

Clinical Practice

  • Conduct independent, autonomous consultations (video, telephone and asynchronous) for patients presenting with minor ailments and undifferentiated primary care conditions.
  • Assess, diagnose and manage acute presentations including URTIs, UTIs, skin conditions and ear, nose and throat conditions within agreed clinical scope.
  • Issue prescriptions independently as a qualified non-medical independent prescriber (NMP), in line with GPhC standards and DCA's prescribing governance framework.
  • Ability to review clinical information and prescribe asynchronously for a range of primary care conditions.
  • Refer appropriately to GPs, ACPs, or specialist services where presentations fall outside autonomous scope.

Medicines Safety & Governance

  • Adhere to DCA's clinical governance framework, including compliance with CQC standards and regulated activity requirements.
  • Contribute to medicines safety reviews, significant event analyses (SEAs) and audit activity as required.
  • Maintain accurate and contemporaneous clinical records using DCA's digital clinical systems, ensuring documentation meets medico-legal standards.
  • Support antibiotic stewardship initiatives and rational prescribing programmes across the clinical workforce.
  • Participate in regular clinical supervision, peer review, and quality assurance activities.

Education & Multidisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively within DCA's multidisciplinary clinical team, providing pharmacist expertise and medicines support to GPs, ACPs, and other clinicians.
  • Contribute to service improvement projects, clinical pathway development and digital innovation initiatives.
  • Attend DCA education and MDT events and engage with training opportunities in digital health at DCA.

Safeguarding

  • To promote a culture of patient – centred and good professional practice relating to the safeguarding of adults, young person’s and children at risk
  • To actively implement safeguarding protocols for children, young persons, and vulnerable adults and to know who to refer to and how to escalate concerns about radicalisation
  • To ensure that provisions in relation to all Mental Health Legislation including the Mental Health Act 2007, Mental Capacity Act 2005), are implemented in accordance with the legislative requirements, Codes of Practice requirements and National and Government Guidance

Education/Training/Experience

  • MPharm degree (or equivalent) with current registration with the General Pharmaceutical Council (GPhC).
  • Qualified Independent Prescriber (IP) (1 year minimum independent prescribing experience) with annotation recorded on the GPhC register. Must be able to prescribe autonomously from day one.
  • Minimum 2 years' post-qualification experience working in a primary care setting (GP practice, PCN, community pharmacy with primary care contract, or equivalent).
  • Completed the CPPE Care Pharmacy Education Pathway
  • Demonstrable experience in autonomous management of minor ailments and undifferentiated primary care presentations without GP supervision
  • Experience conducting remote patient assessments (phone and video) (Desirable)

Knowledge/Skills

  • Proficiency with clinical IT systems (ideally with Jira and Teams/Slack).
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage deadlines
  • Commitment to patient-centred care and ongoing professional development.
  • Excellent communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to proficiently document patient consultations according to organizational policy and national guidelines
  • Ability to recognize individual learning needs and actively seek professional development opportunities in line with local and national frameworks (e.g., GPhC revalidation requirements).
  • Ability to act as a professional role model, demonstrating organizational values and behaviours.
  • Skill in sharing knowledge and evidence-based insights to support team development and quality care
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • A patient-centred approach ensuring high levels of patient satisfaction and clinical care.

Benefits

Why you want to work here:

We understand the importance of good health and happiness for our patients and our team is just the same. At our Doctor Care Anywhere, you're not just an employee; you're a valued member of our team. We believe in giving you the freedom to supercharge your career with us while feeling completely supported. Here's what you can look forward to when you join us:

🩺 Private Medical Insurance: We've got you covered including Opticians & Dental appointments!

👩‍⚕️ Doctor Care Anywhere subscription: For you and 5 of your family and friends, Get ready to enjoy health consultations on the go!

🏝️ 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays (FTE): You've earned it! Enjoy time off to recharge, explore, and make incredible memories.

🎁 Birthday Day Off: Go and celebrate however you like!

🧘‍♂️ Buy' up to 5 days of additional annual leave (FTE) as part of our focus on health and wellbeing

🌳 Company Pension scheme planting a money tree for your future

🌈 Charity Days: Join us in giving back to the community! We're all about making a difference together.

👶 Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Pay: Extra support during this special time.

🚴 Bike2Work Scheme: We love an eco-friendly commute!

🏡 Remote Working: Work where you're comfortable.

🚀 Development Opportunities: Get ready to grow, learn, and make strides in your career!

🌍 30-Day Work Abroad Allowance Take your laptop overseas and work for up to 30 days a year.

Plus, if you're in a clinical role, you'll enjoy some extra perks like:

Insurance: For any DCA related work you will be covered with medical indemnity.

Your Hours, Your Way: Enjoy flexible hours that work around your other commitments with the ability to split sessions.

Instant Help: Get live support during your shift via instant messaging.

Top-Notch Training: Learn from the best with high-quality training and guidance from experienced clinicians.

Top Marks: We're all about quality and security – ISO9001 & ISO27001 accredited.

jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, merchant success is about helping businesses make the most of the platform. We value strong relationships, clear communication, proactive problem-solving, and people who take ownership of helping merchants succeed.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Merchant Success Manager to help Bask Health's merchants successfully launch, operate, and grow their businesses using our platform.

This role is responsible for managing long-term relationships with merchants and helping them achieve meaningful business outcomes through product adoption, operational improvements, and ongoing support.

You'll serve as a primary post-sale relationship owner for a portfolio of merchants, including entrepreneurs, direct-to-consumer operators, and businesses building telehealth experiences.

Our merchants use Bask Health to manage important parts of their businesses, including storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, and pharmacy-related processes.

You'll develop a strong understanding of how these different platform capabilities connect to the merchant's overall business.

You'll help new merchants navigate onboarding, understand available features, and establish workflows that support their business goals.

You'll work closely with merchants as they move from initial setup into active operations and ongoing growth.

As a senior member of the team, you'll manage merchants with more complex needs, higher business impact, or greater operational requirements.

You'll build relationships with merchant founders, business owners, operators, and other key stakeholders.

You'll learn how each merchant acquires customers, manages its online storefront, handles the customer journey, and evaluates business performance.

You'll use that understanding to provide practical recommendations for improving platform adoption and operational efficiency.

You'll proactively identify opportunities for merchants to make better use of available platform features.

You'll help merchants understand how storefront configuration, questionnaire experiences, checkout workflows, and other capabilities affect their operations.

You'll work with internal teams when merchants encounter technical issues, product limitations, or workflow challenges.

You'll coordinate with product, engineering, customer support, and relevant operations teams to resolve issues and keep merchants informed.

You'll be expected to take ownership of escalations and maintain clear communication until issues are appropriately addressed.

You'll monitor merchant engagement, product usage, and account health to identify potential risks.

You'll proactively reach out to merchants who may be struggling with adoption, experiencing operational challenges, or showing signs of disengagement.

You'll develop retention plans that address merchant concerns and support long-term relationships.

You'll participate in or own renewal discussions within Bask Health's approved commercial processes.

You'll also identify opportunities for merchants to expand their use of the platform when additional capabilities align with their business needs.

You'll work with sales and leadership on commercial expansion opportunities when appropriate.

You'll conduct merchant business reviews to discuss progress, adoption, operational challenges, and future priorities.

You'll use available performance data and customer feedback to guide your recommendations.

You'll maintain accurate records of merchant interactions, account health, renewal timelines, and follow-up commitments.

You'll also help identify recurring merchant issues and recommend improvements to onboarding materials, support processes, and customer success playbooks.

You'll share merchant feedback with product and engineering teams to help inform future improvements.

Because Bask Health supports healthcare-related businesses, you'll need to recognize when an issue should be handled by the appropriate clinical, pharmacy, compliance, or technical team rather than providing guidance outside your responsibilities.

You may also support the development of internal merchant success processes and share best practices with less-experienced team members.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant merchant account ownership, not a formal people-management position.

We're looking for someone with strong post-sale customer success experience and recent, substantive experience supporting e-commerce merchants or merchant-facing software platforms.

You should understand how online businesses operate and be comfortable discussing merchant challenges, customer journeys, retention, and growth.

You'll need to be proactive, organized, commercially aware, and comfortable managing multiple merchant relationships.

Success in this role means helping merchants adopt the platform effectively, resolve challenges, maintain healthy accounts, and build sustainable businesses.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of merchant accounts throughout the post-sale customer lifecycle.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for assigned merchants.
  • Build strong relationships with merchant founders, business owners, and operational stakeholders.
  • Lead merchant onboarding and coordinate successful transitions from sales.
  • Help merchants understand and adopt relevant Bask Health platform capabilities.
  • Develop merchant success plans aligned with business goals.
  • Understand merchant business models, storefront operations, and growth priorities.
  • Guide merchants through platform setup and operational adoption.
  • Support merchants in understanding storefront and checkout capabilities.
  • Help merchants identify opportunities to improve their platform workflows.
  • Monitor merchant engagement, product usage, and account health.

  • Identify opportunities for merchant account expansion.

  • Conduct regular merchant business reviews.
  • Discuss adoption, operational performance, challenges, and next steps with merchants.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to address technical issues.
  • Coordinate with pharmacy and operations teams when merchant issues involve relevant workflows.
  • Communicate clearly with merchants during troubleshooting and escalation processes.
  • Gather merchant feedback and share product improvement opportunities.
  • Identify recurring challenges in merchant onboarding and adoption.
  • Recommend improvements to merchant success playbooks and processes.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records, account notes, and follow-up commitments.
  • Track merchant renewal timelines and account risks.
  • Help merchants understand new platform features and product updates.
  • Support merchants through changes in available platform capabilities.
  • Use available account data to guide recommendations and prioritize outreach.
  • Share best practices with other merchant success team members.
  • Collaborate across teams to improve the overall merchant experience.
  • Take ownership of merchant outcomes and follow through on commitments.

Requirements

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced fire protection professional with a strong background in fire and life safety plan review to join Aoka. Plans Examiners review architectural and fire protection plans for compliance with the International Fire Code (IFC), International Building Code (IBC), applicable NFPA standards, and local amendments, helping ensure buildings are designed to protect occupants and first responders. This is a flexible, remote, part-time role paid at $40 to $50 per hour, based on experience and qualifications.

Work is assigned on an as-needed basis depending on project availability, and you can accept assignments based on your workload. There are no guaranteed minimum hours.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Review architectural and fire protection plans for compliance with the IFC, IBC, applicable NFPA standards, and local amendments
  • Evaluate fire sprinkler, standpipe, and fire pump submittals, including hydraulic calculations (NFPA 13, 13R, 13D, 14, and 20)
  • Review fire alarm and detection system plans, including device layout, notification, and battery calculations (NFPA 72)
  • Verify means of egress, including occupant load, exit capacity, travel distance, and exit signage and lighting
  • Assess fire-resistance-rated construction, fire barriers, opening protectives, and penetration firestopping
  • Review fire apparatus access, hydrant placement, fire flow, and special hazards such as hazardous materials, kitchen hood suppression, and smoke control
  • Prepare clear, accurate review comments and required corrections in VertexPlans
  • Coordinate with designers, contractors, developers, fire marshals, and building officials to resolve review comments
  • Use VertexPlans for project tracking, documentation, communication, and report submission
  • Consistently meet established turnaround times while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Strong technical command of the IFC, IBC, and NFPA 13, 14, 72, and 101
  • Working knowledge of Texas fire code adoption and local fire marshal requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Comfort using digital plan review and reporting tools
  • Ability to manage a flexible schedule and meet review deadlines independently

Education and Experience

  • Active ICC or TCFP Fire Plans Examiner certification required
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in fire plan review
  • Prior experience performing fire plan reviews for municipalities preferred
  • Availability to work part-time on an as-needed basis remotely

Physical Requirements

  • Extended periods of working on a computer to review plans and prepare comments
  • Ability to review detailed drawings and documents on screen for long periods
  • Ability to communicate by phone, email, and video with project teams

Why Work With Us

  • Competitive pay of $40 to $50 per hour, based on experience and qualifications
  • Dollar-for-dollar company match up to 5% of employee contributions (subject to plan eligibility)
  • Work remotely with flexible, project-based assignments
  • Accept assignments based on project availability and your workload
  • Work alongside experienced engineers, code officials, fire marshals, and development professionals
  • Meaningful work helping shape safer communities through fire and life safety

About Aoka

Aoka is a government services provider offering full building department support to more than 80 cities across Texas and several beyond the state. Our services include planning and zoning, building and fire plan review, civil plan review, and building, fire, and health inspections. At the federal level, we support HUD and OHP programs. Aoka gives agencies the expertise and capacity to keep projects moving, enforce codes consistently, and protect public safety. Our proprietary software, VertexPlans, streamlines plan reviews, inspections, and reporting—ensuring faster turnaround times and better communication for our clients.

Our Values: Continuous Improvement | Diversity of Thought | Empathy | Focus

Our Vision: Using technology to reshape construction.

Apply Now to Join Our Team!

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

As a Senior Data Engineer on the Data Platform team, you will build the data foundation that Lyric's products run on.Data Platform team owns the canonical data model for Lyric's core healthcare data domains, the framework that ingests, transforms, validates, and serves that data across a multi-tenant platform, and the quality guarantees our consuming teams build against. Our stack is Snowflake, Airflow, dbt, and Python.

This is a hands-on building role. You will design and deliver pipelines within our unified framework, implement the canonical data model in production, build validation and observability into the data path rather than around it, and help consuming teams get what they need without a bespoke build every time. You will work closely with our Principal Data Engineer, who sets architectural direction, and you will be expected to contribute to that direction.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and own data pipelines in our unified framework using Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake.

  • Implement the canonical data model in production, working within the architecture set by the Principal Data Engineer and contributing to it based on what implementation reveals.

  • Build automated validation and data quality checks into pipelines at defined stages, so that defects are caught before they reach consumers.

  • Instrument pipelines for observability, including freshness, lineage, and failure alerting.

  • Contribute to self-service capability that allows consuming teams to declare the data they need and receive it as governed output rather than a custom build.

  • Partner directly with consuming teams across invoicing, analytics, and reporting to understand their requirements and translate them into data they can rely on.

  • Migrate and consolidate existing data workloads onto the unified framework without disrupting the consumers depending on them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation for pipeline and data quality incidents, and in the incident reviews that make fixes permanent.

  • Hold a high engineering bar: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD, and documentation that stays current.

  • Mentor engineers, share knowledge deliberately, and raise the technical level of the people around you.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering, building and owning production data pipelines.

  • Strong Snowflake experience, including streams and tasks, warehouse sizing and performance tuning, SQL optimization, and working knowledge of RBAC, clustering, and micro-partitions.

  • Production experience with dbt and Airflow, including how to structure models and DAGs so that someone else can maintain them.

  • Strong programming expertise in Python and deep SQL proficiency.

  • Solid data modeling skills, with experience designing schemas that serve more than one consumer and the judgment to know when a requirement belongs in the shared model versus a consumer-specific extension.

  • Experience building testing and data quality validation into pipelines rather than checking data after the fact.

  • Disciplined engineering practices: version control, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD applied as a matter of course.

  • Ability to work directly with non-engineering consumers of data, understand what they actually need, and communicate constraints and tradeoffs clearly.

Preferred

  • Experience with multi-tenant data platforms, including tenant isolation and handling per-customer variance within a shared model.

  • Experience modeling data that changes over time: event history, corrections and restatements, and the difference between point-in-time and as-of reporting.

  • Experience in healthcare claims, healthcare payments, or another regulated domain with PHI or PII handling and auditability requirements.

  • Familiarity with Datadog or comparable observability tooling applied to data pipelines.

  • Experience building internal tooling or platforms that other teams use directly.

Join our mission to drive innovation, technical excellence and global impact and contribute to the development of groundbreaking software solutions to shape the future of healthcare.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.description:
About Swimply

Swimply is the marketplace that lets homeowners rent out their private pools, hot tubs, courts and backyards by the hour. Thousands of hosts across the United States and Canada use Swimply to share space they already own with families and small groups in their community.

Because hourly backyard rentals are new, most local codes were written before they existed. Towns, counties, health departments and homeowners associations regularly try to fit Swimply into rules written for hotels, public pools, home businesses or overnight short-term rentals. We are building a dedicated regulatory function to manage those matters at scale and to move the rules in our favor, state by state.

You will own the day-to-day operation of the program and work directly with our General Counsel, our CEO, our Head of Operations and the outside lobbyists and local counsel we retain.

The Role

The Regulatory Affairs Manager runs Swimply's regulatory program end to end. Half of the job is operational: every notice a host or the company receives is logged, answered and tracked to a close. The other half is strategic: finding the bills, partners and officials that let us fix the rules for a whole state at once instead of town by town.

What You Will Do

Run the notice program

  • Own the regulatory intake: the regulatory inbox, the host reporting form and escalations from the Host Success team.
  • Log every cease-and-desist letter, notice of violation, HOA demand and listing takedown in the regulatory tracker, by state, city, issuing agency and legal theory.
  • Sort each matter by the theory being used against us: public pool classification, home occupation or zoning, short-term rental rules, business licensing and tax, or HOA covenants.
  • Send the approved standard response to the host or code officer, and follow up until the matter is closed or escalated.
  • Escalate to the General Counsel within one business day anything involving a subpoena, a records demand, a lawsuit, criminal exposure or a threat to a whole market.
  • Publish a weekly regulatory report for the CEO and General Counsel: new notices, open matters, trends and recommended next steps.

Change the rules, state by state

  • Track bills and ordinances in our priority states, starting with New Jersey, New York, California and Texas, and flag any short-term rental or health-code bill our language could be added to.
  • Keep our model state bill and model city ordinance current.
  • Prepare the testimony, one-pagers, fact sheets and talking points our lobbyists and executives use with legislators and staff.
  • Reach out directly to selected city planning, code enforcement and health departments to explain our safety standards before a problem starts.
  • Manage outside firms and budget.
  • Day-to-day manager for our lead lobbying firm, state lobbyists and local zoning counsel: scopes, weekly updates, deadlines and invoices.
  • Build and maintain a bench of zoning counsel and lobbyists in each problem state, ready for when a matter escalates.
  • Own the regulatory budget against the plan the board approves, and give leadership a clear cost-versus-outcome view before any new engagement is signed.

Build allies

  • Represent Swimply in short-term rental coalitions, state chambers of commerce, realtor associations and pool and spa industry groups.
  • Recruit and prepare hosts to speak at hearings and council meetings.

Keep us compliant

  • Handle lobbying registrations and periodic disclosure filings at the state and city level.
  • Support Finance on offers to collect and remit local taxes in jurisdictions that confirm our legality in writing.
  • Research permit, occupancy and licensing requirements for new products and new markets, including Canada, and brief the General Counsel and product teams.
  • Pull and organize platform data when counsel needs it to respond to a government request.

Requirements

Required

  • 5 to 8 years in government affairs, public policy, regulatory operations or local government.
  • Hands-on experience with how state legislatures and city councils actually move a bill or ordinance: committees, staff, hearings and timing.
  • Experience managing outside vendors such as lobbying firms or consultants, including scopes and budgets.
  • Clear, plain-English writing. You can turn a zoning code section into a one-page explanation a homeowner or council member understands.
  • A system for high volume. You keep dozens of open matters across many states moving without losing one.
  • Calm, professional manner with code officers, health inspectors, HOA boards and frustrated hosts.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Policy or government affairs work at a sharing-economy or marketplace company, such as short-term rentals, space rentals, ride-share or car-sharing.
  • Experience as a legislative or council staffer, or in a city planning, zoning, code enforcement or public health department.
  • Existing relationships in New Jersey, New York, California or Texas.
  • Prior registration as a lobbyist, or experience handling lobbying disclosure filings.
  • Familiarity with pool safety, public health or short-term rental regulation.
  • Spanish proficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Content Designer, Intakes & Clinical Workflows
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Content Designer, Intakes & Clinical Workflows to lead the development of clear, accurate, and user-friendly content across Bask Health's patient intake and healthcare-related product experiences.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and operate direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together patient onboarding, digital questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy coordination, and commerce tools.

These experiences often involve complex information, detailed questions, required acknowledgments, and important instructions. We're looking for someone who can make that information easier to understand without sacrificing accuracy, completeness, or appropriate safeguards.

As a Senior Content Designer, you'll shape the language and information structure that guide patients and authorized users through important workflows. You'll work on everything from questionnaire instructions and field labels to error messages, confirmation screens, status updates, and operational guidance.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role that combines UX writing, content strategy, information architecture, and product collaboration. You'll be involved throughout the product development process, from understanding user needs and defining content requirements to writing, testing, and refining content in production.

A major focus of this position will be digital patient intake experiences. You'll help ensure that questions are understandable, instructions are appropriately sequenced, terminology is consistent, and users know what information they need to provide.

You'll also work on content supporting clinical and pharmacy-related workflows, collaborating with appropriate subject matter experts to ensure that language accurately reflects approved processes and does not create confusion about medical decisions, eligibility, or treatment.

You'll collaborate closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, researchers, and operational stakeholders. Rather than simply reviewing copy at the end of a project, you'll contribute to product decisions and help shape how information is organized and presented.

You'll help establish reusable content patterns, terminology standards, and writing guidelines that create consistency across Bask Health's platform. This includes designing content that works across different merchant experiences while maintaining clarity and accuracy.

Because Bask operates in healthcare-related environments, content quality directly affects how users understand and navigate sensitive workflows. You'll need to balance plain language, accessibility, precision, privacy, and appropriate clinical review.

You'll also use research findings, usability testing, product feedback, and workflow observations to identify confusing language and improve content effectiveness.

We're looking for a content designer who enjoys solving complex communication problems, can work independently on challenging product experiences, and understands that great UX writing is about helping people successfully use software—not simply making text sound better.

What You'll Do

  • Lead content design for patient intake questionnaires and healthcare-related workflows across Bask Health.
  • Develop clear, concise, and accessible language for complex digital product experiences.
  • Write and improve questionnaire instructions, question labels, helper text, and response options.
  • Design content for multi-step intake flows, including introductions, progress messaging, and completion states.
  • Simplify complex terminology while preserving the meaning of approved clinical and operational information.
  • Collaborate with product designers to improve the clarity and usability of patient-facing interfaces.
  • Create content for form validation, error messages, and recovery experiences.
  • Develop clear confirmation messages and next-step instructions.
  • Improve how patients understand required information, acknowledgments, and consent-related interfaces.
  • Design content for patient status updates and administrative workflow communications.
  • Create consistent terminology across intake, clinical, pharmacy, and patient-facing experiences.
  • Partner with clinical and pharmacy stakeholders to validate specialized terminology and workflow language.
  • Ensure that content accurately reflects approved product functionality and operational processes.
  • Develop reusable content patterns for questionnaires and other configurable workflows.
  • Contribute to content standards within Bask Health's broader design system.
  • Establish writing guidelines for tone, terminology, clarity, and accessibility.
  • Work with product managers to define content requirements early in product development.
  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure content is implemented correctly.
  • Participate in product discovery and help identify content-related usability problems.
  • Review user journeys to identify confusing instructions or unnecessary cognitive effort.
  • Support usability testing focused on comprehension, terminology, and task completion.
  • Use research findings and product feedback to improve existing content.
  • Help structure complex information so users can find and understand what they need.
  • Review content across responsive interfaces and different screen sizes.
  • Support content consistency across configurable merchant experiences.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary text without removing important information.
  • Document content decisions, terminology standards, and reusable writing patterns.
  • Independently own complex content design initiatives from discovery through implementation and iteration.

Requirements

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating content design work for digital products.
  • Experience independently owning content design projects from discovery through implementation.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered content design principles.
  • Experience writing for complex digital products, applications, or multi-step workflows.
  • Excellent writing, editing, and information organization skills.
  • Ability to simplify complicated information without losing essential meaning.
  • Experience creating interface content, including labels, instructions, helper text, errors, and confirmation messages.
  • Strong understanding of information architecture and content hierarchy.
  • Experience designing content for forms, onboarding flows, or transactional experiences.
  • Familiarity with plain-language writing principles.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive content practices.
  • Ability to create consistent terminology across complex products.
  • Experience developing or contributing to content guidelines and design systems.
  • Familiarity with Figma or comparable collaborative product design tools.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.
  • Ability to work effectively with software engineers during implementation.
  • Familiarity with usability testing and user research methods.
  • Experience incorporating user feedback into content improvements.

  • Experience working with subject matter experts to validate specialized information.

Nice to Have

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

As a Manual Exploratory Tester (User Testing) , you will play a critical role in validating the quality of our Luma platform. You will focus on exploratory/user testing—investigating new features, workflows, and edge cases to uncover unexpected behaviours and usability issues. You’ll work closely with developers, product owners, and automation engineers to ensure defects are caught early, well-documented, and resolved quickly.

A background in science (chemistry, biology, or related field) is required as you will understand the scientific workflows and real-world use cases of our customers.

In this role you will get to:

  • Conduct exploratory and manual testing (UAT) across web-based applications within the Luma platform.
  • Develop tests/exploratory test guides to ensure business requirements are met and provide detailed feedback to design/product.
  • Validate new features, integrations, and scientific workflows, ensuring functionality aligns with product requirements and user expectations.
  • Log clear, reproducible bug reports and collaborate with developers for quick resolution.
  • Provide critical feedback on usability, scientific workflow efficiency, and overall user experience.
  • Collaborate with automation engineers to identify areas suitable for automated coverage and review assertions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness activities.
  • Advocate for quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

We are looking for people who have an education in, or significant work experience in Biology, Chemistry, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences or similar scientific field and can demonstrate experience as a User Tester, Scientific Application administrator/owner, Software Tester, QA Analyst/User Testing, with a strong focus on exploratory testing

The key skills we are looking for

  • Extensive knowledge of biology or chemistry, with the ability to understand and test scientific user experiences and workflows.
  • Experience using or testing scientific/informatics software, ideally within a scientific environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity to probe beyond obvious test cases.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies, edge cases and usability issues.
  • Personal experience using AI-driven tools and workflows to support day-to-day work.
  • Understanding of SaaS architecture, integrations and security.

You may also have:

  • Experience testing SaaS or complex web applications
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Zephyr Scale, or similar test management/bug tracking systems
  • Hands-on experience with backend validation, including API testing and database checks
  • Calling APIs with tools like Postman/Bruno
  • Practical knowledge of GraphQL, including querying, mutations, and schema validation
  • experience with backend validation of APIs, services, and database interactions to ensure data integrity and system reliability.
  • Tools like Postman/Bruno for RESTful API testing and validate GraphQL queries/mutations against backend services.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Dotmatics is an equal opportunity employer. We are a welcoming place for everyone, and we do our best to make sure all people feel supported and connected at work.

jobs.title: Content Designer, Patient Experience
jobs.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.

Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.

About the Role

We're looking for a Content Designer, Patient Experience to help create clear, intuitive, and supportive content across Bask Health's patient-facing digital experiences.

Bask Health enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses. Our platform brings together patient onboarding, digital questionnaires, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce capabilities.

As a Content Designer, Patient Experience, you'll help shape how patients understand and navigate these experiences through thoughtful interface language, clear instructions, and well-organized information.

Patients interacting with digital healthcare services may need to provide personal information, answer detailed questions, understand available options, complete checkout, and follow instructions about what happens next. Each interaction should be understandable, accessible, and designed to reduce unnecessary confusion.

This is a hands-on product content role combining UX writing, content design, information architecture, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll contribute throughout the product development process, from identifying content needs and reviewing user journeys to writing, testing, and refining content.

Your work will focus on the broader patient experience, including onboarding, questionnaires, account creation, checkout, confirmation screens, status messaging, and ongoing patient interactions supported by the platform.

You'll write and improve interface content such as navigation labels, form instructions, helper text, error messages, progress indicators, confirmation messages, and next-step guidance.

You'll also help ensure that patients understand what information is being requested, why certain steps are necessary when that explanation is appropriate, and what to expect after completing an action.

You'll collaborate closely with product designers, product managers, engineers, UX researchers, and operational stakeholders to ensure content supports user needs and accurately reflects product functionality.

Because Bask supports healthcare-related businesses, patient-facing content requires careful attention to clarity, privacy, and appropriate clinical boundaries. You'll work with authorized subject matter experts when content involves medical terminology, treatment-related information, consent, or clinical processes.

You'll also help maintain consistent terminology and content patterns across different patient journeys, including configurable experiences used by Bask's merchant customers.

You'll use usability research, patient feedback, and available product data to identify where language or information structure may be contributing to confusion, errors, or incomplete workflows.

We're looking for someone who understands that patient-facing content should be both practical and considerate, can simplify complicated information, and enjoys improving digital experiences through thoughtful communication.

What You'll Do

  • Design clear, accessible content across Bask Health's patient-facing digital experiences.
  • Write interface copy for patient onboarding and account creation.
  • Develop instructions and helper text for digital patient questionnaires.
  • Improve the clarity of multi-step patient workflows.
  • Write navigation labels, button text, form guidance, and confirmation messages.
  • Create understandable error messages and recovery instructions.
  • Develop progress messaging that helps patients understand where they are in a workflow.
  • Write content for patient checkout and payment-related experiences.
  • Create clear order confirmation and next-step messaging where supported by the product.
  • Improve how patients understand required information and form fields.
  • Collaborate with product designers to simplify complex patient interactions.
  • Review patient journeys to identify confusing language or unnecessary cognitive effort.
  • Develop content for patient account settings and profile management experiences.
  • Create clear empty states, notifications, and status messages.
  • Help patients understand the distinction between submitting information and receiving subsequent review or approval.
  • Support appropriate content for consent-related interfaces and required acknowledgments.
  • Work with product managers to define patient content requirements.
  • Collaborate with engineers to ensure interface copy is implemented accurately.
  • Partner with UX researchers to evaluate patient comprehension and usability.
  • Use research findings and patient feedback to improve content effectiveness.
  • Apply plain-language and accessibility principles to patient-facing content.
  • Help establish consistent terminology across patient experiences.
  • Contribute reusable patient content patterns to Bask Health's design system.
  • Support content consistency across configurable and white-label patient journeys.
  • Collaborate with clinical and pharmacy stakeholders when specialized terminology requires review.
  • Review patient-facing content for accuracy, clarity, and appropriate expectations.
  • Document content decisions and reusable writing guidelines.
  • Own assigned patient content design projects from discovery through implementation and iteration.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of professional experience in content design, UX writing, product writing, or a closely related field.
  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating content design for digital products.
  • Strong writing, editing, and information organization skills.
  • Experience writing content for user-facing web or mobile applications.
  • Understanding of user-centered content design principles.
  • Ability to simplify complex information into clear, actionable language.
  • Experience writing onboarding instructions, form guidance, error messages, and confirmations.
  • Strong understanding of plain-language writing principles.
  • Familiarity with information architecture and content hierarchy.
  • Experience designing content for multi-step digital workflows.
  • Understanding of accessibility and inclusive content practices.
  • Ability to write for users with different levels of technical familiarity.
  • Experience collaborating closely with product designers and product managers.
  • Ability to work effectively with engineers during implementation.
  • Familiarity with Figma or comparable collaborative product design tools.
  • Experience reviewing interfaces and identifying content usability problems.
  • Familiarity with usability testing and user research methods.
  • Ability to incorporate user feedback into content improvements.
  • Experience maintaining consistent terminology across product experiences.
  • Familiarity with content guidelines or design systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate content recommendations clearly.
  • Experience working with cross-functional product teams.
  • Ability to balance user needs, product requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Ability to independently manage assigned content design projects.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing content for healthcare or telehealth products.
  • Familiarity with patient-facing digital healthcare experiences.
  • Experience writing for patient onboarding or intake questionnaires.
  • Understanding of health literacy and patient comprehension challenges.
  • Familiarity with healthcare terminology and patient communication practices.
  • Experience working with clinicians, pharmacists, or healthcare operations teams.
  • Understanding of HIPAA and healthcare-related privacy considerations.
  • Experience designing content for sensitive user interactions.
  • Familiarity with consent-related interfaces and required acknowledgments.
  • Experience writing content for checkout or transactional workflows.
  • Understanding of subscription-based patient experiences.
  • Experience developing content for status updates and ongoing patient communications.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards such as WCAG.
  • Experience collaborating with researchers on comprehension testing.
  • Understanding of white-label or configurable SaaS platforms.
  • Experience maintaining reusable content patterns across multiple brands.
  • Familiarity with localization and internationalization considerations.
  • Experience using product analytics to identify content improvement opportunities.
  • Experience designing content for AI-assisted patient experiences with appropriate safeguards.
  • Experience working in fast-moving, cross-functional product teams.
