jobs.description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.


Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.


Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.


As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.


We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.


Collectors is seeking a Capital Markets Compliance Lead to build the governance, oversight and integrity of its market-facing activity across grading, custody, pricing data and marketplaces. You will report to the Head of Risk & Compliance and work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Finance and business leaders.


Our businesses sit unusually close to the market: we authenticate, store, price, publish data about and help sell the assets themselves. We hold our market conduct to a capital-markets standard because collectors and partners make financial decisions based on our grades, prices and custody. This role is strategic: you will design and inspect controls and set the standard.

What You'll Do

Build a firm-wide markets compliance framework that is risk-based, auditable and scalable, and keep it current as our product set grows. Understand how our roles as grader, custodian, data and index publisher, and marketplace operator interact while documenting and implementing controls around each of those roles.


Market Integrity and Information Controls:

  • Design the controls around market-sensitive, non-public information: grading and population data before release, pricing and index changes, vault holdings and transaction activity. This includes wall-crossing, restricted and watch lists, access controls and escalation, treated with the seriousness of a securities-market information barrier.
  • Own the employee and insider trading framework for relevant assets: pre-clearance, personal-trading and holdings rules, blackout periods, attestations, surveillance and escalation. Align with Legal and HR and the existing employee market participation policy.
  • Oversee conflict-of-interest management across all of our roles, including vendor solutions, and report it to executives and the board as necessary.
  • Lead internal investigations of suspected misuse, working with Legal and Employee Relations.

Pricing, Index and Data Governance:

  • Build the governance framework for the prices, valuations and indexes we publish: methodology, change control, error handling, complaints and conflicts.
  • Design and implement controls over how partners and licensees use Collectors grades, prices and data in their own marketing. Much of this is rigorous documentation.
  • Review data and pricing products, licensing and marketing for accuracy, fairness and regulatory risk, including claims about performance, accuracy and ratings.
  • Embed controls over data quality and pricing inputs where people rely on them to make financial decisions.

Transactions and Fair Dealing:

  • Design the compliance program for the transactions we facilitate: fair-dealing standards, pricing and disclosure, what we are obliged to deliver, and settlement controls.
  • Address the risk of self-dealing and side-dealing: trading ahead, principal versus agent conflicts, undisclosed interests, and staff or affiliate participation.

Products, Partners and the Business

  • Provide compliance input into new products and features from inception, with a fast new-product review that gives product teams a clear answer with documented conditions.
  • Work with Legal and outside counsel on regulatory questions, and turn their conclusions into operating controls.
  • Run due diligence and ongoing oversight of commercial and data partners, including review of their marketing and disclosures.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, including teaching executives how well-run market businesses manage conduct risk, what regulators look for, and what has to be true before a new product ships.
  • Be a systems thinker: automate monitoring, attestations, testing and reporting wherever regulation allows, so the program is data-driven and scales without headcount.
  • Build and develop a markets compliance team over time. Produce reporting for executive and board audiences on conflicts, attestations, exceptions, testing and open issues.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years in markets, capital markets or investment compliance experience at an exchange, trading platform, broker-dealer, asset manager, or index or market-data provider. A broad alternative-assets or digital-assets platform is a strong fit.
  • Deep hands-on experience with MNPI, information barriers and wall-crossing, restricted and watch lists, pre-clearance, personal-trading surveillance and code-of-ethics programs.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. securities and markets regulation and of marketing and communications standards, the judgment to apply them by analogy where they do not strictly reach, and the instinct to bring in counsel at the right time.
  • Understanding of trading mechanics, market microstructure, fair dealing and principal versus agent conflicts.
  • Experience reviewing investment marketing, disclosures, and data or research products.
  • Familiarity with surveillance technology and data-driven monitoring.
  • Experience building a program in a business adopting market-conduct standards for the first time; treats controls as how we get to yes.
  • Can explain regulatory expectations to senior executives and coach non-specialists, with results you can describe with numbers (for example exam findings closed, program coverage, review turnaround).

Salary Range:

The salary range for this position is $157,000 - $200,000. Actual compensation within this range varies based on a variety of factors, including location, job level, experience, and skill set. This role may be eligible for bonuses or other forms of compensation; please ask your recruiter for more details.

Reasons To Join Us

  • Health Insurance: All full-time employees are eligible to enroll in Medical, Dental, and Vision.
  • Additional Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for fertility, commuter, and educational assistance benefits.
  • 401(K) Matching Plan: We are proud to offer a competitive 401k matching plan to support your future financial goals.
  • Vacation: All salaried employees are eligible for flexible time-off.
  • Holiday Pay: All regular, full-time employees are eligible for ten company-paid holidays.
  • Employee Discounts: Employees receive discounts on select grading services for approved submissions.

jobs.candidate_required_location: Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Pakistan
jobs.description:
Overview

  • World Business Lenders (WBL) is a privately held portfolio lender specializing in real estate-secured business loans for underserved businesses. WBL operates with a fully remote, multinational workforce and an experienced executive leadership team.
  • Typically, the work schedule is from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, though additional hours may be required based on business needs.

About the Role

  • The Valuation Quality Control/Review Appraiser will serve as a subject matter expert in residential or commercial real estate appraisal. The role is responsible for reviewing appraisals and other valuation reports prepared by internal analysts and third-party providers, identifying material deficiencies, and recommending property values to the appropriate committee.
  • This position is focused on appraisal review, quality control, collateral risk assessment, and communication of clear, supportable valuation recommendations. It also entails producing appraisals from start to finish.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently delivers accurate, timely, and defensible valuation recommendations.
  • Identifies material appraisal deficiencies and effectively communicates collateral risks.
  • Provides clear, well-supported recommendations to credit and investment committees.
  • Maintains high-quality, consistent appraisal review standards and supports junior analysts.

What You'll Be Doing (Core Responsibilities)

    • Review residential or commercial appraisals, evaluations, broker price opinions, automated valuation models, inspections, and related valuation reports.
    • Assess the accuracy, completeness, credibility, and suitability of each report for its intended use.
    • Evaluate property characteristics, highest and best use, zoning, market conditions, comparable selection, adjustments, income assumptions, capitalization rates, cost estimates, and value reconciliation.
    • Identify unsupported assumptions, mathematical errors, stale data, weak comparables, excessive adjustments, material omissions, and other valuation deficiencies.
    • Return deficient reports for correction, clarification, or additional support.
    • Develop an independent recommendation of property value based on the appraisal, supporting market evidence, internal records, inspections, and other available information.
    • Recommend acceptance, modification, rejection, or further investigation of submitted valuation conclusions.
    • Prepare concise written summaries of findings, risks, and recommended values.
    • Present valuation recommendations to Investment Committee, Asset Resolution Committee, Initial Credit Review Committee or other decision-making committees.
    • Explain valuation methodology, assumptions, market evidence, and collateral risks to management and committee members.
    • Recommend additional appraisals, inspections, environmental reports, engineering studies, or other analysis when existing information is insufficient.
    • Review work completed by junior analysts and provide technical guidance on appraisal methodology, comparable analysis, adjustments, and report documentation.

Requirements

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in real estate, finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field.
  • Required Experience
    • 7+ years of experience in real estate appraisal, appraisal review, collateral valuation, underwriting, credit, asset management, or a related field.
    • Demonstrated experience reviewing both residential and commercial real estate appraisals.
    • Strong knowledge of the sales comparison, income capitalization, and cost approaches.
    • Experience evaluating comparable selection, market adjustments, income and expense assumptions, capitalization rates, highest and best use, and value reconciliation.

jobs.description:

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

We're looking for the performance marketer who wants to own profitable growth across Google and Microsoft for our Make & Manage Money business, set the plan, and build the campaigns themselves. Our listicles connect people with offers across personal finance, insurance, banking, credit cards, gaming apps, and more, and winning here means understanding how intent, creative, landing pages, offer selection, partner payouts, and lead quality work together. You'll run an eight-figure annual media portfolio with the freedom to put budget wherever it earns, and the trade is that it's yours: you find what's holding growth back, whether it's in the account or not, and you go get it fixed.

Tip: Only apply if you've directly owned and profitably scaled $10M or more a year in paid media for affiliate or consumer lead generation.

Why This Seat

  • Real ownership. You own the portfolio across Google and Microsoft, set the plan, and make the calls. No layers between you and the result.
  • Partners who can move the levers. Yield, account management, and creative work alongside you on payouts, offers, and landing pages, so you're fixing the whole funnel, not just the account.

  • An AI-forward stack. Claude is in the daily workflow, with room to automate analysis, concepting, and creative iteration.

What You'll Bring

  • Ownership, Accountability & Strategy. You set the plan, prioritize the tests, and make the call, then bring your manager recommendations, not questions about what to do next.
  • A track record of profitably scaling affiliate or consumer lead gen, with direct ownership of $10M or more in annual media spend.
    • Buying traffic to competitive affiliate listicles, comparison pages, or multi-offer marketplaces.
  • Hands-on depth in Google Ads or Microsoft Ads, and the range to own a portfolio across both. If your strongest experience is in Microsoft Ads, audience buying, or native inventory, we want to hear from you.
    • Scaling across Search, Display, Demand Gen, YouTube, and native placements.
  • A real grasp of affiliate economics: partner payouts, revenue per click, conversion rates, offer mix, traffic quality, ROAS, and margin.
  • A habit of finding the actual constraint. You can tell whether a problem sits in the buying, the creative, the landing page, the offer, the payout, or the measurement, and you go to the team that owns the fix with a clear ask.
  • Clear, direct communication, including short performance updates that say what changed, why it matters, and what you need.

Nice to Have

  • Running across several consumer categories or variable-payout partner programs.
  • Using AI and self-serve creative tools to speed up analysis and asset iteration.
  • Working with competitive intelligence tools and in regulated consumer categories.
  • Building playbooks or mentoring other media buyers.

What You'll Own

  • Strategy and execution across Google Search, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included.
  • Budget allocation, pacing, forecasting, reporting, and profitability for the portfolio.
  • A prioritized growth plan that names the biggest constraints and the tests most likely to move the business.
  • The case to Sales, Account Management, Yield, Creative, Product, and Analytics for what the campaigns need, and the follow-through until it lands.
  • Campaign architecture, bidding, targeting, conversion signals, exclusions, tracking, and testing discipline.
  • Testing new inventory and platforms with a clear hypothesis and a point where you stop.

What Great Looks Like

  • You run the portfolio on your own and bring your manager recommendations and decisions.
  • Profitable spend and margin grow because of a deliberate, prioritized testing plan.
  • Microsoft grows into a real second source alongside Google.
  • Partner teams know what you need, why it matters, and how their work moves growth, and payouts, offers, or pages change because of the case you made.
  • Your playbooks make the broader paid team better.

This Isn't the Right Seat If You

  • See the ad account as the whole job.
  • Want someone else to set the plan or tell you what to test next.
  • Have mostly managed agencies or reporting rather than building campaigns yourself.
  • Would rather not push other teams for changes you don't control.

jobs.title: Group Accountant
jobs.description:
If you are ready to take a next step in your accounting career, and you feel that energy industry is where you can find the thrill (we definitely do!), keep reading - and if that's a match, we'll be happy to set you up with our HR crew for an interview.

Location: Spain or Belgium, but remote set up is also possible within European E&C Group Locations

Team: Global Finance Team

💡Why E&C Consultants?

We’re proud to be a Great Place To Work® certified company, where satisfaction, growth, and flexibility are our way of working.

You can read more details here: Becoming an E&Cer, but here’s what makes us stand out:

  • We put people first: employee fulfilment, pride and well-being are balanced and at the heart of everything we do

  • We grow together: as E&C expands, so do your opportunities to develop professionally

  • We work differently: our Teal management means no micromanagement - just empowerment and flat structure

  • We give you time to recharge: enjoy 46 days off per year, no matter where you live or work

About the role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Group Accountant to join our Group Finance Team and support the accurate and timely financial reporting of E&C's entities.

You’ll own key month‑end activities: from posting close entries to balance‑sheet and intercompany reconciliations. Help review the monthly numbers to spot anything that doesn’t add up. You’ll work hand‑in‑hand with our Internal Accountant, Financial Controller and external accounting/tax partners to make sure reporting is accurate, complete and on time. It’s a hands‑on role for someone who knows double‑entry and accrual accounting, enjoys digging into financial data like a number detective, and takes pride in owning and resolving discrepancies.

You’ll start by owning a few specific entities and accounting areas and getting to know the numbers inside out. We’re looking for someone curious and analytical who can read what a balance or transaction really means, flag anything that looks off, and chase it down until it’s fixed. As you settle in, there’s plenty of room to grow: take on more entities, tackle trickier accounting issues, and broaden your role in group financial reporting.

Requirements

🎯Do you already feel like E&C is a place for you? Let's see if this particular role is also what you're good at. As a Group Accountant you will be trusted with:

  • Month-end close: Own the month‑end close for your assigned entities: prepare journal entries and adjustments, review the monthly numbers, spot anything that doesn’t add up, investigate discrepancies and drive them to a clean resolution so reporting is accurate and on time

  • Month-end review: Support the review of monthly financial results for assigned entities and accounting areas, identifying unusual balances, discrepancies or potential accounting errors and investigating items requiring explanation or correction

  • Reconciliations: Prepare monthly balance‑sheet reconciliations (accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, etc.) and run intercompany reconciliations: find mismatches, investigate the causes and work with colleagues to clear items and post any corrective entries

  • Internal and external collaboration: Partner closely with the Internal Accountant, Financial Controller and our external accounting and tax partners to coordinate month‑end tasks and make sure the close and reporting are timely and accurate

  • Information provision: Prepare clear reconciliations, schedules and supporting explanations so the Group Finance Team and external partners have everything they need for reporting and tax work

  • Issue resolution: Investigate accounting discrepancies and outstanding items and work collaboratively with the wider Group Finance Team and external partners to ensure they are appropriately resolved

  • Group-wide consistency: Help ensure that accounting treatments, close procedures and supporting documentation are applied consistently across E&C’s entities

  • Continuous improvement: Help make finance smarter and more efficient. Suggest and implement better processes, controls and close procedures, and spot ways to use systems and tech to save time and reduce errors

🧩 We feel that to be successful & satisfied in this role, it’s good to bring a mix of curiosity, analytical thinking, and a grounded accounting mindset. Ideally, we look for:

  • A good understanding of double-entry accounting and core accounting principles. You understand debits, credits and why they matter

  • Clear understanding of the accruals concept, you recognise income and expenses in the right period so the numbers tell the true story

  • Strong numerical skills and a keen eye for detail

  • A special talent for spotting when balances or postings look wrong, and the persistence to dig in and find the root cause

  • Good organisational skills and the ability to work effectively to deadlines

  • Spreadsheet savvy, you use Excel/Sheets to analyse, reconcile and present tidy supporting workpapers

  • Comfortable collaborating with internal colleagues and external accounting/tax professionals

  • Proactive, adaptable and curious. You enjoy learning new systems and looking for smarter ways to work

  • A strong working level of English, both written and spoken

🌟 These desirable skills will help you shine in the role (but don’t worry if you don’t tick every box):

Relevant accounting experience, including practical involvement in month-end close activities, is highly desirable. Previous experience working in a multi-entity environment would also be beneficial. Experience using the following accounting or ERP packages would be beneficial although not required: Exact Online, QuickBooks Online, Xero, DATEV, Sage and enova365.

You don’t need a professional accounting qualification to apply. We value hands‑on accounting experience and solid technical knowledge above formal certification!

If you are still here and reading, you must be really interested. Great, as E&C is the best place to be! Last but not least then, a sneak peek into our application process:

  • First call with HR or Team Leader - 45min

  • Assessment: online ability tests + personality questionnaire - 45min

  • Final round interview: Business case (can be prepared in advance) & discussion on the online assessment + meeting the team - 90min

Send your application by clicking on the application button. Please send us your CV in English only and include the following statement in your application: "I hereby give consent for my personal data included in my application to be processed for the purposes of the recruitment process under the Personal Data Protection Act as of 29 August 1997, consolidated text: Journal of Laws 2015, item 2135 as amended"

Highlights

Join our Finance Team to provide hands‑on accounting support and manage client accounts.

Position Overview

Designers at Autodesk can think across the system, champion design ideas, collaborate with stakeholders, advocate for the customer, and deliver impactful data-driven designs. Our designers use creative and innovative solutions to deliver high-quality experiences that delight our customers.


Help shape how millions of people supervise and trust AI inside the tools they use to design and make the world. As Principal Experience Designer on the team behind the Autodesk Assistant, you'll define how agentic AI behaves in software that people use to design and build real things. When an agent proposes a change to a building model or a part, how does someone see what it did, trust it, and undo it? That's the work.


The Autodesk Assistant is how customers will experience AI across our Design and Make platform, embedded inside Autodesk products. In this position you'll set the design direction for the agentic experiences the Assistant brings to product teams across the portfolio. Our customers are professionals whose work has real cost and safety consequences, and they won't hand control to an AI they can't check. Our team stewards the patterns that let them check it.


At Autodesk we look to hire innovators who reimagine what's possible, those with diverse backgrounds who elevate our thinking, and leaders who help shape the world and our future.


For consideration, candidates must include both a resume + portfolio with password when applying.

Responsibilities

  • Define the agentic interaction patterns that Autodesk product teams adopt when they integrate the Autodesk Assistant, including reasoning visibility, action controls, permissions and consent, and citation and grounding
  • Raise the quality bar for AI experiences in the Autodesk Assistant and advocate for it with partners. Define how we'll know an experience is working, such as task completion and adoption
  • Lead the design of patterns that product teams across Autodesk adopt, so they build on shared patterns rather than point solutions
  • Build working prototypes with real data to test interaction models with customers and to give engineers a clear target
  • Mentor senior and staff designers on the team, and support designers across Autodesk who are shipping Autodesk Assistant capabilities inside their own products
  • Partner with senior stakeholders in Product, Engineering, and AI Research on Autodesk Assistant decisions, and push on frontier-model capabilities when the experience calls for it
  • Partner with Data Scientists and others using data to support driving data informed decisions and experimentation

  • A portfolio that shows organizational impact as well as craft
  • You're an expert in human-centered design, and you adapt the process to fit larger, more complex problems
  • A point of view on what makes an AI experience good, and a track record of raising the bar
  • You've designed how people supervise AI that acts on their behalf (reasoning visibility, controls, citations, consent), and other teams adopted those patterns in their own work. You can show how you measured adoption
  • You've shipped generative AI to production and can show what it did for users or the business
  • You choose a direction when the model's behavior, the data, and the requirements are still changing
  • You use AI tools to build working prototypes with real data and to move ideas toward shipped work, without lowering the craft bar. Your portfolio includes work that AI tools helped you make
  • You've mentored senior and staff designers, and you still ship your own work
  • You're a clear communicator and storyteller who works closely across functions
  • Demonstrated partnership with Data Scientists or other related cross-functional partners using data-informed decisions to influence design direction

  • Experience designing for multi-agent workflows or tool-use orchestration (for example, MCP)
  • Familiarity with frameworks for evaluating AI experience quality, such as Minimum Trustworthiness, Transformative Value, or equivalent quality-gate models

jobs.title: SEM Specialist
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Trakstar and Compensation
jobs.description:
At Mitratech, we are a team of technocrats focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in its diverse and inclusive work culture centered around great people practices, learning opportunities, and having fun! Our culture is the ideal blend of entrepreneurial spirit and enterprise investment, enabling the chance to move at a rapid pace with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

Due to business and compliance requirements, this position is open only to candidates residing in MEXICO. Applications from candidates located outside this region will not be reviewed.

About the role

Product managers at Mitratech are revenue engineers. You own how your products grow revenue and keep customers successful. You choose the capabilities that matter most, either because they help sales and renewals close or because they make customers more successful. You turn those choices into requirements engineering builds from, then work with customers, support, sales and engineering until the results show up in revenue and retention.

You report into the Product Management organization and work with a distributed engineering and design team across several countries.

What you will do

  • Find the revenue opportunity. Talk to customers and admins every week, read usage and satisfaction data, join win-loss and renewal reviews, and write down the problem with the revenue case behind it.
  • Work with sales and customer success to find where a missing capability costs deals or renewals, and decide what to build in response.
  • Keep the roadmap for your area current and explain what is on it, what is not, and the revenue reason for each choice.
  • Define the problem worth solving and the job the customer is trying to get done, with the evidence behind it. Give design and engineering a clear enough picture of the problem and the outcome that they know what to build and can tell when it works.
  • Plan releases with engineering, estimate effort together, and manage scope as the release moves.
  • Represent the customer in engineering, design, support and sales conversations.
  • Demonstrate what you are building to customers and to the wider organization, collect their feedback, and secure agreement from stakeholders before a release goes to market.
  • Give sales, support and customer success what they need to sell and support each release: positioning, demos and answers to the questions customers ask.
  • Define the metrics for your area (revenue, retention, adoption and customer satisfaction), report on them, and check each release against the revenue case you made for it.

What you bring

  • 5 or more years of product management experience, including at least 3 in business-to-business enterprise SaaS.
  • A record of shipping software that real customers use, and the artifacts to show how you worked: requirements, roadmaps, discovery notes, metrics.
  • Experience working with engineering teams across time zones.
  • A record of tying product decisions to revenue, retention or expansion, with the numbers to show it.
  • Comfort with product analytics and with turning data into a decision.
  • Written and spoken English at a professional level. You will write requirements and present in English every day.
  • A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, engineering, information systems, economics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in HR technology, such as performance management, learning, applicant tracking, compensation, payroll or HCM.
  • Experience adding AI-assisted features to an enterprise product.
  • An MBA or master's degree.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira and Productboard.

How Mitratech will assess the role

Mitratech's product management career path defines the Product Manager level as working independently on problem definition, discovery, release planning, stakeholder alignment, metrics and influence, and as developing the skills of strategy, pricing, negotiation and customer engagement. Interviews assess against those expectations.

We are an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Government
jobs.description:
For People is improving government digital services for the disadvantaged population. We work directly with government agencies to modernize software, systems, and platforms so that they better serve people.

Your Impact

Every month, hundreds of thousands of people go looking for facts about Medicare and Medicaid. They are researchers, reporters, policy staff, and health care providers. When the data is hard to find, a file is too large to post, or a column quietly changes its name between releases, their work slows down or goes wrong.

This project supports the website where the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) publishes that data for the public. It holds a large catalog of datasets, lookup tools, and dashboards from many parts of the agency, available as downloads, interactive tools, and a public API. As Lead Product Manager, you will lead the team that builds and runs it. This is a hands-on role. You’ll facilitate partner meetings, support the team when they are blocked, and get into project details as needed to report clearly on the team’s progress. You’ll work elbow-to-elbow with the project’s technical and product leadership. You will learn about the work enough to identify and help mitigate delivery risks and hold the team accountable for what we promise to government partners.

This position is a full-time position contingent on For People being awarded a federal contract. If awarded, this position’s expected start date is February 2027.

Our Culture

For People is a team of humans. We place a significant amount of emphasis on positive work-life balance, setting healthy expectations, and making sure our loved ones are taken care of first. That means picking a child up from school during the day or going for a mid-day walk is okay!

This position is 100% remote. Our entire team is remote across the United States, from the West Coast to the East Coast. There will never be a return-to-office, as we have none! Occasional travel to CMS headquarters in Baltimore, MD (2-3 times per year) is required. These trips are infrequent and scheduled well in advance.

This full-time position's published base salary range is between $100,000 and $160,000 annually. Salary will be determined based on relevant experience. All positions include generous benefits (e.g., For People pays 100% of Gold-tier employee health insurance premiums) and annual company profit sharing.

Your Opportunities

On this project, you will be the delivery lead on a cross-functional team of about 15 people spanning engineering, design, user research, and support functions. The team may expand to up to 25 members in the future. As the Lead Product Manager, you will:

  • Build a collaborative and trusting team culture across all disciplines in the program
  • Run agile practices including sprints, planning cycles, demos, and retrospectives, all of which include CMS stakeholders
  • Coordinate with CMS offices that publish data on the public portal; share progress transparently and build positive working relationships with partner contracting teams
  • Proactively identify and mitigate risks to project delivery
  • Keep the program in line with contract, security, and accessibility requirements, including Section 508 and the site's Authority to Operate (ATO)
  • Report status and outcomes to CMS and For People leadership, using live dashboards wherever possible and finding efficiency gains through automation
  • Lead the handoff from the current contractor in your first few months, so users see no disruption

You Bring

  • A humble and caring attitude aligning with For People’s values: passion, fun, curiosity, sustainability, humility, and respect
  • Deep knowledge of agile product management principles and open data standards
  • Experience with collaboration and delivery tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub
  • Experience developing and evolving a product roadmap that communicates the vision and business value to stakeholders
  • Ability to oversee Task Order management activities, including reporting, sprint planning, product planning, and coordination of delivery activities
  • Ability to analyze complex problems and develop effective solutions involving schedules, technology, methodologies, tools, resources, and solution components
  • Experience facilitating stakeholder engagement across multiple Government components, business owners, and data owners
  • Experience leading Government digital or technology projects of similar size and complexity

It Would Be Great If You Also Have

  • Experience with public websites built on Drupal
  • Familiarity with CMS security processes
  • Experience leading a contract transition from an incumbent team
  • 10+ years of relevant experience in program or project management, including managing government contracts
  • Master's degree in management, public administration, information technology, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience with open data projects and demonstrated expertise in DCAT-US 1.1, the federal metadata standard for open data
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams, with the ability to lead teams of 15 to 25 people as the contract grows

Some Fine Print

You will be working on a United States government platform, and they have a few basic requirements for contractors like ourselves. All work must be physically performed within the United States at all times. In addition, you must be a United States citizen and be able to pass a government-performed public trust background check.

For People is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, and/or veteran status.

Job Type: Full-Time

Location: United States, Preferred Eastern and Central Time Zones

Department: G&A

Company Overview

Irth Solutions is a software product company developing innovative technology platforms designed to set industry benchmarks. With a strong product culture, collaborative work environment, and significant growth potential, Irth offers an exciting opportunity to work with modern, enterprise-scale data platforms.

Position Summary

The VP of FP&A leads all financial planning and analysis at Irth, covering both corporate FP&A and business partnering for Sales, Customer Success, Product/Engineering, Operations, G&A and acquired businesses. You will build the planning engine, modernize the tooling, and turn financial data into decisions that drive ARR growth, margin expansion and cash generation. You will establish efficient FP&A processes that enable continued scaling of the function while focusing on growth, talent development, and strategic insights that drive value creation.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Executive Partnership

  • Serve as the CFO's thought partner and a visible member of the finance leadership team, helping shape corporate strategy, the long-range plan and annual operating priorities
  • Own the sponsor's value creation plan, including EBITDA bridges and initiative tracking, and lead the preparation and presentation of financial results and outlook to the executive team, board and PE sponsor.

Corporate FP&A and Planning

  • Own the annual budget, rolling forecast and long-range plan, including ARR, bookings, retention, headcount and margin drivers
  • Build and maintain integrated three-statement models (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow) to support board reporting, lender requirements and sponsor reviews
  • Lead scenario and sensitivity planning, including downside and acquisition cases, so the CFO, board and sponsor can see the range of outcomes, the key risks and the options for responding to them
  • Lead monthly and quarterly close-to-forecast cycles, variance analysis and board and sponsor reporting packages
  • Define and track SaaS KPIs and unit economics (ARR, NRR/GRR, CAC payback, LTV, Rule of 40, gross margin by line)

Business Partnering

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product/Engineering, Operations, Services and G&A leaders to set targets, shape resourcing and evaluate ROI on investments
  • Provide performance reporting with actionable insights to business partners
  • Translate financial insights into clear recommendations for executives, and challenge assumptions constructively
  • Support pricing, packaging, compensation plan and go-to-market decisions with rigorous analysis

EPM and Systems

  • Select, implement and own the enterprise planning platform (e.g., Pigment, Drivetrain, Adaptive, Planful or Anaplan), including data integration with the ERP, CRM, HRIS, and data warehouse.
  • Establish model governance, version control and a single source of truth for planning data

Cash Management and Capital Allocation

  • Monitor covenant compliance, debt service and working capital (billings, collections, deferred revenue)
  • Evaluate capital allocation trade-offs across organic investment, M&A and debt paydown

M&A and Integration

  • Lead financial integration for acquired companies, including budget onboarding, reporting alignment, synergy tracking and post-close performance versus the deal thesis --- drive cross functional alignment to acquired target’s investment thesis

Team Building and Scaling the Function

  • Build, hire, coach and develop an FP&A team across corporate FP&A and business partnering, setting clear performance expectations, creating career paths and a succession plan, and growing future leaders within the function
  • Design the operating cadence, processes and controls that let FP&A scale with the company
  • Other responsibilities and projects as assigned

AI and Automation

  • Identify and deploy AI and workflow automation to streamline forecasting, variance commentary, reporting, reconciliations and other cross-functional and back-office processes
  • Partner with IT, Accounting, Revenue Ops and other teams to put practical, well-governed AI use cases into production

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience implementing an EPM or planning tool such as Pigment, Drivetrain, Adaptive, Planful or Anaplan
  • Advanced three-statement modeling skills and a strong command of SaaS metrics and revenue recognition concepts
  • Proven cash management experience, including 13-week cash forecasting and working capital analysis
  • Ability to sit, stand, travel and complete general office activities with or without reasonable accommodation
  • Exposure to M&A, including diligence, valuation and post-close integration
  • Experience scaling an FP&A function and running both corporate FP&A and business partnering
  • Demonstrated experience using AI to drive cross-functional and back-office automation
  • Experience working in a dynamic PE backed environment
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field

Preferred

  • Experience with Salesforce, Sage Intacct or Netsuite, or a similar ERP, and a BI tool such as Power BI, Tableau or Looker

What You Bring

  • A leader who sets a clear vision for the team, develops future leaders, holds a high bar for accuracy and integrity under pressure, and earns the trust of the CFO, executive team and sponsor through consistent, candid communication

What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months

This role supports development of the data transformation layer in Snowflake, helping turn raw source data into clean, business-ready data, builds and maintains Power BI semantic models, and automates the manual processes that slow the business down. The Analytics Engineer shares responsibility for the team’s data models and transformation code, providing coverage and continuity across the full data flow from raw data to business-ready data. The ideal candidate has strong data modeling fundamentals, hands-on SQL and Power BI expertise, and a builder’s mindset for replacing manual work with reliable, automated solutions.

At Ferrellgas our corporate roles are fully remote, enabling talented professionals to support our field operations from wherever they are. These positions play a critical role in driving business growth, providing strategic and operational support that empowers our teams in the field to deliver exceptional results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Responsibilities

  • Design and build transformation logic that applies business rules consistently and aligns with the team’s standards and architecture.
  • Publish and maintain well documented and performant Power BI semantic models that enable reporting and self-service.
  • Identify, prioritize, and automate recurring manual processes such as data refreshes, extracts, and report distribution.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable data models and validate that models answer real business questions.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented SQL transformations using dbt, with Git-based version control.
  • Manage data projects end to end, coordinating with IT source system owners, the Data Warehouse team, and business end users from requirements gathering through development, testing, and delivery.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description:
Leidos is seeking a Network Engineer to support Federal Civil customer in the Washington, DC metropolitan area.


LOCATION: This position is remote; however, prefer candidates that are within driving distance to the Washington, DC area.

CLEARANCE: Must be a U.S. Citizen capable of obtaining and maintaining a Public Trust clearance prior to start.


POSITION SUMMARY:

This role supports the engineering, operation, maintenance, and modernization of secure, mission-critical enterprise networks across geographically distributed environments.

Working alongside the Senior Network Engineer, you’ll implement, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network solutions across on-premises and hybrid cloud infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with engineering, cybersecurity, and service desk teams to keep the network available, high-performing, and secure while supporting modernization efforts. You’ll also contribute to documentation, configuration management, and continuous service improvement.

A strong foundation in networking and the ability to work across multiple network technologies are essential.


PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Serve as a Tier 2/3 technical resource for operational and engineering issues affecting mission-critical enterprise infrastructure, escalating complex architectural challenges to the Senior Network Engineer as needed.
  • Assist in the planning, deployment, configuration, and maintenance of network infrastructure solutions across geographically distributed, multi-vendor environments.
  • Analyze and troubleshoot technical network issues involving multiple systems, implementing approved corrective actions to maintain network reliability, performance, and security.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching infrastructure, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, routing redundancy, and network failover.
  • Administer and support enterprise network security solutions, including Cisco Firepower, Firepower Management Center (FMC), ASA, firewall rule updates, access controls, and security hardening.
  • Implement, monitor, and sustain secure site-to-site and remote-access VPN solutions, including Cisco Secure Client/AnyConnect and connectivity with external partners and vendors.
  • Support and maintain hybrid cloud network connectivity integrating on-premises infrastructure with AWS networking services, including VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and load balancing.
  • Administer enterprise wireless networking and network access control technologies, including Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Support the execution of network infrastructure upgrades, modernization initiatives, lifecycle replacements, and security remediation activities under the technical guidance of senior engineering staff.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and capacity; assist in gathering metrics and implementing approved improvements to strengthen service delivery and operational resilience.
  • Participate in incident investigations and root cause analysis, gathering diagnostic data and executing corrective and preventive tasks.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and service providers to troubleshoot issues, coordinate maintenance windows, and implement technical tasks.
  • Update and maintain network diagrams, configuration records, technical implementation plans, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Execute incident, problem, change, and service request management tickets while ensuring technical accuracy, thorough documentation, and adherence to SLAs.
  • Partner with the Senior Network Engineer to test and implement network automation scripts, configuration templates, and process improvements to increase operational efficiency.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 4 years’ experience; additional years of experience accepted in lieu of degree.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, administering, and troubleshooting complex enterprise network infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong working knowledge and hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VRFs, and network redundancy/failover.
  • Hands-on experience supporting and administering Cisco and/or Juniper enterprise networking platforms (such as Juniper EX/QFX & Junos OS, and Cisco ISR & IOS devices) in multi-vendor environments.
  • Hands-on experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting enterprise network security infrastructure, including Cisco ASA, Firepower & FMC, access control policies, and remote-access VPN solutions (Cisco AnyConnect/Secure Client).
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot multi-system network issues, assist with root cause analysis (RCA), and implement approved corrective actions.
  • Experience executing network infrastructure changes, device upgrades, and security remediation activities in production environments following established change control procedures.
  • Experience updating and maintaining accurate network diagrams, technical documentation, configuration records, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with experience working alongside senior engineers, cross-functional teams, vendors, and ISPs to resolve operational issues.
  • Familiarity or hands-on experience supporting AWS network infrastructure and hybrid cloud connectivity (e.g., VPCs, Direct Connect, Transit Gateways, load balancers).
  • Experience administering enterprise wireless infrastructure and Network Access Control (NAC) solutions, such as Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE).
  • Exposure to virtual computing platforms (e.g., VMware/vSphere) as they relate to network connectivity, as well as Cisco CUCM/UC voice solutions.
  • Active Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) certification.
  • Ability to obtain a DoD 8140 / IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., Security+ CE, CySA+, CCNA-Security, GSEC, SSCP).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Cisco Certified CCNP or Juniper JNCIP-ENT.
  • Experience with Cisco Meraki wireless solutions.
  • Experience with Cisco ISE.
  • Experience with Dell switches and OS10.
  • Experience with ServiceNow.
  • Security+ CE certification.

*** Candidates selected for an interview should note that it will be conducted live via video, with cameras on at all times. As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, candidates complete formal identity verification.***

jobs.title: Director of Marketing
jobs.description:
The Director of Marketing leads marketing strategy and execution across WorldVia Travel Network and WorldVia.com, with responsibility for driving lead generation, supporting revenue growth, and strengthening brand performance across the company’s key lines of business. This role owns the marketing plans and programs that bring demand into the business, turn attention into action, and help ensure marketing contributes directly to measurable business outcomes.

This person will oversee internal and freelance marketing teams, guide multi-channel campaigns, and ensure marketing efforts support both brand growth and revenue performance. The ideal candidate brings travel agency, host agency, travel brand, or adjacent travel-industry experience, along with the ability to lead teams, manage priorities, and connect marketing activity to growth.

Requirements

Marketing Strategy & Growth

  • Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies for WorldVia Travel Network and WorldVia.com that support lead generation, customer acquisition, member engagement, and revenue growth.
  • Oversee lead generation performance across both brands, including the planning, execution, optimization, and reporting needed to grow qualified demand.
  • Monitor travel industry trends, customer behavior, and competitor activity to identify opportunities for innovation, differentiation, and growth.
  • Establish annual marketing priorities, goals, and performance measures aligned with company and revenue strategies.

Marketing Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and mentor the marketing organization, including internal and freelance marketing contributors across functions such as network marketing, consumer marketing, partner marketing, content, communications, creative, and digital execution.
  • Direct the work of internal staff, freelancers, agencies, and external vendors to ensure alignment with company objectives.
  • Establish clear goals, priorities, accountability measures, and professional development plans for marketing team members.
  • Foster a collaborative, high-performance marketing culture focused on results, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee marketing budgets, resource allocation, agency relationships, and departmental planning.

Campaign & Channel Oversight

  • Oversee event marketing efforts across the business, including campaigns that drive awareness, registrations, attendance, follow-up engagement, and business impact for in-person and virtual events.
  • Oversee marketing efforts across digital marketing, email marketing, social media, website marketing, paid media, search, content, and event-related channels.
  • Guide the creation of sales and marketing collateral, promotional materials, presentations, messaging, and campaign assets across brands and audiences.
  • Build clear campaign calendars, priorities, workflows, and expectations that keep multiple teams aligned and moving efficiently.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are strategically aligned, effectively resourced, and consistently executed across all customer touchpoints.
  • Review and approve campaign strategies, messaging frameworks, and major marketing initiatives.

Revenue Performance

  • Analyze marketing, campaign, event, and channel performance data to evaluate effectiveness, improve results, and inform future investment decisions.
  • Present performance insights, strategic recommendations, and marketing outcomes to executive leadership.

Cross Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary marketing leader partnering Partner closely with sales, agency development, partner relations, member development, and executive leadership to ensure marketing supports the company’s broader growth and revenue goals.
  • Represent the marketing function in strategic planning and leadership discussions.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with key internal stakeholders, external partners, agencies, and freelance contributors.

Leadership Scope

The Director of Marketing leads a multi-part marketing function that includes both day-to-day execution oversight and broader planning responsibility across brands and revenue priorities. This role is responsible for helping teams do their best work, keeping initiatives on track, and ensuring campaigns, event marketing, and lead generation programs are aligned with the company’s goals.

This is a hands-on leadership role that requires strong judgment, collaboration, and follow-through. The person in this role should be comfortable leading people, setting direction, reviewing work, and staying close enough to the details to maintain quality and performance.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • Progressive marketing experience, including leadership responsibility for multi-channel marketing functions.
  • Demonstrated success developing and leading marketing strategies that contributed to business growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and revenue performance.
  • Experience leading marketing teams, including responsibility for performance management, coaching, prioritization, and resource allocation.
  • Experience owning or significantly contributing to lead generation programs and campaign performance.
  • Experience supporting event marketing, including attendance-driving campaigns and follow-up engagement.
  • Experience managing or coordinating the work of internal teams, freelancers, agencies, or other contributors.
  • Experience in the travel agency, host agency, travel brand, hospitality, or broader travel industry space.
  • Ability to connect marketing activity to business growth and revenue impact.
  • 10-25% travel for attendance at company meetings, team collaboration, industry events, and other business-related activities.

Preferred

  • Experience working across both B2B and B2C brand environments.
  • Experience marketing to independent travel advisors, agency owners, and travel consumers.
  • Experience with website-driven acquisition, digital demand generation, and content-led campaigns.

Competencies

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to lead and manage teams with clarity and accountability.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to guide marketing decisions.
  • Strong understanding of lead generation and performance-oriented marketing.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, contributors, and deadlines at once.
  • Collaborative mindset and strong cross-functional partnership skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and modern marketing and reporting tools.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Employer-Sponsored Medical and Dental Insurance with Employee Contribution
  • Fully-Funded Life Insurance (1x salary) & LTD (Long-Term Disability Insurance)
  • Optional Employee-Paid Vision Insurance and STD (Short-Term Disability Insurance)
  • 401k with up to 4% Company Match
  • Paid Time Off + Company Holidays
  • Additional Time Off for Your Birthday and Work Anniversary
  • Discount Travel Program
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment

Equal Opportunity & E-Verify Statement
WorldVia is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

WorldVia participates in E-Verify. We will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the United States.

jobs.title: Content Writer / Copywriter
jobs.description:
Job Title: Content Writer / Copywriter

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. client business hours (with flexibility for deadlines and content calendars)

About the Role:

Our client is seeking a Content Writer / Copywriter to create compelling, high-quality content that informs, engages, and converts. This role involves producing blog posts, landing pages, ad copy, sales collateral, and thought leadership content. The Writer ensures all outputs are on-brand, SEO-friendly, and aligned with marketing and sales objectives.

Responsibilities:

  • Content Creation:
    • Write long-form and short-form content including blogs, case studies, whitepapers, newsletters, and web pages.
    • Produce copy for ads, email campaigns, and sales collateral.
    • Ensure all content aligns with brand voice, style, and tone.
  • SEO & Optimization:
    • Research keywords and incorporate SEO best practices into writing.
    • Collaborate with SEO specialists to optimize for search intent and ranking.
    • Update existing content to maintain freshness and relevance.
  • Research & Subject Expertise:
    • Conduct in-depth research on industry topics, competitors, and trends.
    • Interview subject matter experts (SMEs) for thought leadership content.
    • Translate complex topics into clear, engaging copy.
  • Editing & Quality Assurance:
    • Proofread for grammar, clarity, and consistency.
    • Ensure deliverables are accurate, plagiarism-free, and error-free.
    • Maintain content calendars and deliver work on time.
  • Collaboration:
    • Work with designers, marketers, and sales teams to align copy with visuals and campaigns.
    • Incorporate stakeholder feedback into revisions while maintaining brand integrity.
  • Performance Tracking:
    • Monitor content performance using Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar tools.
    • Provide recommendations to improve engagement, conversions, and SEO rankings.

What Makes You a Perfect Fit:

  • Strong storyteller with a flair for persuasive and engaging writing.
  • Skilled at tailoring tone and style for different audiences and formats.
  • Organized multitasker who can manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Curious researcher who thrives on learning new industries and topics.

Required Experience & Skills (Minimum):

  • 2+ years professional writing or copywriting experience.
  • Portfolio of content across multiple formats (blogs, web copy, ads, collateral).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Google Workspace.
  • Strong research and editing skills.

Ideal Experience & Skills:

  • Background writing for B2B SaaS, marketing agencies, or professional services.
  • Familiarity with SEO tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Clearscope).
  • Experience writing conversion-focused copy (ads, landing pages, email sequences).
  • Knowledge of content management systems (WordPress, HubSpot).

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Content Writer / Copywriter’s day revolves around producing high-quality, conversion-focused content. You will:

  • Research industry trends and gather insights for upcoming topics.
  • Draft blog posts and long-form content for marketing campaigns.
  • Write ad copy, landing page text, or sales collateral to support lead generation and deals.
  • Collaborate with designers and marketers to align copy with visuals and campaign strategy.
  • Edit and proof content for accuracy and brand consistency.
  • Track content performance and optimize older pieces for better SEO and conversions.

In essence: you ensure content is persuasive, optimized, and impactful, fueling marketing and sales results.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs):

  • Consistent content delivery aligned with deadlines.
  • Growth in organic traffic and engagement from written content.
  • Conversion performance of landing pages and ad copy.
  • SEO rankings and visibility for target keywords.
  • Positive stakeholder feedback on clarity and effectiveness of content.

Interview Process:

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  3. Portfolio Review + Practical Task (e.g., draft a blog intro and ad copy for a sample product)
  4. Client Interview with Marketing Leadership
  5. Offer & Background Verification
