jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: http://snout.com

🐶 Our mission


Every pet should get the care they need, regardless of cost. Vet med prices are up 40% since 2020, and pet owners are stuck having to pick between their bank account and furry friend. At Snout, we aim to solve this by enabling clinics to offer pet wellness plans, that actually work.

🚀 The opportunity


Snout is one of the fastest growing wellness plan providers in the veterinary space, trusted by clinics across the U.S. We're a small but mighty startup team and we're on the lookout for an experienced and remote Growth Marketing Manager based in the United States to help turn the interest pet parents show in the clinic into completed plan enrollments.

💻 The role


As a Growth Marketing Manager, you'll be the owner of the pet parent's path to enrollment, from the first flyer they see in an exam room to the moment they complete sign-up. You'll map the prospect journey, build the nurture flows around each appointment, create the in-clinic assets and consumer tools that capture interest, and track what converts. You'll work closely with Clinic Success and Marketing. We don't have an in-house creative team yet, so you'll write your own copy and wireframe your own emails and assets, with support available.

Your impact, measured in plan sales, will be felt by clinics and pet parents alike. Clinic teams get clear, client-facing materials that explain Snout in the exam room and at home. Pet parents get the right information at the right time, so they enroll understanding exactly what their plan covers and start as confident, engaged members. And Snout learns which messages and channels drive enrollment, so we can scale what works and get more pets the care they need.

If you're a builder who likes taking an idea from a blank page to launch, a writer who can turn plan benefits into a clear reason to act, and a marketer who wants to see the numbers behind every send, we'd love to hear from you.

Snout is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We know that great candidates may not check every box — and that’s okay. If you're excited about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply if you meet at least 75% of qualifications including the first bullet. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know — we’re happy to support you.

🛠 What you’ll do


  • Own the prospect journey from first lead capture through completed enrollment, mapping lead stages, triggers, timing and handoffs so every pet parent gets a relevant next step
  • Build and improve direct-to-client nurture journeys for pre-appointment, post-visit, incomplete enrollment and lapsed prospects, segmented by appointment details, clinic, species, breed, age and behavior
  • Expand and maintain Snout's in-clinic assets (flyers, posters and exam-room pieces), each with QR attribution so it can be tested and improved
  • Create consumer tools, like pet health guides by species, breed and age, that put Snout's data to work capturing and nurturing prospects
  • Design custom assets and journeys for corporate partners alongside the teams who manage those relationships
  • Track funnel performance and test messaging, timing and channels to grow plan sales and conversion

💡What we're looking for


  • 4+ years experience in growth, conversion, acquisition or lifecycle marketing
  • Experience owning a prospect journey from lead capture through completed purchase or enrollment, ideally in a B2B2C or partner-led consumer channel
  • Hands-on experience building marketing automation workflows triggered by prospect behavior, including segmentation, personalization, A/B testing and funnel reporting
  • Strong copywriting, with a portfolio of customer-facing emails, campaigns or landing pages that turn product benefits into clear, conversion-focused messaging
  • Ability to wireframe, or ideally build, your own emails, landing pages and marketing assets
  • Experience connecting offline touchpoints to online conversion (ex. QR codes or promo codes), and a track record of taking work from first idea through launch

🌟 What will make you stand out


  • Pet, veterinary or healthcare industry background
  • Experience developing referral, loyalty, member perks or community programs
  • Experience turning CX feedback and cancellation reasons into education and engagement campaigns
  • Familiarity with Marketo, Customer.io or similar platforms (including SMS or in-app messaging), design tools like Canva or Figma, and AI tools for ideation and execution

💖 Why you should join Snout


  • Fast growing, venture capital backed technology company focused on improving access to veterinary care
  • Ability to have a meaningful impact from Day 1, where your voice and opinion matters
  • Unlimited potential to grow in your career, learn and expand your skillsets
  • Collaborative, flexible, and friendly culture

❌ Why this role might not be a fit for you

About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Role

We're looking for an SEO Content Specialist to help execute our content and AI-first search strategy. You'll build topical authority and create content that ranks on search engines and gets cited by AI answer engines like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity. Your work will be measured by its impact on traffic, AI visibility and sign-ups, not by how much you publish.

Responsibilities

  • Write, edit and refresh content that meets E-E-A-T standards: real expertise, author credibility, accurate sources and first-hand insight.
  • Collaborate and work closely with the content team to plan, brief and produce content that supports our search and AI visibility goals.
  • Collaborate and work closely with the tech team to implement technical SEO changes, schema and site improvements, and make sure they ship on time.
  • Create content frameworks, including templates, brief formats and structure guidelines, so content is consistent, AI-first and easy to produce at scale.
  • Track AI visibility and citations against competitors, test new tactics, and adjust the strategy based on what works.
  • Improve click-through rates from search by testing and optimising titles, meta descriptions and rich results.
  • Make our content AI-first, so it's easy for both search engines and LLMs to retrieve, understand and cite. That means clear answers, structured formats, entity-rich copy and strong source signals.
  • Research keywords, entities and search intent, and plan semantically complete content around business goals.
  • Build topical maps and pillar-cluster (hub-and-spoke) content structures that establish topical authority in our core areas.
  • Own on-page and technical SEO: internal linking, schema markup, crawlability, indexation, Core Web Vitals and site architecture.
  • Report monthly on traffic, rankings, CTR, AI visibility and conversions.
  • Help execute our AEO and GEO strategy, supporting decisions on which topics, questions and platforms to prioritise so the brand shows up in AI-generated answers.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • 3-5 years of experience in SEO content writing or content marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Proven experience creating topical maps and content frameworks, and turning them into pillar-cluster content plans.
  • Hands-on experience with Ahrefs or Semrush, Search Console, GA4, Screaming Frog and a CMS such as WordPress.
  • Solid technical SEO knowledge, including site audits, schema, internal linking, indexation issues and basic HTML.
  • A practical understanding of AEO, GEO and how LLMs and AI search engines find and cite content.
  • A strong grasp of topical authority, topic clusters, semantic SEO, entities and E-E-A-T.
  • Experience executing SEO or content strategies with measurable results.
  • Strong ownership, attention to quality and a record of delivering on time.

Details

  • Fully remote based in India
  • Salary: $15,000-$20,000 USD per year, depending on experience and location

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully remote work from the comfort of your home
  • Eligibility for employee equity plan (stock options)
  • Reimbursement package for home office expenses and professional development, up to $1.5k
  • Generous time off policy of 21 days (birthday included 🎉), 8 holidays of your choice, and 2 paid volunteer days
  • Wellness program with fitness and mindfulness classes
  • Love your work and our mission of serving nonprofits!

The Application Process

We have 6 stages:

  1. Apply here and fill out our questions to tell us about you!
  2. Prescreen Call with the Talent Team
  3. Interview with Hiring Manager
  4. Assignment
  5. Panel/Final Interview
  6. Background & Reference Checks

If this sounds like the right role for you, please apply today and let us know why. We look forward to hearing from you!

Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

Customer Success Manager 

At Cardata, customers are at the centre of everything we do. Our Customer Success team protects retention by helping customers get greater value from their reimbursement programs and building strong, lasting relationships.

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll own a portfolio of customer relationships after implementation, helping customers navigate their programs, resolve challenges, and achieve meaningful business outcomes while contributing to Cardata's GRR and NRR goals.

This is a hands-on role that combines customer relationship management with problem-solving and day-to-day execution and management of customer expectations. You'll develop a strong understanding of our platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently investigate issues, troubleshoot challenges, and guide customers toward practical solutions.

You'll thrive here if you're naturally curious and enjoy learning, are resourceful, highly organized, and an excellent communicator. You enjoy digging into complex problems, finding answers, and balancing competing priorities while ensuring customers feel supported and nothing falls through the cracks.

This is a remote-first role with occasional travel, approximately 2–3 times per quarter.

What you'll do

  • Own a portfolio of customer relationships, understanding their business objectives, reimbursement programs, and ongoing needs to deliver a responsive, reliable customer experience while managing customer expectations.
  • Investigate and resolve customer challenges, using platform knowledge, documentation, data, and internal resources to troubleshoot issues, identify root causes, and drive solutions through to completion.
  • Manage a high volume of customer requests, triaging inquiries, prioritizing by urgency and business impact, and maintaining clear ownership of deadlines and follow-ups and managing customer expectations.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively, setting expectations, explaining complex information, and keeping customers informed throughout the resolution process.
  • Develop deep knowledge of Cardata's platform and reimbursement workflows to confidently answer questions, guide customers, and identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness.
  • Monitor customer health, adoption, and program performance, identifying risks and taking action to protect retention and customer satisfaction.
  • Lead customer check-ins, and renewal preparation, using customer insights to demonstrate value and provide practical recommendations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve customer outcomes and expand value, partnering with Account Managers on potential growth opportunities.
  • With support of Customer Success Associate, interpret data insights to inform customer conversations and recommendations.
  • Partner with Support, Product, Engineering, and Implementation to coordinate resolutions, address recurring issues, and improve the customer experience.

What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Implementation, or a similar customer-facing role, within B2B SaaS.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the curiosity and resourcefulness to investigate unfamiliar issues, identify root causes, and independently drive resolution.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to simplify complex information, manage stakeholder expectations, and navigate challenging customer conversations.
  • Excellent organization, prioritization, and time management skills, with experience managing a busy portfolio, high volumes of inquiries, and competing deadlines.
  • Strong customer ownership and relationship-building skills, with a track record of building trust, following through on commitments, and delivering a reliable customer experience.
  • Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to quickly learn SaaS platforms, understand operational workflows, and navigate interconnected systems.
  • Sound judgment and attention to detail, particularly when assessing urgency, investigating issues, and determining when to involve internal partners.
  • Strong ability to recognize customer risks, protect retention, and identify opportunities for account growth.
  • Strong affinity for continual learning of new tools, products and programs.

Compensation

The expected base compensation for this role is 68,000–76,000 CAD annually, dependent on experience and competency. This role is also eligible for target variable incentives of 5,000-10,000 CAD, with actual earnings dependent on experience, skills, and performance.

This is a vacant position, and we are seeking someone who will bring a new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.

Cardata is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates will be equally considered without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, language, citizenship, creed, religion, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, physical and/or mental handicap or financial ability. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to bring their authentic selves to work.

If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: United Arab Emirates
URL: http://www.compsych.com

About ComPsych

تُعد شركة ComPsych® Corporation أكبر مزود عالمي لخدمات الصحة النفسية وبرامج GuidanceResources® للحياة. وانطلاقاً من التزامها الراسخ بالابتكار المتواصل وتبنيها لنهج شامل في تقديم الرعاية، توفر ComPsych خدماتها لأكثر من 163 مليون فرد موزعين على 200 دولة. وتحت مظلة علامتنا التجارية GuidanceResources®، نقدم برامج مخصصة ومتكاملة تماماً تشمل مجالات الصحة السلوكية، وإدارة حالات الغياب، ومسارات العافية؛ وهي برامج تهدف إلى تمكين الموظفين من عيش حياة أكثر صحة وإنتاجية، فضلاً عن تعزيز التميز المؤسسي. تفضل بزيارة موقع compsych.com لتكتشف الأسباب التي دفعت 40% من الشركات المدرجة ضمن قائمة "Fortune 500" لاختيار ComPsych لتلبية احتياجاتها المتعلقة بالصحة النفسية.

 

 

ComPsych® Corporation is the world’s largest provider of mental health services and GuidanceResources® for life. Fueled by a commitment to relentless innovation and a comprehensive approach to care, ComPsych provides services to more than 163 million individuals across 200 countries. Under our GuidanceResources® brand, our personalized and fully integrated programs include behavioral health, absence, and wellness journeys, which empower employees to lead healthier and more productive lives, while driving organizational excellence. Visit compsych.com to find out why 40% of the Fortune 500 choose ComPsych for their mental health needs.

About the Role

 

المسمى الوظيفي هو "استشاري توجيه" (Guidance Consultant)، وهي وظيفة تعتمد نظام العمل عن بُعد ومقرها دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة. تُعد هذه الوظيفة عقداً محدد المدة وبدوام كامل، وهي مثالية للمتخصصين في مجال الصحة النفسية ممن يقدّرون التميز السريري ويتحلون بالتعاطف في نهجهم المهني، فضلاً عن قدرتهم على النجاح والتميز في بيئة عمل سريعة الإيقاع تضع سهولة الوصول وسرعة الاستجابة والرعاية المتمحورة حول العميل في

 

يقوم مستشارو التوجيه بتقديم دعم مباشر للعملاء عبر الهاتف والمحادثات النصية، حيث يتناولون القضايا المتعلقة بالصحة السلوكية، والرفاه العاطفي، والشؤون الأسرية، ومسائل العافية الشاملة؛ وذلك بمنتهى الاحترافية والتعاطف، وبالاستناد إلى حكم سريري سديد.

 

وبصفتها جزءاً من أكبر جهة مزودة في العالم لـ "برامج مساعدة الموظفين" (EAP) وخدمات الرعاية المُدارة للصحة السلوكية، فإن هذه الوظيفة تتيح فرصة استثنائية للنمو المهني. إذ يوظف المستشارون خبراتهم السريرية لتقديم الدعم الفوري في لحظة الحاجة، وتوجيه العملاء نحو الموارد المتاحة، وتسهيل إجراء الإحالات المناسبة وفي الوقت المناسب، لضمان استمرارية الرعاية وتحقيق نتائج إيجابية.

 

 

 

The job title is Guidance Consultant and is a remote working role residing in the country of United Arab Emirates. This is a Fixed-Term, Full-Time position and is ideal for mental health professionals who value clinical excellence and lead with empathy, and who thrive in a fast-paced environment where access, responsiveness, and client-centered care are essential.

 

Guidance Consultants provide direct client support via telephone and chat, addressing behavioral health, emotional well-being, family concerns, and overall wellness-related issues with professionalism, compassion, and sound clinical judgment.

 

As part of the world’s largest provider of Employee Assistance Programs (EAP) and managed behavioral health care services, this role offers an exceptional opportunity for professional growth. Consultants leverage their clinical expertise to deliver in-the-moment support, guide clients through available resources, and facilitate timely, appropriate referrals to ensure continuity of care and positive outcomes.

 

What You'll Do

تقديم الدعم عبر الهاتف والمحادثة النصية من خلال إجراء تقييمات سريرية أولية شاملة، وإحالة العملاء إلى الموارد المناسبة، بما في ذلك المعالجون النفسيون، والمرشدون، وموارد العافية ذات الصلة.

 إجراء تقييمات للعملاء وتطبيق منهجيات التدريب (Coaching) لتطوير استراتيجيات مخصصة للصحة والعافية تدعم إحداث تغيير إيجابي في السلوك.

 ضمان الالتزام ببروتوكولات القسم، وأفضل الممارسات المتبعة في القطاع، والمتطلبات الخاصة بالعملاء؛ وذلك للحفاظ على الامتثال التنظيمي وضمان تقديم خدمات عالية الجودة.

 تقديم الخدمات بأسلوب يتسم بالكفاءة الثقافية، والشمولية، والاحترام للأفراد من خلفيات متنوعة وذوي احتياجات متباينة.

 توظيف التقدير السليم للمواقف، والتفكير النقدي، ومهارات حل المشكلات لتقييم الحالات، ومعالجة الشواغل بسرعة، وتسهيل تقديم الدعم المناسب لتعزيز تجربة العميل الشاملة.

 توعية العملاء بالموارد المتاحة، ومعايير الأهلية، والخدمات التي يقدمها البرنامج بأسلوب مهني ومتعاطف.

 الحفاظ على توثيق دقيق وشامل وفي الوقت المناسب لجميع التفاعلات مع العملاء ضمن نظام قاعدة البيانات الخاص بالمؤسسة.

 البقاء على اطلاع دائم بأحدث الاتجاهات والموارد وأفضل الممارسات الناشئة في مجال الصحة السلوكية، وذلك لتعزيز جودة تقديم الخدمات بشكل مستمر.

 التعاون مع الأطراف المعنية (أصحاب المصلحة) داخل المؤسسة وخارجها لضمان استمرارية الرعاية ومواءمة الخدمات مع التوقعات المحددة لكل عميل.

الالتزام الصارم بالسرية الطبية ولوائح حماية البيانات المعمول بها (مثل: GDPR في أوروبا، وPDPA في سنغافورة، وPIPEDA في كندا، وPDPL في الإمارات العربية المتحدة).

 أداء أي مهام إضافية أخرى تُسند إليه.

 

 

  • Provide telephonic and chat support by conducting comprehensive clinical intakes and referring clients to appropriate resources, including therapists, counselors and relevant wellness resources.
  • Conduct client assessments and apply coaching methodologies to develop tailored health and well-being strategies that support positive behavior change
  • Ensure adherence to departmental protocols, industry best practices, and customer-specific requirements to maintain compliance and high-quality service delivery.
  • Deliver services in a culturally competent, inclusive, and respectful manner to individuals from diverse backgrounds with varying needs.
  • Apply sound judgment, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills to assess situations, resolve concerns promptly, and facilitate appropriate support to enhance the overall client experience.
  • Educate clients regarding available resources, eligibility criteria, and program services in a professional and empathetic manner.
  • Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely documentation of all client interactions within the organization’s proprietary database system.
  • Stay informed on emerging behavioral health trends, resources, and best practices to continuously enhance service delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure continuity of care and alignment with client-specific service expectations.
  • Maintain strict adherence to medical confidentiality and applicable data protection regulations (e.g., GDPR in Europe, PDPA in Singapore, PIPEDA in Canada, PDPL in UAE)
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

 يُشترط الحصول على درجة الماجستير أو ما يعادلها من مؤهلات الدراسات العليا في علم النفس، أو الخدمة الاجتماعية، أو الصحة السلوكية، أو أي مجال ذي صلة بالصحة السلوكية من مؤسسة معترف بها.

 في حال كان الإطار التنظيمي المهني المعمول به في بلد أو ولاية العمل يعترف بشهادة البكالوريوس كمعيار أساسي للالتحاق بالتخصص ذي الصلة، يُمكن اعتبار هذه الشهادة من مؤسسة معترف بها، بالإضافة إلى الخبرة العملية ذات الصلة بعد الحصول عليها، معادلةً لها.

 يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة لممارسة المهنة و/أو الحصول على الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثما يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

يجب على المرشحين استيفاء جميع المتطلبات التعليمية والخبرة اللازمة للتأهل للممارسة المهنية و/أو الترخيص أو التسجيل لدى الهيئة التنظيمية المختصة في ولاية عملهم، حيثم

  يكون هذا التسجيل أو الترخيص مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو اللوائح.

 الأهلية لممارسة المهنة و/أو التسجيل في بلد الإقامة وفقًا للوائح الوطنية

 إجادة استخدام برامج مايكروسوفت أوفيس وأنظمة معلومات العملاء

 يُفضل الخبرة في العمل ضمن بيئات متعددة الثقافات أو دولية

 مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع توجه قوي نحو خدمة العملاء

 القدرة على التعامل مع المعلومات الحساسة بسرية تامة والحفاظ على خصوصيتها

متطلبات أخرى

 

يُشترط توفر اتصال إنترنت عالي السرعة ومستقر وموثوق، بالإضافة إلى مساحة عمل خالية من المشتتات أو المقاطعات أو الضوضاء.

القدرة على الظهور عبر الكاميرا أثناء التدريبات والاجتماعات والفعاليات المتعلقة بالعمل.

يجب أن تكون قادراً على الجلوس أو الوقوف أمام المكتب لفترات طويلة أثناء العمل على جهاز الحاسوب.

 

 

  • Master's degree or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Psychology, Social Work, Behavioral Health, or a related behavioral health field from a recognized institution is required.

Compensation and Benefits

يتراوح نطاق الأجر لهذا المنصب ما بين 110,000 و128,560 درهماً إماراتياً سنوياً. وسيتم تحديد قيمة التعويضات وفقاً لمعدلات السوق المحلية السائدة والمتطلبات القانونية المعمول بها. وفي الحالات التي يقتضيها القانون الساري، سيتم تزويد المرشحين بمعلومات نطاق الراتب خلال عملية التوظيف أو بناءً على طلبهم.

تُقدَّم المزايا وفقاً لقانون العمل الإماراتي، وتشمل الإجازة السنوية، والعطلات الرسمية، والتأمين الصحي الإلزامي، ومكافأة نهاية الخدمة. وسيتم تقديم تفاصيل إضافية خلال مرحلة تقديم العرض.

 

 

نحن جهة توظيف تكفل تكافؤ الفرص، ونلتزم بممارسات توظيف عادلة وشفافة وقائمة على الجدارة. سيتم النظر في طلبات التوظيف المقدمة من جميع المتقدمين المؤهلين دون أي تمييز يستند إلى العمر، أو الجنس، أو الهوية الجندرية أو التعبير عنها، أو التوجه الجنسي، أو العرق، أو اللون، أو الأصل الإثني، أو الجنسية، أو الدين أو المعتقد، أو الإعاقة، أو حالة الحمل أو الوضع الأبوي، أو الحالة الاجتماعية أو الأسرية، أو الوضع العسكري أو وضع المحاربين القدامى، أو الخلفية الاجتماعية والاقتصادية، أو المعلومات الجينية، أو أي خصائص أخرى يحميها القانون المحلي أو الوطني أو الدولي المعمول به.

نحن ملتزمون بتوفير عملية توظيف شاملة وميسرة للجميع. إذا كنت بحاجة إلى أي تسهيلات أو تعديلات في أي مرحلة من مراحل عملية التوظيف بسبب إعاقة أو لأي سبب آخر، يرجى التواصل معنا عبر البريد الإلكتروني recruiter@compsych.com، وسنعمل معك لتلبية احتياجاتك.

 

تلتزم شركة ComPsych Corporation وشركاتها التابعة بالتعامل مع بياناتك الشخصية بمسؤولية وشفافية. سيتم استخدام المعلومات التي يتم جمعها أثناء عملية التوظيف لتقييم طلبك، وحيثما ينطبق ذلك، لإعداد وإدارة عرض التوظيف المقدم إليك. ستتم معالجة بياناتك الشخصية وفقاً لقوانين الخصوصية المعمول بها في بلد إقامتك أو نطاق ولايتك القضائية، والتي قد تشمل قانون خصوصية المستهلك في كاليفورنيا (CCPA)، واللائحة العامة لحماية البيانات في الاتحاد الأوروبي (GDPR)، وقانون حماية المعلومات الشخصية والوثائق الإلكترونية في كندا (PIPEDA) والتشريعات الإقليمية المتعلقة بالخصوصية، وغيرها من قوانين الخصوصية الوطنية أو المحلية السارية. للحصول على تفاصيل كاملة حول البيانات الشخصية التي نجمعها، وكيفية استخدامنا لها، وحقوقك بصفتك متقدماً للوظيفة، وكيفية التواصل معنا لطرح أسئلة تتعلق بالخصوصية، يرجى مراجعة إشعارات خصوصية بيانات المتقدمين ذات الصلة: "إشعار حماية البيانات للمتقدمين للوظائف في المنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية وسويسرا والمملكة المتحدة" و"إشعار خصوصية المتقدمين للوظائف على المستوى العالمي".

 

 

 

The pay range for this positions is 110,000 - 128,560  AED per year. Compensation will be determined in accordance with applicable local market rates and legal requirements. jobs.title: Navy Account Executive - Public Sector
jobs.description:
Unstructured is defining the standard for enterprise data transformation in the age of LLMs and generative AI. In just two years, we've raised over $65M from world-class investors, including Menlo Ventures, Bain Capital, Databricks, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and IBM.

Our open-source toolkit has been downloaded 97M+ times and is used by 90% of the Fortune 1000. We power production AI workflows across commercial and federal sectors — transforming PDFs, HTML, Word docs, images, emails, and more into AI-ready data pipelines that scale.

We're not just building tools; we're building the backbone of generative AI and the infrastructure that unlocks intelligence across industries.

About the Role

We are seeking a Strategic Navy Account Executive to drive revenue growth and adoption of our recently FedRAMP High certified software across the Department of the Navy — Navy and Marine Corps. You will be our dedicated seller in this space, owning a greenfield territory and building pipeline, partnerships, and customer wins from the ground up.

This role requires a hunter mentality, deep Navy procurement fluency, and the ability to position modern AI infrastructure solutions to both technical and mission-focused stakeholders.

What You'll Own & Drive

  • Own and execute territory and account plans to hit revenue and pipeline targets across the US Navy and Marine Corps

  • Build pipeline from scratch through proactive outbound prospecting across program managers, contracting officers, and senior acquisition stakeholders

  • Develop teaming relationships with Navy-focused primes, systems integrators, and ISVs

  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder DoD sales cycles with a capture mindset

  • Partner with solutions engineering and product teams to deliver tailored, compliance-aligned solutions

  • Manage pipeline, forecasts, and CRM hygiene with discipline and accuracy

  • Represent Unstructured at key Navy and defense industry events including Sea-Air-Space, AFCEA WEST, NDIA, and PAE/PEO industry days

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years selling into DoD / Navy accounts with a proven track record of landing net-new logos

  • Full-cycle quota ownership — this is not an overlay or pre-sales role

  • Strong understanding of Navy/DoD procurement processes, contract vehicles, and budget cycles

  • Familiarity with DoD compliance frameworks: CMMC, RMF/ATO, IL levels, FedRAMP

  • Technical conversancy in AI, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure

  • Startup grit — comfortable building territory from scratch with limited support

  • Willingness to travel ~25–30% for conferences, customer meetings, and partner events

  • US citizenship required

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling AI, data infrastructure, or ETL solutions

  • Existing relationships with Navy-focused primes, SIs, or channel partners

  • Prior military service, DoD civilian experience, or time at a Navy/USMC program office

  • Experience with MEDDPICC or similar enterprise sales methodologies

Compensation

On-target earnings (OTE): $290,000 – $430,000, split 50% base / 50% commission at target. Base salary range: $145,000 – $215,000. Eligible for commission and equity.

Why You’ll Love It Here

You’ll be surrounded by smart, kind, low-ego people who genuinely enjoy building together. We invest in our team with company offsites, best-in-tech swag, and the tools you need to do your best work, wherever you’re based.

We support you holistically, not just at work. For full-time, US-based employees, that includes:

  • Health: Medical, dental, and vision coverage through Justworks, effective the 1st of the month following your start date. All medical plans include fertility coverage, plus access to One Medical, Talkspace (12 free therapy sessions a year), Kindbody, and Teladoc. If you waive medical coverage, we pay a $250/month allowance.

  • Financial: 401(k) with company match (100% of the first 3% you contribute, 50% of the next 2%), company-paid life insurance, and optional supplemental life, short- and long-term disability, accident, critical illness, and hospital coverage. FSA and HSA options available.

  • Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building.

  • Time off: Flexible paid time off (unlimited), up to 80 hours of paid sick leave a year, 12 company holidays, and a company-wide winter break between Christmas and New Year’s.

  • Family: 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all parents, available after 6 months, plus up to 6 additional unpaid weeks.

  • Remote setup: A $500 home office stipend and a $75/month cell and internet stipend.

  • Team: Team and company offsites throughout the year.

We want you focused on building, growing, and staying energized for the long haul. If you’re excited about what we’re building, we’d love to meet you.

Unstructured is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive culture where everyone can do their best work. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Director, Strategic Engagements (Northeast)
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

What We Do:

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Director, Strategic Engagements, Northeast, to join our team. The individual will be an integral member of the Commercial team and will support commercially focused HCP engagement activities for Azetukalner.

Key primary responsibility is to support key US Commercial Strategic market development strategies for the epilepsy launch. Individuals should be an exceptional business leader with deep epilepsy experience who will work Regionally to maintain: 1) KOL Engagement and 2) Uncover key market impact drivers 3) Support regional business planning across matrix colleagues. This role will ensure close working relationships with cross-functional partners in a compliant manner.

This position requires close collaboration with the Commercial team, Medical Affairs and other key business partners to elevate corporate brand awareness/ advocacy. This role requires demonstrated ability to thrive in a dynamic and ambiguous environment. Position will require greater than 50% travel (can be up to 75% travel) to field-based educational events (many occurring on weekends). This includes internal meetings, advisory boards, medical meetings, and congresses.

This position reports to the Senior Director, Customer Engagement, and will be fully remote.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

· Identify, cultivate, and maintain long-term relationships with national and regional epilepsy KOLs, advisors, and other influential stakeholders.

· Own commercial KOL influence mapping, including stakeholder profiling, engagement strategies, and communication plans that inform customer prioritization and commercial planning.

· Monitor and synthesize stakeholder insights, treatment trends, unmet needs, and competitive dynamics, translating findings into actionable recommendations that inform commercial strategy, launch readiness, and regional business decisions.

· Serve as a strategic advisor to Commercial leadership by providing market intelligence, stakeholder perspectives, and recommendations that shape launch planning, customer engagement strategies, and business priorities.

· Support launch readiness initiatives by identifying and engaging key stakeholders who influence awareness, perception, advocacy, treatment positioning, and early adoption of Azetukalner within assigned regions.

· Lead cross-functional coordination across Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Advocacy, and other matrix partners to ensure aligned customer engagement strategies and execution.

· Drive coordinated account planning by integrating stakeholder insights and partnering across matrix teams to develop and execute aligned engagement plans for priority customers and accounts.

· Identify emerging market opportunities, barriers to adoption, and customer needs, and recommend actions that strengthen launch preparedness and commercial execution.

· Attend and lead strategic engagement activities at national and regional congresses, professional meetings, and key industry events, including stakeholder mapping, partner engagement, and field education support.

· Collaborate with Marketing, Analytics, Medical Affairs, and other cross-functional partners to refine disease-state education, brand strategy, customer engagement approaches, and market development initiatives.

· Identify and develop strategic partnerships with professional societies, advocacy organizations, and other external stakeholders to advance disease awareness, education, and advocacy efforts.

· Facilitate and coordinate high-impact engagements between Xenon senior leadership and national and regional KOLs.

· Formalize meetings (live, virtual, Congress) with senior leadership and National and Regional KOLs

· Develop and propose short- and long-term objectives for the function in accordance with overall Company strategies and plans

· Plan and manage budget proposals and approved budgets in accordance with the Company’s strategic and operating plans and Finance policies

· Recruit, lead, direct, develop, coach and evaluate direct reports, if any, in accordance with the Company’s Human Resource policies and practices

· Act in accordance with Company policies, including, for example, the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and ensure policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any

· Travel is 50-75%

· Region covers: MA, NY, PA, NJ, CT, RI, VT, NH, ME

· International travel may be required

· Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

· A minimum of a BA/BS Degree in a related field is required; MBA, PharmD, PhD or other related graduate degree preferred

· A minimum of 10 years of experience in Epilepsy marketing, medical, key account management, sales, or sales leadership, ideally engaging with KOLs/Influential HCPs and professional healthcare organizations

· Deep understanding and experience working cross functionally with various key internal & external stakeholders with a strong ability to innovate, collaborate and deliver results with desired outcomes

· Demonstrated understanding of key industry trends and ability to develop strategies to stay ahead of the competition and maximize patient outcomes

· Demonstrated ability to build and manage relevant and lasting customer relationships with strong focus on patient impact and outstanding customer centricity

· Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills

· Able to work independently under tight timelines and be willing to contribute significantly to day-to-day operations as needed

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

jobs.title: City Manager, New York
jobs.description:
Flex is building AI-native financial services for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the Role

We're seeking an ambitious problem solver with a record of achievement on an exponential trajectory.

As City Manager, you'll lead Flex's growth in New York. You know the business owners, the culture, and which rooms matter. Your job is to turn that into new Flex customers.

You'll build a target list of 50 business owners you'd most like to bring to Flex. From that list, you'll identify five North Star accounts; the high-priority relationships that could have a meaningful impact on Flex's growth and visibility in your market.

Your job is to develop a strategy for reaching those owners, building relationships, and ultimately bringing their businesses onto Flex. Some opportunities will move quickly, while others will take time. You'll also build relationships within their networks, creating additional opportunities for customer acquisition.

You'll take ownership of these relationships from the first conversation through conversion, working with our sales and industry teams to move opportunities forward.

You'll work closely with teams across Flex, including sales, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership, plus City Managers in other markets. Your city is yours to run, with a team behind you.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the city’s dream list of 50 owners, prioritizing five North Star accounts and identifying the best path to each.
  • Curate rooms built around the people on your list: Plan and host events that bring the right people together, including intimate dinners, customer gatherings, and strategic brand activations.
  • Develop relationships with prospective customers and guide them from initial conversations through account opening, staying involved as their businesses grow with Flex.
  • Evaluate and negotiate sponsorships and memberships, and only say yes to the ones that put you in front of people on the list.
  • Develop a monthly market plan covering your priority accounts, upcoming initiatives, and progress toward customer acquisition.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to move opportunities forward, generate customer referrals, and share insights from your market.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline, track applications and referrals, coordinate events, and manage your local budget.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Your 50 are written, your five are picked, your first rooms have happened and you’re in real conversations with your North Star accounts.

First year: Your North Star accounts are on Flex, the customers you brought in are active and spending, and people around the city are sending you introductions without being asked.

Above all, we care about results: accounts closed and how they use Flex once they’re open. Plenty of great customers will come from outside your list, and those count too.

Requirements

  • Strong relationships with your city’s business owners. You could write the dream list this week and say how you know each person on it.
  • A track record in sales or business development, in financial services, private banking, real estate, hospitality, membership clubs, or another relationship-driven business. You’re comfortable asking for the business and closing.
  • A pulse on your city: the restaurant everyone’s talking about this month, the best rooftop, where to take someone for a serious cocktail. People trust your taste.
  • An eye for design: venue, event flow, how a space photographs, and the details, like menu cards and table settings, that make something memorable.
  • The ability to spot the right opportunities, build a strategy to pursue them, and stay organized throughout.
  • A competitive streak, and the judgment to know when bringing in a teammate helps close the deal. You make calls the way the CEO of Flex would, with the company’s interest first.
  • Currently based in New York.

Nice to Haves

  • Bilingual skills, which may be preferred or required depending on the market.

Compensation

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Manager, Paid Search (PLA)

jobs.title: Senior Director, Field Access
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Xenon Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:XENE) is a neuroscience-focused biopharmaceutical company dedicated to drug discovery, clinical development, and commercialization of life-changing therapeutics for patients in need. We are looking for great people who thrive in a respectful, collaborative, inclusive, and productive culture to join the Xenon team.

What We Do:

We are advancing an exciting product pipeline to address indications with high unmet medical need, including epilepsy, depression and pain. Our Phase 3 azetukalner program represents the most advanced, clinically validated potassium channel modulator in late-stage clinical development for multiple indications. In March 2026, we announced positive topline data from our Phase 3 X-TOLE2 study of azetukalner in focal onset seizures (FOS), and we submitted a New Drug Application to the Food and Drug Administration in the third quarter of 2026. Our Phase 3 epilepsy program also includes a second FOS study, X-TOLE3, which would support regulatory submissions outside the U.S., and the X-ACKT study in primary generalized tonic-clonic seizures, which would support regulatory submissions for an additional epilepsy indication. We also have multiple Phase 3 azetukalner clinical trials underway in major depressive disorder (MDD) and bipolar depression (BPD), based on topline data from our Phase 2 X-NOVA clinical trial. In addition, we are proud of our strong heritage in human genetics, deep understanding of ion channel biology, and expertise in novel chemistries to enable potent, selective ion channel targeting. We continue to advance an early-stage pipeline of novel therapeutic candidates, including Phase 1 studies for XEN1701 and XEN1720 (targeting Nav1.7) and XEN1120 (targeting Kv7), which are being developed for pain. Backed by a strong balance sheet to support our growth plans, we continue to build a fully integrated, premier neuroscience company with strong discovery, clinical development, corporate, and commercial operations.

About the Role:

The Senior Director, Field Access, will build and lead a national team of Field Access Managers, responsible for optimizing access to azetukalner (AZK), Xenon’s first product launch, for patients with epilepsy. This critical, field-based role will execute the brand’s access and channel strategy and serve as a key member of the Market Access leadership team. The Senior Director will work closely with colleagues across distribution, services, and sales to align priorities, define escalation pathways, and ensure consistent field execution and pull-through. The Senior Director will coach and develop the Field Access Manager team to build and maintain relationships with targeted customers, including physician offices, leading epilepsy treatment centers of excellence, and local advocacy organizations. We are seeking a strategic, collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced start-up environment and is eager to contribute across the organization to drive success.

This position reports to the Senior Vice President, Market Access and will be fully remote, with frequent travel to Xenon’s offices near Boston, MA, USA. The level of the position will be commensurate with the candidate’s education and industry experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hire and lead the Field Access team focused on ensuring patients have access to AZK that is consistent with brand strategy

  • Drive patient access outcomes that are equal to or better than branded products in relevant competitive categories

  • Establish access goals, productivity measures, MBOs, and action plans for the team

  • Establish a CRM tracking methodology for the team’s account interactions

  • Establish a close working relationship with sales leadership to support and enable field execution

  • Work closely with Market Access colleagues to share challenges, key insights into market dynamics, and successes

  • Establish ways of working across internal, field, and channel partners

  • Participate in the market access strategic planning process, forecasting, and budgeting

  • Collaborate compliantly with field sales to ensure goal alignment and execution

  • Work closely with the National Account team to stay abreast of payer coverage, formulary nuances, product positioning, and any emerging gaps in coverage

  • Partner with the Commercial Operations team to maximize use of data and reporting that enables higher customer and account satisfaction

  • Manage budget proposals and approved budgets in accordance with the company’s strategic and operating plans and Finance policies

  • Ensure the Field Access team adheres to all company policies, compliance training requirements, and other legal and regulatory directives

  • Develop and propose short- and long-term objectives for the function in accordance with overall Company strategies and plans

  • Plan and manage budget proposals and approved budgets in accordance with the Company’s strategic and operating plans and Finance policies

  • Recruit, lead, direct, develop, coach and evaluate direct reports, if any, in accordance with the Company’s Human Resource policies and practices

  • Act in accordance with Company policies, including, for example, the Code of Business Conduct and Ethics and ensure policies are understood and followed by direct reports, if any

  • Some international travel may be required

  • Other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred

  • 12+ years in biotech/pharma market access, patient services, or related field-facing roles with a focus on pharmacy benefit products

  • 5+ years hiring and leading field-based reimbursement/access teams

  • Entrepreneurial, team-oriented leader with specialty product launch experience in a start-up environment; comfortable with ambiguity

  • Deep knowledge of U.S. payers (commercial/Medicare/Medicaid), specialty pharmacy, patient services, and copay assistance

  • Ability to lead and influence cross-functional stakeholders in a matrixed organization

  • Ability to simplify complex issues into clear, actionable solutions

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with executive presence and a collaborative working style

  • Effective decision-making and problem-solving abilities

  • Strong analytical skills; able to turn insights into account performance and ask the right questions of analytics partners informing strategy

  • Up to 50% travel may be required based on business needs

Our Total Rewards program includes base salary, target bonus, and stock options, as well as a full range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, short-& long-term disability, accidental death & dismemberment, and life insurance programs, Employee Assistance Program, travel insurance, and retirement savings programs with company matching contributions.

Xenon encourages time to rest and re-charge through vacation, personal days, sick days, and an end-of-year company shutdown. Xenon highly values employee development and has an expanding Training, Learning & Development program, including a Tuition Assistance program for advanced degrees.

jobs.title: City Manager, Nashville
jobs.description:
Flex is building AI-native financial services for business owners.

We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023, Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue, with a clear path to profitability by late 2026. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.

Our customers are affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.

Team & Locations

We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the Role

We're seeking an ambitious problem solver with a record of achievement on an exponential trajectory.

As City Manager, you'll lead Flex's growth in Nashville. You know the business owners, the culture, and which rooms matter. Your job is to turn that into new Flex customers.

You'll build a target list of 50 business owners you'd most like to bring to Flex. From that list, you'll identify five North Star accounts; the high-priority relationships that could have a meaningful impact on Flex's growth and visibility in your market.

Your job is to develop a strategy for reaching those owners, building relationships, and ultimately bringing their businesses onto Flex. Some opportunities will move quickly, while others will take time. You'll also build relationships within their networks, creating additional opportunities for customer acquisition.

You'll take ownership of these relationships from the first conversation through conversion, working with our sales and industry teams to move opportunities forward.

You'll work closely with teams across Flex, including sales, finance, marketing, operations, and leadership, plus City Managers in other markets. Your city is yours to run, with a team behind you.

What You'll Do

  • Build and own the city’s dream list of 50 owners, prioritizing five North Star accounts and identifying the best path to each.
  • Curate rooms built around the people on your list: Plan and host events that bring the right people together, including intimate dinners, customer gatherings, and strategic brand activations.
  • Develop relationships with prospective customers and guide them from initial conversations through account opening, staying involved as their businesses grow with Flex.
  • Evaluate and negotiate sponsorships and memberships, and only say yes to the ones that put you in front of people on the list.
  • Develop a monthly market plan covering your priority accounts, upcoming initiatives, and progress toward customer acquisition.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to move opportunities forward, generate customer referrals, and share insights from your market.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline, track applications and referrals, coordinate events, and manage your local budget.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: Your 50 are written, your five are picked, your first rooms have happened and you’re in real conversations with your North Star accounts.

First year: Your North Star accounts are on Flex, the customers you brought in are active and spending, and people around the city are sending you introductions without being asked.

Above all, we care about results: accounts closed and how they use Flex once they’re open. Plenty of great customers will come from outside your list, and those count too.

Requirements

  • Strong relationships with your city’s business owners. You could write the dream list this week and say how you know each person on it.
  • A track record in sales or business development, in financial services, private banking, real estate, hospitality, membership clubs, or another relationship-driven business. You’re comfortable asking for the business and closing.
  • A pulse on your city: the restaurant everyone’s talking about this month, the best rooftop, where to take someone for a serious cocktail. People trust your taste.
  • An eye for design: venue, event flow, how a space photographs, and the details, like menu cards and table settings, that make something memorable.
  • The ability to spot the right opportunities, build a strategy to pursue them, and stay organized throughout.
  • A competitive streak, and the judgment to know when bringing in a teammate helps close the deal. You make calls the way the CEO of Flex would, with the company’s interest first.
  • Currently based in Nashville.

Nice to Haves

  • Bilingual skills, which may be preferred or required depending on the market.

Compensation

Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Additional Information

Why Join Us

Build something generational — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners.

Work on real money, real risk — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale.

Solve hard problems — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles.

True ownership — Small teams, high trust, real accountability.

Founder-level exposure — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors.

High bar, high taste — Move fast without cutting corners.

Elite peers — People here are builders, not tourists.

Real upside — Meaningful equity if you help build something big.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.description:
About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

Location:

US-based, Remote East Coast. Candidates in the NYC area have a hybrid option.

The impact you will have

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

  • Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced

  • At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit

What you will be doing

Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day.

Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830.

Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures.

Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger.

Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes.

Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor.

Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start.

Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you.

Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants.

External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves.

What you bring

  • Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists

  • You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it

  • Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor

  • You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger

  • Experience developing a small team or a single direct report

Nice to have

  • Active CPA license

  • Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar

  • Public accounting background, especially audit

  • Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable

  • Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual

  • Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure

jobs.description:
Account Manager – Merchandising, Retail & Auto

About WorkWhile

WorkWhile is on a mission to help workers earn a better living and live better lives. 83 million Americans work hourly jobs, often with unpredictable schedules that pay close to minimum wage and offer limited benefits, leading to financial instability.

WorkWhile identifies the best hourly workers and matches them with shifts that fit their skills, location, and life. Businesses get access to a quality workforce, while workers get stable income and unmatched benefits, including next day pay, free telehealth services, and financial services.

We have the audacious goal to align incentives and solve inefficiencies in the labor market, disrupting the $650 billion staffing and recruiting market. Backed by Khosla Ventures and recognized by the Inc. 5000 for 10x growth, WorkWhile is reshaping the future of work.

Role Summary

WorkWhile is looking for an Account Manager to join our Merchandising, Retail & Auto pod and build long-term, trusting relationships with our clients. This role is focused on managing a portfolio of accounts - from big-box, grocery, and specialty retailers to merchandising and consumer brands and other multi-location operators - ensuring they have the right in-store, reset crew, and distribution center workforce to keep operations running smoothly, especially during peak seasons, resets and remodels, inventory cycles, and high-volume periods.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for your clients, driving satisfaction, retention, and growth while acting as a strategic partner who understands the fast-paced, demand-driven nature of retail and merchandising operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the lead point of contact for all account management matters for your clients, including staffing planning, escalations, and ongoing strategy

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with store operations managers, district managers, merchandising and DC leaders, HR leaders, and other key stakeholders

  • Develop a deep understanding of each client's environment - including seasonal hiring surges, reset and remodel calendars, inventory events, and customer traffic patterns - to proactively meet their workforce needs

  • Maintain and grow client contracts, identifying upsell and expansion opportunities across store locations, distribution centers, regions, or new job categories

  • Develop trusted advisor relationships with key accounts, aligning WorkWhile's solutions to their operational goals and labor challenges

  • Ensure timely and successful fulfillment of shifts and workforce solutions in line with client expectations and SLAs

  • Communicate the progress of weekly, monthly, and quarterly workforce initiatives clearly to both internal teams and client stakeholders

  • Forecast and track key account metrics including fill rates, worker performance, client satisfaction scores, and revenue growth

  • Prepare regular account health reports and business reviews tailored to operations leadership

  • Collaborate with the Sales team to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts and expand WorkWhile's presence across new store locations, banners, or regions

  • Partner with Ops teams to ensure worker supply meets client demand, especially during peak periods (holidays, back-to-school, large reset programs, etc.)

  • Assist with challenging client requests or issue escalations, providing quick and effective resolutions to minimize operational disruption

What You Bring

Modern software demands continuous security validation. Cobalt is pioneering the evolution beyond legacy, point-in-time PTaaS through our Autonomous and Continuous pentesting platform-providing continuous, scalable, and AI-driven security coverage across enterprise environments.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Domino, we build solutions that help the largest, highly regulated organizations adopt AI to accelerate mission-critical use cases. Our platform integrates a streamlined model and app development environment, advanced model, agent, and app hosting capabilities, and novel governance capabilities providing regulator-ready AI at scale. Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for over a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. In the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

Domino's Solutions team is the customer-facing engine behind how leading enterprises build, scale, and govern AI-powered applications - solving real business challenges, not just deploying technology. Solutions Engineering earns technical credibility before the deal closes. Customer Engineering, where this role lives, owns everything after: adoption, implementation, expansion, and the kind of delivery that makes customers renew and grow. Global Support and SRE keeps it all running at the level enterprise customers depend on. Three functions, one relentless motion, and a team that earns its reputation on what it ships, not what it scopes.

What your impact will be

  • Own pre-sales as a function, not a set of individual deals: set and enforce the standards for how opportunities get qualified, how POCs get scoped, and how SEs engage — with a single, consistent bar across the team regardless of which GVP or AE is in the room.
  • Be the check on the sales process: you have the standing and the judgment to push back on a deal, a scope, or a timeline when it doesn't meet the bar — even when that's an uncomfortable conversation with a GVP or a top seller.
  • Coach and develop the SE team: you sit close enough to the opportunities to give real, specific feedback — on technical approach, on deal strategy, on what a customer actually needs — not just process oversight from a distance.
  • Bring enough technical fluency to ask the hard question before the customer or the SE gets there: you don't need to build the model, but you need to know when the architecture, the POC design, or the technical claim doesn't hold up.
  • Partner as a peer with GVPs and account teams: you have the presence and the sales acumen (not just the technical credibility) to shape how a $5M+ enterprise deal is qualified, resourced, and run — and to hold your ground when priorities compete.
  • Build the operating rhythm for pre-sales: capacity allocation, opportunity prioritization, and the recurring cadence that keeps SE time going to the deals that deserve it — and away from the ones that don't.
  • Recruit and build the bench: as the team scales, you're identifying gaps, hiring against them, and building a pre-sales org that can hold its own against enterprise competitors.
  • Be a discerning voice on deal quality: you can tell the difference between a deal worth the team's time and one that isn't, and you say so — with a recommendation, not just a red flag.

What we look for in this role

  • 8+ years in enterprise, solution-selling pre-sales or sales engineering, with direct experience on complex $5M+ deals — you know what real enterprise sales cycles demand.
  • People leadership experience is required: you've built, coached, and managed a technical or pre-sales team, and you know how to develop talent, not just direct it.
  • An operational builder at heart: you define process where none exists, hold people to it, and don't let "how we've always done it" survive contact with a better way.
  • Presence that holds up in the room: you can stand toe-to-toe with a GVP or an enterprise seller and not get steamrolled — this role sets the bar on rigor, and needs someone who can enforce it under pressure.
  • Technically conversant, not technically deep: you understand what's possible and plausible in AI/ML delivery well enough to be respected by the SE team and to catch a shaky technical claim — you're not expected to be the most technical person in the room.
  • Sharp, discerning judgment on opportunity quality: qualification, technical fit, and deal health are things you evaluate critically, not rubber-stamp.
  • No vertical expertise required — your edge is operational and sales rigor, not domain specialization.
  • Comfortable with travel and heavy customer-facing time; East Coast location preferred.

What we value

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply
  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible. At Domino, everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything
  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company

Visa Sponsorship: Visa sponsorship (including H-1B and other employment-based visa categories) may be available for this position depending on business considerations and the role's requirements.
