jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

To enhance our team we are seeking a motivated Sales Development professional to join our Sales Development Representative, Americas team here at Panopto and make a visible difference for our business.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As a Sales Development Representative, you own everything to do with generating new qualified leads for our sales pipeline: strategy, planning, and execution. You will own specific activity targets for qualifying potential customers from both inbound (they contact us) and outbound (we contact them) initiatives. In addition to activity targets, you will explore and recommend creative outbound sales campaigns to drive qualified pipeline.

You'll also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Build Pipeline & Outreach: Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up, outbound cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn messaging.

  • Prospecting & Discovery: Perform effective discovery and qualification calls with prospects. Attend in-person trade shows and exhibitions to represent Panopto.

  • Lead Qualification: Research target accounts, identify key decision-makers (particularly C-Level, VP, and Director personas across HR and IT departments), and generate interest to maintain and expand your database within your assigned territory.

  • Team Collaboration: Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Account Executives for further development and closure, assisting and partnering with them to bring new customers on board.

  • Technology: Master how the Panopto platform is used by our customers to effectively qualify prospects based on their specific needs and requirements.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Complete onboarding, gain deep fluency in the Panopto platform and value proposition, master internal sales tools (Salesforce, Outreach, Lusha/ZoomInfo), and comfortably begin executing daily inbound and outbound prospecting activities.

  • Within 6 Months: Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly activity and qualified lead targets, effectively run discovery calls with key HR/IT stakeholders, and forge strong cross-functional partnerships with regional Account Executives.

  • Within 1 Year: Serve as a reliable engine for regional pipeline growth, contribute novel outbound messaging campaigns, over-achieve quota targets, and begin developing core sales leadership skills for career progression within Panopto.

  • Your Legacy: Establish scalable demand generation frameworks in your territory that expand Panopto's reach and set the benchmark for sales development excellence.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

You’ll join a globally diverse team that thrives on clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

We operate with a bias toward action—balancing strategic thinking with execution—and hold ourselves accountable to outcomes that drive the business forward. The Sales Development team works in close partnership with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Marketing leaders in a tight-knit culture to ensure an exceptional journey for leads from initial outreach to becoming long-term customers. Collaboration is at the core of how we work, and we value diverse perspectives that strengthen our collective thinking.

The Foundation for Success

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience: 1–2 years of experience working in a sales role (any industry) OR completion of a sales/customer-facing internship (preferably in SaaS/Tech or fundraising).

  • Core Sales Competencies: Proven inside sales/sales development experience converting prospects and a track record of meeting/over-achieving targets. Solid experience in opportunity qualification, pre-call planning, and confident phone control.

  • Tools & Systems: Hands-on experience working with Salesforce (or similar CRM), Outreach, and lead enrichment tools (e.g., Lusha, ZoomInfo).

  • Professional Skills: Ability to stay organized, multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

What Sets You Apart

  • Industry Focus: Previous experience in B2B tech/SaaS sales.

  • Persona Experience: Prior success qualifying opportunities involving multi-stakeholder decisions with C-Level, VP, and Director personas in HR and IT.

  • Productivity Tools: High proficiency with web presentation tools and corporate productivity suites.

Join Us

Join Panopto and be part of an exciting journey where your passion for working in a collaborative environment will make a significant impact on our growth trajectory. We're looking for people with excellent communication and listening skills, a genuine interest in what we do, and a fantastic attitude when faced with business challenges.

Compensation

Total Rewards: The salary range for this position is $45,000 - $50,000 USD per year. This position is also eligible for commission earnings per the Sales Commissions Plan with an on-target-earnings of $76,923 USD as part of the compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.

At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Additional Information

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuable Recruiting Tips from our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

jobs.title: Head of Mid Market Sales, Americas
jobs.description:
About Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Bolt, and Notion, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

We have, in just a few years, replaced incumbents Greenhouse and Lever more than 500 times each, clear evidence of strong product-market fit and a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software. Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space.

And the market opportunity is growing. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

To scale Ashby into the hundreds of millions of ARR, we are seeking a senior B2B SaaS sales leader to lead our high performing Mid-Market sales team in AMER. The start date of this role will be Q1. This is currently a second-line leadership role, initially overseeing a team of three managers growing to four in Q2. This strategic leadership role reports directly to our Head of AMER Sales (Leigh Brown). There are three primary responsibilities that this senior sales leader will take on:

  1. Build an Amazing Team. Hire, lead, coach, and develop the North American sales team including Managers and Account Executives.

  2. Execute on the Sales Plan. Be accountable for the region’s revenue and results. Foster programs that ensure high-caliber execution across all segments.

  3. Unlock new Opportunities. Partner with peers in Revenue Operations and Marketing, to expand Ashby’s Serviceable Addressable Market to clear a path to $200M+ in ARR in 2027 through a focus on new verticals and products.

You will have a significant impact in defining our go-to-market strategies to help us achieve our ambitious growth plans. You can read more about our Sales Team here.

If we are even moderately successful, we'll have an incredible growth story to tell in just a few years!

You could be a great fit if:

  • 💼 You’ve been a second line sales leader at a $100M+ high growth SaaS company

  • 🥇 You have a proven track record of hiring high performing Managers and AEs who quickly move the needle. You’re also comfortable making timely performance management decisions.

  • 📊 You have managed a Mid-Market sales-led go-to-market motion (100-1000 FTE).

  • 📈You are well versed in modern pipeline generation practices and programs that ensure sustainable pipeline coverage for substantial YoY growth.

  • 🤝 You’re an expert collaborator who builds relationships internally and can drive change initiatives forward to improve overall operations.

  • 🤓 You connect the dots quickly. You can evaluate the health of the business, and hone in on the most impactful areas to drive performance and bend the growth curve. Your team trusts you to provide practical advice and consultation to navigate challenging or complex issues

  • ⚙️ You are adept at developing sales strategies for multi-product platforms and competitive rip-and-replace deals

You shouldn't apply if:

  • You haven’t managed managers at a high growth SaaS business

  • Your primary focus is the forecast and extracting information from your direct reports. At Ashby, your job is to bend the curve, not just report the numbers.

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points that should give you an idea of what it is like to be a Sales Leader at Ashby:

  • We're highly collaborative and we believe in a team-based sales motion to maximize our win rates on high impact deals

  • We believe in developing subject matter expertise (not just on our product but also the talent acquisition space broadly) which allows us to provide a differentiated buyer experience

  • We continue to make material investments in engineering and product because we know at the end of the day, having the best products makes winning new customers easier

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over decades of experience, and thoughtful & clear communication both internally and with customers. Please read more about our operating principles here.

Interview Process

Our interview process is designed so you can showcase your achievements and points of learning and apply those to a practical exercise. We'll provide you with sample customer calls and pipeline data so you can develop a well informed perspective on our product and the Mid Market segment. You’ll have opportunities to ask questions of our team throughout.

The interview process for this role is four rounds in the following order:

  1. Intro Call (30 min) - You'll meet with Steph Fish, our TA Manager for Sales, to discuss your fit for the role and address questions about our market and solution

  2. Experience Deep Dive (1 hr) - You'll walk Leigh through your leadership experience in some detail to highlight your achievements, and points of learning.

  3. Panel Presentation (1 hr) - We'll provide you with Ashby data and seek your perspective on the business and focus areas. You'll discuss your approach to leadership, hiring and developing managers and sales execution.

  4. Final Round (2.5 hrs) - You'll have a set of four interviews with a range of cross-functional leaders

Benefits

  • You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

  • You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: AI Growth Engineer
jobs.description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

Role Overview

As Cresta’s Growth Engineer, you’ll build the technical surface of how Cresta goes to market. You’ll develop custom AI agents on Cresta’s own platform for marketing use cases, build the interactive experiences and tooling our growth team runs on, and own cresta.com. This position requires strong engineering fundamentals, high agency, and the ability to go deep in an unfamiliar domain quickly. If you are self-driven, AI-native, and eager to own something end to end, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

AI Agent Creation

  • Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents on Cresta’s platform for marketing use cases, working alongside our forward deployed engineering team.
  • Build the agent experiences prospects actually touch — event registration, demo and trial surfaces, and the moments where someone would rather just ask Cresta a question.
  • Take agents from prototype to production, including the evaluation criteria, guardrails, and human review steps prospect-facing work requires.
  • Integrate agents with the systems behind them — CRM, marketing automation, event tooling — so a conversation produces a real downstream action.
  • Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams: identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through what you learn deploying against a real audience.

Growth Experimentation and Tooling

  • Build the surfaces that don’t exist yet: launch microsites, event experiences, embeddable tools. When a campaign needs something the website can’t carry, you build it.
  • Build interactive assets that show what Cresta does instead of describing it: calculators, benchmarks, assessments, and demo experiences built on our own product.

The Website

  • Own how cresta.com is built and maintained on Webflow, including the custom code and tooling layered on top, partnering with the agency that handles a portion of day-to-day build work.
  • Ship the pages, campaign surfaces, and interactive experiences the marketing calendar depends on, working from creative direction set by brand and design.
  • Own the instrumentation where the site meets our GTM stack, in partnership with Marketing Ops: forms, gated content, event tracking, and attribution.
  • Ship the technical work behind our SEO and AEO programs, in partnership with the owners of those programs.

What We’re Looking For

  • 7+ years working in software development, web development, AI/ML engineering, or growth engineering.
  • Strong across the stack — application code, APIs, data, and infrastructure — in Python, TypeScript, Node, or similar.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred.
  • A track record of learning a domain fast and going deep. You’ve been dropped into something unfamiliar and become the person other people come to.
  • High agency. You define your own work, ship without being told what to build, and treat gaps as yours to close.
  • Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
  • Comfortable as the deepest technical voice on a non-engineering team, scoping ambiguous requests and explaining tradeoffs to marketers.
  • Ownership. You treat the outcome as yours, including when something breaks or was built badly before you arrived.

Nice To Have

  • Experience owning a marketing website. Useful context, not a hard requirement.
  • Technical SEO and AEO experience grounded in tests rather than theory.
  • Marketing and GTM systems integration: HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, Segment, GA4, GTM.

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Flexible PTO to take the time you need, when you need it
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Retirement savings plan to help you plan for the future
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • In-office meal program and commuter benefits provided for onsite employees

Compensation at Cresta:

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

Compensation for this position includes a Base Salary + Equity.

Base Salary Range: $160K - $280K + Equity

Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details. In addition, total compensation includes a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

jobs.title: Soho Support Coordinator - Member Services - (Remote - Miami Based & Seasonal)
jobs.description:
The Role…

This is an exciting time to be joining our Soho Support guest service team. We are a global function, supporting members with all their needs, from application enquiries, restaurant reservations, bedroom bookings and Soho Home retail enquiries.

Soho Support Member Services serves as the first point of contact to members looking to visit our Houses in New York and Los Angeles. The role is fast-paced and diverse, tasks can range from booking restaurant reservations to providing membership invoices, discussing private hire opportunities in our houses, and going the extra mile arranging special occasions.

Key responsibilities…

  • Act as a warm, professional, and knowledgeable first point of contact for Soho House members, delivering exceptional service via telephone and email.
  • Respond to all member queries in a timely and efficient manner, consistently meeting or exceeding departmental SLAs and personal performance KPIs.
  • Deliver a proactive, solutions-focused service to a diverse global membership, anticipating needs and enhancing the overall member experience.
  • Manage a variety of requests including membership administration, club and restaurant enquiries, and general support across our Houses in New York and Los Angeles.
  • Take ownership of member queries from initial contact through to resolution, ensuring a seamless and personalised experience.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal teams and support departments to resolve issues and continuously improve service delivery.

What We’re Looking For…

  • Self-motivated and solution driven, with the ability to absorb training materials quickly and demonstrate initiative
  • A natural communicator with a polished and professional telephone manner, alongside excellent written communication skills.
  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive and resourceful, with a strong sense of ownership and the confidence to take initiative in problem-solving.
  • Results-driven, with a clear understanding of working towards and achieving individual and team KPIs.
  • Adaptable, resilient, and motivated, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and progress within the business.

Your experience…

Required

Why work with us...

Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to enhance your career.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Digital Assets
jobs.description:
About the Company

Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.

Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.

About the role

CertiK works with banks, regulators and regulated financial institutions that adopt digital assets. We build regulatory technology for these markets, and we are hiring a solutions consultant to be CertiK's presence with clients across Europe. You will meet with banks, CASPs and regulators, present our products and services, learn their problems, and lead consulting-style engagements to solve them.

This is a forward-deployed role. You work from the client's side of the table, embedded with compliance and risk teams at banks, VASPs and regulators in the Europe and neighbouring markets when an engagement calls for it, owning the relationship on the ground. What you learn there sets the direction for Product and the commercial approach.

What you'll do

  • Spend extended periods on site with compliance, risk and innovation teams at banks, CASPs, custodians and regulators in the Europe and nearby markets

  • Run discovery with clients and prospects: understand their workflows, tools, pain points and regulatory obligations, including the reason behind each request, and document them in the client's own words

  • Bring findings back to Product and Business Development in a form that shapes the roadmap and the sales approach

  • Partner with Business Development in client meetings and regulator conversations: BD owns the commercial relationship, you own the solution and the follow-up on the ground

  • Present CertiK's products and services clearly to senior client teams, and turn pain points into scoped proposals with clear deliverables and timelines

  • Deliver advisory engagements, including licensing readiness reviews, gap analyses, technical due diligence, digital asset strategy assessments, workshops and reports

  • Represent CertiK at industry events and regulator meetings in the region

  • Coordinate with CertiK teams in the US, Europe and Asia across time zones

Requirements

  • 3+ years in a client-facing role such as consulting, solutions or business development, or in a compliance, risk or regulatory role at a financial institution or CASP

  • Experience working with or inside banks, CASPs or other regulated financial institutions, whether in-house or through consulting or advisory engagements; you understand how a compliance or risk function runs day to day

  • Available to be based at client sites for weeks at a time, with regular travel across the Europe and occasional travel beyond it

  • Knowledge of bank regulatory compliance and technology

  • Professional writing and presentation skills: produces client-ready reports and presents them to senior compliance, risk and executive audiences

  • Operates independently: runs a client relationship and an engagement end to end with light supervision

  • Location: Europe. Frequent on-site time with clients across Europe.

Bonus points

  • Knowledge of MiCA, FCA, BaFin, AMF or other European licensing regimes

  • Experience with VASP licensing, regulatory examinations or compliance remediation

  • Experience with compliance, risk or surveillance software

  • Big 4 or financial services consulting background

  • A second European language

  • Existing relationships with compliance, risk or innovation leaders across Europe banks, CASPs or regulators

Compensation

Additional Information

This role must be performed outside the United States. We are unable to consider candidates who will work from within the U.S.

jobs.title: Manager, Sales Operations
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

To enhance our team, we are seeking an experienced Manager, Sales Operations who combines strong people leadership with a passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement. In this role, you will lead the team responsible for supporting our global sales organization throughout the quote-to-close lifecycle, including frontline sales support, deal desk, contracting, and order processing. You’ll play a key role in ensuring efficient day-to-day execution while proactively identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve the seller experience, and drive scalable operational improvements in partnership with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As a Manager, Sales Operations, you will lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for the day-to-day operational support of our sales organization. You'll oversee critical processes spanning sales inquiries, quoting, commercial approvals, contracting, and order processing, ensuring accurate and timely execution while maintaining appropriate commercial controls.

Beyond managing daily operations, you'll serve as a proactive partner to Sales Leadership, Business Systems, Finance, Legal, and Product, identifying operational bottlenecks, evaluating existing workflows, and driving improvements that enable our sales teams to work more effectively. You'll combine a hands-on understanding of sales operations with an analytical, solutions-oriented mindset to help build efficient, scalable processes that support revenue growth.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Operations Managers and Specialists responsible for frontline sales support, deal desk, contracting, and order processing. Establish clear expectations, manage workload distribution, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Oversee daily sales support operations, ensuring timely and effective resolution of sales representative inquiries related to quoting, Salesforce processes, commercial policies, and other operational needs. Establish clear escalation paths and SLAs to ensure consistent, high-quality support.

  • Manage deal desk operations and commercial approval workflows, ensuring adherence to established pricing policies, discounting guidelines, and approval matrices.

  • Partner with Sales Leadership and senior stakeholders to maintain and refine approval processes that balance deal velocity with appropriate governance.

  • Serve as the primary operational escalation point for non-standard commercial terms, discounting approvals, and order processing exceptions, collaborating with Finance, Legal, and Sales leadership.

  • Ensure accurate and timely sales order processing, including validation of executed agreements, opportunity, and order data, and required documentation. Partner with Finance and Accounting to support data flow for accurate invoicing, reporting, and downstream financial processes.

  • Proactively evaluate sales operations workflows, identify recurring bottlenecks, manual processes and sources of friction, and develop actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, accuracy, and the overall seller experience.

  • Establish, track, and maintain operational performance metrics, including request volumes, turnaround times, processing accuracy, and recurring issue trends. Regularly report operational insights, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to Revenue Operations leadership.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and existing technology capabilities to reduce administrative burden, streamline repetitive tasks, and improve the scalability of sales operations.

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures, process documentation, and internal knowledge resources to promote consistency, enable team development, and support efficient onboarding and execution.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement and Sales Leadership to identify recurring knowledge gaps and opportunities for improved training, communication, or self-service resources that reduce unnecessary operational requests and improve sales team effectiveness.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Build strong relationships with your team, Sales Leadership, and cross-functional partners; develop a thorough understanding of existing quote-to-close processes and operational challenges; establish visibility into team performance and workload; and identify initial opportunities to improve efficiency and the seller experience.

  • Within 6 Months:Establish consistent operational performance standards and reporting, implement initial process improvements that address recurring bottlenecks, and strengthen collaboration with Sales Leadership and Business Systems to prioritize and execute workflow enhancements. Demonstrate progress in reducing unnecessary manual effort and improving the consistency and quality of sales support.

  • Within 1 Year: Deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency, processing accuracy, and the seller experience. Establish a proactive, data-informed approach to continuous improvement, with scalable processes, stronger cross-functional workflows, and a team empowered to independently resolve challenges and contribute ideas for improvement.

  • Your Legacy: You built a high-performing Sales Operations team that is recognized not only for delivering reliable, responsive support, but for proactively solving problems and making it easier for the business to operate. You’ve developed a team of confident, capable professionals and established a culture where operational challenges become opportunities for meaningful, lasting improvement.

Values in Action

  • Customer First, Always: You proactively surface friction points in the customer experience before they are escalated — and propose solutions, not just reports.

  • Thrive Together: You share work-in-progress for early feedback, knowing that challenge improves the outcome. You separate critiques of ideas from critiques of people.

  • Elevate the Craft: You hold the bar high on your own work and invest in developing those around you. You treat every project as an opportunity to learn something new.

  • Act with Ownership: You define success by outcomes, not activity. You flag problems early and bring a proposed path forward, not just the problem.

  • Clarity Over Complexity: You default to the simpler solution. Your written communication — internal or external — is direct, specific, and free of filler.

How We Thrive

You’ll join a team that thrives on clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement.

We operate with a bias toward action, balancing strategic thinking with execution, and hold ourselves accountable to outcomes that drive the business forward. Collaboration is at the core of how we work, and we value diverse perspectives that strengthen our collective thinking.

The Foundation for Success

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent practical operational experience.

  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience within Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Deal Desk, or Commercial Operations in a B2B SaaS or technology organization, with at least 1–2 years of direct people management or formal team leadership experience.

  • Demonstrated success leading operational teams, managing competing priorities, coaching and developing employees, and ensuring accurate, timely execution of critical business processes.

  • Proven ability to identify operational inefficiencies, analyze root causes, and implement process improvements that enhance productivity, accuracy, and scalability.

  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce CRM, including opportunity management, quoting workflows, approval processes, reporting, and data management. Experience working with CPQ solutions and related sales technologies.

  • Strong understanding of the quote-to-close lifecycle, including sales support, commercial approvals, contracting, order processing, and cross-functional handoffs to Finance and Accounting.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate operational challenges into actionable recommendations and collaborate effectively across teams.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience partnering with Business Systems or IT teams to design and implement Salesforce enhancements, workflow automation, or other operational technology improvements.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional process improvement initiatives across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Product, Customer Success, and Legal, from identifying opportunities through implementation and measuring outcomes.

  • Experience developing operational KPIs, capacity planning models, or dashboards to improve team performance and inform operational decisions.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled productivity tools, ticketing platforms, or business intelligence solutions used to streamline operational workflows.

  • Prior success improving or scaling sales operations processes and teams in a growing B2B SaaS organization.

Join Us

Join Panopto and play a key role in building the operational backbone that powers our global sales organization. If you take pride in mentoring early-career talent, streamlining complex sales workflows, removing roadblocks for sales reps, and driving measurable operational efficiency, you will feel right at home here.

Total Rewards

The salary range for this position is $115,000 - $125,000 USD per year. This position is also eligible for a bonus as part of the compensation package.

Base pay offered may vary depending on various factors, including, but not limited to: job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and other eligibility factors such as geographic location. The Total Rewards package includes competitive base pay and an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs such as health insurance, flexible spending accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. At Panopto, we know that great people make an organization great. We value our people and offer employees benefits that are market competitive for our industry. Learn more about what working at Panopto can mean for you.

At Panopto, our commitment to pay equity and transparency is unwavering. We do not engage in salary negotiations beyond the established range to maintain fairness and prevent potential pay disparities among team members based on negotiation strategies.

Compensation

Additional Information

Beyond the Requirements: At this point, we hope you're feeling excited about the job description you’re reading. Even if you don't feel that you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply. We're eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways - not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want people to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work here.

Recruiting Tips: From crafting an impressive resume to presenting your best self during our interviews, we're dedicated to ensuring you feel well-prepared and self-assured as you embark on opportunities at Panopto. Discover some valuable Recruiting Tips from our team.

The standard interview process at Panopto involves several steps, outlined below, to ensure we approach the process thoughtfully and consistently:

Application Review -> Recruiter Call -> Video Interview & Assessment -> Hiring Manager Call -> Interview Loop -> Debrief -> Offer

Our people and culture

Panopto’s mission is to be the leader in visual and audio-based learning in a capture and post-capture world. Our user base is as diverse as the world’s universities and businesses. Panopto’s commitment to fostering a fair, equitable, and inclusive culture empowers each member of our team to express their authentic selves, contribute their distinct perspectives and make a meaningful impact both individually and collectively. This inclusive environment not only encourages creativity and the free exchange of ideas but also harnesses the power of varied viewpoints. As a result, we are better equipped to tackle our most intricate challenges, leveraging the wealth of different experiences and backgrounds within our team. This collaborative spirit empowers us to challenge ideas (not people) recognizing that our shared success relies on collective wisdom. It drives us to continuously improve and innovate, ultimately elevating the quality of our products and services. It’s what sets Panopto apart as a unique and rewarding place to work.

Our purpose

We believe that video can have a transformative effect on learning. So we built a video knowledge management platform that helps businesses and universities improve the way that they train, teach, and share knowledge. Since 2007, we have been a pioneer in video capture software, video management, and inside-video-search technology. Panopto has been adopted by more than 1,600 companies and universities worldwide with over 11 million end users. Today, Panopto’s knowledge management platform is the largest repository of expert learning videos in the world. A proud remote-first company, Panopto is headquartered in Pittsburgh, with offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Sydney, and has received industry recognition for its innovation, rapid growth, and company culture.

Panopto is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We value and encourage diversity and solicit applications from all qualified individuals which will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected criteria, in accordance with applicable law. Panopto is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. If you require accommodation for interviewing or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please provide more detail on how we can further support you by reaching out to the Employee Experience department.

Remote, US: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely.

Remote, International: Candidates looking for flexible or remote-friendly positions are encouraged to apply. Panopto is proud to be a remote-first company. Employees in this position are eligible to work remotely. Still, they may make regular trips to the local international office from time to time, where applicable.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager - Revenue
jobs.description:
Are you a proactive accounting leader who thrives at the intersection of complex financial data, healthcare reimbursement, and internal controls? Luna Care is seeking a Revenue Accounting & Controls Manager to take full ownership of our healthcare services revenue reporting, accounts receivable valuation, and outsourced RCM financial oversight. If you love digging into the details, plugging revenue leakage, and driving scalable automated reporting from the ground up, we want to hear from you.

How you will have an impact

  • Drive Revenue Integrity & Close Excellence: Lead the monthly revenue close under ASC 606, managing journal entries, accruals, reserves, and reconciliations to deliver audit-ready, institutional-grade financials.

  • Oversee Strategic Vendor Governance: Act as the independent financial checkpoint for our outsourced RCM partner—enforcing SLAs, monitoring performance metrics (denials, clean-claim rates, NCR), and holding vendors accountable to corrective actions.

  • Plug Revenue Leakage & Protect Cash: Investigate billing trends and identify reimbursement shortfalls, unbilled services, and missed authorizations, collaborating cross-functionally to recover yield and improve cash conversion.

  • Modernize Financial Architecture: Lead NetSuite and RCM system integration enhancements, automating reconciliations, exception reporting, and controls to eliminate manual workflows.

  • Provide Actionable Commercial Intelligence: Analyze revenue per visit, market trends, and payer mix to guide budgeting, executive forecasting, and pricing strategies.

    What You Will Do

    • Reconcile completed patient visits, billable services, claims, cash postings, and unapplied cash between RCM subledgers and NetSuite.

    • Oversee AR valuation, aging schedules, collectability, implicit price concessions, contractual allowances, and bad debt reserves by payer and market.

    • Establish and maintain internal controls, write-off approvals, and segregation of duties across revenue operations.

    • Validate claim-level data against financial statements to ensure accurate payment posting, aged AR management, and timely collections.

    • Partner with Operations, Finance, and Tech teams to design automated dashboards and eliminate recurring operational bottlenecks.

    • What Luna can do for you

    • Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision) for you and your family on the first of the month following your start date.
    • Flexible PTO and paid holidays to recharge and care for what matters most.
    • 401(k) with company match to invest in your future.
    • Wellness benefits, paid life insurance, and more!
    • Remote-first flexibility with opportunities to connect in person at company gatherings.
    • A culture built on trust, purpose, and belonging—where every voice matters.

    What you can do for Luna

    Required Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

    • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience with a strong foundation in revenue recognition (ASC 606), accounts receivable valuation, and internal controls.

    • Deep knowledge of healthcare reimbursement models, insurance claims workflows, and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).

    • Advanced Microsoft Excel capabilities and solid experience navigating modern ERP environments.

    • Proven ability to analyze complex billing subledgers, reconcile massive datasets, and communicate financial insights across business units.

      • Strongly Preferred Qualifications:

      • Active CPA license.

      • Hands-on NetSuite implementation or systems integration experience.

      • Prior experience in outpatient healthcare, physical therapy, or multi-site clinic operations.

      • Experience managing outsourced RCM vendor SLAs, remediation plans, and vendor audits.

      • Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI or SQL.

    Compensation

    Salary is commensurate with experience and the location where you will be working.

    Additional Information

    Physical therapy, delivered.

jobs.title: Senior Paid Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Hi 👋 I'm Harriet, and I lead Marketing at Ashby.

We've built a business with 5,500+ customers, a highly differentiated product, and a brand that people genuinely care about. We've invested in content, customer stories, community, and the foundations of a strong marketing program. Now, we have an opportunity to build a much bigger paid engine to support our next stage of growth.

We're looking for a Senior Paid Marketing Manager to build it.

You'll take ownership of our existing LinkedIn program and expand across Meta, Google Search, YouTube, and other channels. You'll have meaningful budget, strong creative and technical partners, and the autonomy to build a program that creates qualified pipeline and strengthens our brand.

This is a hands-on role. We want someone who knows their channels inside out, enjoys getting into the details, and can take a campaign from initial hypothesis through execution, analysis, and optimization. You'll have access to specialist support when it makes sense, but you'll be the person driving the work.

We also believe AI creates an opportunity for exceptional individual contributors to do work that previously required much larger teams. We're looking for someone who is already exploring that opportunity and wants to push it further.

What makes this role interesting

You get to build with the resources most marketers wish they had.

Paid is relatively underdeveloped at Ashby compared with the scale of our business. You get to build something substantial without unwinding years of accumulated complexity or fighting for the resources to make it work. We have strong content, customer proof, product differentiation, and an established brand. You'll start with a monthly budget in the hundreds of thousands of dollars and the support of our design, web, and RevOps teams.

You can rethink how paid marketing gets done.

We want to enable exceptional individual contributors to accomplish more through AI, automation, and better workflows. You'll have the freedom to experiment with new tools, build systems that improve your output, and challenge established ways of working.

You'll build a program that makes the brand and business stronger.

We believe great paid marketing combines analytical rigor with creative judgment. You'll optimize for pipeline and efficiency while building campaigns that earn attention, communicate our differentiation, and give the right buyers a reason to care about Ashby. We don't want a lead-generation machine that makes our brand worse.

What you'll own

Build and scale our paid program. Own strategy and execution across LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Search, expanding into YouTube and other channels as opportunities emerge. Prioritize audiences, develop campaign hypotheses, manage budgets, and turn promising experiments into repeatable sources of qualified pipeline.

Drive creative strategy and experimentation. Develop campaign concepts, write ad copy, brief creative, and shape landing-page tests. Work closely with design, content, and product marketing to produce distinctive work. Build a disciplined testing cadence across audiences, creative, offers, and conversion paths, knowing when to scale, iterate, or stop.

Use AI to increase your impact. Build practical workflows using AI, agents, and automation to improve research, creative iteration, campaign operations, and analysis. We want someone who actively experiments with new approaches, evaluates their effectiveness, and turns what works into repeatable systems.

Own measurement and performance. Drive our approach to paid measurement in partnership with RevOps. Establish the signals and reporting needed to understand qualified reach, conversion, pipeline contribution, and efficiency. Develop better ways to assess incrementality, make informed decisions with imperfect attribution, and translate performance data into clear investment recommendations.

Connect campaigns to the buyer journey. Partner with sales, lifecycle, and ABM to understand what makes an opportunity valuable and how paid can influence the journey from first touch through pipeline. Adapt messaging and investment to our customer segments and markets.

What you'll work on in your first six months

  • Take ownership of LinkedIn, identifying opportunities to improve qualified reach, creative, and progression into pipeline.

  • Build and scale Meta, establishing a strong creative testing cadence and the landing pages and follow-up needed to make the channel work.

  • Expand Google Search and launch YouTube, evaluating additional channels where there's a compelling audience and learning opportunity.

  • Establish a stronger operating system for paid, including AI-enabled workflows, measurement, and a clear approach to allocating investment.

The goal isn't to scale every channel equally. It's to build a broad set of opportunities, learn quickly, and concentrate investment where the evidence is strongest.

What we're looking for

We care more about what you've built and how you think than the number of years you've spent in marketing.

  • You're a domain expert in paid media. You have deep, hands-on expertise in LinkedIn, Meta, and Google Ads. You understand the platforms, know how to structure and optimize campaigns, and can explain how your decisions have influenced qualified pipeline. You've personally built and scaled programs in sales-led B2B SaaS.

  • You're a builder, not just a strategist. You're excited to get into the accounts, develop the creative, run experiments, investigate performance, and solve problems yourself. You know when external expertise can help, but you don't need an agency to do the core work.

  • You combine analytical rigor with creative taste. You understand performance metrics and experimentation, but you also know what makes advertising compelling. You can connect campaign decisions to buyer quality and pipeline without losing sight of the brand you're building.

  • You're already changing how you work with AI. You can demonstrate how you've used AI tools, agents, or automation to improve your output. You think critically about where automation helps, how to evaluate its results, and how to turn useful experiments into repeatable workflows.

  • You take ownership of measurement. You can work with CRM data, establish useful performance reporting, investigate attribution limitations, and drive better measurement approaches rather than waiting for someone else to provide the answers. You own budgeting and explain the case for reallocating investment.

  • You're a strong cross-functional partner. You work well with sales, design, content, product marketing, and RevOps. You seek out context, share what you learn, and care about the overall customer experience rather than optimizing your own channel in isolation.

Experience with YouTube, display, and programmatic is valuable, as is familiarity with HubSpot and measurement platforms like Dreamdata. You don't need to have mastered every channel, but you should have the expertise and judgment to expand beyond your core strengths.

This isn't the right role for you if

  • You prefer managing agencies to building campaigns. You want to set the strategy and have other people execute it, rather than getting into the details yourself.

  • You measure success primarily through platform metrics. You're satisfied with lower CPCs or more leads without understanding whether you're reaching the right buyers or contributing to pipeline.

  • You treat brand and performance as separate disciplines. You optimize individual campaigns without considering how the work shapes a prospect's perception of Ashby or contributes to long-term demand.

  • You haven't meaningfully changed how you work with AI. You're interested in the topic but haven't experimented with workflows, tools, or automation that improve your output.

  • You rely on other people to supply the ideas. You need a content team to hand you finished assets, a creative team to develop every concept, or an agency to tell you what to test next.

  • You prefer a proven playbook to an open-ended problem. You'd rather repeat an established formula than question assumptions, explore new opportunities, and work out what makes sense for this business.

  • You optimize your channel at the expense of the bigger picture. You don't enjoy collaborating with other teams or taking responsibility for the experience beyond the ad click.

We want someone who takes real pride in their craft, is generous with their expertise, and is excited to build something that the whole team can be proud of.

The tools you'll work with

Our core stack includes LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, HubSpot, and Dreamdata, alongside AI-assisted tools for research, creative development, analysis, and automation.

You'll also have access to design, web, and RevOps support, as well as specialist external partners when they can add meaningful value.

You don't need experience with every tool. You do need to be comfortable evaluating new ones, building useful workflows, and working independently with performance data.

A little about working at Ashby

We're building software that helps recruiting teams do some of their most important work better. We care deeply about the quality of our product, the experience we create for customers, and the company we're building along the way.

We value thoughtful, ambitious people who take ownership, communicate clearly, and keep improving. We give people meaningful responsibility and expect them to exercise good judgment in how they use it.

We're deliberate about how we work. We believe strong teams can accomplish a lot without unnecessary process, layers of management, or endless meetings. We make time for considered thinking, direct feedback, and the kind of collaboration that makes the work better.

If that sounds like an environment where you'd do your best work, we'd love to hear from you.

Interview Plan

Our interview process is:

  • 30 minutes intro call with Michelle (Recruiter Screen)

  • 45 minutes interview with Harriet (Hiring Manager)

  • 45 minutes interview with Sam (Paid Marketing Consultant)

  • Take-Home Assignment

    • Live Debrief to follow with Harriet and Sam

  • Final panel (1-1.5 hours)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • Opportunity to work with a talented and passionate team.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅.

  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

  • If you’re in the US, top-notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us and a 401k match.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
