jobs.title: Digital Success Engineer
jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

What you'll do at Jamf

The Digital Success Engineer builds the automation, tooling, and integrations that power Jamf’s digital customer success motion — the agents, agentic workflows, and connected systems that deliver proactive, one-to-many engagement at scale. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Programs, the role partners with the Digital Success Strategy Manager, who owns the strategy and requirements for the motion, turning that vision into working, maintained technology that reaches customers and drives adoption.

What you can expect to do in this role:

  • Builds and maintains the automation, tooling, and integrations behind the digital customer success motion, including agentic workflows, in-app guidance, and the connectors that tie them to systems such as Snowflake, Salesforce, Gainsight, and Slack.
  • Turns the strategy and requirements set by the Digital Success Strategy Manager into working technology including scoping, building, testing, and shipping the components that deliver the engagement model.
  • Monitors, troubleshoots, and improves the digital-success tooling in production, including fixing issues, versioning changes, and keeping the motion running reliably.
  • Implements the logic that targets and personalizes engagement — translating adoption, health, and usage signals into the triggers and flows that drive proactive outreach.
  • Applies AI-assisted and modern development tooling — agent and prompt engineering, version control, and connector-based (MCP) workflows — evaluating outputs for accuracy before they reach customers.
  • Builds in the guardrails for automated customer-facing communication — draft-first review, human approval where needed, and controls that keep the motion safe to run at scale — consistent with the governance set for the motion.
  • Partners with the Customer Success Analytics Engineer and data teams on the data, definitions, and pipelines the tooling depends on.
  • Documents and packages what is built so it can be maintained, reused, and handed off.
  • Works with general autonomy on how to build, taking direction from the Digital Success Strategy Manager on what to build and in what priority, and escalating cross-functional or technical decisions as needed.
  • Evaluates emerging AI tools, models, and platforms, and recommends adoption where they meaningfully improve the reliability, speed, or reach of the digital customer success motion.

What we are looking for:

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Engineer

Role Overview:

As an AI Engineer at Particle41 you will design, develop and deploy machine-learning and deep-learning models/solutions (including generative-AI) that address complex business problems. You will collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, software engineers and client stakeholders. You will also build scalable pipelines, ensure production readiness, monitor performance and iterate proactively.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Lead end-to-end development of AI/ML models: from data ingestion & preprocessing to model training, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
  • Build generative-AI solutions (RAG, Agentic Workflows, MCP Servers, Conversation AI Agents) aligned with business goals.
  • Work closely with data engineering teams to build/maintain data pipelines, feature stores and orchestration frameworks.
  • Develop and integrate AI models into production systems (APIs, microservices, cloud deployments).
  • Optimize models/solutions for performance, scalability, robustness and cost-efficiency.
  • Monitor models/ solutions’ performance in production (drift, bias, fairness, reliability) and implement remediation.
  • Document model design, experiments, data provenance and solution rationale.
  • Stay abreast of latest AI/ML research, frameworks, tools (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, MCP Clients/Servers, Agents SDKs, LiveKit etc.) and propose innovative ideas.
  • Work directly with clients to understand problem statements, translate business requirements into AI solutions, and clearly communicate results.

Skills and Experience We Value:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML model development and deployment.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and experience with major ML/AI frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, LangGraph).
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS), RAG and Agentic workflows.
  • Experience building or fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs).
  • Experience deploying models into production: building REST APIs, microservices and monitoring.
  • Familiarity with Text-to-Speech and Speech-to-Text models/solutions like Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Cartesia etc.
  • Experience in computer vision, time-series modelling (ARIMA, Prophet) or multimodal AI.
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and frameworks (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker).
  • Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, statistics, and machine-learning fundamentals (classification, regression, clustering, deep learning, sequence models).
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Publications, open-source contributions, or personal projects in the AI/ML domain

jobs.title: Global Alliance Lead, Capgemini
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the role

The Global Alliance Lead is one of the most strategically important roles in our Ecosystem. You will own our relationship with one of the world's leading technology and transformation partners end-to-end — from C-suite engagement through to practitioner enablement and joint pipeline creation. You will be the architect of how the GSI and NewCo go to market together, ensuring our platform becomes the trusted data foundation inside the GSI’s agentic AI delivery practice globally.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Global Head of GSI Relationships. You will orchestrate across sales, partner solution architecture, marketing, and partner operations — bringing the full weight of the organisation to bear on one of our highest-leverage commercial relationships.

What You'll Do

Relationship strategy and executive engagement

  • Own the global GSI relationship at partner and C-suite level, building trusted relationships with Capgemini, practice and delivery team leads.
  • Define and execute a multi-year joint strategy that positions dbt + Fivetran as the default open data infrastructure layer within the GSI’s enterprise AI and agentic workflow delivery
  • Represent NewCo at GSI’s internal forums, client briefings, and industry events — articulating a compelling narrative around open data infrastructure and its relevance to the GSI’s strategy.

Platform integration and practitioner adoption

  • Drive adoption of the dbt + Fivetran platform within GSI delivery teams — ensuring practitioners, solution architects and practice leads are certified, confident, and actively recommending the platform in client engagements
  • Work with GSI's practice leadership to embed NewCo's platform into their business groups, standard delivery architectures, RFP responses and client proposals — with particular focus on GSI's Data & AI practices

Enablement and go-to-market

  • Design and execute a frictionless enablement programme for GSI practitioners globally — certifications, reference architectures, use case playbooks, and joint delivery assets
  • Partner with GSI's marketing and alliances teams to develop joint go-to-market campaigns anchored to open data infrastructure, trusted AI delivery, and closing the gap between AI POC and production
  • Support GSI in building and positioning client-facing agentic AI value accelerators — with NewCo platform as the foundational data layer — the "NewCo inside" model

Pipeline and opportunity development

  • Source and develop new pipeline opportunities through the GSI relationship — identifying client situations where open data infrastructure creates measurable value.
  • Drive co-sell motions alongside GSI account teams, ensuring NewCo is present and influential at the point of client opportunity
  • Maintain a rigorous view of GSI-engaged pipeline — tracking opportunity sourcing, progression, and closed business attributed to the alliance

Telemetry and performance

  • Define and track the signals that indicate a healthy, high-performing GSI relationship: certifications, sourced opportunities, platform deployments, practitioner engagement, and joint wins
  • Report regularly to the Global Head of GSI Relationships on alliance health, pipeline contribution, and strategic progress
  • Identify risks and gaps in the relationship early and mobilise internal resources to address them

What you will bring

  • 15+ years of experience in strategic alliances, enterprise sales, or partner management within the data, cloud, or enterprise software industry
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, global relationships with major consulting firms or global system integrators at a senior level
  • Deep understanding of the modern data stack and the business value of open data infrastructure — dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent experience strongly preferred
  • Ability to engage credibly at C-suite and partner level within a global consulting organisation — understanding how GSIs make decisions, build practices, and go to market
  • Strong commercial instincts — able to identify, thoroughly qualify and develop joint pipeline opportunities, not just manage existing relationships
  • Track record of operating as a cross-functional orchestrator — influencing without direct authority across sales, engineering, marketing, and operations
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills — able to translate technical platform capabilities into compelling business narratives for consulting and enterprise audiences
  • Familiarity with AI, agentic workflows, and the data governance landscape is a strong advantage + strong knowledge of GSI's operating model and contacts within.
  • Willingness to travel globally to engage GSI leadership and teams across regions

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • A clearly defined joint strategy with GSI signed off at partner Executive level and on track to primary Global Strategic Practice.
  • Material increase in GSI practitioner certifications and active platform deployments across Data & AI and Insights & Data practices
  • GSI-sourced pipeline contributing measurably to NewCo's revenue
  • At least two joint go-to-market campaigns live in the market delivering pipeline — anchored to GSI's agentic AI and trusted data agenda
  • First client-facing agentic value accelerators built on NewCo platform delivered with GSI — positioning NewCo as the trusted data infrastructure inside GSI's AI delivery
  • A telemetry framework in place tracking alliance health and pipeline influence

Why This Role

This is a rare opportunity to own a marquee relationship at a defining moment for both companies. GSI’s are publicly committing to capturing the full value of the agentic AI revolution for customers — and the merged dbt + Fivetran platform is the trusted data infrastructure that makes AI production-ready. The person who builds this alliance well will sit at the intersection of the two most important forces in enterprise technology right now: the scale of a global systems integrator and the open infrastructure that makes AI trustworthy enough to deploy at scale.

This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings.

Perks and Benefits

  • Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.

About Doximity

Doximity is the leading clinical AI company with the largest network of U.S. clinicians. Doximity’s AI-powered workflow platform is trusted by over 85% of U.S. physicians and 300+ health systems. Doximity's mission is to help clinicians be more productive so they can provide better care for their patients.

At Doximity, we value curiosity, ownership, inclusion, and a commitment to making a meaningful impact. If you're excited about solving complex problems that improve healthcare, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

Doximity is seeking a Manager, Commercial Insights and Strategy to help scale and elevate our Marketing Strategy & Insights function. This highly client-facing leader will partner closely with senior leadership to drive data-informed marketing strategy, unlock growth opportunities across our pharma business, and strengthen our analytics capabilities.

jobs.title: Mission Director - USASOC (FedS059)
jobs.description:
This position offers a base salary of $145,000 - $185,000. (Total on-target earnings of $290,000 to $370,000)

Role Description:

The Mission Director is a quota-carrying, full-lifecycle business owner responsible for identifying, shaping, closing, and executing new business within the US Army Special Operations Command (USASOC) ecosystem.

You will build trusted relationships with Mission Heroes (our customers), identify meaningful problems, shape solutions using Defense Unicorns products, and lead opportunities from initial discovery through contract award. Once awarded, you will remain accountable for the contract throughout its lifecycle, including cost, schedule, performance, staffing, margin, and customer satisfaction.

This role is designed for someone who wants broad ownership. As the portfolio grows in size and complexity, Mission Directors will increasingly lead through program managers and delivery leaders while retaining accountability for portfolio outcomes.

Responsibilities:

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

1. Build the Business

  • Identify and develop net-new USASOC opportunities and build trusted relationships with Mission Heroes and key stakeholders.
  • Own a quota and grow a diversified portfolio of business.

2. Shape and Close Opportunities

  • Define customer problems, scope, and desired outcomes to shape solutions using Defense Unicorns products and the right acquisition approach.
  • Lead opportunities through proposal, negotiation, and contract award.

3. Own Contract Execution

  • Serve as the program leader for new contracts you close, with direct responsibility for execution until the portfolio reaches the scale where additional program management support is warranted.
  • Manage delivery risks, scope changes, and mission outcomes.

4. Build and Lead the Team

  • Define and build the team required to execute each contract. Personally lead contract execution and, as the portfolio grows, lead program managers and other delivery leaders across the portfolio.

5. Grow the Portfolio

  • Maintain an active pipeline and continue developing new opportunities while executing existing contracts by identifying follow-on work, expansions, and adjacent opportunities.
  • Own customer retention, portfolio growth, and gross margin.
  • Grow from individual contract ownership into a broader portfolio leadership role.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • Experience within the USASOC community, or a closely related defense environment.
  • Strong understanding of the culture, mission, stakeholders, and terminology within the domain you support.
  • Experience in one or more of the following: military operations, government program management, acquisition, contracting, business development, or defense industry program leadership.
  • Working knowledge of federal acquisition, including contract vehicles, acquisition strategies, and contract negotiations.
  • Strong commercial judgment and comfort owning revenue-generating activities.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and hold accountability for outcomes.
  • Willingness to operate across business development, contracting, staffing, and execution, personally driving critical work while building and leading the teams required to scale.
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity, identifying opportunities, and creating a path forward without a predefined playbook.
  • Technical fluency sufficient to understand and communicate Defense Unicorns products, cloud-native technologies, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and modern software delivery concepts.

Candidates located near major USASOC hubs are preferred.

Ability to travel approximately 25-40%.

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, App o11y | UK | Remote
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in the UK.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

What makes you a great fit:

  • A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management
  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
  • Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
  • A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, application instrumentation, SDKs, and telemetry collectors
  • Experience with distributed tracing or continuous profiling systems, such as Grafana Tempo or Grafana Pyroscope
  • Experience with eBPF and/or automatic instrumentation
  • Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
  • Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings
  • Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 94,508 - 113,410. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

  • A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management
  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
  • Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
  • A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

  • Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings
  • Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Ireland.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

What makes you a great fit:

  • A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management
  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
  • Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
  • A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, application instrumentation, SDKs, and telemetry collectors
  • Experience with distributed tracing or continuous profiling systems, such as Grafana Tempo or Grafana Pyroscope
  • Experience with eBPF and/or automatic instrumentation
  • Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
  • Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings
  • Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 107,120 - 128,544. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.

  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. jobs.title: Cloud Engineer
jobs.candidate_required_location: Anywhere in the World, North Carolina
jobs.description:
Headquarters: US
URL: https://knack.com

Location: US Based (Full-Time, Remote) or International Contractor (Full-Time, Remote)

If US-Based:
This will be a remote position based in the United States. Knack offers a complete benefits package to those working in the United States. Employees must be available during standard US business hours and maintain their primary work location within the US. Any extended time working outside the United States requires prior written approval.

International Contractor:
This is a full-time, remote position, but candidates must have four hours overlap with Eastern timezone.

Role Overview

Knack runs thousands of customer applications across multiple global regions, including dedicated private environments. As a Cloud Engineer, you’ll own and evolve that infrastructure, harden it to meet SOC 2, HIPAA, and customer security requirements, and build the infrastructure behind our growing AI capabilities.

We’re an AI-forward team. You don’t need to type every Terraform block, but you do need to understand what’s happening, direct AI tools well, verify their work, and own the outcome. This role includes a weekly 24/7 on-call rotation.

About Knack

Knack is an AI-powered no-code software development platform enabling organizations to manage, analyze, and share business data. The no-code market is growing at over 30% annually and projected to be almost $200B by 2030. Founded in 2010, Knack has grown into a leading player in the no-code movement, enabling businesses, teams, and individuals to build custom applications without writing a single line of code.

Serving a wide range of industries, from healthcare and education to finance and nonprofits, and organizations from small businesses to Fortune 500s, Knack enables users to boost data visibility and streamline operations.

To date, the platform has powered 400,000 apps and stored more than 5 billion data records for over 15,000 customers. Its enterprise-grade functionality includes an AI-powered visual builder, robust data structures, user access controls, and automation capabilities, all delivered by a fully remote team committed to trust, continuous improvement, and measurable impact.

 

Key Responsibilities

Run AWS infrastructure as code, with AI in the loop

  • Manage AWS infrastructure through Terraform using our pull-request-based GitOps workflow, and resolve configuration drift across regions.
  • Use AI tools to draft, review, and explain Terraform changes, then verify every plan before it merges. You own every change you approve, regardless of who or what wrote it.
  • Maintain reusable modules and the standards that make AI-generated changes safe and consistent.

Make AWS and Claude work together

  • Help design and operate how AI assistants work with our AWS environments, for investigation, analysis, incident triage, and infrastructure changes.
  • Define the IAM roles, permission boundaries, logging, and approval gates that govern what AI tools can see and do.
  • Evaluate AI access for blast radius and auditability.

Implement security controls with our security lead

  • Enforce encryption at rest and TLS in transit, tighten IAM and S3 permissions, manage WAF rules and security headers, and rotate secrets.
  • Drive pentest and audit findings to verified fixes in every environment.
  • Secure the AI tooling itself, including agent credentials, secrets handling, MCP server exposure, and prompt injection risk.

Support compliance and audits

  • Configure and maintain SOC 2 and HIPAA controls such as log retention, alarms, VPC flow logs, and backups.
  • Ensure AI-assisted changes keep the same review, approval, and audit trail as any other change.
  • Gather audit evidence and help maintain security tooling.

Build monitoring, alerting, and runbooks

  • Create dashboards and monitors that catch issues before customers do, and tune noisy alerts.
  • Keep runbooks current and written so that both people and AI assistants can follow them.

Keep systems patched and current

  • Lead OS upgrades, runtime and end-of-life migrations, dependency updates, and certificate renewals.

Operate and scale databases and customer environments

  • Tune, resize, and secure databases on multiple platforms.
  • Provision or decommission dedicated customer servers for Sales and Support.

Resolve escalations and automate repeat work

  • Troubleshoot production issues for Support, Sales, and Engineering.
  • Replace recurring manual tasks with automation, CI/CD improvements, or self-service tooling, using AI to move faster while verifying what it produces.

Participate in on-call

  • Participate in our weekly 24/7 on-call rotation, responding to production alerts and following up with fixes or runbook updates so the same issue does not repeat.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 3-5 years in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, including 2+ years working in AWS production environments. Looking for someone who has experience shipping infrastructure changes through code review. Depth matters more than the number.
  • Experience operating a multi-tenant SaaS platform at scale, including participating in a 24/7 on-call rotation.
  • A degree is not required. Demonstrated hands-on experience counts equally.

Technical depth

  • Deep AWS knowledge across compute, networking, and security services, such as EC2, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, and RDS.
  • Strong Terraform understanding, including module design, state management, and pull-request-based CI/CD workflows. You can read a plan and explain what will be created, changed, or destroyed, and where the risk is.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals: least-privilege IAM, encryption in transit and at rest, network security groups and WAFs, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring and logging tools and building actionable alerts.
  • Experience administering relational and NoSQL databases in production.
  • Solid Linux and container (Docker) fundamentals.
  • Able to read and reason about code and scripts in Python, Go, Bash, or Node.js/TypeScript, including large JavaScript/TypeScript codebases when tracing infrastructure-related bugs. You do not need to write them from scratch.

How you work with AI

  • Daily, practical use of AI tools like Claude, with the judgment to critically review AI-generated scripts, Terraform, and IAM policies, and accountability for everything you ship.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, or ISO 27001, including evidence collection and control implementation.
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud or other regulated or isolated environments.
  • A security certification or equivalent depth, such as AWS Certified Security - Specialty, CompTIA Security+, or CCSP, or experience with SIEM, intrusion detection, or threat modeling.
  • Experience running AI/LLM infrastructure, such as Amazon Bedrock, LLM gateways, vector databases, or MCP servers.
  • Experience governing AI agent access to cloud environments, including scoped IAM roles, session logging, and approval workflows.
  • Familiarity with GitOps tooling for Terraform and CI/CD platforms such as CircleCI, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodeBuild.
  • Experience with data warehouses and pipelines (for example, Redshift and ETL tooling).
  • Kubernetes/EKS experience.
  • Experience at a small or early-stage company where you wore many hats.

 

Interviews will be recorded and transcribed by an AI notetaking tool so our team can focus on the conversation and review it accurately later. Notes are used only for evaluating your application. You can opt out at any time by letting your recruiter know.

 

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/knack-cloud-engineer-1

About the Client

Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact.

Recognized consistently as a top workplace, it combines deep industry expertise with a collaborative, innovative culture. Its centralized European hub plays a key role in supporting operations across the EMEA region, ensuring excellence and efficiency at scale.

Â 

About the Project & Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions.

The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data.

The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework, including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management.

  • Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations.

  • Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture.

  • Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution.

  • Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs.

  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Core Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering.

  • Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK.

  • Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations.

  • Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs.

  • Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar).

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain, particularly migration between frameworks.

  • Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis.

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains.

  • Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production.

  • Familiarity with React and FastAPI.

Interview Process

  1. Interview with GT Recruiter

  2. Cultural Fit Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Interview

  5. Offer

Why Join Our Client?

  • Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems.

  • Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform.

  • Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential.

  • Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.

jobs.description:

Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis

  • Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes.
  • Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements.
  • Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
  • Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
  • Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.

System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis

  • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
  • Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
  • Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
  • Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
  • Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
  • Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.

Requirements Authoring

  • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
  • Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
  • Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
  • Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.

Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance

  • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
  • Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.
  • Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins.
  • Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements.
  • Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.

Ticket Creation & Scoping

  • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach.
  • Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions.
  • 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or equivalent role in a software-, data-, or technology-driven environment.
  • Experience working within healthcare technology, healthcare operations, payer/provider systems, pharmacy, claims, revenue cycle, eligibility, or related healthcare domains.
  • Ability to understand and reason about SQL, data structures, system logic, APIs, configuration, and technical workflows well enough to validate platform behavior and collaborate effectively with engineering teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to write clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development tickets that engineering teams can implement with minimal rework.
  • Strong analytical rigor with the ability to distinguish confirmed facts from assumptions, challenge unclear reasoning, and validate conclusions.
  • Experience facilitating requirements and solution-review sessions involving business, clinical, operational, and technical stakeholders.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt business and technical information for different audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with healthcare claims, eligibility, reimbursement, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, or healthcare financial processes.
  • Experience working with configurable or rules-driven healthcare platforms.
  • Experience supporting client, provider, health system, or partner implementations.
  • Understanding of data pipelines, ETL processes, APIs, healthcare integrations, and data exchange concepts.
  • Experience managing a shared product backlog across multiple customers, implementations, or business units.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data standards, regulatory requirements, or privacy considerations such as HIPAA.

Key Competencies

  • Requirements elicitation and translation
  • Healthcare workflow analysis
  • Technical and data analysis
  • System behavior reconciliation
  • Product and backlog management
  • Stakeholder facilitation and decision-driving
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Analytical rigor and structured problem-solving
  • Dependency and impact analysis
  • Documentation discipline and traceability

jobs.title: Head of Product  - Beamable
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States
URL: https://www.skillz.com

About Beamable 

Beamable is the backend and LiveOps infrastructure platform for game developers, the system that lets studios build, operate, and scale live games without constructing the underlying architecture themselves. Backend services, identity, analytics, meta-game systems, virtual economies, and AI-native tooling: all integrated into a single platform that eliminates the point-solution stitching that has defined game development for too long. Beamable also powers Wingman, an agentic LiveOps product that gives game teams a unified operating system to understand, optimize, and act on live game performance in real time. This is the future of how games are operated.

Beamable is part of FIRY, a founder-led global technology portfolio operating at the intersection of gaming, AI-powered performance marketing, and developer infrastructure. Acquired in January 2026, and together with Skillz, our competition platform, and RZR, our AI-driven ad network, Beamable sits at the foundation of a compounding ecosystem that no standalone competitor can replicate. If you want to build the infrastructure that games run on at a company with the vision and resources to back it — Beamable is the right place to do it.

About the Role 

Beamable is seeking a Head of Product to shape its platform vision and lead its next phase of growth in the game backend market. This is an opportunity to build the product function from the ground up, guide the platform from early access through public release, and advance AI integration to deliver meaningful value for game studios.

As the company’s senior product leader and sole product practitioner, you will own product strategy, roadmap, launch milestones, and success metrics, combining strategic direction with hands-on execution. You will work directly with studios and design partners, represent Beamable’s product vision at industry events, and translate customer insights into clear priorities. Success in this role means delivering a successful public launch, developing early-access studios into reference customers, and establishing a product foundation that drives adoption and sustained revenue growth.

Responsibilities 

  •  Product Strategy & Vision Ownership. Set the product vision for Beamable’s platform — spanning player engagement, developer tools, data enrichment, and player intelligence — and own the roadmap from early access through public release and beyond. Partner with the CRO on packaging, pricing, and tracking the studio funnel quantitatively.
  • Public Release & Launch Execution. Drive Beamable’s product through its launch milestones: early design partners, public release, and strategic partnerships. Define and own the go/no-go criteria for each milestone, ensuring the product ships when it’s ready to win.
  • Studio Partnership & Customer Discovery. Spend meaningful time every week with studios, design partners, and game developers — running discovery calls, demos, onboarding sessions, and roadmap reviews. Join sales calls and paid pilots with the CRO and turn each design partner into a reference case.
  • AI Integration & Product Intelligence. Define the guardrails, data policies, and feedback loops that make Beamable’s AI capabilities safe, effective, and trustworthy for game teams. Integrate with best-in-class tools studios already use and shape the intelligent systems that differentiate the platform.
  • Metrics Ownership & Product Function Build-Out. Define success metrics across the studio lifecycle — time to value, pilot conversion, retention, usage, and revenue per studio — and do your own analysis in SQL. Establish the product processes Beamable runs on: discovery, specs, prioritization, and launch reviews.
 
 

Key Competencies

  • Platform Product Strategy. Proven ability to set and execute product vision for a developer-facing platform, owning the strategy across multiple capability areas simultaneously — not just a feature set.
  • Customer-Facing Product Leadership. Equally credible with studio heads, producers, and engineers. Comfortable running a demo, leading a discovery call, supporting a sale, and representing the product at industry events including GDC and Gamescom.
  • Gaming Live-Ops Domain Expertise. Deep understanding of what a studio’s growth or live-ops team does day-to-day — events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, and player data — and what slows them down.
  • AI/ML Product Judgment. Experience shipping AI or ML-driven features to production. Knows where AI adds genuine value, where it needs guardrails, and how to define data policies that serve both studio needs and platform integrity.
  • Data Fluency & Metrics Ownership. Can build dashboards, write SQL, and live with retention, churn, and revenue metrics over time. Runs experiments before big bets rather than after.
  • 0-to-1 Startup Product Leadership. Comfortable being the only PM in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment. Has built product processes from scratch and can hold the strategy and the execution at the same time.
  • Technical Depth. Conversant in data warehouses, APIs, SDKs, and system design. Can earn the respect of engineers and studio technical leads without needing a dedicated translator.

Experience 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or a related field; equivalent experience considered.
  • 10+ years in product management, including experience as a product lead or head of product owning a product line’s strategy — not just a feature set.
  • Proven experience in gaming live-ops — either running live games or building tools for teams that do: events, offers, economies, segmentation, player support, or player data.
  • Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup as a solo or founding PM, with demonstrated comfort operating in ambiguity with shifting priorities.
  • At least one AI or ML-driven feature shipped to production and used by real customers.
  • Demonstrated data fluency: SQL, product analytics tools, and a track record of living with business metrics over time to drive decisions.
  • Experience with customer engagement platforms (Braze, CleverTap), game backends (PlayFab, Nakama, Unity Gaming Services), or data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery) preferred.
  • Experience taking a product from early access to public launch preferred. 

Total Starting Compensation including Base + Bonus + Equity: $212,625 + Bonus + Equity

Location: Remote - CA, NV, or NY

Travel Requirement: Less than 10%

jobs.title: Senior Backend Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: http://www.halcyon.ai

What we do:
Halcyon is the industry’s first dedicated, adaptive security platform that combines multiple proprietary advanced prevention engines along with AI models focused specifically on stopping ransomware.

Who we are:
Halcyon was formed in 2021 by a team of cyber industry veterans after battling the scourge of ransomware (and advanced threats) for years at some of the largest global security vendors. Comprised of leaders from Cylance (now Blackberry), Accuvant (now Optiv), Fireye and ISS X-Force (now IBM), Halcyon is focused on building products and solutions for mid-market and enterprise customers.

As a remote-native, completely distributed global team, we recognize great talent can exist anywhere. We invite you to apply to a job you’re interested in and we'll work a plan to meet your needs.

The Role  

  

At Halcyon, we’re building a world-class anti-ransomware platform grounded in innovation and resilience. As part of that vision, we’re looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our cloud team. You’ll lead the development and evolution of our data platform and API services, working within a modern tech stack that blends Scala and Rust.   

You’ll join a team focused on building scalable, maintainable backend systems that serve both internal and customer-facing functions. Your primary focus will be on Rust and Scala services, with opportunities to shape our transition to Rust where it makes sense. Python development experience is highly valued, particularly for supporting our security analysis platform which includes malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning workflows.  

Responsibilities  

  • Lead the design and delivery of features across our data platform and public API services, including ingestion, transformation, and enrichment of security data. 
  • Drive system design, architecture, and data flow decisions in partnership with product and platform engineering. 
  • Build, deploy, and own Scala-based backend services in production, keeping them reliable, secure, and performant. 
  • Help shape and execute our migration of selected APIs from Scala to Rust, ensuring consistency and continuity along the way. 
  • Set the bar for code quality, documentation, and operational excellence.  
  • Lead design reviews, code reviews and take part in on-call and incident response. 
  • Support and enhance our Python-based security analysis platform, including malware analysis engines, automated threat detection, and machine learning model workflows.  

Skills and Qualifications  

  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with recent experience in a JVM-based codebase.  
  • A track record of designing and owning distributed systems from start to finish. 
  • Experience with Rust, or a well-formed view of when it’s the right tool, and the ability to help guide a migration.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Greece
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/ssarktiaEdEzba97Jjs1YN/jobs-at-patchstack

Overview

Patchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code. That product is early. We have good signals from hosts and hackathons, but we haven't yet found who it serves best, what they value, or why they'll keep paying for it.

You'll be the product manager who finds that out. You'll talk to customers, use the product in real AI-assisted workflows, test ideas quickly with our designer and engineers, and build the measurement that tells us what's working. You'll work alongside two small engineering squads, a senior product designer, QA and infrastructure. You own which customer problems we invest in and how we learn from the results.

About you

You're happiest early, before the answers exist. You'd rather run a small test this week than wait for perfect data. You're comfortable in a terminal and have built things with AI-assisted tools, so you can use our product the way our customers do. You form your own view on technical claims rather than taking "it's not feasible" or "the metric improved" at face value. You say what you think, including when it's awkward, and you change your mind when the evidence says so. You work well in a flat team with little process, and you help people around you get better rather than taking work off them.

This is a fully remote job, based anywhere in Europe.

Responsibilities

  • Run customer discovery for the JavaScript product: interviews, observed usage, support and event feedback, and your own hands-on use.
  • With Growth and Product Marketing, recommend which customers and problems to focus on, backed by evidence of who uses, who pays and why.
  • Shape what we build with the Senior Product Designer from early discovery through testing. You own the problem and intended outcome; they own the design response.
  • Agree outcomes and priorities with the engineering squads and help them turn validated problems into work. Squads own delivery.
  • Build and ship small prototypes, experiments and product changes yourself where that's the fastest way to learn, within our review and QA process.
  • Own product measurement in PostHog: define the actions that matter, get tracking in place, and combine the numbers with customer evidence to explain what's working.
  • Keep what we've learned, decided and assumed visible in Notion so the team can make good investment calls.
  • Raise risks, gaps and decisions early, and escalate anything beyond your remit.
  • Experience as a product manager on a technical or developer-facing product, ideally pre or early product-market fit.
  • Examples of changing or stopping a product direction based on customer and technical evidence you gathered yourself.
  • Hands-on with AI-assisted development, the command line, packages and dependencies. You don't need to be a production engineer, but you need to be at home in that environment.
  • Strong customer research and data analysis skills, including building useful measurement from little reliable data.
  • Clear, direct communication with designers, engineers and leadership in a remote, low-process team.
  • €75–100k salary, depending on location and experience, plus company stock options
  • 4.5-day working week (half-day Fridays)
  • Remote-first, with reasonable overlap with EU timezones
  • 38 days' paid time off a year (including public holidays) plus 3 health days
  • Company laptop, and co-working membership or home-office equipment

About Us

We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health.

Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth.

We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.

Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.

We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where".

Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare.

Role overview

Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

What Youâll Do

Preferred Qualifications
